summary:
A grim world will be generated...

Explore everything from bare deserts...

... to snow covered mountains.

Recruit blacksmiths, brutal pirates, noble intellectuals and everything inbetween. 

They will all struggle to survive in a world overrun by the undead...

... and you will be their guide!

A game inspired by Rimworld, Dwarf Fortress and Terraria:

 All humans have unique portraits, different backgrounds and come from distinct cultures. They will develop and age as the seasons change and the years pass.

 They all have different skills and abilities; some will become expert miners, great counsellors, and others master blacksmiths.

 Manage their needs, set their priorities and equip them for war or work. They will eat, sleep, socialize, create art, fight and abandon your faction if pushed too hard. They might return later, but as a friendly visitor or leading an attack? 

 Defend your settlement from hordes of undead, bandits, large raiding parties and necromancers.

 Mine for riches deep below the surface, discover ancient shrines and powerful magic.

 Start practicing necromancy, raise the dead and have them work for you - see if you can defend your faction from paladins instead! Or maybe harness the powers of light and try to banish the undead for good!

 Craft a huge variety of weapons, armor and clothes from all kinds of materials.

 Plant crops and later harvest to create food and medicine.

 Hunt animals, or tame them to produce milk and fur.

 Grow your knowledge by plenty of research options. All the way from longbows to muskets and grenades.

 Trade with visiting merchants, convince them to join your settlement or plunder them if you wish!

 Create caravans, travel the world by land or sea; discover new locations and establish new settlements.

PS: This game is in the same franchise as Grim Nights. However, this game will focus less on tower defense and much more on your villagers and the management of your growing settlement.

危险在每个转弯处等待着你。快速思考，不要犹豫，因为每一秒的损失都可能使你从猎人变成猎物...
恐龙重生》是一款具有科幻气氛的开放世界游戏。尝试在这个被恐龙占领的危险星球上生存。
武器定制

修改你的武器库。从消音器、握把、瞄准镜和其他配件中选择。创建完美的武器，然后去打猎。
多样化的世界
探索一个充满危险和不朽景观的世界。不要被你周围环境的美丽所迷惑。每一个转折点都有死亡在等着你。
高级恐龙行为
十几种恐龙，在天空和地面上都有。每一种都有其独特的生存本能。分析它们的踪迹，观察它们的习性，寻找弱点，找到最佳的攻击时机。
随机掉落
留意随机空投的物资。这些神秘包裹的内容将帮助你在这个危险的星球上为生存而战。
危险的环境
在这个世界上，植物群和动物群都对人类构成致命的威胁。在这里，你必须仔细考虑你的每一个动作。规则很简单--杀人或被杀。

Immerse yourself in the world of Dinos Reborn and feel like a dinosaur hunter! 
Danger awaits you at every turn. Think fast and don't hesitate, because every second lost can turn you from hunter to prey...
Dinos Reborn is an open world game with a sci-fi atmosphere. Try to survive on this dangerous planet overrun by dinosaurs.
Weapon Customization

Modify your arsenal. Choose from silencers, grips, scopes and other accessories. Create the perfect weapon and go on the hunt.
Diverse World
Explore a world of danger and monumental sights. Don't be fooled by the beauty of your surroundings. Death awaits you at every turn.
Advanced Dinosaur Behaviour
A dozen species of dinosaurs, in the sky and on the ground. Each with its own unique survival instincts. Analyse their tracks, observe their habits, look for weaknesses and find the best moment to attack.
Random Drops
Keep an eye out for random airdrops of supplies. The contents of these mysterious packages will help you in your fight for survival on this dangerous planet.
Dangerous Environment
In this world, both flora and fauna pose a deadly threat to humans. Here you must think through every move you make. The rules are simple - kill or be killed.

summary:
Play this strange little idea that combines turn-based planning with old-school 2D side-scrolling. I would call this game an experimental strategy game. Build a deck and get a hand of cards. Arrange those cards in the order that you want your little robot to follow. Press play and watch your little obedient robot advance through the stage.

You take control of a little obedient robot that you kind of program with cards you find.

Learn your robot's movement cards by practicing with them. Give them a try and see what each card does. Once you know how to use them you can plan and try to dodge enemies as you make your way to the exit.

You click and drag cards into whatever order you want. 

Then when you're ready, hit the play button and watch your robot follow the commands on the cards.

You can add cards to modify your robot's moves.

You have to travel through many different terrains, such as the jungle, the arctic, the desert, the fire land and much more. Along your journey, Mauri will pickup new weapons, like the cutter, which he can use to smite down the enemies that lurk around the Islands. Only after completing his journey and finding all the hidden bottles, can Mauri cure his hangover and sleep well!

Mauri Mursu's Hangover is a new, 8-bit topdown adventure RPG in 2022! The game gets its inspiration from adventure game classics from the 80s and 90s and mixes in a lot of quirky off-beat humor, exploration and quests. If you are a fan of those games, you will love this one!

summary:

Thumb Fighter is a wacky and fast paced minimalist one-button fighting game.
Does it sound too simple? Maybe. It is too simple? Maybe? Is it fun? Absolutely!

After many years of huge success on other platforms it will hit the Steam Store as a premium fully featured game :)
By being this simple Thumb Fighter offers one of the most inclusive fighting experiences you can find.
Fun assured to children, families, couples, friends, you name it!
Literally everyone who played thumb fighter (Believe us, millions of people played already :) ) will tell you.
Thumb Fighter it's a great ice breaker, with its one-button mechanic anyone can play and the battles still awake desperation, laughters and goose bumps.

Thumb Fighter's thumbs have one and only one movement, a head hit. 
Try to grab your opponent when it's (guard?) is down until you achieve the victory.

FEATURES

Single Player Mode (can you defeat all thumbs and become Thumb... master...champion lord... of all thumbs? 

 Quick PvP, PvAi, Ai vs Ai (why not?) battles.

 Tournament Mode ( Create up to 8 players tournament to define who whashes the dishes)

 Minigames nobody asked for (but great time killers while you drool like a zombie over your lap)

 Campaign Mode

 More than 100+ characters

DISCARDED FEATURES
- Procedurally generated levels (we already did that in Hidden Lands)
- Minimalist racing mechanic (we already did that in Turn Right)
- Online Matches (For now.... we'll see in the future ¯_(ツ)_/¯ )

name: Dark Treasury
Short Fuse
summary:
Good news! You bounced off the police station at just the right angle, collided as planned with the giant, green bowling ball, and crashed into the blue truck. The driver never saw it coming and you definitely broke your old high score. Now do it again!

What would you do if you didn't have to worry about getting a headache from running into a wall? If you could launch yourself out of a giant cannon? If your world had roof tops filled with beach balls? Well, if you ever asked yourself those questions, do we have the game for you!
Game Play
Short fuse is a 3D physics game where you become the ammo! Aim, launch yourself, navigate in the air, then crash into whatever seems the most fun. Watch your score grow, discover pickups, and explore the various levels, each with a different layout, theme, and difficulty!
The Levels
Expertly crafted by a veteran team of Peruvian kamikaze pilots and two and a half summer interns, the broad selection of levels offers varying game play and challenge.
The Players
Why only fire one nitwit out of a cannon if you can select from 30? Exactly! That's what we thought too, so we implemented 15! We're half way there!
The High Scores
Oh right. We have scores, too. Big ones even - at least if you do your job right.

name: In My Defense
summary:
This is a challenging, old-school, retro, side-scrolling shooter. You must defend your base, against the onslaught of alien attackers. 

Features:

Radar of entire playfield, shows where threats exist

Picture in picture view of the base, so you can keep an eye on it

28 waves

16 power-ups. Power-ups can be combined

 10 bonus twin-stick shooter levels, starring Hitch, the security robot, take place under the base. Many enemies on these levels are spawned by generators, that must be destroyed. Ensects attack power generators, damaging the base. There are gas outlets that cause large explosions, if shot.

 Multiple weapons, including: Lasers, Bombs, and the dreaded Sonic Bomb, which can mass-kill enemies

Many enemy types, each with unique abilities, including one whose weapon can be stolen

Boss battles

Snow, thunderstorm, and darkness environments. Dark environments must be lit with flares

AI-powered wingmen can be summoned to assist. Careful, they can be turned against you

Rock launchers help you defend the base. You can pick them up and re-position them with your ship

You can escort evacuation ships to the opposite side of the playfield. If they escape, you are rewarded with resources. Supply landers can be brought to the base for more resources.

Defensa- your ship's computer voice. She informs you when you activate power ups, warns of threats, and makes comments about the unfolding events

Original Soundtrack- original soundtrack written specifically for the game by six different composers

Optional arcade style controls, where the joystick on the gamepad only moves your ship vertically. Horizontal movement is done via thrust and reverse buttons

Randomized waves - no two waves are the same, for improved re-playability

New Endless wave mode- One increasing endless wave with all regular enemies. How long can you last?

New upgrade store - collect metal from destroyed enemy ships to purchase upgrades and supplies for your ship.

A gamepad is recommended.

name: Imercyve: Living with Intellectual Disability
summary:
Warning: This experience features flashing images and is not suitable for photosensitive viewers.

It's mid-morning, and the sun peaks through blinds into an open-plan kitchen and lounge. A darkened television reflects the rest of the room—a familiar place, a little unkempt and filled with everyday objects. What would it be like if this recognisable place suddenly became the backdrop for some very unfamiliar challenges?

Developed in partnership with support services not-for-profit Mercy Connect, this experience explores the efficacy of an immersive approach to strengthening communication and understanding between advocates and people with a disability by simulating a variety of effects that may be familiar to those with diverse and high care needs.

You'll learn through first-hand experience how many of the interactions generally taken for granted may look or feel different other people. Most importantly, you will recognise these difficulties and how disability support organisations play an important role in helping people to overcome their challenges.

By purchasing this experience, you are supporting our continued efforts to develop software that explores essential physical and mental health subject matter.

文明和生物一样，有生存和扩张的本能。

桀斯种族为了逃避恒星巨大化带来的灭绝事件，建设了方舟——奥德赛号。

因未知原因，奥德赛号与迪肯母星发生了正面冲击，巨大的烟尘掩盖了天空，山川河流都今非昔比。

桀斯内部因宗教与信仰的冲突而分裂，多方混战导致大地布满了战火迪肯种族蓄势待发，准备重新夺回家园。

name: Demon Skin
summary:
《成魔》（Demon Skin）一款暴力、血腥的砍杀游戏，故事发生在残酷的黑暗魔幻世界，融合了独特的战斗机制、角色扮演元素、格斗元素乃至平台游戏的部分机制。游戏的战斗系统十分灵活，玩家可将各种姿态与不同类别的兵器结合，充分增强战斗的效果，创造属于自己的战术策略。

黑暗已经渗入宇宙偏远的角落，危及世界的安危，只有强大的游荡圣团能够抵御这一威胁，因为圣团的成员拥有异于常人的神圣力量。群魔举行邪恶仪式，企图恢复某一强力神器的法力，不料被一个游荡之人撞见。此人出手，意欲终止邪恶仪式，却被神器释放的能量刺穿，当场变成了魔怪！

游荡之人急于恢复原形，可是他要找回神器，才能恢复原形。主角踏上了冒险之路，一边击杀汹涌而来的魔怪，一边寻找神器。

掌握各种姿态，提升你的技能，以迅雷不及掩耳之势格挡，以壮观的终结招式造成最大的伤害！时刻注意体力水平和角色其他的身体状态，这些因素都会直接影响战斗的结果。

获得晶石碎片，变得愈发强大，强化自己的骨甲，成为令敌丧胆的凶魔。

海量兵器供你挑选，30余种锐利兵器与钝兵器随你使用，每一种都只适合对付某一类敌人。就算赤手空拳，都能击杀敌人，只是效率会比较低下，但也会很有意思！

技能树庞大。积累经验，学习新的连招，提升自身的生命、体力和攻击能力！

敌人种类多达数十种，有骷髅、僵尸、蜘蛛，也有狼人、蜥蜴、魔像，每一种敌人都需要不同的策略应对！

秘密与神器。某些稀罕的古代神兵藏在游戏世界的神秘地点。升到一定等级之后，找到这种兵器就能解锁令人叹为观止的超级技能！

黑暗的魔幻世界，山河原野阴郁黯淡，既有万里冰封的荒原、深居地下的牢城，也有暮光之下的森林和不死生灵的窝巢。残酷的世界仿佛拥有生命一般，不过这里的骇人生灵并非个个都是心怀恶意。你在冒险的路上会遇到敌人，也会遇到强大的战友！

name: Dungeons & Dummies
summary:
Descend alone or drag up to 7 friends with you into a deep, ever-changing dungeon that absolutely does not care about your feelings.

Every run is a calculated risk. By “calculated,” we mean you’ll say “one more floor” at least three times before something terrible happens. Head downward for shiny loot, questionable quests, and the promise of becoming stronger… assuming the dungeon doesn’t humble you first. The deeper you go, the harder enemies hit, the rarer supplies become, the more frequent traps become, and the exit starts feeling like a myth.

Greed is encouraged. Survival is optional.

Back in town, recover your dignity. Sell your spoils, buy better gear, reorganize your inventory for the fifth time, and confidently announce your new “build strategy” before immediately abandoning it next run. Customize your character, specialize your role, and debate whether this is finally the run where you play it safe.

It won’t be.

Whether you’re cautiously poking around early floors or desperately sprinting from something you absolutely should not have aggro’d, every decision matters. And sometimes the bravest move… is pretending you meant to extract early.

name: The Trolley Problem Game
summary:
The Trolley Problem Game turns the classic Trolley Problem into a diverse set of problems that fall into many different categories—some are moral dilemmas, some are educational, and some are just for fun!

Would you kill one person to save five? Is it ethical to kill baby Hitler? Would you spare the burning of the Library of Alexandria but destroy everything written on Wikipedia?

The game includes two modes—Free Play and Utilitarian Mode. In Free Play mode, you can make choices as you see fit, and in Utilitarian Mode, you are encouraged to make decisions that are considered the most ethical according to the Utilitarian characters in the game, where you can accumulate points and a streak for agreeing with them.

The game has more than 300 ethical decisions, each taking around 45 seconds, which means the game currently has about 4 hours of gameplay (or even more if you like to read!).

The game will include links to different pages where you can argue with other players about what the correct ethical decision is. The game also records and shows the way other players have chosen to answer the questions.

If the game gets popular enough we will add the ability to create your own problem and share it with the world!

name: Yummy
summary:
《Yummy》是一款多人联机斗智斗勇的可爱游戏，在游戏的“饥饿办公室”地图里，20个饥肠辘辘的玩家将在线打造一场大型吃播秀。当游戏开始时，你不仅要尽可能地吃东西，也要随时提防被“东西”吃掉，在这个“什么都能吃、吃什么变什么”的设定中，你很难辨认出什么是真正的物品什么是你的竞争玩家。为了不成为一个饿死鬼，请带上你的朋友一起杀出重围吧！

【初始形象的选择】
在《Yummy》定制的“饥饿办公室”里，你的初始形象将随机变成办公室的任意物品，文件夹、办公桌、墙上的便利贴、墙角的一盆花，甚至可能成为卫生间的马桶（哈哈哈哈哈哈）......

【我不是人的苦恼】
在这个疯狂的饥饿环境中，为了夺得最后的生存，你将与办公室中隐藏的其他19位玩家争夺有限的“食物”，在这个什么都能吃、吃什么变什么的设定中，你将会遇见各种各样的有趣情况：想吃掉墙上的壁画可你却是最低位的垃圾桶，想变身为桌上的小多肉可你却不小心吞掉了旁边脏兮兮的烟灰缸；想偷袭正在藏匿的其他玩家却被黄雀在后的高玩玩家一口吞下......
【小短腿的走跑跳】
为了能吃到更多的东西，所有被玩家“附身”的物品都会幻化出一双可爱的小短腿。当你随机变成一个小键盘的时候，你可以悄悄地走到电脑旁边后一口吃掉它；当你处于被动挨打的情况，你就可以用你的小短腿跑起来了，在《Yummy》中跑步一方面可以减缓饥饿值上升，另一方面你可以迅速逃离其他玩家的攻击范围；面对较高的物品时，你可以用你的小短腿跳上高台一点一点靠近目标，或者，直接跳起来一口吃掉它！
【吃不饱的饿死鬼】
在游戏进行一会儿后，你可能会发现你的饥饿值并不会因为你的不停进食而降低，最好的情况是你吃得足够多饥饿值便会上升得足够慢，玩到这里你就会发现《Yummy》的“阴险”之处了，原来办公室的所有玩家只不过是一群永远不可能吃饱的饿死鬼，除非你赢得最后的胜利（耶）！！！

summary:
You are an orb battling disorder and restoring peace to the alt-realm.

Die Rangliste is a leaderboard-run twin-stick shooter inspired by games like Geometry Wars and Downwell. The game features a unique time-stop and teleport mechanic that allows the player to stop time and choose an area to teleport to before resuming time. If you teleport while time is stopped, you will not see where you teleported until time resumes. You may teleport with a visual indication when time exists.

Compete for leaderboard supremacy on 

five never-ending levels
separated into two sets of leaderboards: time-stop mode and no-time-stop mode. 

 In the second mode, you are not allowed to stop time and must rely solely on quick maneuvering.

Careful randomization gives meaningful encounters that are never the same twice. 

Level difficulty increases linearly in a way unique to each of the five levels. 

The game is meant to be challenging early to avoid painful defeats and is moderately difficult after just a minute in.

46 track sound-track with tracks and sound-effects unique to each level. 

The game was balanced around the use of a 

 dual-stick controller

 A controller is the recommended way to play. All xbox-like and playstation controllers should work by default. Other, nonstandard controllers can be set up in the options menu. Keyboard and mouse play is also fully supported.

And at Alpha Centauri's Science Institute, Nae and Dio are dispatched to information that an unknown Cube caused a disaster.
Whether you can't beat the Cube is up to you.

Characters
Each character has a clear personality. Dio is good at using weapons, but Nae can't use them! 
Using strategies that bring out the character's personality, you can lead the battle efficiently.

Turn-based Strategy Roguelike
Tetra Cube is a single-play turn-based strategy game. Player must explore maps and grow characters to combat enemy threats so that Nae and Dio can successfully defeat the Cube. Since it has the characteristics of roguelike, the structure of the map, the placement of enemies, and acquisition of items are random, so it requires accurate judgment according to the situation.
Survivors
There are survivors left in the lab who survived the attack, and players need their help to achieve their goals.
Help the survivors defeat the enemy!
Hacking
Nae can hack enemies and turn them into allies. The game of the game varies greatly depending on how you use hacking.

The Ultimate Dodgems - Bumper Car Simulator with Online Multiplayer Support! 

This brilliant attraction is fun for all ages. Dodgems or Bumper Cars will always be remembered as one of the longest running and most successful attractions in the amusement industry. No other ride can compete with Dodgems when it comes to family fun and entertainment. 

Bumper-to-bumper traffic never been this fun – or bumpy!

Grab all your friends and family for fantastic fun on our classic Dodgems simulator game. Step into the dodgem arena, take control of your own bumper car, and race around as you try to avoid the chaos! summary:
ADD TO WISHLISIT

Build and Discover: America（建立和发现美国） 基于美国历史的创建模拟器。
在征服者抵达新大陆的那一刻，你就将亲身参与其中。

未知世界广阔且变化莫测。
狂野的西部，未知的环境和无数的可能。

你能收集全50颗星吗？

游戏给出了历史性的挑战，鼓励玩家们做出决策，体验实时管理，并在了解公民需求的基础上发展政治技巧。
发展贸易，开展现代化，安排运输，征服新世界，并直面意外和威胁。狂野西部，国际贸易，新香料和美食，文化冲突和待发现的世界在等着你的到来。

Katsu is the owner of the best restaurant in town. But the Tengogo mafia is determined to bring his business down by putting a curse on all the food, transforming the dishes into terrible demons. Only our heroes, with their new powers, can stop them.

《你的朋友Wiggles》

它是夜晚缠绕你的噩梦，是自童年起啃噬你的悔恨，也是伴随你成长、难以摆脱的被遗弃恐惧。

寻找出口

你在一片森林中醒来，不知身处何地。
手中只有一个熟悉的小装置——你该如何逃脱？

一次短暂而紧张的体验，环境充满深意。

一个噩梦般的故事，需要你在游戏中逐步发现。

The summer air is often filled with romance in the city of love. When one of the major universities announces a language and culture course for the entirety of the summer, many wealthy students from abroad jump on the chance to go abroad. What about you? You're just there to clean their rooms... but why are they so interested in you?

 A brand-new, 30k word long Otome Visual Novel

 Choose between 3 different romantic interests, or pursue your happiness on your own

 4 different endings

 Original Soundtrack of 10 tracks!

 2560x1440 HD graphic with more than 200 images

MEET THE CAST!
Elizabeth Faucade
Elizabeth is the Main Character of the story. She Is a student in Paris.
The only way for her to work there is to be able to support herself without the help of her parents. This means that she has to work a lot during the summer – and study and work during the year as well. During the year she stays with a wealthy family and watches their kids for her rent and food money, but it's barely enough. Even though she is struggling, she is thrilled to be in the city of love. During the summer she is working long hours as a cleaner / 'maid' and this time she is working in the dormitories where all the wealthy kids are.
Doesn't like the job she has for most of the year but doesn't mind cleaning, however she wouldn't be able to support herself if she had to work full time just to pay rent and study, etc.

Express your individuality by customizing your character with unique items earned through gameplay, which are added to your Steam Inventory. Show off your unique character design while navigating through challenges, whether competing solo or sharing the chaos with others in multiplayer matches!

Box Run - a thrilling battle to be the last one standing as players push each other off disappearing boxes on a crumbling map.

Don't Fall From The Platform (DFFTP) - a high-stakes survival challenge where quick jumps and sharp reflexes help players outlast others on platforms that vanish every few seconds.

Bomb Tag - a nerve-wracking chase where players must pass a ticking bomb to others before time runs out, dodging disaster to be the last one standing.

King Of The Point - a chaotic free-for-all where players earn points by holding their ground on a designated spot while battling to push others off, with the highest scorer claiming victory

Speedrun - a race against time through a challenging parkour course, where speed and agility determine who claims the fastest finish.

Maze Escape - a race through a procedurally generated labyrinth where players navigate twists, turns, and dead ends to be the first to reach the exit. 

More modes to come in later stages of the game

name: Particles in Space
summary:
Len Lye在78岁逝世前几个月完成了他最后一部伟大的电影。这部影片回归了其早期作品《自由基》（Free Radicals）中的黑白技法。Len Lye创造了他所谓的具有“嘶嘶感”（zizz）的“充满活力的小图像”或“锯齿形线条”。这些成簇的微小刮痕赋予了影片独特的质感——画面看起来虽然粗糙，但实际上却极其精妙。

片名《太空粒子》（Particles in Space）指的是宇航员在太空中偶尔会看到的那种能量闪光。影片的原声配乐融合了巴哈马的“跳跃舞鼓”（Jumping Dance Drums）、尼日利亚约鲁巴人的鼓乐，以及Len Lye自己的金属动态雕塑所发出的声音。此外，片头字幕展示了Len Lye在胶片上刮刻字母和单词的精湛技艺，这种创作手法后来也被斯坦·布拉哈格（Stan Brakhage）等其他电影制作人所效仿。

name: Jin Conception
summary:
故事始于3名角色进入Final Layer，其中2人一去不返，消失得无影无踪；剩余一人成功归来，却称对事实经过毫无印象。8名可玩角色的命运就此交织……
孰敌孰友？
孰真孰假？
你相信谁？

游戏主要特色：
• 半回合制游戏。兼具策略性及平衡性。
• 战斗与行动场地相同，战斗开始时无需切屏。
• 内含状态系统。例如：玩家处于定身状态时无法逃跑。
• 双重/三重Jin技能。小队内角色可以进行连携攻击，造成更大伤害。
• 施放战术陷阱。战斗中可以设置陷阱，例如：延迟攻击。
• 开放式结局。
• 敌人的身份立场及阵营人数可能改变。

《Jin Conception》是单机游戏，玩家需要辨明敌友，看破真身。

Jin Conception Music:

Nine playable characters stories intertwine when three characters enter Final Layer and two vanish without a trace. One returns from Final Layer but claims to not remember what happened. Who do you trust? Who is telling the truth and who is lying? Who is friend and who is foe? 

Key Features:

 Strategic turn based combat involving balance.

Battles happen on the same field as movement, no switching screens when combat starts.

Affliction and buff system, for example, players cannot run away if they have stuck affliction.

Double and triple Jin techs allow party members to combine attacks with each other to form stronger attacks.

Traps can be set in combat for strategic purposes such as delaying an attack for later.

There is more than one ending.

The foe or foes can change.

Every step of the way has at least one clue to guide the player.

Hint system to guide players to the next destination.

One can ignore hints and clues to explore.

A reward is provided at the end for correctly deducing the friend(s) and foe(s).

Your time is respected, save the game anywhere and anytime when not in battle or a cutscene.

 The entire game can be beaten without grinding.

 There is romance.

 The story is not told in sequential order and is a puzzle.

 There is RNG in some boss battles in order to surprise the player on repeated playthroughs.

 There is more gameplay then story.

 After a single playthrough is completed, the game is designed to be speed rushed but it is not required to speed rush it.

 There is additional content in Continue Game+.

Jin Conception has monsters that can one shot, difficult bosses and no hand holding.

The White TetraForce has the power of light. The Black TetraForce has the power of darkness. The Blue TetraForce has the power of bravery and courage. The Red TetraForce has the power of strength. When the pieces of the TetraForce are combined, a power so great could potentially destroy the entire planet or make the world a better place depending on the intentions of the one who holds that power.

Immerse yourself in a massive world that is cluttered with enemies, surprises, and more importantly, memories!

The world will soon be taken over by a dark mage named Rokar. He is on the same mission as Jack; to find all of the artifacts. Rokar tried to recruit Jack to help him in his endeavor to find the artifacts and use the combined pieces of the TetraForce to change the world. However, Jack and Rokar have different visions on how the world should be like.

Will Jack and his friends find the artifacts before Rokar and his army? Will Rokar and his army find the artifacts before Jack and his friends? Is Rokar REALLY the evilness that Jack and his friends need to worry about?

Experience the Depths of the Islands on Kylamar. From the city to the forest to the desert to the tundra, Jack and his friends will discover treasures, friendships, enemies, and surprises.

Each Playable Character Can Learn Several Moves to Attack their Enemies. From physical attacks to magical attacks, there are several attacks that can be learned to enhance the fighting and gain the upper hand in a fight. name: Goat over it
summary:
一个基于物理的游戏，您只需要两个键即可控制山羊的平衡，从而到达山顶。
一键负责前爪，
第二个是后腿的钥匙。
跳跃的高度还取决于按压的持续时间。
这样您就可以使跳跃更加准确。
精美的图形将帮助您更加感受到游戏的乐趣

乍一看，这比看起来容易，但是如果您仍然设法在检查点模式下完成游戏，这有助于了解游戏的机制，那么将为您打开无检查点的模式。在其中一个错误中，您又重新开始。

如果您是复杂游戏的狂热者，并且通过了Bennett Foddy的Getting Over It，那么此游戏适合您。

A physics-based game in which you only need two keys to control the balance of a mountain goat to get to the top of the mountain.
One key is responsible for the front paw,
and the second for the key for the hind leg.
The height of the jump also depends on the duration of pressing.
That allows you to make jumps more accurate and careful.

 At first glance, this is easier than it seems, but if you still managed to complete the game in the checkpoint mode, which helps to understand the mechanics of the game, then the mode without checkpoints will open for you. In which one mistake and you start all over again. 

If you are a fan of complex games and have passed Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy, then this game is for you.

name: Zombie Neighborhood
summary:
The Zombie apocalypse has begun, and the world is plunged into chaos. Facing this scenario, you must help a small group of people very different from each other to live together and survive the maximum number of days possible (without killing one another!). 

In Zombie Neighborhood, you must survive as long as possible exploring the scenario resources, hiding from zombies (or confronting them), while you improve your safe house and hope that help arrives soon. 

THINK STRATEGICALLY

Every day the game presents some challenges that must be completed until the nightfall. You can use different kinds of characters, with different types of abilities to fulfill these goals and also to explore the surroundings looking for the best resources, weapons and bombs. 

The game movements are limited; each new day comes with a small number of moves to do while you explore. As the movements decrease, the day comes close to the end. Your decisions should be strategic to equalize accomplishing obligatory missions, exploring scenarios freely and resolving the characters’ most odd wishes. 

TAKING CARE OF CHARACTER’S EXOTIC WISHES

Each character from your group has a strong personality and unique abilities too. You must balance advantages and disadvantages from each to maintain a good mood in the house and also do a better exploration of the world around according to your needs. 

As the world is chaotic, people are also “crazier” than usual, so your characters will start to have strange and exotic cravings as time goes by. It is fundamental to solve these wishes so they don’t go really mad and run away from the house nor freak out close to a zombie. No one wants a group member running naked around the streets and attracting more zombies to the front door!

name: Confusing game
summary:
Do you want to test your reaction time, quick thinking, and ingenuity? Then this is the logic game for you. 

You find yourself in a game world where the characters are ladybirds that are on different flowers. The goal of the game is to make the characters appear on the same flower.

To do this, you need to run the characters of the game in a certain order (clicking on them game mouse). If you run them at the wrong speed, or in the wrong order, then you lose.

There are hints, but they need to be found.

At first glance, the game seems easy, but it is only at first glance. 

The game has three difficulty levels "easy", "normal", "hard". " Each has thirty tasks. If you lose in two difficulty levels "normal", "hard", then you will be surprised, be careful!

If you think that the game is easy, go immediately to a more difficult level and challenge yourself.

summary:

A completely open research tree lets you decide what you want as long as you have the resources(No need to research somthing rubbish to get to somthing good).

Your tanks are only the sum of their parts. 

No power?(you cant move)

No ammo?(you cant shoot)

No Scanner?(no locking onto targets for you)

No Correction thrusters?(you cant flip over or drive up walls.... yup) 

Enimies will call for help when needed and will actively group up and search for the player if they knew you were there. 

Irritate them too much and you may find an area near impossible to survive in.

With 92 component slots inside the tanks body, 22 armour and 9 weapon slots you will kit you tank for each mission, researching new components and getting upgrades to old ones as you go.

Picking the correct components will be important alowing you to be equipped for the right situation and to not waste valuable resources

summary:
ARE YOU READY TO SAVE THE WORLD FROM AN ALIEN INVASION?
An intergalactic fleet reigned by a dark entity invades Earth and you must fight for your life.

Be ready, because this is a 3D first-person virtual reality shooter, and the foes will be coming from everywhere, out of nowhere, even behind you so… watch your back!

Wake up the hero inside you while discovering who The Last from Mars is.

GET READY TO MEET YOUR NEW ENEMIES
Ancient civilizations are scattered throughout the galaxy. They have the most unusual and functional lifeforms.

Some are huge and have brutal strength, others are tiny and crawl for resources. There are those who are swift and threatening, chances are you’ll hear them before you see them.

Although many of us suspect alien life exists, the ones who say it out loud are thought as crazy, conspirators, or paranoid. Someone, in a far corner of the universe, was aware of their existence and manipulated them to do its bidding.

This sovereign of shadows curbed them using orbs as a decoy in the form of an offering, making them his subjects. These orbs are attached to their bodies and force them to do their will.

Now, these alien puppets have assembled into their own intergalactic order to carry out their sinister plans

GET ORBS AND SAVE THE WORLD!
The player begins the game with a simple laser gun, the ability to teleport, and slow-time.

Aliens enter from outside the playable map, and as the rounds progress, difficulty increases.

As players fight the aliens, they receive orbs. These orbs are used to upgrade weapons and hire perks.

Other perks, called drops, have a chance to only be dropped after an alien is killed.

ARE YOU PREPARED ENOUGH?

Strategy is key in order to survive.
You must think about every move you make, sharpen your reflexes, and be prepared.

Weapon upgrades

Augmented experience

summary:
Farmer Wars

Waterfowl hunting (also known as wildfowling) is the practice of hunting ducks, geese, or other waterfowl for food and sport.
Ok, that's enough snooty refinement. Now it's just you, your guns, your confident canine companion, and the great outdoors! In Duck Flighting (sic) you get to relive the iconic arcade experience of Duck Hunt in a brand new package.

But wait!
There's more.
– Many types of guns! Some, uh, better suited for hunting than others, but that just makes your feats all the more impressive, right? 
– Hunt ducks and geese.
– The birds become faster every round. 
– And don't forget your companion. We know – it's a German shepherd and they're not ideal for the job, but that's just the model we happened to have lying around.
– Where are your hunting grounds? Even we're not sure, and we honestly don't care either – they're lovely enough and the game is FUN.

So come on!
Give it a shot...

summary:
How often can you see the seaside, particularly when you do not live anywhere near it? Or snow falling over a mountainous area? The world has many beautiful places for you to see – and seven of them are brought to you in this Virtual Reality game.

Here, you can see the evening seaside in its full beauty, with the moon shining light upon you as if you were right under its gaze. You may come into contact with everything from your surroundings – from rocks to music playing instruments. Relax as you are listening to the sounds of the sea, just as if you were there.

If you want to move to a different environment, you have five others to choose from. After looking at the sea, you may even dive into it. You can look at the moon shining over the surface of the water, the fish banks swimming all around you – even see great sharks. But worry not! This game allows you to see all of nature’s beauties without putting you in any danger.

Other fascinating environments are also available to you. You may look at the Earth from different planets – witnessing a meteor fall with your own eyes. You may even take yourself to a mountainous area, where snow is falling as you are gazing at the lake. After that, you can simply go to a sandy beach and listen to the sounds of the waves crashing as you are surrounded by palm trees.

This Virtual Reality game allows you to interact with the environment and explore the world – seeing places that might seem too far away from you. You are your own hero in this world, no matter where you want it to take you. It’s a place where you can be yourself, relax, and simply unwind for as long as you wish.

name: [Neolithic]To the End
summary:
太长不看版介绍

恭喜，你发现了Steam上的这个隐藏游戏

这是一个从2004年至今依然由一个开发者单独在保持更新的古老的角色扮演游戏。

在FANDOM维基上有更详细的信息（当然，这个维基本身也在建设中）

一些不那么常见的游戏内容：

一个古老的的RPG游戏里一般能看到的所有东西，加上...

离奇魔幻的冒险故事。

完全的文字转语音支持。 (不想阅读角色扮演游戏里成吨的文字？没关系，在对话框出现的时候按下“S”键，你的系统会朗读给你听！)

自由的角色跨存档导入导出，可自定义整个队伍: 

第一人称的枪械战斗。

将敌人转化为宠物。

可以部署的陷阱和路障。以及有各种功能的可放置家具。

建立你自己的信仰，并加上各种奇怪的信条。 

你自己的可编辑口袋空间，带有地图编辑器。支持对所有地图在游戏过程中的编辑。还可以导入导出RMXP地图。

有各自不同游戏机制的各种魔法物品和异常实体。

从3D打印机里制造各类物品。

种植和收获食物....或者其它古怪的东西。

在任务板上无尽的过程生成任务。

一个强大的作弊控制台可以运行RUBY脚本语言。

各种小游戏！都是这个开放世界游戏的赠品。

常年高频更新。鬼知道你会发现这里还加入了什么奇怪的东西。

DRM-Free! 

高度可自定义的游戏体验。

风险: (我会很诚实地告诉你这些问题。)

1, 游戏使用一个古老的2004年的引擎开发。 （因为这是为了纪念那段回忆。）

2, 只有一个开发者。

3, 我的2D美术能力是悲剧。

因此，我提供了一个诚实的免费试用版本。该试用版本将会更新至游戏中某段剧情完结。

它将基本上实时反应当前的开发进度和游戏现状。

如果发现游戏超过14天出现未解释的更新停止现象，可以基本确定开发者已经死亡。

在该种情况下请勿购买游戏。

作为可能是世界上最后一个至今仍然在不断更新的RMXP游戏，我并没打算将其做成一个伟大的游戏。（甚至也没打算把它做成一个符合常理的游戏）

相对而言，这将会是一个独特而有趣的游戏，有一些现在人们再也无法见到的元素，让人们可以发出疯狂的笑声。

甚至是在一个黑暗的世界中，甚至是在这个世界和其所基于的开发引擎的寿命都将走向终点的时刻。这是一座对往昔的纪念碑。

这是一个时代终结的时刻，而这个游戏将随其直至终焉之时。

故事 

欢迎来到我们的秘密组织[数据删除]。我们是所有同行中最古老的一批。

很长时间以来，我们见证了他人的兴衰。

而现状却并不乐观，世界在2008年，2012年，2015年，2020年差点玩完了。

有人预计世界接下去还会在今年、明年、后年继续迎来末日.....（等等，这完全不符合逻辑。）

但是，随它去吧，就算这是真的，就算悲剧不可避免将会发生。我们依然还活着。

所以，诸君，请振作起来！

我们将继续前行。

只要我们依旧屹立，世界便不会倒下。

直至终点。

游戏特性:

不平衡也不公平

在人们称为“常态”美好的面纱下，潜藏着这样一个真相，那便是这个世界从不公平。

总有难以杀死的怪物，他们甚至一拥而上让我们无力招架。

就算并非面对超自然的威胁，一位功夫大师也可能在一颗普通子弹之下毙命。

生活便是如此不公。

然而，我们继续战斗，用手头的一切 

我们有枪和自己的魔法，甚至我们知道如何让超自然的生物听从我们的号令。

我们有各种工具和神奇物品，我们通晓从战斗到社交的种种技能。

如果一道锁无法被撬开，那么也许可以直接炸了它。

总会有解决方案的。

如果没有的话，愿那些飞舞的蝴蝶救赎我们的灵魂。

你，与众不同...

我们未能预期你的到来，你不在任何的名单上。我们对你所知甚少。

让我们看看你是谁，从这成吨的特性、技能、熟练度中发掘出你将成为怎么样的人。

也许在你的帮助下，我们还有希望。

带领我们……

闯荡在这片辽阔的世界

从古老的遗迹到现代的大都会。

从世界的东方到西方。

你忠实的同伴将会伴随你一同冒险。

你将遇到那些被我们保护着的生活于“常态”下的人们过着自己的生活。

你也将发掘出神秘的未解之谜，在于黑暗中潜伏的邪恶势力的战斗中将其一一破解。

一段隐秘的历史

Neolithic-To the End是一个具有超自然元素的现代开放世界角色扮演游戏。

这个游戏背后的故事：

自第一个Neolithic系列（或者被更多的人称为“石器时代单机版”）游戏首次于2004年发布于中国某个被遗忘的角落以来，首次出现在Steam上。

A STORY TO BE TOLD AND A WORLD TO BE DISCOVERED

After waking up not knowing what happened a lioness cub tries to find her owners with the tracks that they left behind not knowing that it will lead her to a journey that will challenge her and know what happened to her owners. Discover the land of Flihela that is filled with windy plains, crimson red forest and snowy ravines all through the eyes of a lioness cub, and a little girl who just lost her precious furry friend blaming herself for what happened. name: Gravel Gang
summary:
Gravel Gang is a simple but challenging real-time strategy/tactic casual game.

Make smart plans and show your strategic skills, fight and conquer the challenging maps to WIN!

You will be richly rewarded for victories, you can buy epic heroes and prove your skills with them.

Download it and experience for yourself!

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Online multiplayer is one of the most exciting features of Gravel Gang, allowing you to test your skills against other players from around the world. You can join matches with random opponents and battle it out on the same challenging maps featured in the single-player mode.

EVERY MAP IS A NEW CHALLENGE

Maps with 3 to 6 players and some with holes in the middle. Each opponent starts from a corner and tries to conquer the map. Last team standing is the winner, try to survive, invade areas, fight enemies in big gang-wars and show your strategic-thinking-skills.

NEW HEROES TO UNLOCK

Earn coins and unlock new heroes. From humans to witches and zombies, it's all there.

Each hero comes in 6 different colors and you can unlock them all at once!

PLAYABLE OFFLINE

3 different bot difficulty levels, with which there is a certain challenge for everyone, more difficult maps offer much more reward. Even without an Internet connection, fun is guaranteed, because the game is also playable offline.

FREE GAME

Play this game without spending money, we provide you with free updates and new content constantly. Earn a lot of coins from wins in different Maps, collect the rewards from achievements and buy great heroes with them.

ACHIEVEMENTS

With great rewards to claim, one can now start unlocking and collecting achievements. The rewards bring with them new goals to achieve, while having fun in the challenging maps.

If you prefer playing with friends, Gravel Gang also offers the option to create private lobbies. Invite your friends to join, and you can compete against each other in intense gang-wars, each trying to be the last team standing.

name: Horse Club Adventures
summary:
Horse Club Adventures carries you off to the wonderful world that revolves around the Lakeside Riding Stable. Together with Hannah, Sarah, Lisa, Sofia and their 
horses, you experience lots of thrilling adventures!

There is an amazing amount to discover in this open world game. The popular Horse Club game characters and the lovingly designed locations in Lakeside, such as the café, the caravan and the riding stable, are brought to life here. 

Horse Club Adventures is an excitement-packed action adventure with numerous missions, popular mini-games, intriguing secrets to be revealed and loads of unlockable objects, as well as collectibles and customisation options.

FEATURES

Lively, colourful and detailed world including many familiar and new characters along with the settings from the Horse Club world!

Over 40 different main missions with a gripping story revolving around Lakeside! 

30 optional sidequests, including a thrilling tale about the mysterious Edith Jacobs that involves her, too!

Numerous optional mini-games, such as horse grooming and cleaning hooves! 

All sorts of unlockable new outfits and embellishments for the game character. For example, new hairstyles, breeches, blouses, boots, riding helmets in the widest variety of colours.

Numerous unlockable embellishments for your own horse, such as tail types, manes, saddles, blankets and colours for a maximum degree of customising.

Fabulous collectibles, such as stickers and photos that are unlocked one after the other.

90 racecourses with three degrees of difficulty are distributed across the world and invite to galloping to achieve the fastest lap time. 

Marvellous soundtrack with numerous electrifying pieces of music.

name: Nevermore: The Chamber Door
summary:
In the poem The Raven by Edgar Allan Poe, the narrator is faced with a creature that enters his room and remains on the bust of Athena, goddess of wisdom, thus placing himself above reason and logic. The crow speaks only one word, "Nevermore", which the narrator interprets in different ways to answer his own questions.

In THE CHAMBER DOOR something similar happens, but before Athena a door opens, a portal to another world of creatures and demons of nightmares. While the dark-feathered raven contrasts with the marble of Athena, of light and darkness, life and death, our hero is taken by something above reason, making him enter that door with the certainty of the unknown.

THE CHAMBER DOOR is a game of introduction to the NEVERMORE universe. You will be introduced to fluid combat mechanics and endless possibilities. Aggressiveness and agility is the basis of combat, you will be rewarded in a combos ranking system where your variety of blows is your greatest weapon, but beware, NEVERMORE contains dangerous creatures and any mistake can be your last.

As you progress through the game, you'll craft exclusive mirror cards to build your character according to your combat style. Each card can bring new abilities, new mechanics or even improve your stats.

When passing through the CHAMBER DOOR you will face hordes of varied enemies in an arena system, at the end of each level you find a passage to proceed to the next one. As you defeat these hordes, you will eventually come across more powerful entities and stronger bosses.

If you fail and get defeated, you will return to the first level, however, in a roguelike system, you keep the souls you captured in your last adventure to evolve your charms through the statue of Athena, thus becoming stronger and more prepared to advance further more on your next try.

You are Kilok, a young Krah, living with the rest of his dying species down at the very bottom of a giant megacity. There - everything is overgrown, rusted down and pested. So you have to get your way up to the top of the skyscrapers and it is a deadly way.

You'll find out that things havent been like this back in the days.

Play through various areas in this rusted steampunk city up to the glorious and clean skyscrapertops where the evil awaits. But are you ready for the cruel secrets of the Lorus?

Solve Puzzles with the ancient Powers you discover and restore what was once in Order.

name: Essence of Time
summary:
In Essence of Time, you are thrust into a school of elemental magic at a critical moment in history; it is time to choose a new emperor. As is tradition, the emperor will be chosen from the students. However, when controversy surrounds the winner, civil unrest grows into outright war.

Fortunately, you have access to the essence of time! By repeating those fateful last days at the academy, you can try to change who becomes emperor and prevent war from breaking out.

Essence of Time mixes turn-based RPGs and visual novel storytelling with time-travel puzzle solving. As you explore various timelines, you will experiment with your sphere grid, make new friends, wage combat against deadly foes, and unravel the many mysteries held within the hearts and minds of all who cross your path.

name: The Killing Cloud
summary:
CAN YOU BREATHE NEW LIFE INTO A DESPERATE CITY THAT"S GASPING FOR AND AND GRASPING FOR HELP?

San Francisco in the 21st Century. The City by the Bay's famous fog has become and infamous lethal shroud. A permanent toxic mist that's choked half the population, and now cloaks the sinister doings of a fanatical crime syndicate, The Black Angels. You, you're the grittiest hard nosed cop ever to wear an SFPD uniform. Your assignment: descend into the poisonous mist in your XB500 hoverbike, capture the villainous ringleaders, and solve the mystery of the Cloud that kills. Hurry, before San Francisco gasps its last breath.

FEATURES:

 Unique adventure combined with exhilarating flight simulation.

 Authentically scaled reproduction of San Francisco including major landmarks and over 240 buildings.

 Comprehensive hoverbike simulation features flight and hover modes, forward and reverse thrust, refueling, radar detection, weaponry, and internal and multiple external views.

Fly ten daring assignments, tracking down crime's kingpin and the source if the deadly cloud. 

Use a variety of gameplay techniques including, piloting skills, mapping strategies, investigative know-how, interrogation and sleuthing.

name: Theme Park Mystery
summary:
SOLVE A HAIR RAISING ROLLER COASTER RIDE OF SUSPENSE!

What shocking evil lurks in your uncle's Magic Canyon Theme Park? What drove the fun seekers away and your uncle insane? Only you can find the answer during your fright-filled trip through this playground of peril.

Creep aboard the Monorail of Fear and journey through four wicked worlds:

Dragonland, with it's horrible gremlins, sinister creatures, and armed apes. 

Dreamland, where you become a pawn in a nightmarish chess game and you're haunted by your own imagination

Futureland, with its floating ghouls and spine tingling, enemy infested, coaster.

Yesterdayland, where Zoltan the mysterious fortune telling wizard dispenses valuable clues, essential tickets and life saving magic. All at a Price. So play the Spirit Slot Machines and press your luck. You may even win enough to buy back your life.

But no amount of money can spare you the unearthly evils of Magic Canyon. Your only hopes are strategy and courage as you hunt for secret items like hidden keys, fiery torches and supernatural potions. So step through the creaking turnstiles and begin. Remember, you must avenge your uncle's death. Just don't forget, the theme of this park is terror.

Features: 

4 distinct levels each with their own unique gameplay style and themes: 

Perform perilous platforming in Dragonland as you dodge attacks and try to reach your goal.

Test your wits in a game of chess in Dreamland, where you are one of the pieces.

Hop aboard a rollercoaster in Futureland. Blast oncoming enemies before you get derailed.

Explore the park in Yesterdayland, the central hub of the park where you can play games to earn coins.

Uncover mysteries about the park by visiting the fortune teller Zoltan.

Defeat 8 demons scattered around the park. Each posing a unique challenge.

name: Maru and her make-believe world
summary:
玛鲁与她梦幻般的境界是一款关于童年和童年时代怀念的游戏。这场在梦幻世界上的小冒险适合那些喜欢仔细看一切事物，想要放松并沉浸在该游戏过程中就好像沉浸在卡通或童年回忆中的玩家。

Maru is a game about our childhood, it is about our sweet nostalgia of the kid’s life. This is a story-driven adventure quest in the imaginary world with exploration elements that will suit best for those who would like to chill and immerse in their own childhood memories.
Explore the imaginary world of Maru with her imaginary creatures and reveal the hidden secrets of her family and life.

Features:

 - Imaginary creatures would help Maru to solve puzzle and overcome obstacles in a unusual and fun way

 - The calm and relaxing tone of the game will remind you about old-school quests but with a bit of adventurous tempo to be more fun.

 - The story about childhood, but for those who are already adults. No violence, but about growing up and rethinking our lives while we do.

name: 聖女と皇王の誓約結婚
summary:
初恋もまだなのに、初対面の皇王(元カレ)と結婚!? 奇跡の逆転劇開幕!

聖女ジュリエッタは、敗戦間近のイゼルタ皇国の新たな皇王ルキノに四百年前の誓約を持ち出されて結婚することに!
ルキノと敗戦後の民の生活を守るべく奔走する中で、ジュリエッタは処刑覚悟で皇王になったルキノの優しさを知り!?
――「まだ勝てますよ、この戦争」
ジュリエッタの隠された力がここから奇跡を起こす! 聖女と皇王の大逆転劇物語!!

name: VR Girls’ Room in Darkness
summary:
2008年，一个名叫金米（Kimmy）的女孩奇怪地失踪了。 她的父母找了很长时间，但没有找到她，所以他们离开了这片悲伤的土地。 十二年后，您在一次意外旅行中发现了这栋无人居住的房子。
由于新的COVID流行病，您失去了工作并变得无家可归，所以您住在这所房子里。 但是您没想到，到了深夜，突然传来一阵奇怪的笑声，所以您醒了。 。 。

在游戏中，您拥有手电筒，但其功率有限。 您可以在屋子里找到散落的电池来维护手电筒。 同时，您必须找到打开房间和解锁房间的钥匙。 在其中，您可能会遇到各种超自然事件。 最后，您将克服恐惧并找到最后的机制，只有意识到这是一场闹剧。

In 2008, a girl named Kimmy disappeared strangely. Her parents searched for her for a long time but failed to find her, so they left this sad land. Twelve years later, you found this uninhabited house during an accidental trip. Due to the new COVID epidemic, you have lost your job and become homeless, so you live into this house. But you didn't expect that, late at night, there was a burst of strange laughter, so you woke up. . .

In the game, you own a flashlight, but its power is limited. You can find batteries scattered in the house to maintain the flashlight. At the same time, you have to find the key to open the room and unlock the room. In it, you may encounter various supernatural events. In the end, you will overcome the fear and find the last mechanism, only to realize that this is a farce.

name: 聖女と皇王の誓約結婚 2 恥ずかしいので聖女の自慢話はしないでくださいね…!

イゼルタ皇国の皇王争いにルキノの妹アンジェラが巻き込まれ、人質にされた!
ジュリエッタとルキノはアンジェラを取り戻すため他国と同盟を結ぶことを考える。

そんなジュリエッタにルキノは「ずっと皇妃でいてほしい」と告げ!?

summary:
バイク事故を起こしてしまった“奥村コージ”。
大けがを負ったうえ、愛車は廃車寸前。
さらに入院費までのしかかっていた。
病室で落ち込んでいると、担当の看護師が入ってくる。 コージはその顔を見た瞬間、思わす息を呑んだ。そこにいたのは、学生時代に自分を心底嫌っていた同級生 “倉田サナ工”。
「ホント最悪よ。私も名前を見てびっくりしたわ......。 でも仕事だから、やらないわけにはいかないし......」
まさに弱り目に祟り目。 “天敵”のサナエに雑な態度を取られながら、 入院生活を送ることになるのだった。
(俺、無事に退院できるんだろうか......)

name: 王太子の最愛姫 亡国の元王女は隣国で初めての恋を知る
summary:
戦によって国も家族も失った、敗戦国ゲルンヴィッテの第二王女・フォルティーナ。
絞首刑に処されようとしていた彼女を寸前で救ったのは、
戦後処理に訪れた中立国ギデノルトの王太子・ルートヴィヒだった。

ある事情から父王によって世間から隔絶され、
姉に虐げられ育ってきたフォルティーナは、生に執着せず感情も希薄だった。
そんな様子を気にしたルートヴィヒは、彼女を国に連れ帰り保護することに決める。
同情から始まったはずの気持ちは、純粋無垢な心に触れる度に恋に変化していって――。

一方、亡国の王女であるフォルティーナの周囲では、様々な思惑が絡み合う。
やがて彼女を中心とした大きな事件に発展していき……。

生きる意味も、恋する喜びも、あなたが教えてくれた。
【国を失った無感情な姫君】×【窮地を救った隣国の王太子】の
王道シンデレラロマンス！

summary:

エステファニアは自身が患う“ユッグ病”の手がかりとなる書籍を発見する。
しかし、そこにあるはずの記録は、すべて白紙だった――。

シニルの不器用で過保護すぎる愛情は、ますます甘く、そして独占的に加速していく!!

その出来事をきっかけに明かされる、ルーチェとピースの過去。
そして使い魔は、エステファニアから“強い執着の匂い”を嗅ぎ取り、告げる。

絡み合う過去と感情。気付いてしまった想いは、もう止められない――!!
大反響・推し活恋愛ファンタジー、第5巻!

name: Minesweeper Versus
summary:
Minesweeper Versus requires tactics and strategy to uncover hidden mines before your opponent beats you to it. It's a modern take on the classic free minesweeper game, for two players.

Gameplay
The goal of Minesweeper Versus is to uncover more bombs than your opponent. The location of most mines is discovered through a logical process, but some require guessing, usually with a 50-50 chance of being correct. Clicking on the game board will reveal what is hidden underneath the chosen square or squares (a large number of blank squares may be revealed in one go if they are adjacent to each other). Some squares are blank while others contain numbers (from 1 to 8), with each number being the number of mines adjacent to the uncovered square.

Matchmaking
Depending on the type of game, you can win or lose Elo. A highscore can be seen in the lobby.

Custom Game
You can play against your friends where neither win nor lose elo.

name: PATHFINDER 08
summary:
Pathfinder 08 is a fun and challenging adventure. It is a platform game with a focus on exploration and retro inspiration with some RPG elements. Your hero is a traveler looking for

treasures in dangerous places inhabited by monsters. He uses a sword that has several types of improvements and throughout his adventure he acquires skills that will enable

collect previously inaccessible resources. Destroy as many monsters as you can to supply your battery of energy and use your special abilities strategically, either to protect yourself

or attack.

Pathfinder 08 features:

- Exploration skills are acquired during the adventure.

- Active and passive attack skills.

- Puzzles.

- Enemies have different strategies to be overcome.

- Epic bosses where you need to use strategies to win.

- Pixel graphics.

- Gamepad support.

name: Dear Mom
summary:
"...there are things I couldn't say, but there's so much I wish you had known. There are things I never meant but said, being rude, speaking in arrogant tone. But, time made me realize that black and white isn't always wise, and that sometimes, things can be grey..."

'Dear Mom' is a short narrative-adventure game, an emotional narrative about a child’s feelings written to her mom, a letter which, always, will remain unread.

Key Feature: -

 A poetic narration of a letter, written to mom.

 Focuses more on experience rather than actions and puzzles.

 A 15-30 minutes immersive emotional experience.

 An unforgettable lifetime experience.

Voice Credit - Veronica Laux (@RonixVa)

name: Build Em' Faster
summary:
Build a perfectly balanced castle 

Identify the best location for your castle regarding the area specificities, opportunities and weak spots. Then build the perfect defense, balanced between the security of your main towers, the efficiency of your turrets and the convenience for upcoming fixes and upgrades.
 Choose and carefully place your turrets 

Taking into account your available credits, time to impact and reload time or the proximity with your very defense ; carefully select and place your turrets within your castle remaining space.
 Reduce enemy to ashes 

Bomb the enemy ships and walls, wisely selecting which to destroy and which to keep, generating patterns that will be a nightmare for your enemies to fix.
 Build back your walls 

Rebuild your defenses as fast as possible, keeping in mind that you will need castle towers to earn credits, credits to build turrets and space to place them ! And a poor defense placement can quickly become your doom !

 Learn all games mechanics through a perfectly balanced campaign.

 Play versus the computer over dozens of maps in various environments : artic, temperate, desertic...

 Challenge your friends with up to three players on the same computer !

 Steal enemies' turrets with landing tracts and propaganda with hot air balloons !

 Take the in-game editor in your own hands and create an unlimited number of single or multiplayer maps.

name: Tales From The Cache
summary:
Never before have you experienced a treasure hunting game like TFTC. Plunge into an atmospheric open-world, teeming with life. Just remember, you are not just a visitor in this world, you are a living and breathing part of it. 

TFTC gives you a chance to explore interesting locations, by using your GPS tracking unit, to discover interesting treasures.

Tired of walking between your hunts? Get the Enduro "Lynx" motorcycle and drive around! This capable off-road motorcycle will carry you across rough terrain at breakneck speeds. Exploring the open world has never been more fun.

Treasures scattered all over the world, you’ll find something interesting and challenging in your local woods. Develop your character by unlocking various skills and equipment upgrades. Simple, intuitive gameplay elements combined with beautiful landscapes make for a truly enjoyable experience.
Key features:

 Beautiful, handcrafted locations

 Dynamic environment with fully dynamic weather, daytime, living world.

 Skill system to develop your character and upgrade gear.

 Climbing and scaling of obstacles for more freedom of movement.

 Different GPS unit upgrades

summary:

合宿をして漫画を作るとだけ聞かされていたが、実は実結先輩の作りたい漫画とはエロ漫画のことだった……!

summary:

과거의 상처로 인해 남자에게 마음의 문을 굳게 닫아버린 라온 ›. 그런 그의 일상에 쌍둥이 형제 서우 ›와 제우 ›가 불쑥 찾아든다. 오랜 짝사랑을 고백할 용기가 없는 서우는 쌍둥이 동생 제우에게 자신을 대신해 라온에게 다가가 달라고 간절히 부탁한다.

처음에는 마지못해 나섰던 제우. 하지만 어느새 라온의 곁에서 보내는 시간이 자연스럽게 늘어가고, 라온 역시 똑같이 닮은 두 얼굴 뒤에 전혀 다른 온도가 있다는 것을 서서히 느끼기 시작한다.

두 남자 사이에서 흔들리는 라온의 마음—
과연 그의 닫힌 문을 진정으로 두드릴 '라온의 남자'는 누구일까?

summary:
以一个贫穷船员的身份开启桀骜不驯的职业，并一路向上晋升，成为群岛上最富有、最危险的船长。接管海上航线、建造藏身地、建立船队，并和敌船船员作战，成就一段传奇的海盗生活！

最开始，您只是一个新手船员，您的船小得犹如一艘独木舟，之后您通过厉害的海盗手段为自己的梦想之船购买、制作或“安排”部件。更换必要的部件，添置航行所需的装备，重点关注航行速度或耐用性，选择您喜欢的方式去统治这片汪洋大海！

召集船员

大帆船很棒，但是您需要船员去开船。拜访沿途的城镇和港口，品尝各式美酒，并招募一些能让您成为真正海盗的船员！

扩展基地

无论是贸易、还是打劫，或是寻找宝藏，您都需要一个地方来收集并堆放物品。当您在沙滩或洞穴发现这个完美的地方，务必抢占下来并修建基础设施和建筑，来让您的公司蓬勃发展。 

寻找宝藏

……以及寻找宝藏的方法。您可以翻开每一块石头，检查每一寸海底，但是如果时间有限，可以试试寻找其他海盗、商人和可能知道一些藏宝故事的可疑人员。

扬帆起航

有时候会发生这种情况——海盗没办法单纯靠贸易为生，因此需要采用一些更动态的方式去获取必要的资源。在海上，您可能会遇到其它行船，它们携带的物品如此之多，让您情不自禁想要打劫。这种方法可比老实挣钱有效多了。

成为海盗！吼吼！

Build your ship

Start as a rookie sailor on a boat as tiny as a canoe and use your smart pirate moves to buy, craft or "arrange" add-ons for your dream vessel. Replace necessary parts, attach equipment needed for rides, focus on speed or durability, choose your own style of ruling the seas!

Gather the crew

Galleons are great, but you need a crew to run it. Visit towns and harbors along your way, have a pint or five and recruit a crew that will make you a real pirate!

Extend your base

Whether it's trading, looting or finding treasures, you need to collect and stack your goods somewhere. When you spot this perfect place on a beach or inside a cave, claim it and take care of infrastructure and buildings to make your company thrive. 

Find treasures

...and a way to look for them. You can turn every rock upside down and check every inch of the sea bottom, but if time is a factor, try searching for other pirates, merchants and shady people who may know a few stories about hidden chests. 

Go on a ride

As it happens sometimes - a pirate won't make a living from the trade alone and needs to incorporate a bit more dynamic forms of getting the necessary resources. On the seas, you might meet other fellow ships that just carry too much goods not to loot them. Way more efficient than honestly earned money.

Become a pirate! Arr!

name: My Father My Son
summary:
有两个幸存者：一场突然的暴风雨后，父子他们俩发现自己在一个无人荒岛。本应使他们彼此靠近的帆船之旅，就变成了生存的谋杀斗争。英雄只能依靠自己。

只有合作才能救他们的命。

与两个失踪的幸存者—父亲和儿子在一起，体验一下地图上没有的黑暗，荒岛中的令人兴奋的旅程。走上充满逻辑谜题和潜伏危险的道路，并帮助家里人彼此亲近。离开这个神秘的地方，与英雄在一起发现该地方中所隐藏的。

使用键盘或手柄单独或共同控制两个角色（1个游戏者—1个角色）。你可以随时更改控制方法。在两条道路移动，根据需要自由更改。明智地利用父亲（强壮和身高）和儿子（小的而敏捷）之间的差异，这将使英雄们更容易合作来解决合作谜题。

游戏最重要的特色：

合作或一个人玩来控制两个角色（本地在一个屏幕或线上）

选择任何一种控制两个角色的方式：通过手柄或键盘

基于两个不同能力角色的合作：父亲和儿子来解决环境谜题

通过激动人心的灵巧序列战斗生存

两个角色和两个道路都随时可以互相切换

2.5D Low Poly(低多边形）式的游戏

父子关系惊险气氛中有趣的故事

Only cooperation can save them

Together with two lost castaways, a father, and son, experience a thrilling journey through a dark, uninhabited island that isn’t on the map. Overcome a path full of logic puzzles and hidden dangers and help the family get closer to each other. Escape from this mysterious place and discover together with the characters what’s hidden here. 

Control two characters alone or in co-op (1 player - 1 character), using either a pad or the keyboard. You can change the control method at any time. Move along 2 paths, changing them freely as needed. Take wise advantage of the differences between the father (strong and high) and the son (small and agile), which will make it easier for the characters to work together on co-op puzzles.

MAIN FEATURES OF THE GAME:

Play alone, controlling two characters or in co-op (local on one screen or online)

Choose any method to control both characters: using pads or the keyboard

Solve environmental puzzles based on the co-operation of two characters with different abilities: a father and son

Fight for survival in thrilling arcade sequences

Two characters and two tracks that you can change at any time

Low-poly 2.5D side view game

An engaging story about a father’s relationship with his son in a thriller atmosphere

name: Agent Murphy
summary:
代理墨菲是一个令人兴奋的平台游戏射击游戏，沉浸在一个不妥协的战斗和动态战斗的世界。 作为墨菲特工，手持手枪，MP5，霰弹枪和手榴弹的无尽弹药，你必须完成20个充满随机敌人和独特武器的关卡。 游戏结合了节奏动作和战略思维的元素，迫使你适应战场上不断变化的情况。％在整个游戏中，你会发现不仅普通的敌人，而且史诗般的boss战，需要精确，反应和管理武器库的技巧。 游戏的视觉部分是在明亮的像素图形，这给了复古游戏的气氛，并在同一时间创造了一个现代的视觉感知。 一个大气的配乐与发条图案伴随你在每个级别，沉浸在紧张的时刻和创造一个独特的气氛。％
 主要特点：
％
 激烈的行动

动态战斗与连续行动和使用各种武器，包括手枪，MP5，霰弹枪和手榴弹。
 随机生成的敌人

每个级别都提供需要适应和策略的新型敌人。在每个级别结束时，强大的老板正在等待测试你的反应和准确性。％
 像素艺术

丰富多彩的复古图形，营造出独特的氛围，类似于经典游戏。一个小时的动机配乐，增强了游戏的感觉，让你沉浸在动作平台游戏的世界中。

Dive into the adrenaline-pumping world of "Agent Murphy," a relentless fast-paced platformer and side-scrolling action shooter that will test your skills to the limit. As Agent Murphy, you are armed with an impressive arsenal of weaponry to thwart your enemies' onslaught.

Game Features

Intense Action-Packed Gameplay: Engage in relentless fast-paced action as Agent Murphy, armed with an inexhaustible pistol, MP5, shotgun, and grenades, battling through hordes of randomly generated enemies in a side-scrolling platformer shooter.

Dynamic Challenges: Experience unpredictable encounters with randomly generated enemy types and weapons, keeping you on your toes and requiring quick adaptation and strategic thinking to survive.

Striking Pixel Art Visuals: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world brought to life through colorful pixel graphics, capturing the essence of retro gaming nostalgia while delivering a modern and captivating aesthetic.

Epic Boss Battles: Conquer challenging boss encounters that demand precision, reflexes, and mastery of your arsenal, adding thrilling climactic moments to the 20 meticulously designed levels.

Immersive Clockwork Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere with a captivating clockwork-themed soundtrack that enhances the intensity of each level, further elevating the overall gaming experience.

name: 邪馆
summary:
邪馆无间是一款支持实时3D语音的第一人称3D狼人杀类游戏。游戏在传统狼人杀规则上加入了身份转换，并且通过规则鼓励每个玩家对局势做出自主独立的判断而不仅仅是跟着大部分人的逻辑走。游戏最多支持8-10人联机游玩。游戏至少需要5人一局来获得完整的游戏体验，需要7-8人一局来获得较好的游戏体验。

游戏中，你扮演的是一家灵异事件探索公司的员工，这家公司旨在用科学仪器记录并解释灵异现象，并且拍成纪录片来盈利。

你和同事们这次的目标是一栋洋馆，它从前是一个邪教的据点，2年前，邪教成员在里面集体自杀。1年前，购买并住进这一建筑的家庭也发生了惨案——父亲杀死了一整家人，然后在房间内自杀了。从那之后，这栋房子被认为住着恶鬼，即使数次降价，也没有人敢购买。因此，拥有这栋建筑的房地产商希望你们能找出建筑异常的原因并且将其解决。

公司中另一个部门的同事在3小时前进入了洋馆，并且安放好了发电机和用于检测磁场的信号监测器，但是在那之后，他们就都失去了联系。

你们的任务，是回收洋馆中信号监测器的数据，并且想办法搞明白上一只小队的下落。为此，公司还派出了私家侦探，医生和安保人员与你们同行。

然而在进入洋馆一段时间后，你突然觉得头疼，晕眩，眼部充血，你的意识模糊，仿佛听到了一个细微的女声在对你说话。

“杀光他们……”

游戏规则：

内鬼需要杀死所有人公司员工来获胜，公司员工需要回收所有数据或杀死全部内鬼来获胜

游戏中不同的职业有不同的技能：

安保：开局时拥有一把装有一把子弹的手枪，可以杀死它人

医生：开局时拥有一个用于救援濒死队员的医疗包

侦探：检查尸体时能查出凶手身份

研究员：能在更远处看见监测器的位置。当完成数据回收任务时，有概率获得地图上一个补给箱的访问权限，补给箱中有手枪或医疗包，捡起后就可以实现身份转换

内鬼：可以使用随时间变强的暗杀技能，每段时间能获取所有玩家的位置信息

游戏的特色在于局内会进行身份转换，玩家通过搜索尸体可以捡起尸体上的手枪或医疗包，或者在补给箱中拾取特殊道具。每种职业都会在游戏有良好的游戏体验，并且发挥极其重要的作用。

与传统狼人杀不同，游戏中的投票不会直接让玩家出局，而是让玩家被标记一段时间。每个人都可以根据自己的判断来影响战局，而不需要服从其他人的判断。

Evil Mansion is a multiplayer first-person 3D Werewolf game. The game supports up to 8-10 people to play online and you need at least 5 people for a round (better 7 or 8).

In the game, you play as an employee of a supernatural event exploration company. This company aims to use scientific instruments to record and explain supernatural phenomena, and make a documentary to make a profit.

The goal of you and your colleagues this time is a mansion. It used to be a stronghold of a cult. Two years ago, members of the cult committed suicide in it. One years ago, the family that bought and moved into this building also suffered a tragedy: the father killed an entire family and then committed suicide in the room. Since then, this house is considered to be inhabited by evil spirits, and even if the price is reduced several times, no one dared to buy it. Therefore, the real estate agent who owns this building hopes that you can find out the cause of the abnormality of the building and solve it.

A colleague from another department of

name: Car Mechanic Manager 2023
summary:
汽修经理是一款经营管理类游戏，靠你自己经营好汽修业务，建立起你梦想中的那个汽车修理厂! 

 。

建立、扩张以及现代化你手中的汽车修理厂，保持良好的声誉并吸引更多的客户。用心地经营好你的业务，监督你的专业团队，提升你的车间条件，为顾客提供最优质的服务，同时战胜竞争对手! 购买最先进的设备，优化维修程序，使利润最大化。

要知道，汽车行业中并不只有你的存在 - 竞争是相当激烈的! 你必须带来各方面最高的质量，并以较高的水准展示你的广告宣传力度，以保持行业领先地位!！

作为一名优秀的管理者，你时刻要对市场保持高度的警惕。不要错过推广你的汽修业务和获取新客户的任何机会。不断扩张且灵活应对各种事务。尽量多样化你所提供的产品。适时提供拖车服务，为争取客户努力! 复原经典，给旧车注入新的活力，让它们重新焕发光彩！

Car Mechanic Manager is a tycoon management game that lets you manage your own car mechanic business and build the car workshop of your dreams! 

Build, expand and modernize your car workshop to maintain a good reputation and attract new customers. Manage your business efficiently, supervise your crack-team of professionals, promote your workshop, provide top quality service, and destroy the competition! Buy cutting edge equipment and optimize the repair process to maximize profits.

Remember that you’re not the only one in the car industry – competition is fierce! You have to bring the highest quality and take your advertising to the next level to keep ahead! 

As a good manager, you always need to be watchful. Do not miss out on new opportunities to promote your car mechanic business and acquire new customers. Expand and be flexible. Diversify your offer. Provide towing service and fight for customers! Restore classics and put a new spin on old cars to make them shine again!"

name: Dystopians
summary:
和一群流浪者开始您的旅程，慢慢在充满机遇和对比的反乌托邦高层赛博城市中找到自己的位置。不断满足每位成员的需求，为他们找到安全的房子，以各种方式收集现金，建立必要的联系并向邻近地区扩张。

AI 驱动的船员
雇佣成员，为他们提供装备，并分配一些事做 – 每位船员都在等待命令和计划，并且每个人都有自己的做事方式。找到一种方法来联系他们，并将他们安排到可以充分发挥个人特长的地方。

食物链顶端
穿过低端城市的底层，应对一切事情以及想要利用您的每个人，到达上方的区域，最终穿过污染稍少的空气看到太阳。

黑暗的反乌托邦城市
置身被污染、腐朽但始终充满活力的世界。当心警察和军团，找到生存之道，无论是从事新业务、为其他船员办事还是只是四处劫掠。

赛博技术装备
让科技为您服务。为您的帮派成员购买、制作、修理和安装赛博组件，提高他们的统计数据以及战胜城市的机会。

Start your journey as a group of outcasts to slowly find your place inside a dystopian high-rise cybercity full of opportunities and contrasts. Keep satisfying the needs of each member, get them a safe house, collect cash one way or another, make necessary connections and expand to neighboring districts.

AI-driven crew
Hire members, equip them and give something to do - every crew member awaits orders and a plan, and each of them has their own way of doing things. Find a way to reach them and send to places where they can fully use their individual pros.

Top of the food chain
Dash through the ground floors of the low level city, deal with everything and everyone who wants to exploit you, get to the districts above and eventually see the sun through a slightly less polluted air. 

Dark & dystopian city
Dive in a polluted, rusty but always vibrant city. Beware the cops and corps, find your way to survive whether it's a new business, getting things done for other crews or just looting around.

Cybertech equipment
Make technology work for you. Buy, craft, repair and install cyberware on your gang members to increase their stats and a chance to win against the City.

name: Freelancer Life Simulator: Prologue
summary:
ADD MAIN PART TO YOUR WISHLIST

This is a story about the uncle of the protagonist, who left the city under mysterious circumstances. In this game you can find out what made your uncle leave the city, as well as get to know the life of a "simple" freelancer.

In this game you can play the role of a freelancer, carry out various orders for the development of programs, games and design. You can Improve your knowledge by taking various courses and discover the opportunity to complete more difficult tasks. Each task is a mini-game, passing which you earn money.

Don't forget that you are human, you have needs: hunger, thirst, fatigue.

If you have wondered in your life whether you want to connect your life with the development of programs, games, then this game will show you what it is like to be a freelancer

name: 战车向前冲
summary:
战车向前冲
战车向前冲，是一款驾驶战车的跑酷游戏，你要在时间限制内，沿着笔直的道路努力地冲往终点。

玩法介绍

道路上不只有你的战车，还有许多交通工具挡在你面前，运用你高超的驾驶技巧绕过他们，或者，将战车的炮管转向，轰的一发排除掉。

每次开炮击中路上的交通工具，都能够为你多延长一点时间限制，如果连续击中累积连击数，还能够让延长的时间再依最大连击数来增加额外倍率的时间，更有利于往终点迈进。
但是，每次开炮后需要装填弹药的时间，这段时间你将无法再次开炮，如果遇上塞车就束手无策了，而且被打飞的车辆会留下阻碍视线的烟雾，让你看不清楚前方。要连续开炮让延长时间效率最佳化，或是保留来清除眼前障碍，这一切都靠你随机应变。

不过你驾驶的可是陆上的猛兽-战车，面对路上的交通工具除了开炮外，你还能直接撞飞他们。
小心，这会让你的战车受点伤，速度变慢，且中断连击数，好好的判断情势使用。
多种场景
道路不是一成不变的，面对不同路况，你需要小心应变。

● 宽广明亮的林中大道，一开始总是友善的。

● 昏暗的神庙遗迹小径，你会看不清楚前方的路况。

● 拥挤城市道路，狭小的两线道上除了车子外还有其他固定路障，却在车道外有巧妙的空间可以利用。

● 太空，神奇的环境与不可预期的飞来横祸。
各式战车

游戏内提供了14台不同的二战战车供选择，各有着不同的特性，像是加速快，极速高，装甲厚，或者装填时间短，努力过关赚取奖励，一一解锁吧。
挑战模式

每当通过一个环境，就会解锁该场地的挑战模式，挑战模式内不变换场地，还有随机出现能加倍取得延长时间限制与修车的路上交通工具，利用这些优势，看你能在倒数时间结束前跑多远。
特殊体验
游戏支援多种解析度下游玩，在超宽萤幕或是直立萤幕上游玩有更多乐趣。

RUN TANK RUN
Run Tank Run is a parkour game where you drive a tank and rush forward along a straight road to reach the goal within a time limit.

INFO

On the road, you'll encounter other vehicles blocking your way. Use your superior driving skills to avoid them, or turn your tank's cannon and blast them away.

Each time you fire and hit a vehicle, you can gain extra time, and if you achieve consecutive hits, you can accumulate combo points and earn bonus time based on your maximum combo. However, you need to reload your ammo after each shot, during which time you'll be unable to fire again. If you get stuck in traffic, you'll be helpless, and the smoke from the destroyed vehicles will block your vision, making it hard to see ahead. You need to make quick decisions about whether to continue firing to extend your time or to use your ammo to clear obstacles.

Remember that you're driving a tank, a powerful vehicle that can also ram other vehicles aside. However, this action can cause damage to your tank, slow you down, and interrupt your combo. Use it wisely.
STAGES
The road is not always the same, and you need to adapt to different conditions:

● The wide and bright forest road is always friendly at the beginning.

● The dark temple rui

name: CooKing: Around the World
summary:
你喜欢做饭吗？还在学习中吗？或者你担心自己做个炒鸡蛋都会把厨房烧了？无论你的答案是什么，这款游戏都会让你成为自己厨房的主厨。

进入厨房，穿上你的虚拟围裙。在这里，你不会做微波香肠或煮意大利面，也不需要点外卖。幸运的是，你不用担心烧焦食物、洗碗或因切洋葱而流泪。
故事
你扮演一名初学厨师，需要根据餐厅菜单准备菜肴。你会先从简单的菜肴开始，然后，随着你出现在越来越多的餐厅，菜肴会变得更加复杂。

玩法

Story

Gameplay
The goal of the game is to figure out what ingredients each food is made from. Some foods will require two ingredients, others require three. Moreover, it may be necessary to first produce another ingredient that will later be used for a food on the menu. On a given level (restaurant) the menu includes 10-12 dishes. You complete a level when you discover all the dishes on the menu of the particular nation’s cuisine. Each time you have successfully discovered all the dishes on the menu, you are transferred to the cuisine of another nation, where more food and new ingredients await you. Furthermore, if you have managed to discover a dish, it can even be made at home based on its recipe in the game.

태산 그룹 오너 가의 유일한 아들
방성현.

나는 그의 추문을 덮을 용도로 태산그룹에 팔려 왔다.

부부 침실에 그림자조차 보이지 않는 그였으나
어른들의 감시를 피하기 위해서는 방성현의 도움이 필요했다.

"나랑 자요"
"...내가 왜 그래야 하지?"
"그렇게 하면 집안의 압박으로부터 자유로워질 거예요."

취기로 살짝 풀린 성현의 눈매가 길어졌다.

"시늉만 해도 좋고, 침대에서 다른 여자 생각해도 좋아요.
대신, 피임만 확실히 해 줘요."

그의 오만한 눈빛에 온몸이 떨렸으나, 더 이상 물러날 수는 없었다.
이건 도발이었고, 구걸이자, 협상이었다.

"내가 떠나면요. 성현 씨는 어떻게 되는 거예요?"
"어떻게 되긴 뭘 어떻게 돼."

사색에 잠긴 서늘한 얼굴이 자신을 똑바로 바라봤다.

"넌 밝은 곳이 어울려. 그러니까 가랄 때 가."

언제부터 마음이 이렇게 커져 버린 걸까.

"날 사랑하면 이 지옥에서,
평생 같이 썩어 문드러져야 해.
...그럴 수 있겠어?"

Anarkade 是一款多人竞技场射击游戏，以像素图形风格和刺激的平台动作为卖点。

携上带来炸裂搞笑的爆炸性武器，奔跑、跳跃、击溃对手。通过易学难精的直观控制方式，使用转角悬挂和踢墙跳等招数，建立优势，从各个角度发起攻击。

可定制的角色：
戴上怪异的帽子、防毒面具、维京服饰等，让你的角色在废土之上鹤立鸡群。

风格迥异的关卡主题，以及独一无二的物理机制：
在不拘一格的竞技场中射出一条血路 – 太空中、冰面上，甚至在古代的埃及。

多种武器，战术截然不同：
携带小刀前往枪战... 或者背上加特林机枪或火箭筒；甚至于丢出一颗保龄球炸弹，将对手统统炸飞！

在本地比赛或联网多人比赛中，穿越随机生成的竞技场时，务必要搜刮箱子以获得升级物品和武器。

Anarkade is a Multiplayer Arena Shooter with 2D platforming mechanics that features multiple weapons, randomly generated arenas, and humorously bloody animations.

Anarkade is a multiplayer arena shooter with pixel art graphics and intense platforming action.

Run, jump, and frag your opponents with explosive weaponry that causes hilarious hijinks. With intuitive controls that are easy to learn but hard to master, players can gain an edge over rivals by performing moves like wall jumps and corner hangs to strike from anywhere.

Customizable characters:
Make your character stand out in the wasteland with an absurd range of hats, gas masks, Viking apparel, and more.

Contrasting Stage themes with unique physics:
Shoot your way through an eclectic collection of arenas in space, on ice or even in the ancient terrain of Egypt.

Multiple weapons with distinctive tactics:
Bring a knife to a gun fight... or a Gatling gun or a bazooka. Heck, even use a bowling bomb to blow away your opponents!

Make sure you loot crates for power ups and weapons while navigating randomly generated arenas in local matches or online multiplayer.

A group of friends like to explore and investigate abandoned buildings.
One day, they decided to explore an old, weird mansion in their town. While they were investigating the building, they felt something was weird.

summary:
Destroy aliens, dash between planets, and buy powerful upgrades. Exodemic is a compact roguelike that combines frenetic shoot 'em up gameplay with a procedurally generated overworld filled with vendors, trading hubs, and combat encounters. Race against the clock to save the human race.

A deadly virus has been weaponized and threatens the human race. Do you have what it takes to stop it in time?
Race Against the Clock

With every passing second, the virus spreads. Destroy enemies as quickly as possible while dodging their attacks by dashing and warping between planets in adrenaline-pumping combat encounters. Your contagion meter tracks the progress of the infection throughout the sector. Time is of the essence--if the meter fills, it's game over.
Explore the Galaxy

Each run takes place on a procedurally generated map filled with a variety of vendors to help you accomplish your mission of clearing out all hostile enemies in the sector. Choose your path strategically! Each encounter gives the virus time to progress.
Upgrade Your Ship

Your ship is equipped with augment slots that allow you to strengthen the effect of your weapons and dash. Enemies drop scrap when destroyed that can be used to buy stronger augments from vendors and other outposts that you encounter during your run. Discover synergies and over-powered combinations to wipe out enemy hordes with ease.

name: 星际神格
summary:
一款回合制剧情冒险科幻角色扮演游戏。 并不大，玩家操作很简单，只需要看剧情，操作移动并且在战斗界面快速选择即可。 有一些简单的支线区别，整体探索最多两个小时。

游戏性：这款游戏背景在外星人Liop入侵地球后的数年，主角作为人类反抗组织茉莉的一名顶尖成员，

再次返回了自己的故乡，位于亚洲的上隆市，并遇到了他曾经的朋友，并肩作战，帮助人类，并参与到一个诡异的阴谋中。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

特色：运用了rpgmaker引擎并采用了即时回合制战斗，在回合制战斗中依然能体验到需要快速反应的刺激感。

一个还算不错的剧情，和还算宏大的世界观，几十种装备和许多的彩蛋。

同时还有一些小迷题，但“彩色字”部分会给出提示。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

简单来说，这款游戏仅仅是我做出的实验性质的产品，它体现了我的游戏制作理念——剧情先行。

您所玩到的剧情花了我大概20分钟时间在纸上来构思，但它的背后是几十万字的小说作为世界观背景设定。

它并不困难，但它需要您慎重的审视每一段剧情，尽量的去好好探索。

对了，我们如果后续有更新的话，会以dlc的形式在做出其他作品，请把这个当成它的......前传吧。

它本来应该叫做“星际神格”的，但可惜我注册的时候没有想好。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

wow，但不管怎么说，我还是对于作品可以上架steam感到兴奋。

Explore the world of Galaxy Life, build a space colony, attack enemies, grab items and rule the universe. Galaxy Life is full of interesting planets and characters. You'd be surprised how big Galaxy Life is! In this free to play MMO strategy game that mixes traditional easy-to-play casual gameplay mechanics with touches of more traditional genres and features like tower defense, RTS, or several competitive PvP features in a persistent on-line Galaxy. You play together with others or your friends and take on evil, so gather your friends to fight evil in this Galaxy Life social game!

Features:

+ Challenge friends or foes in battles for loot and control over the Galaxy!
