summary:
让我们看看你有多好。 买你最喜欢的车，上路吧！

欢迎来到高速公路上的至尊比赛！ 作为一名司机，您必须尽可能在高速公路上行驶而不会发生事故。

为了为您和您周围的人提供最大的安全性，汽车将巡航控制设置为固定速度。

name: Animals Collision
summary:
Animals Collision is a party game. Play as humanoid animal and fight for your victory: solo or online up to 4 players. There is no space for other animals on the arena!

Animals Collision is a party game for up to 4 human (online) or computer-controlled players. The game features several different levels in which the goal is to defeat opponents. The last player standing wins the round and the first player to win a set number of rounds wins the game. The main mode of play is Free for All, but online is possible in 2v2 teams.

FEATURES

Different levels with different crazy things happening. Sheep with rockets, turtles with chainsaws, flying penguins... Falling boxes from the sky with a reward or not, everything can change very quickly in your favor or harm. Apart from that, you have to show your fighting skills on the arena against different opponents.

Humanoid animal characters with unique look, attacks and skills. Choose between: Cat, Lizard, Bear, Rabbit, Ram, Wolf, Panda, Raccoon, Capybara, Tiger.

AI Bots as bonus in addition. Initially, the game was planned to be played online only, but bots were added. They are not very smart, but it's better than nothing. This will allow you to play offline (Single player mode) and no need to connect in online game rooms. You can choose versus how many bots to play: 1, 2 or 3. Also keep in mind that they will all attack only you (yes, they are friends) - this can be a challenge that will be definitely a lot of fun.

Game Modes: Single player, Lan or Online up to 4 players. Also available game types are: Free for All or 2v2 teams (online).

This is "Free To Play" game. If you are worried that there will be no one to play with... you can invite your friends and play with them. It's better than AI bots in Single player mode (and probably more fun).

It's not "Pay To Win" game. Only additional content as DLC (Maps, Characters, Skins).

Even if you don't have a DLC content for this game, you can play online on DLC maps,

name: Gargoyles Remastered
summary:
重溫歌利亞的傳奇，拯救即將毀滅的世界。

Gargoyles Remastered 精心重现了这个 90 年代经典的 16 位横向卷轴平台冒险游戏。通过由广受好评的动画系列为灵感而设计的增强画面、动画和音效，回味歌利亚和石像鬼的史诗旅程。以丰富细节逼真还原石像鬼的世界，绝对能让同名动画系列的粉丝和怀旧游戏爱好者为之激动。体验维持前作本身的经典玩法，同时加入成就、游戏倒带等新功能！

主要特色

• 扮演石像鬼的领袖歌利亚：使出碎石般的力量，用利爪攀登石塔和建筑，并在空中滑翔，掌握动作连贯的空中攻击和肉搏战，拯救世界不受邪恶毁灭。

• 身历其境的图形体验：实时且无缝地在以动画系列为灵感的画面和忠于原版游戏的经典 16 位模式之间切换。

• 真实石像鬼游戏体验：在经由石像鬼动画系列为灵感而设计的动画与音效中，重温歌利亚和石像鬼对抗邪恶奥丁之眼的战斗故事。

• 自定义属于你的玩法：利用现代功能，包含立即倒带、宽屏幕呈现和成就，掌握经典游戏！

• 重制版原声带：体验经过重制和优化的原声带，带来更令人身历其境的冒险旅程。

Relive the legend of Goliath and save the world from destruction.

Gargoyles Remastered is an artfully crafted revival of the ‘90s classic 16-bit side-scrolling platform adventure. Relive the epic journey of Goliath and the Gargoyles featuring enhanced visuals, animations, and SFX, all inspired by the acclaimed animated series. The world of Gargoyles comes to life with a level of detail that will thrill fans of the animated series and retro gaming enthusiasts alike. Experience classic gameplay that stays authentic to its predecessor while including new features such as achievements, gameplay rewind, and more!

Key Features

• Play as Goliath, leader of the Gargoyles: Use stone-crushing strength, scale stone towers and buildings with razor-sharp claws, and glide through the air as you master mid-air attacks and hand-to-hand combat in non-stop action to save the world from destruction.

• Immersive Graphics Experience: Seamlessly toggle in real-time between graphics inspired by the animated series and classic 16-bit mode true to the original game.

• Authentic Gargoyles Experience: Relive the story of Goliath and the Gargoyles’ battle against the evil Eye of Odin with new animations and sound effects inspired by the Gargoyles animated series.

• Customize Your Experience: tailor your gameplay with modern features including instant rewind, wide-screen presentation, and achievements!

• Remastered Soundtrack: Experience the original soundtrack, remastered and optimized for a more immersive adventure.

name: Underground Evee's Hell
summary:
Underground is an action-adventure, survival and exploration game with RPG elements. Its top-down gameplay takes Evee (protagonist) to explore the bowels of an underground system built to survive chemical-biological warfare.

Underground – The System
Developed by Neoh Games Studios

Underground is an action-adventure, survival and exploration video game, its top-down gameplay takes Evee (protagonist) to explore the bowels of an underground system built to survive a chemical-biological war. Taking the player through synthetic biomes such as forest greenhouses, desert areas, residential condominiums and maritime areas; facing biological and mechanical enemies created to protect the underground from imminent threats, there are also enemies transformed by the chemically altered atmosphere after the war.
The story - with threats of a possible chemical-biological war, some world leaders ordered that refuges be built to resist the coming war, with the capacity to shelter hundreds and even thousands of people for a long period; these are the underground, isolated, self-sustaining havens. Each subterranean is powered by aortic crystals, metritic energy crystals that keep synthetic biomes 'alive' and manage the system's behavior and defenses. The system has a simple objective, to maintain the balance of synthetic biomes and eliminate any type of biological invasion or not in the refuge. As it was to be expected, the undergrounds did not completely resist the nuclear chemical bombardments, making many undergrounds uninhabitable and totally hostile, few refuges partially resisted the war, bringing a problem that puts human existence in possible extinction; with the atmosphere made chemically toxic, the little oxygen and fresh water from underground become vital. Underground 01 of Ricks Cross located in Houstonian-USD is the largest built and the one that apparently suffered the least from the war. name: NOTE2 FALCON
summary:
Note2 needs to find Ana, daughter of scientist Dr. Anderson, its creator. Ana was taken hostage by the evil robot Note1, the first robot created by Dr. Anderson. Note2 needs to find Ana on one of the 11 planets in the solar system X. Is Ana still alive? Run, be quick, help Ana!

Note1 (N1) was the first A.I. created by Dr. Anderson, a scientist at the US National Space Agency. However, Note1 was infected by a virus and its entire programming changed. Note1 referred to humanity, taking many hostages to the order of solar system X, a system created by him and his army with the aim of exterminating planet earth and establishing a new nova where humans are truly superior and humans are slaves. . Even Ana, daughter of Dr. Anderson, was taken hostage by Note1.

With that, Dr. Anderson created Note2 (N2) the second A.I. in an attempt to stop Note1, defeating his army and find Ana from the 11 planets created in the solar system X. Note must save Ana alive. He was created for this, to save her.

Along the way, Note2 will encounter Note1's army that will try in every way to stop him on his mission.

Control Robot Note2 in this saga to find Ana. In the game you will use various jump commands, double jump, Flash (Dash), jump with dash, and shoot, against the evil Note1 and his army. In the stages you encountered several were marked by Note1. In this game you'll test your skills in time, space and reflexes on each obstacle posed by Note 1. In addition, you'll face moments of inverse gravity, floating platforms, powerful lasers. And you will still pilot Note2 as a Ship in phase 10. It is worth remembering that Note1 has imprisoned many human beings besides Ana, free them.

name: Adventures of Samuel: The Worst Game Ever Made
summary:
This game is an absolutely terrible platformer game that has nothing unique or interesting about it. While playing the game, leaving task manager open is advised. This game is not fun and can be damaging to mental health if played in large quantity.

The game's title speaks for itself.

This game was built to be the most miserable experience you will ever have playing a video game. Don't believe me? The motto for this game is "it's not a bug, it's a feature."

However, you may be wondering: What is this game? What makes it so bad?

Adventures of Samuel is a remaster of the first game I ever made using Game Maker Studio (please don't ask for the original, I'm not going to give it to you). The original game was a simplistic precision platformer game that wasn't very good. It wasn't the worst game ever made, like this one is, but it surely wasn't a masterpiece. The original game consisted of 8 chapters with 7 levels each. The graphics MAYBE rivaled some crappy NES games, and the music was stolen from Nintendo (which is why I took the original down, it was never on Steam, it was on Gamejolt). 3-4 years after I make this god awful game, me and a couple of buddies of mine thought it would be REALLY funny to remake the original and turn it into the worst game I possibly could. So I did. Was it funny? Yes. Absolutely.

Enough about the game's "lore," let's get on to what THIS game is. As I've said, this is a remake, and like any good remake, it takes what the original did and does it better. In this case, it's being a garbage game. This game, similar to the original, has 8 chapters, with 20 levels each, totaling to 160 (a level refers to one screen, or "room" in Game Maker Studio terms). The graphics resemble updated (yet still low quality) versions of the originals, and the music ISN'T stolen from Nintendo this time, or by anyone, for that matter. name: LoveCrafting
summary:
Summon, dominate and sacrifice unnameable beasts for power in a card-based roguelite deck-builder. Embrace the power of madness.

Through a turn-based summoning ritual, you'll have to play your cards right, to dominate the creature while empowering its Strength, Power and Toxicity. The more powerful the creature is, the bigger the reward but the deadlier the risk. Death is permanent, so be careful about your strategy : You may regret going down the path of madness ...

"That is not dead which can eternal lie, And with strange aeons even death may die." 
- H.P. Lovecraft
Pitch
« Inspired by dreams, you embody a master of the occult arts aiming for the Ascension, a ritual supposed to elevate yourself to the rank of Divinity.
By summoning and sacrificing creatures and lesser deities, you will travel the world, searching for esoteric places where you can practice your art and gather power. »
Features

Build your deck to summon and dominate eldritch creatures. 

Conduct turn-based rituals and invocation where death is permanent. 

Recruit, Influence and even Sacrifice your disciples to gather more power. 

Choose the fate of your summoned creatures and assume the consequences. 

Dominate the Three Cosmic Horrors and face the Elder to complete your Ascension. 

Unlock new Characters to play as and new cards to play with each time you finish a game. 

About
Created during the game jam Ludum Dare n°49, Lovecrafting is developed by Nameless XIII, a french indie studio from Toulouse. It is a roguelite card and deck-building game, in which the player summons a creature, with the objective of making it more and more powerful while surviving its attacks.

name: Frost League
summary:
Frost League is Dystopian realistic FPS story about criminals of banking experts. Realistic&Cinematic graphics, comic style scenes and more.

2 White Collar Workers

Timur Eroluk and Roger Orfeus sell private loans in exchange for money and assets at the international bank where they work. They offer loans to customers who can't get loans to make big profits at a young age.
Timur and Roger, who took the opportunity when the economic crisis approached and provided loan conditions for private customers and similar excuses, established a small bank of their own inside the bank. Strange accounting results catch up with them and they get into illegal paperwork for the mafia and gangs.

Realistic FPS experience, comic book technique storytelling technical and graphical improvements, day and night light simulation and many more improvements.
Key Features:

Dystopian&Tactical Gameplay

Try old and new production weapons.Specialize in firearms.

Meet the Gang

Meet Kruslin Fyodorovich Popov, Lorenzo, Theobold and more. Experience the untold stories of those behind the smuggling.

Provide Justice

Fight the gangs and the mafia with the equipment you have. Become a hero who reveals the truth in this brutal journey.

Experience A Brutal Country

Sunflower fields, canyons and skyscrapers... See and experience all over Deuken City.

name: Descentium
summary:
Whilst researching the mysterious new element Descentium, A remote facility in Southeast Asia has gone radio silent. Alina, an elite operative who works for Descent Laboratories has been sent to investigate. Will Alina discover the secrets of the temple or fall into madness?

Descentium is a Rogue-lite First Person Shooter, in which you fight through hordes of monsters from another world, who have surfaced from deep within a Cambodian temple. Unlock amalgamated weapons, scientific trinkets and more as you discover secrets about those who came before you and the origins of the mysterious element... Descentium.

As Alina, you will wield the power of the rifts and weapons corrupted by their touch. Push through the temple to find the source of this incursion, while growing stronger, revealing the temple's secrets and the downfall of those that came before you with every run.

The void is ever shifting and uncertain, choose from a range of boons that will enhance your abilities and customize your weapon with a variety of upgrades. There is a broad range of builds to discover in order to fit the play style you want.

A new challenge awaits as you step through the portal each time into a randomly generated sequence of arena style rooms. Use the Descentium Fabricator to create permanent upgrades and add new temporary buffs to the ritual tables and portals, giving yourself the advantage the next time you explore the temple.

name: Poly Memory: Birds
summary:
Cute, relaxing, polygonal memory game with birds.

Poly Memory: Birds— cute, relaxing game with pictures of different birdy that will test your memory. The object of the game is to find paired pictures to pass the level.

There are many cards with different pictures of birdy, each of which has its own pair. You can open only 2 cards at one time. When opening new ones, the previous cards are closed again and you need to remember their location. When you open 2 identical cards, they will disappear. Thus, you must to find a pair to all cards, keeping in mind the location of the pictures.

In Poly Memory: Birds:

- 50 levels
- Polygonal art
- Achievements
- Relax music

name: Tilefinder
summary:
Slay bizarre monsters and humans alike as you venture through the procedurally generated kingdom in this turn-based, rogue-like RPG. Explore the various characters and locations of the realm to find the legendary Tile shards, and seal the evil back beneath the castle!

Tilefinder is an indie rogue-like turn-based grid RPG in which you slay hordes of monsters through a procedurally generated kingdom to find the legendary Tile shards! While excavating the castle, a floor tile came loose, releasing eldritch corruption that overtook the kingdom. Now, with the floor tile broken, it is your job to bring all the pieces together and assemble the Tile to seal the evil back where it came from! 

Tilefinder is my passion project; having worked on it solo for years, it has finally come to reality! Although it has bizarre encounters and whimsical dialogue, make no mistake: Tilefinder can be a difficult game in which every choice matters!

Simple Yet Deep Combat
Pick your characters of choice and advance through procedurally generated kingdom maps and slay enemies in a tactical combat game that plays like chess! There are loads of interactions to explore and combos to try on the board! 

Will you die? Probably. Can you succeed in the end? Absolutely! Each run, you will encounter different enemies, spells, and most importantly, different loot - each time, another opportunity to show your best!

Tons of Content
Pick 2 out of 3 playable characters and march on! Each character is unique and has over a dozen learnable spells (which you can get randomly, by the way), so each run will make you adapt your strategy to your spell and item options as you battle your way to the Tile shards! The game includes:

 3 playable classes, each with a unique set of spells
 Over 35 distinct monsters
 11 uniquely designed bosses
 Over 100 items and passive treasures

All these make for tons of different strategies and maps to discover as you go, and even more secrets, Easter eggs and special interactio

name: The Last World

The Last World is a sci-fi simulation game with elements of space, modding and automation in which the player has to discover new planets and terraform them.

The world that we all knew and loved so well is dead. He was killed by a bacterium born in a test tube of a scientist who was trying to create a panacea - a cure for all diseases. The result is one - the disappearance of all life on the planet. On the verge of extinction, people created the "Ironborns" project - an artificial intelligence whose goal is to find a planet suitable for the existence of biological organisms in the endless ocean of stars and give a person a second chance to exist.

The player will have to build and develop his base, explore, trade and much more. The game features a factory mechanic where the player can produce more expensive resources for sale or upgrades. The player will extract resources from the bowels of the planets and process them to obtain components that are more expensive to manufacture. The Last World is a sandbox where the player is free to choose his own path.

You control robotic mechanisms (robots) that have landed on the planet to complete their mission. During the game, you have to build buildings, manage the economy, explore the territory and study the area that surrounds you.

Your mission is to give people a second chance, give them hope and a new home.

The game generates planets - from deserted, lifeless planets to heavenly giants.
Each planet is unique and will dictate its own rules for the game. Every planet is a challenge. You will have to explore the place of deployment to make sure that it has all the necessary resources to build and strengthen the base. Explore flora and fauna, always be one step ahead.

name: 三国仁义传
summary:
书入连环画，梦回山海三国！《三国仁义传》是一款由个人独立开发的2.5D银河恶魔城动作游戏。在极具东方韵味的手绘线条中，你将化身失忆刺客，闯入人类与《山海经》妖兽共存的架空乱世。策马冲阵、寻宝破关，在极具挑战性的硬核战斗中，亲手撕开被神话扭转的三国秘史。

《三国仁义传》是一款由我个人独立开发的2.5D银河恶魔城动作游戏。

本作构建了一个人类与《山海经》妖兽共存的架空三国。画面风格完全由手绘线条勾勒，力求还原中国连环画特有的细致线条与独特韵味。你将在这个动起来的连环画世界里，展开一场关乎命运的硬核破茧之旅。

独创画风：动起来的中国连环画 

人物与场景均采用纯手绘设计，拒绝千篇一律的素材堆砌。我们用细腻的笔触构建了一个视觉独特的奇幻世界，每一帧都是跃然纸上的东方艺术。 

乱世真相：刺客、名将与山海妖兽

扮演一名失忆的刺客，在赤壁战后的乱世中寻找真相。这不仅是英雄辈出的三国，更是一个凡人与《山海经》远古异兽博弈的战场。你将结识各路豪杰，揭开一段被神话扭转、足以灭世的阴秘历史。

大好河山：风格迥异的华夏风光

主线剧情将带你造访10余个风格迥异的场景。从静谧的山水人家到残酷的铁血战场，从大漠孤烟的荒凉到林海雪原的肃杀，带你领略别样的中国风光。

找寻珍宝：能力驱动的深度探索

作为银河恶魔城核心玩法，玩家将在壮丽的山河间通过探索与击败强敌获得神秘珍宝。这些宝物将不断强化你的能力，让你得以抵达此前无法进入的隐秘区域，获取更强力的装备。

百态敌人：极具强度的BOSS试炼

七进七出：骑战与空斗的碰撞

不止于双脚行走。你将体验单枪匹马杀入敌营的马战快感，或是在半空中与妖兽缠斗的惊险。穿插于剧情中的多样化操作，将带给你持续的新鲜感。

硬核试炼：本Demo包含序章的三个关卡，流程约 30分钟。特别说明：Demo中的BOSS强度为故意设计，具有极高挑战性，是专门为热爱动作挑战的硬核玩家准备的试金石。

The game John Christian 2 tells the heroism of a young man in a spiritual battle, who after receiving the armor of God, begins his mission to spread the gospel to every creature. On his journey, John is taken by God to a village and discovers that many people are in need of his help.

Welcome to the John Christian 2 game installation. 

John Christian 2 is a third-person action game with challenging, spiritual battles of good against evil soldiers and masters.

The story tells of the heroism of a young man, who after receiving the armor of God, begins his mission to proclaim the gospel to every creature. On his journey, John is taken by God to a village and discovers that many people are in need of his help. In this spiritual battle, John will need to face obstacles and enemies who want to keep these people in the prison of the works of the flesh. 

To win and see lives set free, he will use the armor of God, the knowledge of the Word gained during his walk, prayer, and the power of the Holy Spirit to face the obstacles of this spiritual battle. 

Standing firm, girded with the belt of truth, wearing the breastplate of righteousness, and having his feet shod with the readiness of the gospel of peace, young John will continue his journey in preaching the message of deliverance. Using the shield of faith to defend himself against the incessant attacks of the enemy, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God, he will fight the good fight and keep his faith until the end of his journey.

name: Orbit Or Beat Extended Edition
summary:
Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various awesome music, control your ball, and dodge all the obstacles to get through all the levels. But be prepared to any unexpected and "unfair" gimmicks designed throughout the levels.

Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various music, dodge various types of obstacles, and successfully finish playing each music to go on to the next level. Be warned, though, the more progress you make, the harder (and even impossible by the looks!) the level becomes for you to finish.
How This Game Works
In each level, you will see a big circle and a small ball circling around the circle. Your main task here is to control the ball (i.e., put it either outside or inside the big circle) to dodge all the obstacles it encounters along the way and successfully finish the level. Each level is accompanied with certain background music, and it will be a lot helpful you listen to the music while playing the game since all the obstacles are positioned according to specific beats of the music.

But note that it won't be that simple; the game will do everything it can to prevent you from finishing each level. Most of the time, you will be required to "focus" on the beats and the obstacles no matter what the game does to you, such as changing the size of the circle, the position and/or speed of the ball, changing colors, and even showing off fake obstacles! Try to get through all those unfair gimmicks and eventually finish all the levels prepared just for you.
Features
The game contains various minor features for you to fully enjoy it, including:

Basic and advanced tutorial

Key binding personalization

Sync adjustment

3 selectable difficulties (easy, normal, hard) prepared for each music

Special difficulties set for ones who are willing to go through challenge

20+ different music

Online ranking system (To be implemented later)

name: Spread: Transmission
summary:
Charge, spread and take over your opponents’ cells in the turn-based casual strategy board game Spread: Transmission! Assert your dominance across various unique islands. The game is not over until the last charge is captured, so flip the board with a single thought-out move.

In Spread: Transmission your opponents will crumble under your wrath, as you strategically plant charges across the board before inevitably launching a devastating combo taking over the entire island and winning the game!

At its heart, Spread: Transmission is a board game. You charge cells to claim them and if a cell is fully charged it will spread, launching a combo and taking over connected cells. Win the game by taking over all of your opponents’ charges. 

You make the rules! Spread: Transmission is capturing the whimsical magic of house rules. Switch up the game at any time with “Labs”, a series of game modes that can be mixed and experimented with to craft beautiful and unique playing experiences.

Want to change the game up with boxes? We got you! What about a lot of boxes that spawn very rarely? Sure. Add a little fog for deeper strategy? Definitely! Spread: Transmission is about playing the game the way you like. A little change to the rules can lead to widely different matches.

Maps facilitate a fun playing experience and are also very capable of introducing gameplay concepts on their own. With over 20 maps to choose from and the ability to create maps on your own, the fun will never end. Design maps exploring various ideas like powerful combos, overcharging cells or just the concept of one-way-connections.

If level design is not your forte, that’s fine too! Just hop over to the workshop and discover countless creative maps and perhaps even your next favorite map.

Among other things, the full game will feature:

 Five mixable game modes in total (including the core game mode)

 Over 20 playable maps

 Online & Local multiplayer for up to 8 players

 Computer-controlled opponents

name: Tuwas vs MUDA
summary:
Real-time economic simulator of an up-and-coming company. Earn profits by distributing the orders to the machines as efficiently as possible. Expand the machine park to be able to accept more and more complex orders.

In this business simulation, you take over the management of a small business and try to increase productivity by avoiding MUDA.

Muda (無駄) is the Japanese word for meaningless activity. It is defined as "...any human activity that consumes resources but produces no value." - Wallace J. Hopp

In this game, MUDA is represented by the little colorful monsters that sit in the factory and do unproductive nonsense.

Productivity is represented by clever squirrels "Tuwas" (German for "DoSomething"). They are always productive and always work hard.

The more efficiently the operation is managed, the more Tuwas work in the hall. With bad management, MUDAs are everywhere and waste valuable working time.

Other companies send you inquiries for which you calculate offers with a suitable price. Always remember to stay profitable. Some of the inquiries are initially not lucrative and would be a financial loss for you.

So go to your office to negotiate directly with the customer and secure a profit for yourself.

If the companies accept your offers, the planning of the production begins.

Strategically distribute the orders to your machines. With clever planning, you can process many orders at the same time and still on schedule. If your financial resources allow, you can rent more machines, which will make it easier for you to distribute the work in the short term.

However, more machines cost more money and require more employees, which leads to higher expenses. If, on the other hand, you plan cleverly, a few machines are sufficient to meet the delivery dates.

If you do not meet a delivery date, the customer is not willing to pay the full price, which has a negative effect on your sales and thus also on your profit.

name: CLOUDED VR
summary:
Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday at the Cloud Hotel. This VR experience is a satirical commentary on our relationship with the virtual world through personal devices.

Our personal devices are so embedded in our everyday lives that it has become an extension of the body. It is the entrance to a world of seemingly no limitations; always and everywhere connected to the cloud and therefore to each other. A blessing and a curse. The utopian online spaces once imagined were optimized into money machines reinforcing anything that gains attention, reflecting a reality of extremes. The virtual online space exploits our feelings through social media and advertising. This experience lightheartedly investigates how we should design future online spaces.

In an attempt to escape reality, U, a user, wants to experience a relaxing stay at the virtual cloud hotel, a perfect stepping stone before one transcends to the Cloud, technological nirvana. Living in a digital world, U strives to satisfy their inner pressure to perform and reach the status they think they deserve. 

Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday in the Cloud Hotel. In this abstract narrative experience, it is up to you to figure out the rules of the world while your attention is diverted.

CLOUDED VR was created as an interactive offbeat VR snack of about 15min. by Uni_verse studio in collaboration with Antfood for RGBXYZ digital art gallery. 

Original idea by Vincent Boon & Enzo Soubra.

name: THE OFFICE ROOMS
summary:
A short exploration game blending liminal spaces and corporate dystopia. Explore an abandoned anomaly control facility and uncover its past and purpose!

A short exploration game set in the abandoned offices of productivity analysis.

Discover its past, purpose, and secrets!
// FEATURES //
INVESTIGATE ANOMALIES:
An abandoned productivity facility still hums with power. Your task is to inspect and contain the remaining “anomalies” - strange rooms that defy logic and design. Each anomaly has its own visual theme and behavior, forming a self-contained mystery to uncover.

CORPORATE HORROR:
A sterile, corporate setting slowly breaks apart into something surreal. Discover fragments of the facility’s purpose and the story of the AI that once ran it - and may still be trying to. Lights flicker, hallways shift, and the environment reflects your descent into its memory.

ENDLESS 9-5 PRODUCTIVITY LOOP:
Each shift begins in the central lobby. Select three anomalies to investigate, explore the facility to locate them, archive their data at the workstation, and return before “End of Day.” Progressively, the systems degrade - and so does your sense of what’s real.

LIMINAL WALKING SIM:
Minimal UI, procedure posters, PA announcements, and 80s-era tutorial videos guide you through your “duties.” But the deeper you go, the more the simulation breaks down.

A SHORT, IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE:
Built for fans of Backrooms, Pools, and Severance, The Office Rooms offers a 1-2 hour narrative experience that blends liminal exploration, subtle horror, and corporate absurdity.

summary:

In 1592, Japan invaded the Joseon on Korean Peninsula, initiating the Imjin War.

Bandits emerged across the land, and corrupt officials exploited the chaos to plunder the people.

In an effort to rectify this situation, an unnamed Seonbi embarked on the path.

As a player, you will encounter bandits, remnants of the Japanese forces, and monsters on your journey.

Using a bow as your primary weapon and a variety of skills and items inspired by the weaponry of the Joseon era, you must strategically utilize them to defeat enemies and reach Hanyang (modern-day Seoul).

Seonbi: Scholar of Joseon is designed to fluidly connect short actions, enabling players to string together combos and experience the thrill of direct combat.

Equip yourself with your unique skills and item combinations, assist the citizens in dire situations, and journey to Hanyang to rectify the chaos that plagues Joseon!

• 不论是耕种建造、经商行贾还是撰书写志，您可以自由的扮演任何社会角色。

•从垄断寡头到原始公社，投票选举到计划经济，玩家们可以自由的制定社会体制的规则。

2简练而千变万化的经济模型
• 模拟仅定义了劳动和交易两个基本概念，玩家群体自发的产生所有上层的系统：所有权、劳动关系、经济体制、社会阶级。

 • 不规定系统货币，以物易物的交易模式允许玩家使用约定俗成的任何货物作为货币，带您重新见证人类经济系统的成长历程。

3丰富多元的文化、社交生活
• 除开物质财富的因素之外，通过广场演讲和著书立说的方式，您同样可以在社会中找到立足之处。您的思想可以决定城市发展的走向。

4探索、扩张、开发、竞争
•殖民开拓是古典时代的特征之一。离开母城市进行探索，寻找新的宜居土地以从零开始。新生城市由于自然条件和人文环境的不同，将展现出显著的多样性。
从长安开始迁徙，和您的同伴一起为天府之国蜀郡铺下第一块砖；或者索性飘洋过海，圈一块宜居土地并为她取名罗马。

It’s winter at Arctic Research Station Delta. The last planes have left for the season, stranding the station’s inhabitants alone in the dark polar months. At 0835 hours, three of the station’s researchers return from a routine surveying trip to find the base in ruins. Something terrible happened, and our three intrepid explorers are determined to find out what… 

Navigate the twisted halls of the once-bustling Station Delta for clues. Normal environments dissolve into the freakishly colorful as you delve deeper into the base for answers as to what happened. 

Avoid roaming psychedelic entities as you investigate the base. Will you freeze up in a tricky spot and hope the creature doesn't hear you, or run for your life? 

Make chilling decisions with your limited resources. Your party is limited, but your options may be less so when you've been cornered by a monster. You decide who will escape with their lives.

name: Happy! the Hippo
summary:
Welcome to Happy! the Hippo, a previously lost 3D platformer collectathon, now brought to life on modern hardware. Roll, bounce, and dive through a handful of enchanting levels. Tackle quests, rescue frogs, and embrace the vintage charm of janky early 2000s platforming, broken glitches and all.

Welcome to Happy! the Hippo, a previously lost piece of video game history! Originally destined for a PS2 release back in 2002, this once-canceled 3D platformer collectathon has been resurrected and ported for modern hardware.

Roll, jump, bounce, and dive through several unique levels, mastering Happy's heavily momentum-based movement to traverse the level your own way. Chain together moves to reach the highest heights and the fastest speeds, picking your own path through each scenario. Tackle the game's challenges as you see fit, and discover that the most rewarding paths might require some creative thinking.

Experience the low-budget jank of early 2000s 3D platformers in all its glory. Purposefully, all bugs, glitches, and movement exploits are left in (excluding where game-breaking or just unfun). Breaking games, abusing console commands, exploiting glitches, and finding unintended ways to play is what got me interested in development. These bugs and jankiness are a huge part of what I love about these B-grade platformers, so I've decided to leave them mostly untouched in this game.

With almost no invisible walls, you're free to go pretty much anywhere. Want to build up an absurd amount of speed and blast across the map at Mach 10? Feel like bouncing your way to a seemingly unreachable spot? You can do all of those things and probably just about anything else. I'm working on this project because I love these kinds of games, at their worst and their best, and polishing away all of the rough edges would totally remove both the charm it has and the excitement I feel for it. This is a love letter to the games I grew up on, and I want to totally embrace the era this game is

summary:
A first-person horror game where you clean up after rowdy high school kids while also keeping a lookout for clues as to their disappearance. Scrub, vacuum, clean... die?

Just do a good job and pay no attention to any odd happenings in the hallways. It's just your imagination. Who is responsible for these missing teenagers? Is the kidnapper still in the school. Is it you?

Key Features: 

Gameplay: A first-person walking simulator with some puzzle-solving elements. name: Sphere Shootout
summary:
在这款2D游戏中，有半高掩体、呼吸回血，靠走位击杀敌人。

《圆球枪战》是一款线上玩家对战的战术射击游戏

2D画面，但系统是有3D高度的。

游戏中有半高掩体，玩家可以蹲在掩体后射击，子弹可以飞出掩体打到对面的敌人，但对面的敌人打不到蹲在掩体后的玩家。

如果玩家想要获得更远的视野，就需要从掩体后站起瞄准，这时敌人就可以从掩体对面打到玩家了。

游戏中采用呼吸回血机制，只要不连续中弹，一段时间后生命值就会回满。

游戏中可以远距离瞄准，最远的狙击步枪可以看到8个屏幕外的敌人，这时就可以在敌人没有察觉时偷袭击杀。

游戏中还有脚步声提示环，会出现在视野看不到的阴影区，玩家只要静步移动，就可以在敌人没有发现玩家时先一步发现敌人。

有了上面的核心机制，游戏中比的就不再是枪法了，而是走位与隐藏。这就把单纯的开枪游戏变成了战术游戏。

In this 2D game, there are half-cover obstacles, health regeneration, and you defeat enemies by maneuvering.

Sphere Shootout is an online PvP tactical shooter.

The visuals are 2D, but the system has 3D height.

There is half-height cover in the game. Players can crouch behind cover and shoot. Bullets can fly over the cover and hit the enemy on the other side, but the enemy on the other side cannot hit a player crouching behind cover.

If a player wants to gain a longer view distance, they need to stand up and aim from behind cover. At that point, the enemy on the other side of the cover can hit the player.

The game uses a breathing-based health regeneration system. As long as the player is not hit continuously, their health will recover to full after a period of time.

The game also supports long-range aiming. The longest-range sniper rifle can see enemies as far as eight screens away, making it possible to ambush and kill enemies before they notice.

There is also a footstep indicator ring in the game. It appears in shadowed areas that are outside the player's view. As long as the player moves quietly, they can detect the enemy before the enemy detects them.

With the core mechanics above, the game is no longer mainly about shooting skill, but about movement and concealment. This turns a simple shooting game into a tactical game.

name: メモリアルソング
summary:
誰にでも心に残っている歌というものがあると思います。そんな想い出の歌を久しぶりに聴いてみると、その歌をリアルタイムで聴いていた頃の想い出が蘇ってくることでしょう。

この「メモリアルソング」は、ただの歌が想い出の歌となる瞬間を描いた物語です。物語の序盤では、主人公達にとって普通の歌なのかもしれません。もしくは、まだ出逢っていないのかもしれません。
そんな歌が想い出の歌となる感動的な瞬間がクライマックスに待っています。その瞬間に驚いて、そして泣いて下さい。彼と彼女の想い出の誕生を、魅力的な歌とグラフィック、そしてシナリオでドラマチックに演出します。

このゲームが発売されるまで、もう少し時間があります。それまでにあなたの部屋を１度見渡してみて下さい。重ねられたＣＤやレコードの中に、あなたのメモリアルソングが眠っていませんか？　その歌を久しぶりに聴いてみて下さい。
「メモリアルソング」がどんなゲームなのか、少しだけ分かってもらえるかもしれませんから。

name: 片神名 ～喪われた因果律～
summary:
图片中的文字如下：

物語は、現在の日本から始まる。

どこにでもいる高校生「雨村 津雲」は、
夏休みの林間学校で出水のキャンプ場に出かけることになった。
起き抜けに不思議な夢を見て、なんとなく心に釈然としない気持ちを持ちながら、
遅刻ぎりぎりで集合時間に間に合い、バスに飛び乗ってキャンプ場へと赴く。
あまりやりたいこともなく、団体行動に任せて日程を過ごそうとする津雲。
そんな彼に、転校生の「結城 流花」が親しげに話しかけてきた。
はじめこそ戸惑いながらも、好意を寄せられて悪い気がしない津雲は、
楽しいひと時を過ごした。

しかし、林間学校の最終日。流花が突然姿を消してしまう。

流花の手がかりを求めているうちに、
津雲は『神隠し神社』として畏怖される出水神社へとたどり着く。
その奥社（おくやしろ）には、不思議な石の塊が祭られてあった。
興味を持った津雲はその石に手を伸ばした……

その瞬間。

光はあっという間に広がって津雲を飲み込んだ。
気を失い、再び目覚めたとき、かれは古代の日本にいた……。

Collect crazy power-ups, upgrade your weapons into tools of destruction, and escape from the robotic zombie horde - alone, or with friends.

FEND OFF THE HORDE
All you wanted was to sneak into Cyberhunk Industries to test out their dangerous new products, and maybe become a handsome, gun-slinging cyborg. As it turns out, Cyberhunk Industries is way ahead of you on the cyborg thing. Their latest failed experiment - the demonic robotic zombies called “hunks” - have been set free, and are out for blood (or… maybe oil).

To survive, you’ll need to fight off increasingly large and fast waves of hunks that will hunt you down through three hand-crafted levels. Learn how to navigate these arenas, evade the swarm of enemies, and start cracking some metal skulls to earn money!

Finding more than one of the same power-up will increase its effect. Up your attack speed with the Super Shades, and fire extra shots when mid-air with Dogfight.

TEAM UP
Fight back the mechanized freaks by yourself, or play online co-op supporting up to four players. Take on the hunks together, and revive your buddies when they’re overtaken!

QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory is a tactical card strategy game based on the work of Miguel de Cervantes. Lead Don Quixote on his heroic journey and experience some of the most familiar episodes of the classic novel published in the 17th century.

Somewhere in La Mancha,
in a place whose name I do not care to recall,
not long ago there lived a gentleman,
the kind who has a lance in a rack, an old shield,
a skinny nag and a greyhound for coursing.

A man much given to reading books of chivalry,
who spent his nights immersed in their pages,
until, from so much reading and so little sleep, he lost his mind.

QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory is an interactive tactical card game which takes you on an adventure. The artistic features of the title and game mechanics will captivate the player from the very first moment.

QUIJOTE: Quest for Glory was created based on appreciation of the literary work which has influenced most outstanding titles in the fantasy and adventure genre and about how feeling misunderstood or out of place can alter our perception of the world.

The game takes advantage of the educational aspects of the novel to make Cervantes' work known among young people across the world. For the first time, we will see the universe of Don Quixote (and himself) with the epic and greatness that the ingenious hidalgo perceived.

name: For Your Information
summary:
First person, single player game about employee who think's that leaving overtime (not paid) in this company is simple.

BEFORE YOU BUY!
This game is working progress and treat the purchase of the game as support in the game creation process!

About the game
"For Your Information" is a stealth game in which the main character tries to escape from the headquarters of the company where he works on
"paid" and "voluntary" overtime. After leaving the desk, he notice that the company is not satisfied with this fact.
During the game, we will visit many floors, offices, open spaces, and warehouses, where we will discover what this company actually does and meet employees who do not agree to such treatment and even want to do something about it!

Current state
Currently, the game has three levels that present different types of gameplay.
Thanks to these levels and playtest players, we collect feedback on various mechanics, which we improve on an ongoing basis.
Work is currently underway on levels 4, 5 and 6.
If you would like to share your opinion, please visit our server (the link can be found in the game's main menu!)

What's next?
Our plan is to have 12 levels with two different endings based on the decisions you make during the game.
The single-player game will outline the plot of the conflict, in which we will be able to continue to participate in the multiplayer version.

name: Sea Of Minds
summary:
Sea of Minds is an immersive game in which you have to move through a crowd by slipping into the bodies of the people present. As you move from body to body, listen to their thoughts, listen to their problems and try to help them. They'll sure be grateful.

Sea of Minds is an immersive game in which the player moves through a crowd by slipping into the bodies of the people in it. Once inside a body, the player can see through its eyes, but cannot move freely and must rely on the person's movement to move forward. They can, however, move into the body of another person.

Each person is different, and when the player is in possession of one, they can also observe their train of thought. By moving between characters, the player becomes aware of their thoughts, opinions and questions, and uses them to unravel the history of this world.

name: Descending Horror
summary:
Find your self in a long lost place with not a sane sentence spoken.

Plunge into the abyss of terror with Descending Horror, a spine-chilling horror game that takes you deep into the heart of a Dark, nightmarish cave system. As you venture further into the darkness, the air grows heavier, and the silence is shattered by the echoes of your own fear. Each step takes you closer to the unknown, where ancient secrets, malevolent entities, and psychological torment await.

Key Features:

Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate a hauntingly beautiful cave environment brought to life with dynamic lighting, eerie soundscapes, and a palpable sense of dread.

Survival and Discovery: Solve cryptic notes, uncover hidden passages, and gather limited resources as you strive to escape the ever-tightening grip of the cave.

Psychological Horror: Experience a descent not just into the earth but into the depths of your own psyche, where reality and imagination blur.

Dynamic Threats: Encounter malevolent forces that react to your actions, keeping you on edge with unpredictable encounters and escalating danger.

Immersive Narrative: Unravel the story of those who came before you—and why they never returned—through environmental storytelling.

Are you brave enough to face the darkness? Your only way out is down.

name: ANETHA
summary:
아네사는 호러 어드벤처 게임입니다. 당신은 실종된 딸을 구하기 위해 해킹범이 전송하는 파일의 암호를 풀어야 합니다. 그러나 그 파일들은 모두 실종된 딸의 숨겨진 비밀을 품고 있습니다. 파일을 풀고, 딸의 비밀에 접근해 나가세요. 당신은 "왜" 이런 비극이 일어난 건지 알고 싶다면 말이죠.

딸을 찾고 있어? 그녀는 지금 내 옆에 있어. 네 딸을 지키고 싶다면 복종해. - ???

비가 거칠게 내리는 날 밤이었습니다. 갑작스레 사라진 딸은 며칠째 돌아오지 않았고, 당신은 이혼 후 딸에게 신경을 써주지 못한 것 같아 초조하기만 합니다.

그 순간 핸드폰에 울린 알람은 기다리던 딸이 아닌, 낯선 남자의 협박과 정체불명의 파일 하나. 남자의 명령에 따라, 파일을 정확하게 풀어보세요.

당신이 몰랐던 딸의 행적이 수면 위로 떠오를 때까지.

사라진 딸을 구하기 위해 납치범이 건넨 파일을 푸세요. 지시를 따라, 실마리를 풀어갈수록 당신의 상상 속 따뜻한 꽃밭이 식어감을 느낄 것입니다.

생각보다 더 차가운 현실 속에서 당신에게 쥐어진 선택, 복수, 단죄, 마지막으로 부성까지.

과연 당신은 어떤 미래를 맞이하게 될까요?
현실을 반영하는 게임, 아네사

때로는 픽션보다 더 픽션 같은 현실이 세상을 배회합니다.

삶의 단면은 언제나 시리게 아프고, 내 안에 사는 괴물을 억눌러야만 하는 날들만이 이어집니다.
그리고 아네사의 시선은 언제나, 괴물의 선명한 눈동자를 응시합니다.

눈을 떼지 말고 지켜봐 주세요.

아네사가 제안하는 현실이, 조금 섬뜩할지라도.
당신의 선택이 만드는 미래

모든 미래는 득과 실을 동반합니다.

원하는 바를 이루려면 뼈아픈 고통을 감내해야 하지요.
사람들은 자신의 미래를 저울질하며 하루를 고민하곤 합니다.

그러나 그런 시간이 언제나 보장되는 것은 아닙니다.
내 딸의 안위를 알 수 없는 절체절명의 순간, 당신에게 주어진 시간은 오직 찰나뿐.

당신이 원하는 득은, 그리고 감당할 실은 어떤 것입니까?
실수는 용납되지 않는다

우리는 게임을 플레이하며 게임에 익숙해질 기회를 얻게 됩니다.
그러나 현실에는, 튜토리얼이 없지요.

사랑하는 딸을 구하기 위해서는, 모든 행동에 앞서 신중을 기해야 합니다.

납치범은 가혹해서, 그리 많은 기회를 주지 않을 테니까요.
사랑하는 내 딸, 내가 모르는 내 딸

아네사는 딸을 찾아가며, 딸을 알아가는 게임입니다.
그러나 당신이 알았던 어리고 순수한 딸은 더 이상 그 자리에 없습니다.

딸은 더 이상 당신이 기르는 방향대로 자라주는 식물이 아니니까요.
늘 곁에 있었다고 생각했지만, 사실은 단 한 번도 함께였던 적이 없었던 건 아닐까요.

사랑해 마지않는 딸을 위해서, 당신은 어떤 일까지 할 수 있습니까?

summary:
You are a young 8 year old boy named Liam, you recently got a ninja mask for a birthday present! You must protect the house from evil doers! You must be sneaky, and make sure to not get caught!

Little Ninja is a new stealth game from Brex Studios. Set in a suburban house, Little Ninja is about a young boy named Liam who sneaks around his house going on imaginary adventures as a ninja.

The game is designed to make the player feel like a kid again, by playing pretend with stuffed animals, thinking your parents don't see you when you are hiding behind a lamp, and just an overall ton of nostalgia with hidden references to childhood media that the team grew up with.

Players sneak around your house as 8 year old Liam, pretending to be a ninja. Gameplay is top-down 2D, and consists of hiding behind cover, quickly dashing out of view from parents and other enemies, completing small challenges such as freeing your stuffed animals, and acquiring items to advance to the next levels. The graphics are 2D pixel art similar to older an RPG art style. Movement is simple WASD along with a dash button. Players can interact with items on your current mission.

More content is planned for post launch release, the initial April 15th launch will include the fully playable campaign with 3 levels.

name: Twilight's Final Judgement Prologue
summary:
Twilight's Final Judgement is a noir turn-based RPG. Players will explore a 1940s New York where the secret elites of the world are the Greek Gods. You will level up and build upon 4 playable characters. Players will also talk with NPCs learn secret lore and form bonds.

Story
Based in New York, in 1949, the main character is Arthur Drake a detective who is a loner in his police force. One night Arthur discovers that his partner and sole friend is killed. By exploring the deeper details of this death, Arthur starts to come across cases that expand into an interconnected network of crimes. As Arthur, your job is to uncover the true reason for these deaths and get justice for the friend you lost. However, there is more than meets the eye to these crimes because the Greek Gods are at play. Throughout the game, the story takes a noir detective theme as well as incorporating Greek mythology. As Arthur discovers what the Gods have to do with these deaths he must face hard truths about his part to play in all of this.
Gameplay Features

A cast of four playable characters!

Challenging turn-based combat!

5 Chapter campaign that will update and release over time.

A bond system that allows you to learn more details of NPCs the more you speak to them.

An open world with different regions of New York as well the Underworld.

name: Battle of the Four Towers
summary:
Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points, but if they defend they lose nothing.

Four Towers have long been at war. For centuries the leaders of the towers were unable to conclude their petty fighting. No matter how often they were attacked, a strong defence always matched it.

Until history erased it. Events were rewritten and scrapped from books as people turned their battle into a ‘sport’.

The rich would gamble their money as the poor only hoped to win the grand prize. Teams would enter and leave as enemies. Alliances between Towers were formed, only for friendships to end. The power of money convinced anyone.

Gameplay
Battle of the Four Towers is an online 1v1v1v1 game best played with friends.
Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits.
Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points (LP), but if they defend they lose nothing. Each action takes 1 LP, so plan accordingly.

Battle of the Four Towers is in early access. Over the next few months, this game will feature many updates to add to its few features. At the moment, this game has the bare minimum. It is best to play games with your friends, but there are plans to continue development to add more features and fix bugs.

name: The Ambassador's Coterie

Slow-burn kinetic short story about two Ambassadors of differing stations, empires, and species reclaiming their common ground -- and other common 'areas'.

Ambassador Gauss isn't out to save the world -- but for love, they just might find themselves stopping a war before it starts.

But, of course, keeping your king's sword in his sheathe isn't easy. What should've been a ten minute, boring, meeting with a foreign dignitary becomes a heated, passionate, affair that throws into question the very foundations of their allegiance to their nation.

Can Gauss navigate these rough waters while still staving off war? Can they keep their secrets safe -- and in their pants?

Set in the Untamed World, a post-post-apocalypse (sic) dark fantasy world created by the Forgotten Workshop. Read as intrigue splashes up against romance, duty stains honor, and lords and lieges swap places for a set of hot, sizzling, moments.

 Kinetic Visual Novel

 Erotic Scenes with tantalizing text

 25 Event CGs

name: Cards of the Dreaming Dragons
summary:
How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family. Figure out what they are thinking and deceive them to win. Play with 3-8 players.

How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family and tests your understanding of how they think. In this world of fantasy, you must figure out what dreams other people had and accumulate more points than any other in order to win. This is an amazing experience with friends, because you want to figure out what they are thinking, all while trying to win. It’s a game of trust, but also of deceit and with its fair share of challenges.

How do you play Cards of the Dreaming Dragons?

 Each turn, a player is assigned the role of the 'dreaming dragon'.

 The dreaming dragon selects a single card from their hand. This becomes their 'dream'.

 They will provide a phrase which describes their dream.

 Then each other player selects a card from their hand which best matches the phrase given by the dreaming dragon.

 Once all players have selected a card, each player (except the 'dreaming dragon') will guess the 'dream' from all the cards.

How do you win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons?

 If all players correctly guess the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points.

 If no player correctly guesses the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points.

 If at least 1 player, but not all players, correctly guess the dream, then the 'dreaming dragon' and any player which correctly guessed scores 3 points.

 If a player guesses a card that is not the 'dream', then the player who put down that card scores 1 point.

Once all points are scored, this ends the turn and the next player takes the role of the 'dreaming dragon'.
In order to win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons, you will need to reach the end of the game board first. Ea

summary:
The Reflection explores the connection to an alternate dimension that contains all the matter of the world inverted. From the surface, there appears to be simply a reflection of light, but submerging into the water reveals that this world is completely tangible, mirroring the world perfectly.

This game is the passion project of a 16-year-old game dev who designed, programmed, and developed this game solo. Any support you give is greatly appreciated.

The Reflection is a game that offers a brand new view on space and matter. The game explores the connection to an alternate dimension called The Reflection that contains all the matter of the world inverted. The portal to this dimension is characterized by a plane of water. From the surface, there appears to be simply a reflection of light, but submerging into the water reveals that this dimension is completely tangible, mirroring the world perfectly. Even moving objects and enemies are reflected, allowing players to interact with them from another angle (literally).

Every aspect of the gameplay is carefully designed to utilize and expand the possibilities of The Reflection. Portals throughout the world enable the player to travel from a surface in The Reflection to its corresponding surface (now a ceiling) in the world. Some enemies exist in The Reflection and appear upside down in the world. Underwater sections of moving platforms disappear completely when reflected. The player also has a grappling ability that allows them to reach portals on the ceiling, which will become the floor once the player teleports to the corresponding surface in the world.

Experience:

• Mind-bending action situations: travel between the world and The Reflection to approach conflicts from a different angle, i.e. attack enemies from below by standing on the reflected ceiling above them (and below them in The Reflection)

• Challenging precision gameplay: complex platforming sections and intense combat encounters, formulate plans to defeat

Welcome to World of Stickman, an exciting real-time strategy world where you'll take part in epic battles of antiquity with Stickman heroes. Choose your civilization - Romans, Egyptians or Vikings - and go to war to rule the ancient world.

Game Features:

Epic Battles: Experience the scale of great battles in real time with hundreds of fighting stickmen. Control various types of troops such as swordsmen, pikemen, archers, ballistae and catapults to defeat the enemy.

Building and Development: Your domain starts with a small settlement. Develop, build buildings, gather resources and strengthen your army. Upgrade buildings to gain access to new units and technologies.

Campaign: Immerse yourself in an exciting campaign that reveals the stories and legends of each civilization. Meet unique characters, traverse key historical moments, and defeat enemies.

Multiplayer and Online: Challenge your friends to battle in multiplayer mode or immerse yourself in online battles with players from around the world. Show off your strategic prowess and top the leaderboards.

Unique Civilizations: Choose your side among a trio of powerful civilizations - Romans, Egyptians and Vikings. Each has unique features, units and strategic advantages.

Cartoon Style: Immerse yourself in a colorful world brought to life with a unique cartoon style an

name: SCALEPLANET
summary:
Somewhere in the third dimension there lives an alien Joe. He can't sit still. He constantly travels and explores the world and galaxies. This time he came across a new planet.

An interesting arcade game about a lonely astronaut.

Explore the planet with Joe. Control the jetpack using the keys.

 Careful gravity! On the way there will be traps in the form of saws,

 asteroids, and all sorts of fragments of an old civilization.

 - Beautiful graphics 

- Interesting gameplay 

- Good and atmospheric music 

- A variety of levels

- Arcade 

- Space

name: CRASH TEST IDIOT
summary:
You must destroy every car in the city.

You have been hired to Crash Test every car in the city.

This is a driving game with a lot of possibilities. The physics engine simulates every component of a vehicle in real-time, resulting in a fun behavior. With meticulous design, intensive research, and experience, the simulation recreates the excitement of Crash Test driving.

You must completely destroy ALL of the Cars.

Each car has its own scoring system.

What is the Highest score You can get ?

Use cool Camera effects like Bullet-Time, so, You can see every detail of the destruction.

Several different car types like Sedan, SUV and Hatchback with many different paint jobs.

Can You be the Top " CRASH TEST IDIOT " ?

name: Stay away from zombies
summary: When you wake up, you find that you are in some unfamiliar gloomy place, reminiscent of an old abandoned basement.

name: Ghost Bros
summary:
Ghost Bros is a 1-4 player co-op ghost investigation game where you and your crew scour the globe for proof of the afterlife...and stream it for profit. Travel to real-life haunted destinations, search for the supernatural, use CPU companions, and build an audience as you risk your health for fame.

Ghost Bros is a 1–4 player co-op ghost-investigation simulation where you and your crew search for proof of the supernatural... and stream it for profit! Travel to real haunted destinations, use Ghost Bros-branded equipment, and build your online following while trying not to anger the entities you uncover.

Features

• Full Twitch integration:
Let your Twitch viewers interact with you in real time! Viewers can vote on objectives, like who investigates a room alone or who taunts the ghost, and even trigger in-game events. Control exactly how they interact with robust options such as subscriber-only events, in-game commercial breaks, and special audience rewards.

• Unique team roles:
Play as different ghost hunting professions, each with their own investigative advantages:
Investigator, Medium, and Technician.

• Stream Manager mode:
Too scared to go in? No problem. Manage the team from a safe distance with streamer-friendly tools to operate cameras, switch feeds, and oversee the chaos. Perfect for real-life streamers and content creators. Stream Managers can also direct CPU controlled investigators to help out with the investigation.

• Single Player Option:
Add CPU-controlled Ghost Bros who will automatically investigate with you. Use voice commands to instruct them to various team functions like repair cameras, unlock doors, and investigate rooms. 

• Real haunted locations:
Unlock and explore real-world haunted sites such as the Pacific Northwest Shanghai Tunnels, each with its own mysteries and restless spirits.

Whether you’re in it for the money, the fame, or to help those plagued by the paranormal—you’re the only thing standing between us and what goes bump in th

name: I am OK
summary:
Join the talented photography student Neera on a captivating journey through her memories. Haunted by recurring nightmares, her life spirals into chaos, questioning everything. Involuntarily, she returns to a place she once left behind: her childhood home.

I am OK is a story-driven 2D adventure game about a young woman's journey through her traumatic past. It deals with mental health, thematizes its stigma in society and centers around one of the strongest human emotions: anger.

Sometimes it's okay to not be okay.

Immerse yourself in the captivating tale of Neera, who has maintained an emotional barrier throughout her entire life. But now, recurring nightmares shatter her inner defenses, throwing her world into disarray—from her career and studies to her personal life. Involuntarily, she returns to an unloved place she once left behind: her childhood home.

Embark on an extraordinary journey of self-discovery with I am OK, where the powerful human emotion of anger takes center stage. Explore the hidden fragments of Neera's past, delving into unique visual impressions and a world that evokes both relief and fury.

Are you ready to accompany Neera on this intense expedition, uncovering the secrets of her past and rediscovering her inner equilibrium?
Key Features

A thrilling storyline: Dive into a rich and deep narrative

A multi-layered female main character: Uncover what Neera has buried deep within her and discover the truth about her past

Unique characters, such as shadow creatures (and a cat!)

Bizarre dream worlds: Experience the intertwining of Neera's reality and her memories

Room-changing puzzles that influence the gameplay

Decision-making: Take influence on the course of the game

Handling anger as a game element: you decide on the use of anger

Hand-drawn graphics in 4K/UHD and charming frame-by-frame animations

Face past experiences

Neera's journey takes her through her memories, revealing secrets and delving into deeply buried thoughts. Along the

name: Party Quest
summary: Party Quest is a 2D MMO platformer chalked full of mini games (Party Quests), secrets, and more! Each unique Party Quest that you find and unlock will challenge you and your fellow party members to accomplish various tasks in a set time limit.

name: Package Inspector
summary:
Plunge into the dystopian land of Taxien and check packages at the local customs office! Which packages need to be sorted out? Which ones support the rebels and which ones support the state? Which side will you choose? And will you earn enough to pay your useless taxes?

The Year is 21xx 

You are an aspiring artist who would like to put a smile on people's faces. Unfortunately, you live in Taxien, the state with the most incompetent... uhm... I mean of course the most competent government in the world! In Taxien, Freedom is still very important!

You get the unique chance to work as a customs officer in parcel sorting! More difficult than you might think, because the job seems simple at first - you have to check the mail for damage and other small things - but with time more tasks will come. But be on your guard! The influence of the rebels continues to grow and we don't want anyone to think you might be working for them, do we? Ha ha ha... ha... ha....

Your task is to earn enough money to finance the fantastic freedom bonus of the state! At the end of the year you can choose where your money is invested in and, who knows, maybe your modest contribution will be the one that decides the fate of Taxien.

But enough talking, get to work! After all, these packages don't control themselves!

Package sorting simulator in dystopian style with increasing difficulty level.

Influence the world around you and experience one of eleven exciting endings.

Choose a side and lead Taxien to a bright future or to its bitter downfall.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Wild Animals
summary: Another new addition to the 1001 Puzzle series. Amazing wild animals in their natural habitat! Put the puzzle pieces together and observe the habits.

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats
summary: A new game in the series of 1001 Puzzles. Cute, funny, cozy cats will melt even the coldest hearts! Assemble the puzzle pieces and enjoy the cute faces of pets.

name: Mystery Solitaire. Grimm's Tales 5
summary:
Help Little Red Riding Hood reach her grandmother's house and protect her from the evil gray wolf.

The mystical and wonderful world of the Grimm fairy tales continues to immerse you in its unforgettable atmosphere.

name: Mystery Solitaire. Powerful Alchemist 2
summary: Return to the Middle Ages and become a powerful alchemist! This is a new sequel to the beloved game.

summary:
"전생에 널 죽인 게 나야. 이번 생의 널 살린 것도 나고.“

부인의 가족을 몰살한 남편, 그런 남편을 살해한 부인.
파국을 맞이했던 원수보다 못한 남편과 현대에서 다시 만나 주어진 시간 안에 재혼해야만 한다.
피를 묻힌 바리에게 분노한 신이 내린 불멸의 삶이란 벌을 청산할 수 있는 유일한 방법이었으니까.

“강해안. 너 신병 앓듯이 머리 아픈 것도 씻은 듯 낫게 해줄 수 있고, 
네가 그토록 사랑하는 아버지 우관수의 명예와 영관도, 내가 평생 보장할 수 있어.”


고요한 바다처럼 평온히 살길 바라는 마음으로 부모님이 지어주신 이름이었건만.
해안의 삶은 전 부인이라 주장하는 여자가 내민 종이 한 장에 의해 더할 나위 없이 파란만장해진다.
관공서 대표 양식 제10호. 그 밑에 적힌 다섯 글자.

“거기에 도장 찍으면 전부 책임져 줄게.”

혼인 신고서였다.

“그러니까, 결혼해. 우리.”

과연 바리는 해안과 전생의 악연을 끊기 위한 재혼에 성공할 수 있을까?

name: ラプシヌプルクル
summary:
惑星「ノーラ」。

三つの月を衛星として持つ地球よりちょっと小さな星。
地球と似ているようで割と違う気がしないでもない環境を持つ 色々な生き物が住む惑星である。
そのノーラの星の空の上にある浮遊島、ラプシヌプルクル島。

周辺の空は乱気流が酷く、よほど天気が良い日でないと 飛行船で訪れることすら難しい島。
このちょっと舌を噛みそうな名前の島では現在、 様々な古代の財宝が次々に出土されている。
そのお蔭でちょっとしたバブルも起きている――

……という設定をあんまり活かせなかった感じのダンジョンＲＰＧ。
性格的に魅力が無い女の子がそのラプシヌプルクル島とかいう所にある
スマウグ大迷宮という場所を調査するのが主なストーリーの内訳で、
それ以上でもそれ以下でもない。

name: Why Me
summary:
3D 第三人称永久死亡攀爬/跑步/游泳游戏，难度渐进。有些陷阱相当乏味。 设置记录时间或记录死亡计数。 问题是“你能打败吗？”游戏？

'为什么是我' -> 攀爬 -> 死亡 -> 诅咒开发者 -> 重复。
 你被困在海洋中央的一块奇怪的岩石上，唯一的出路就是向上。

了解你的眼手协调水平。

提防致命陷阱。

播放永久死亡模式以设置最快的运行时间。

或者只是通过检查点轻松一下（无计时器）。

尝试保持较低的死亡计数。

你知道你可以做到每次跌倒或死亡时都能跑得更好。

考验你的耐心。

设置全球记录

这不仅仅是另一个攀爬游戏。
所以，准备好在升级过程中体验渐进的难度。

你扮演诺兰的角色，他被困在海洋中央的一块奇怪的岩石上。

无处可逃，海洋广阔，充满危险的生物。

你的上方是一条充满难以导航的物体和致命陷阱的道路，也许它是由某些更高维度的生物创造的游戏盒创建这个是为了摆脱他的无聊，然后看你尝试。

奇怪的是死亡在这里只是一个计数，无论你怎么死，你都会重生到岩石底部。

3D 3rd Person Perma-Death Climbing/Running/Swimming Game with progressive difficulty. Some Traps are unfairly tedious. Set a Record Time or Record Death Count. The Question is "Can you beat the game ?"

"Why Me" -> Climb -> Die -> Curse developers -> Repeat.

You are stuck on a strange rock in the middle of the ocean, the only way out is to go up.

Know your Eye-Hand coordination level.

Beware of deadly traps.

Play Permanent death mode to set fastest run time.

Or just take it easy with checkpoints (no timer).

Try to keep a low death count.

You know you can do a better run each time you fall or die.

Test you patience.

Set Global Record

This is not just another climb game.
So, be ready to experience progressive difficulty as you move up.

You play the character of Nolan, who is stuck on a strange rock in the middle of the ocean.

There is no escape, the ocean is vast and full of dangerous creatures.

Above you is a way full of hard to navigate objects and deadly traps, perhaps it is a playbox created by some higher dimensional creature who created this to get rid of his boredom and watch you try.

The strange thing is Death is just a count here, no matter how you die, you spawn back at the bottom of rock.

Please use the discord link to directly connect with the developer and drop your feedback about game, any bug report or suggestions.

summary:
《Unsleepable》是一个有着悬疑故事的 3D 恐怖游戏。主角——麦克·索雷斯，要在这个村庄中找到事情的真相，并离开这个村庄。

故事：

麦克·索雷斯 是一名 16 岁的高中生，某一天下午放学准备回家，班里的一名女同学邀请去她所住在的村庄做客，但事情开始诡异了起来，麦克·索雷斯 意识到，这个村庄已经被诅咒，他要做的，要在这个村庄中找到事情的真相，并离开这个村庄。

特色：

古老经典的游戏画面

打破第三面墙

惊险的追逐战

与游戏中的角色产生联系

悬疑的剧情

"Unsleepable" is a 3D horror game with a suspense story. The main character -- Mike Sorris ,had to find out the truth in this village, and leave the village.

Story:

Mike Sorris is a 16-year-old high school student. One afternoon, after school, he was ready to go home. A female classmate in the class invited him to visit the village she lived in, but things began to be strange. Mike Sorris realized that the village had been cursed. What he had to do was to find out the truth in the village and leave the village.

Features:

Old and Classic graphics

Break the third wall

Thrilling chase

Contact with the charactors

Suspense plot

name: Banner of Blood
summary:
沉浸在充满 Rogue-like 元素的不断变化的动作角色扮演游戏中。作为指挥官，带领你的部队穿越随机生成的战场。用稀缺资源养活你的军队。与野蛮的兽人交锋，并召唤箭雨来击败强大的敌人。

都城求援，科维拉人民不会孤立无援。但在目睹了将领倒下的恐怖场景后，你的军队被击溃了。作为幸存下来的最高级别军官，你必须领导你的人民并重组队伍。

《鲜血旗帜》是一款充满动作和 Rogue-like 元素的中世纪奇幻游戏。 玩家将发现自己面临着不断增长的邪恶势力，依靠他们的勇气和强大的圣物来抵御强大的敌人大军。

穿越兽人控制的广阔荒野，到达王国的腹地。每一次旅程都将是独特且充满挑战的。

重组分散的部队并招募志愿兵。在未来的战斗中，你需要任何能使用武器的人。

夺回在混乱中丢失的遗物，因为它们是取胜的关键。

与嗜血的可怕怪物战斗。

Permadeath - 你很强大，但并非无敌。 即使你倒下了，你的勇气也会为下一个勇敢的灵魂铺平道路。

直接控制英雄的战斗和行动，

指挥你的部队或通过主动战术能力增强他们的能力，做出实时决策。

谨慎选择每个路径点，时刻保持警惕 应对潜伏在阴影中的危险。

面对意外事件和挑战。 有些决定会很困难，但却是必须的。

An ever-shifting action RPG rich with Rogue-like elements. Lead your troops across randomly generated battlefields as a commander. Clash blades with savage orcs, and call a hail of arrows to vanquish monstrous foes.

The capital calls for aid, and the people of Konvila will not stand alone. But after witnessing the horrifying scene of the commander's death, your army was routed. As the highest-ranking officer to survive, the responsibility falls to you, captain, to lead your people and reform the line.

The Banner of Blood is a medieval fantasy game infused with action and rogue-like elements. Players will find themselves up against the ever-growing forces of evil, relying on their courage and powerful relics to fend off formidable armies of foes.

Make your way through the vast orc-infested weald to reach the kingdom's heartland. Every journey will be unique and filled with challenges.

Regroup your scattered troops and recruit volunteers. You'll need anyone who can wield a weapon in the battles ahead.

Reclaim the relics lost in the chaos of war, as they hold the keys to victory.

Battle dreadful monsters that have joined forces with bloodlust-driven orcs.

Permadeath - You are strong, but not invincible. Even if you fall, your courage will pave the path for the next brave soul to take up the mantle.

name: Saber Ship
summary:
包含各种奇怪玩法的音乐节奏游戏

双剑、双手大剑、电弧、棍棒、拳头和一些叫不上名字的武器构成了你的武器库，还有一些离谱的隐藏武器，比如手枪和鞭子

你的敌人是各种棘手的飞行器，分裂、抵抗多重攻击、组成阵型旋转...

100首节奏劲爆的音乐

想玩到自己编辑的乐曲？内置的自定义谱面编辑器，可以一边编辑一边试玩

免费DLC是可收集内容

包含基于数十个AAA级角色的100款皮肤（作为化身使用），附带一些武器皮肤

A musical rhythm game with a variety of strange gameplay

Double sabers, two-handed sword, electric arc, stick, fist, and some nameless weapons make up your arsenal, along with some outrageous hidden weapons like pistol and whip.

Your enemies are all kinds of tricky flying machines, splitting, resisting multiple attacks, forming formations and spinning...

100 pieces of music with a powerful beat.

Want to play your own edited music? With built-in custom track editor, you can play while editing.

Free DLC is collectable content.

Includes 100 avatar skins based on dozens AAA characters, with some weapon skins.

name: Lucky Villager
summary:
幸运村民是一个硬核2D平台游戏，你扮演一个乡巴佬谁去寻找黄金被妖精偷走。 收集黄金，避免陷阱和敌对生物走出森林财富和生存。

幸运村民是一个令人兴奋和具有挑战性的跳板游戏，在那里你开始一个危险的旅程，以恢复丢失的黄金和拯救你的村庄。 这一切都始于一个事实，即你发现了一个古老的藏宝图，通向一个由邪恶的妖精守卫的森林，他们不想放弃他们的黄金。 你必须穿过森林，克服障碍，避免陷阱和战斗敌人，以收集尽可能多的黄金。％在这个游戏中，充满了明亮的像素图形和动态水平，你将面临一个不断增加的难度。 你的跳跃和躲避技能将在每一步进行测试，以及在每个级别，新的困难等待着你去克服，以实现你的目标。主要特点： 硬核游戏与不断的挑战。有趣和多样的水平充满了陷阱和敌人。 
不寻常的敌人

妖精谁保护他们的黄金.简单但迷人的像素图形和丰富多彩的气氛。 
Collective Element

收集黄金以获得最佳结果和发现。

Lucky villager - The luckiest villager goes hunting for gold! Take all the treasure from the evil leprechauns before they chop you into juicy bacon in this hardcore platformer!

Lucky Villager is a 2D platform game where you take on the role of a villager on a journey to save a village.

troubled times have come, your village has been surviving for more than a year, how can you find a very old treasure map in your attic and you don’t believe that this is possible, lipricons? A few years later, when there was no trace left of the village, you, a traveler who left his native land, without leaving the thought of a mythical place, went in search of that very mysterious gold of lipricons. Having reached a very dense forest, you stumble upon evil lipricons on your way, protecting their gold, go around all the lipricons, collect as much gold as possible and leave this terrible forest.

- Nice graphics by Teonni

- Nice soundtrack by Jironnuk

- captivating story

summary:
战利品是一个行动平台游戏，你保卫你的宝藏从盗贼使用有限的武器库和跳过敌人的头。 通过用等离子球摧毁邪恶的小偷来保护您的储蓄！

在战利品的战争，你必须保护你的宝贵财富从无情的小偷谁寻求窃取所有的战利品！ 在这个街机游戏中，你必须使用有限的弹药，跳过敌人的头部并用等离子球摧毁它们。 确保总是拿起新的收费，因为弹药是有限的，而且每次都有越来越多的敌人。

游戏特点：

无尽的行动

游戏不仅限于水平-你不断地战斗敌人的波，试图坚持尽可能长的时间，并保护你的宝藏。％

使用等离子球摧毁敌人，但要小心-他们的数量有限。 收集新的弹药继续防御。 
平台元素

跳过敌人的头部以避免伤害并使用敏捷性和策略击败敌人。 
增加难度

随着每一波新的盗贼，敌人的数量和速度都在增加，这需要你越来越多的精确性和反应。每个新的阶段，敌人都变得更加狡猾和危险，创造了一场真正的生存斗争。

name: The Dream Team
summary:
A fanmade game about Mr. Fruit and the Dream Team. A semi-linear turnbased RPG puzzle game where you play as Fruit, Rob, Blue, and Poppy to save reality from permanent sleep. Plenty of references, and a story deep enough to have things to spoil.

The people of reality are falling into permanent slumber, never being able to wake up. With the help of the Dream Witch Poppy, Fruit, Rob, and Blue will enter the Dream Realm, a space where all dreams converge. There they will enter the dreams of their friends and try to wake them up from the inside.

Join our heroes as they save many familiar faces within the Dream Realm. Return to reality to spend time with friends, record content, and gear up for your next adventure!

The more people you save, the more you can weaken the gate at the end of the Dream Realm to get inside and strike down whoever or whatever is putting people into permanent sleep.

name: BrVR Backrooms Virtual Reality
summary:
Explore 120+ Backrooms levels in a massive single‑player survival adventure. Build, craft, fight, or just wander endless liminal spaces shaped by the community.

BrVR Backrooms Virtual Reality
 Step into the most comprehensive VR recreation of The Backrooms ever created. 
 Featuring 120+ authentic levels, 60+ entities, and complete freedom to explore the way you want in true solo isolation.

BrVR delivers the definitive Backrooms experience in virtual reality.
 This is not another low‑effort maze game or puzzle‑heavy multiplayer project.
 It is a carefully built single‑player survival experience that recreates the strange reality of liminal spaces with atmosphere and depth.

THE BACKROOMS EXPERIENCE

120+ AUTHENTIC LEVELS
 Explore the renowned yellow halls of Level 0, the mysterious Poolrooms, Level Fun, and countless other distinctive spaces inspired by established Backrooms lore. The game is currently in Phase 4 of a five‑phase upgrade plan focused on improved graphics, lighting, signage, optimization, new voice work, NPCs and more.

60+ ENTITIES AND CREATURES
 Face a wide range of inhabitants, from friendly wanderers to hostile forms. You can fight, flee, build traps, or befriend helpful entities that will follow and assist you. 
 Don’t like entities in The Backrooms? Just turn them off in the EXTENSIVE settings menu.

TRUE SOLO EXPERIENCE
 BrVR is single‑player by design. We believe The Backrooms should convey isolation and unease, so the experience remains purely personal and atmospheric.

PLAY YOUR WAY

No Entities Mode for quiet, pure exploration 

No Gore Mode for players wanting a less intense experience 

No Firearms Mode for melee or stealth survival 

Sandbox Mode spawn items, experiment, and test mechanics freely

MORE THAN JUST LIMINAL HALLWAYS

name: XXX Talent
summary: In this choice-based adult visual novel you play Frank, a bully by his own admission who, after living a life of hardship and poor choices, agrees to do a job he believes to be degrading and boring, and finds himself in paradise.

name: Towerland
summary:
A 2D top-down 4-directional shooter with RPG and roguelite elements.

The land of Towerland; a land inhabited by knights known all around the world for their courage, has been invaded by Diabot, a hominous entity that conquers reigns with its army of ruthless creatures.

Many brave knights fought against Diablot, trying to bring back peace in their homeland but, one after another, they were defeated and savagely murdered.

Nowadays, the terrible monster still lives in the last floor of the tower of Towerland's castle, where he rules undisturbed.

After years of war and famine, all the survivors left the devasteted region, except for one brave warrior.

The young warrior-mage who still lives in the devastated country is the only one who can try to end Diabot's evil hegemony.

If he will fail like his predecessors, the reign will be doom once for all.

FEATURES
:
- Five Bosses

- Collect money to buy new powerups

- 3 Different Endings

- 3 Game modes

- Dozens of different enemies

name: The Timekeeper
summary:
A third-person puzzle platformer set in a beautiful, engaging world. Players will learn how to carry and shift colors to solve puzzles.

The Timekeeper is the first title released by Symphonic Entertainment. You'll find yourself in "The Moment", a point in time and space, frozen at the collapse of an ancient civilization. It's your job to uncover the secrets of this collapse in order to leave a message that will save the future.

Players will be tasked with solving puzzles by matching colors and mastering platforming challenges throughout the world to unlock new areas and puzzles, progressing towards the final Keep. As the player progresses, they'll encounter new puzzle elements that will change the way they approach each sequence.

name: Conflict 3048
summary:
Real-time strategy and tactics on an alien world! Command super space soldiers against an array of alien hordes. Commander - we need you!

Conflict 3048 is a real time tactical sci fi game written by Matt Lloyd in 2022.
CAMPAIGN

You play as a commander in the invading army on an alien world, documenting your trials and tribulations as you wage war against the alien hordes. Your tour of duty begins in a small listening post near the front lines and soon has you fighting battles against hundreds of aliens in do or die actions.

ARMY FEATURES

At your disposal are infantry with assault rifles, flame throwers, heavy combat shotguns;mechs with laser rifles and flame throwers, medics with the latest in battlefield healing technology and also air support and artillery. Throw into the mix armoured personnel carriers that can fly to anywhere on the battlefield and you've got yourself a force worthy of eliminating the alien enemies.

GAME EDITOR and SCRIPTING

If you tire of the main campaign you can edit the missions with the editor with the touch of a button, or craft your own new campaigns with full scripting support. The scripting, editing and customisation ability is all documented. In fact the game even ships with source code if you wish to make further changes to the game mechanics. Switching between editing mode and play mode is seamless.

name: The Testing Chamber

For every action, there is a reaction... For every choice, a result... Dive deep into your subconscious as you wander the halls of The Testing Chamber & join hundreds of thousands of other players in one of the biggest & most successful social experiments ever performed.

The Testing Chamber

Unlock your mind in ways never done before and experience new found knowledge simply by wandering the halls of, "The Testing Chamber."

You will answer a series of questions that will reveal things from deep within.

You will perform a variety of actions that will present you with a choice to make.
For every action, there is a reaction...

Can you make it all the way through The Testing Chamber, and if you do, are you sure you want the answers you seek?
