name: Max Traffic
summary:
Max Traffic is a minimalistic traffic simulator.

Max Traffic is a minimalistic traffic simulator where the player controls the flow of cars by managing the traffic lights. It is a mini casual game to relax to, but also excel at, by trying to achieve the highest score.

Each level represents a flag, while the cars hold a minimalistic style. The sounds follow the same pattern by being abstract in their manner.

Features:

• Mechanics: As simple as possible, the players just have to press on the traffic lights to change from red to green and vice versa.

• Relaxing: The game is as stressful as you want it to be, with the time also available on fast and slow. Fast however provides you with double score.

• Competitive: For the hard working people out there, there is a scoring system for each level, at which everyone can excel at.

• Interesting decisions: Every level provides a different traffic management, making the players adapt to every situation.

• Abilites: Every in-game day the players get an ability to help with their progression.

Hope you get as many cars as you can across traffic! See you on the leaderboard!

name: NeoTerra
summary:
NeoTerra is a unique survival city builder where you face the endless winter. Will you be able to prepare in time? Will you save the spark of human civilization even after the whole planet is ejected out of the Sun's orbit and into the void of space... and at what cost?

NeoTerra is a strategy city builder and survival game based on what would hypothetically happen to our planet and human civilization, if it got ejected from Solar system into the void of space. It would be an unstoppable global apocalypse, where humans would have a very small chance to save themselves. Even if equipped with technology decades beyond our contemporary advancements.
Thus, NeoTerra offers a glimpse to a near future where humanity works towards surviving in vaults deep underground. To complicate things further, the setting is placed after the collapse of our current civilization.
THE BEGINNING
"It has been almost thirty years since the end of the Long Fall. Humankind had suffered so much during that period, it is beyond comprehension. Billions perished, and many more had their lives turned to hell. Even these numbers…billions…of people, are inconceivable in our present time. No wonder it all collapsed under the sheer weight of the masses…
We have started to rebuild our world anew, but it was not an easy task. Not at all. Thankfully, it is finally starting to bear fruit and give us some space to breathe! Now there is a young generation which knows the Fall only from the tales of elders and from the rare recordings we have protected. Nature has healed by a large part…people probably too. Hope is rising, even if slowly. Surely, we are far from the peak of past civilization, but our goals are not the same anymore.

The year is 1920. Time to take the reigns, call the shots, and mind your meters! Play as Vladimir Lenin as you manage post-revolution Russia.

name: Terra Flame
summary:
Terra Flame is a horizontal shmup inspired by the 90's. The feature is that you can switch between three types of weapons in real time.

Terra Flame is a horizontal shmup inspired by the 90's. 

Game features:

 A system that can switch between three types of weapons in real time.

 Includes arcade mode and caravan mode.

 Supports ONLINE RANKING.

 It is drawn with Pixel Art that imaged the 90's.

 Includes chiptunes using MD sound sources.

Story:
Humans who have advanced into the universe have completed the defense system and the huge computer STAR FISH to control it. This system maintained the peace of the universe, and many people lived in the universe. However, the defense system suddenly launched an attack on humankind. In response to this unforeseen situation, the special operations unit PHOENIX was ordered to start. The operation name is TERRA FLAME. Its purpose is to stop the runaway defense system and restore peace.

name: VR AirHockey
summary:
Giant air field hockey played on a fantastic field.

You can enjoy playing air hockey on a fantastic field with a huge size that you cannot experience in reality.

Various levels of CPUs are available for both children and adults.

name: Six Aspects
summary: Six Aspects may be the first Same Time Strategy (STS) game melding the tactical nature of turn based systems with the challenging demand of real time strategy.

name: Above The Law
summary:
Take to the skies in your VTOL Police vehicle. Use your radar to track speeders and chase them down, scan for contraband and stop heavily armed street gangs from taking over in this Sci-fi open world action game

Above The Law is a Police action game set in the futuristic vertical city of Utopia that spans 8km in every direction including up. You Pilot the Peace Hawk, a 6 DOF vehicle with VTOL capabilities and a multitude of weaponry.

Its your first day on the job with the Police Force and you cant wait to patrol the skies. There are a lot of people that don't think the law applies to them, they race around the city at dangerous speeds, rob banks, join gangs and terrorize businesses. Its your job to take them down with any means necessary and make them pay for their crimes.

The Police force is a private company that hires freelancers and you get paid per job instead of a salary. Use it on your ship and upgrade its performance, handling, scanners and weapons, to take on any task. 

You will have to patrol the city and use your radar to find speeders, scan for contraband and stop armed gangs from expanding their operations. Visit the local street food vendors to get tips on what is happening, just make sure to order 'the special'

When you have saved a little, you can spoil yourself with a nice car or two. Maybe even an apartment to call your own. It will take a while as the pay isn't much more than an guber driver gets, but you will do a good job and be an honest cop that is going to uphold the law. 

 Play by the book or take bribes. Will you be Above The Law?

name: Roaming The Stars
summary:
A sandbox, space-exploration survival game where you can build bases and explore other planets and moons around the star Craterous.

On a daring mission to the stars you and a team of astronauts are dropped at the star system 'Craterous' 100's of lightyears from your home world. You must explore the system and find out what happened to the rest of your fallen team. 

As you explore you can set up mighty outposts and defend them with state of the art Surface to Space Missiles or SSMs.
The vastness of space and having to make breathable air is not your only obstacle, alien sentry stations and outposts will be the deciding factor of your survival.
Being Stranded will not be all that bad, once the sun sets behind the hills you will be treated to a spectacular view of the night sky, millions of stars and the atmospheres of nearby moons to look at.

Features :
-Every Thing Moves, all planets, all moons
-Full Survival
-Many building options 
-Enemies scattered around
-Ai bases, you can raid them and use them as a place to build structures of your own
-There are more systems than just 'Craterous'
-Collisions (Asteroid and Meteor Impacts)
*This list will grow as more features are added

name: Zombie Death Quota
summary:
Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak. Grenade, shotgun, snipe and flame your way through the zombie horde and then evacuate in the helicopter.

Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak and evacuate in the helicopter.

Explore the island and find Bio-waste containers and neutralise enough Zombies to achieve the Zombie Death Quota.
Scavenge for guns, ammo, grenades and health packs scattered around the island to help you in your mission.

This first person shooter was first launched on the Xbox 360 Indie Games service in 2012, the XBLIG service was closed down in 2017. Play this part of gaming history which is preserved here today and support me by checking out my newest game Splodge Royale.
Weapons

Flamethrower: A Heavy Metal flamethrower.

Shotgun: Never be without one in an apocalypse.

Scoped Rifle: When you don’t want to move much.

Pistol: Infinite ammo.

Machine Gun: Short range, but very good when you are surrounded.

Levels

Play 13 increasingly difficult levels.

name: Apparatus
summary:
Lost, trapped, and alone within the Delta Labs. You must find your way out with your life, any slight mess-up could be your life in this 2D story platformer

You wake up, alone. In the land you find yourself in called 'The Delta Labs', you must attempt to find your way out seemingly endless amounts of caverns of lab equipment, top of the line technology, and killer security robots. You need to watch every step you make, assure yourself that you do not fall into pits, run into lasers, or into a bath of electrified water.

The entire facility is void of life, nobody is around, besides two other things. You and a mysterious Droid which you must avoid

Apparatus is currently in development and coming soon. The main campaign is expected to be above 2 hours long. Apparatus is a story based 2D Sci-Fi platformer with an additional level editor. The game is designed for those who are familiar with platformers but those who enjoy a mysterious story over platforming challenges will enjoy it as well.

name: Pet Vet 3D Wild Animal Hospital
summary: Be animal doctor to cute baby elephants, frisky zebra foals, adorable lion and leopard cubs and more! Help them get better by examining them and helping them heal.

name: Pet Vet 3D Animal hospital Down Under
summary:
Cuddle and play with lots of exciting animals, including sleek dolphins and bouncy kangaroos! Earn the animals trust by caring, feeding and petting them. Lot of work to be done in Pet Vet 3D Animal hospital Down Under!

G'DAY! There's never a dull moment for the Pet Vet! Cuddle and play with lots of exciting animals, including sleek dolphins and bouncy kangaroos! Earn the animals trust by caring, feeding and petting them. Then buy toys and games and get wild with the animals you have nursed back to health!

Enjoy lots of fun activities including hair and make up, shopping for new clothes, swimming, spinning and much more! Choose from various levels of gameplay or play in mission based mode.

7 Australian animal species (wombats, kangaroos and their babies, duck-billed platypus, koalas, seals and dolphins)

2 Characters to choose from!

Animals react when player interacts as doctor or animal keeper

2 Animal hospitals (land and water) and 7 kinds of pens can be built, expanded and outfitted

Leisure Activities: Our Pet Vet can kick back with all new activities including swimming, sun-tanning and even BBQ!

在这款充满复古风格的掌上冒险游戏中，通过滚动一个巨大的核桃来解开谜题。探索各色各样有着独特机制的关卡。帮助奇珂储备过冬粮食并找到回家的路！

奇珂的回家之旅

有着胖嘟嘟的脸庞的花栗鼠奇珂偶然闯入森林里的一个传送门，之后他就被传送到了一个魔法世界！在这里，他发现了许多巨大的核桃，但想把它们带回家可不容易！解决一系列独特关卡中的谜题和挑战，收集大量巨大核桃，帮助奇珂回到他的森林吧！

发挥你的聪明才智！

summary:
这是一个 2D 益智类的游戏，使用不同的物理形态突破重重难关，在这个被机器统治的工业世界上，成为恢复生态和拯救地球的唯一希望。

A Drop of Hope 是一款以机器统治的世界为背景的 2D 益智类游戏。在这个世界里，冷漠的机器人已经占领了整个星球，几乎所有的生命都被屠戮殆尽，大自然已经不复存在，四处弥漫着毁灭和绝望的氛围。

作为一滴有感知力的水滴，你是唤回所有生机的唯一希望。通过在不同的物理形态之间灵活切换，应对游戏中的挑战，突破重重难关，夺回属于我们的自然家园。
觉醒吧，我的朋友

水滴明白了自己的使命。但是只有在自然的法则和您的帮助之下，它才能推翻邪恶的统治力量，让这个绝望的世界重新焕发生机。
使用对您有利的自然法则

您可以在液态、固态和气态之间切换以获得不同的能力来应对挑战，还可以种植植物来恢复生态，结束机器人的暴政。

name: 可愛過ぎる義息子につられて、冷徹侯爵様のお飾りの妻を引き受けたはずが ~思いのほか侯爵様に溺愛されているようです~
summary:
幼い頃に母を亡くしたラシェルは、後妻と異母妹のデルフィーヌに加え、実の父親からも虐げられている。そんなラシェルのたった一つの支えは、全てを知りながらも傍にいてくれる心優しい婚約者・ローレンだけだった。
貴族学校を卒業したら彼と一緒になれる――居場所のない家からも解放される。
そんな思いで勉強にも必死で励むラシェルだったが……
「すまない、僕はデルフィーヌと結婚する」
卒業を間近に控え、唯一の理解者であったローレンから裏切られ――さらには、傷付くラシェルに、ローレンは愛人になるよう持ちかける。
驚き拒むラシェルだったが、彼を誘惑したのだろうと激怒した義母に娼館へ売り飛ばされてしまう。
身も心もボロボロになったラシェルが娼館へ引き渡される寸前に現れたのは、アスティリア侯爵家の若き当主・フェリクスだった。
冷たい美貌と卓越した魔力で知られる孤高の魔術師に、藁にもすがる思いで助けられたラシェルは――。

name: 枯れ専令嬢、喜び勇んで老紳士に後妻として嫁いだら、待っていたのは二十歳の青年でした。なんでだ~!?
summary:
「私のお孫ちゃん、かわいすぎっ」

20歳の枯れ専ヒロイン、若返った旦那様と最高の"ばぁばライフ″謳歌

転生前の60代女性の記憶を持ったまま異世界に生まれたイアナ・アントネッラ。
幼い頃から達観した様子は家族から煙たがられ、家政婦のように扱われ育つ。
実家の領地経営もうまくいかず、自分たちの浪費のせいで資金難に陥っている最中、
御年62歳フェルナンド・ステファーニ公爵との縁談の話が。
公爵は30年ほど前に妻を亡くしてからは独り身だ。

前世で60歳まで生きたため、若い男性は息子のようにしか思えない『枯れ専』の
イアナはロマンスグレーの老紳士に喜び勇んでステファーニ公爵家へ向かった。
しかし……。

「え？　ロマンスグレーの紳士はどこ」
イアナを待ち受けていたのは、どこからどう見ても二十歳くらいにしか見えない年若い紳士だったのだ。

トラブルメーカーの義理息子や、スーパーかわいいお孫ちゃんとともに
達観し肝の据わったイアナと、誠実で思慮深いフェルナンドが
騒がしくも愛しい日々を過ごすドタバタ異世界ファンタジー！

name: 追放された最強魔導師は、弟子の才女と世界を巡る
summary:
弟子は天才、師は規格外。
世界を揺るがす最強師弟の目的は――ゆったり研究旅行！？

魔法学院の教師・アルドは、『禁呪を使った』という濡れ衣を着せられ、学院を追放されてしまう。
だが、彼はこの世界で唯一の無詠唱魔法の使い手。その力の正体は本人にも解き明かせないまま、静かに学院を去ろうとする。
そんな彼のもとに現れたのは、学院主席の天才少女・エリシャだった。
「私は先生の魔法で救われました。これからもずっと、先生のもとで魔法を学びたいです。だから、先生……どうか、私も一緒に連れて行ってくださいませんか？」
無詠唱魔法を操る最強の師と、百年にひとりの天才と称される美少女な弟子。ふたりは各地を巡り、依頼をこなしながら少しずつ絆を深めていく。
やがてその旅路は、世界の〝理〟とふたりの心も変えていき──？
魔法よりも不思議で、誰よりも眩しい。
ちょっぴりドタバタで、あたたかな師弟ラブコメファンタジー。ここに開幕！

summary:
A story about a woman who lives alone near the forest.

"It was every day, practically every day, that I saw a little more of her in that blank in the mirror, a little more form, a little more substance, and now I see her in the night, though she sleeps in the night so she doesn't see me back. I tell the ranger I've seen smoke, that I think someone's living out there, I'm lying, of course, I'm lying so he'll so look, I want him to look because I think she's out there, I think she's alive, but he thinks I'm mad too, he always has, and I think he just comes round when somebody goes missing because he feels sorry for me, he feels I need the company, and in a dream I've seen a way to save her from a terrible fate."

As for the man who sought to apologise to the gods, his wish was granted. But Ardashir escaped with his life.

In 1989 a child sees a man die on a television screen, and she doesn't know how to save him. She spends her time watching the road into the Scheleirland National Forest from her bedroom window, counting the campers who went into the forest, never seeing them come back out. From next door she hears her neighbour sing. By 2015 everyone else is gone, her neighbour an empty shell, burnt out by the world. A family stops by her house on their way into the forest. She thinks, just maybe, she can save them. Maybe this time she can go back, and somehow save them all.

Split over 2500 hand-drawn CG, sixteen main endings, [ ] secret endings, and a narrative that shifts and buckles under the weight of past lives, this is the story of a woman who thought that, if she could try again, then maybe she could avoid a terrible fate.

Please note this game does contain rapidly flickering imagery that may cause discomfort and/or seizures for those with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

summary:
Protect the asteroid mine's reactor from swarms of supersized alien protozoa. This game's groundbreaking AI system uses machine learning to adapt to your strategy in real-time as you build and upgrade your defenses. Fight evolution itself.

Artificial Life vs Tower Defense
It's the dawn of a new type of life. These creeps FEEL different because they actually learn. In this tower defense the AI isn't scripted. Each protozoan has its own neural network that grows and adapts as you play through the stage. The result is enemies that develop truly emergent behavior. Even the developer doesn't know what they will do next. 

Fight Evolution
Protozoa can specialize in niches and gain new abilities depending on how you play. They will figure out how to get around your defenses or mutate resistances to specific types of towers to power through. The more resistant they become to one type of tower the more vulnerable they are to another type so the key is to recognize how they are changing and know the appropriate counter. You can try to bait them into traps but it will only work for so long. Stay ready to switch up your strategy when they start to catch on. 

Incredible Adventure
Protozoa is set in the future during the first ever manned mission to an interstellar world. Many of the stages take place on small moons and asteroids in orbit around a planet. View sunrises and sunsets every few minutes as you fight on a rock moving at thousands of miles per hour. The androids arrived in this system first to establish the foundations for bases and asteroid mines. These resources are vital for the survival of the colony. It's up to you to protect the reactors from the alien protozoa as they are desperately drawn to the power emitted.

summary:
单手驾驶，另一只手射击，在这款爆炸性的 VR 街机游戏中畅玩。Echo Wars 带来即时动作，凭借其防旋转系统无晕动感，拥有巨型 Boss、视觉混乱，以及既夸张又有趣的玩法。

Echo Wars 是一款干脆利落的 VR 街机游戏：跳上沙滩车，握紧武器，一切随即引爆。用一只手驾驶，另一只手射击，准备迎接一连串壮观关卡——巨型敌人、极端环境，以及每一关都会变化的机制。

从坍塌的未来都市，到潜伏致命生物的冰川，再到火山隧道、太空赛道、充满变异卵的实验室和被诅咒的矿井：这里没有暂停，只有精心编排的混乱。想要挑战？“残酷模式”会让你像在街机厅一样大汗淋漓。

Echo Wars 同时支持 VR 与平面屏幕（包含 Steam Deck），既适合短时的肾上腺素冲刺，也适合不间断的街机马拉松。

特色： 

创新的防旋转系统，彻底消除 VR 中的眩晕感。

兼容带力反馈的方向盘和运动平台（仅限 PC）。

支持 VR 模式与平面模式，兼容超宽屏和 Steam Deck。

独特机制：一手驾驶，另一手射击。

16 个关卡，多样化目标，三种难度。

Ricardo Fermín 创作的原创配乐。

Drive with one hand and shoot with the other in this explosive VR arcade game. Echo Wars delivers instant action, no motion sickness thanks to its anti-rotation system, giant bosses, visual chaos, and gameplay as over-the-top as it is fun.

Echo Wars is a VR arcade game that doesn’t waste your time: you jump into your buggy, grab your weapon, and everything starts blowing up. Drive with one hand, shoot with the other, and get ready for a series of spectacular levels featuring giant enemies, extreme environments, and mechanics that evolve in every stage.

From collapsing futuristic cities to icy landscapes crawling with lethal creatures, through volcanic tunnels, space circuits, egg-infested laboratories, and cursed mines—there’s no pause here, only well-orchestrated chaos. And if you’re looking for a real challenge, Brutal Mode will make you sweat like it’s the arcade glory days.

Echo Wars is compatible with both VR and flat screens (including Steam Deck), and it’s perfect for short bursts of adrenaline or full-blown arcade marathons.

Features:

Innovative anti-rotation system that completely eliminates motion sickness in VR.

Compatible with force feedback wheels and motion platforms (PC exclusive).

Playable in VR or on flat screens, with support for ultra-widescreen and Steam Deck.

Unique mechanic: drive with one hand and shoot with the other.

16 levels with varied objectives and three difficulty settings.

Original soundtrack composed by Ricardo Fermín.

name: Wild Blue Skies
summary:
《Wild Blue Skies》重塑了90年代经典的轨道式冒险游戏。加入Bowie Stray与Blue Bombers小队，在这场充满动作元素的怀旧之旅中，肩负拯救世界的使命，翱翔天际！

《Wild Blue Skies》是对90年代经典轨道射击游戏的全新演绎，以精彩刺激的方式诠释现代冒险。

翱翔于汪洋之上，翻越沙漠山脊，穿越险峻洞穴，与层出不穷的敌人激战，击退Grimclaw的势力。在盟友的协助下，你将为恢复和平而战，体验经典街机飞行战斗的惊险刺激！

《Wild Blue Skies》操作直观易学，无论对新手还是资深玩家来说都可轻松驾驭，而惊艳的视觉效果则使人沉浸于手工打造的动漫风格宇宙。凭借引人入胜的游戏循环、分支路径和惊险任务，每次飞行都是一场冒险！

Key Features

 体验经典轨道射击游戏的魅力，搭配全新现代的流畅操控系统

 探索丰富多彩的世界，每处转角尽是令人惊叹的壮丽景色

 与坚毅的盟友并肩作战，纵身投入这场惊心动魄的战役

 迎接紧张刺激的BOSS战和空中缠斗，对决神秘的敌人小队

 踏上征途，消灭邪恶男爵，探索隐秘路径与特殊任务

 成为王牌飞行员，通过简洁但具挑战性的计分系统，征服每项任务

Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

Wild Blue Skies is an exciting and modern take on the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. 

Soar over oceans, desert ridges, and perilous caves, battling waves of enemies and pushing back Grimclaw’s forces. With the help of allies, you’ll fight to restore peace while experiencing the thrill of classic arcade flight-combat! 

Easy-to-learn controls make Wild Blue Skies accessible for newcomers and genre veterans alike, while the game’s stunning visuals immerse you in a hand-crafted, anime-style universe. With its compelling gameplay loop, branching paths, and thrilling missions, every flight is an adventure!

Key Features

 Experience all the classic on-rails shooter action with new and modernized controls

 Discover a rich and colorful world with stunning vistas at every turn

 Fly through an action-packed campaign alongside a stalwart squad of allies 

 Take on exciting boss battles and dogfights against a mysterious rival squad

 Discover secret paths and missions on your quest to take down the evil Baron

 Become an ace pilot and master every mission through a simple and challenging score system

summary:
Zap Dem Rats is a third person adventure RPG of skill where the player helps Mr. Prez regain the Whitehouse. Along the way Mr. Prez transforms zombies into citizens and vanquishes his adversaries

Zap Dem Rats is a Third Person Shooter game of skill where the player helps Mr. Prez overcome his many adversaries to regain the Whitehouse. High score wins.
There is plenty of humorous dialogue as Mr. Prez traverses the city scape, and there is no blood or guts or deaths from the red ray and blue ray guns.
Mr. Prez narrates the tutorial explaining blue and red ray gun function, zapping of signs and the reward for delay zapping.

Mr. Prez must dodge the illogic bombs tossed at him by the Zombies, and when his mental health reaches 5%, his smoking hot White Guardian Angel transports him to a stunning Red Angel at Tommy’s Garage where she rejuvenates, and then returns him to the fray.
In our first scene, Mr. Prez fixes rigged voting machines, transforms zombie voters into good Republican voters or zaps them over to socialistic Venezuela and installs an audit team to correct the crooked vote counting procedures.

Our second scene is all about the fake media, rebranding the big six, stopping the broadcasting of fake media that damages your brain, changing the stupid lies of the media celebrities with the truth, and exposing the biased editorial staffs of two popular magazines. Of course, Zombies continue with their illogic bombardment activities and are transformed or sent to Venezuela.

The third scene is about your second amendment. It has a medical plaza perpetrating and exaggerating the pandemic, followed by Stalin and Hitler’s support of gun confiscation. You run a maze where five Senators expose their gun confiscation plans, and then you meet the 10 Representatives who have scary anti-gun legislation. Finally, you enter the Confiscation Depot where symbolically American guns packed in wooded crates are ready for destruction and Mr. Prez saves them with a magic force field and secures them with a stout fence.

We are accepting player design suggestions for completion of WOKE U, a partially completed scene with a football stadium and lecture halls on opening day with curriculum sign-ups. It is all about the stupid leftist indoctrination of our students at radicalized universities. ANTIFA, Pro-Nouns, multiple genders, what WOKE means and what they want, and even Russian aggression is targeted.

Our last scene pits Speaker of the House Nanci Haglosi and her dangerous Demi-Hornets against Mr. Prez in his final approach to the Whitehouse. There are waves of hornets each with the face of Haglosi culminating in a final wave of elite hornets which fly faster and have more powerful stings. Once all hornets are vaporized with the blue ray gun, Mr. Prez can proceed past the roadblock leading to the Whitehouse. There, cheering crowds greet Mr. Prez who gives a triumphant welcome home speech and the game ends.

Mr. Prez wins by returning to the Whitehouse, and a high score is a win for the player. Player navigation and aiming skills are important to gain high point scores. Easy to play, harder to master.

name: 飛天歷險國際
summary:
《飞天历险》是一款经典MMORPG，故事背景发生在「昆仑镜」所创造的神器世界，由于昆仑镜世界的秩序失恒，世界的管理者「镜王」便召唤玩家前来帮忙。独特的自由转职系统与天赋搭配，「善」与「恶」主线剧情等，各种特色玩法等着您前来一探究竟！

故事背景
昆仑镜，记载着现实世界中所有一切的上古神器，镜中世界中亦存在着一个映射现实的世界，而这个世界则是由十二位镜王共同掌管。
不知从何时开始，昆仑镜世界已经无法完全映射现实，多位镜王也失去了踪影，在查明原因为现实世界的人类所制造的「妄想」被映射到昆仑镜中，「妄想」变成生命且四处干扰昆仑镜后，镜王们便开始计划召唤现实世界中的人们来到镜中世界，处理这一切的纷纷扰扰……。
游戏特色
．自由转职系统
职业间的转换不再有重重限制，亦无需要新创或重建角色，只要这个职业是你想玩的，完成转职任务后，随时都能找转职仙人转换职业。

．附挂天赋，变化多端的组合
透过附挂天赋，即使是刀客也能补血，道士也能耍大刀，只要你想得出来，要怎么搭配就能怎么搭配，练的职业技能越多，组合也就越多越自由，玩法也越丰富。

．丰富的剧情内容
主线剧情不再单一，有着与人类共同奋斗的「善」主线，以及与妖魔为伍的「恶」主线，让你不再只能选择当个大侠。除了大时代凄美的主线剧情，还有许多轻松的小品故事。

．专业的运镜手法，电影般的剧情呈现
剧情任务不再只是单纯的对话，以如同电影般的「第三人称」视角，专业流畅的运镜手法搭配剧情上的互动，可体验到仿佛置身于电影院般的全新感受。

．参考传统黄历的命运设定
在建立角色时提供的生日与生肖，会根据中国黄历设计的系统计算建立自己的命格，而在游戏中会发现许多人与自己的命格有些特别的关系──宿亲、宿敌与真爱，每个关系都是一种缘分。

．以可爱的卡通呈现传统风味
觉得中国传统的元素过于沉闷死板吗？透过生动可爱的卡通贴图模式呈现后，一切都变的平易近人，且随时都能透过设定切换，让你能依照心情随时更换视觉上的呈现。
多样的玩法选择
．生活性与故事性
《飞天历险》拥有完整的生活机制规划设计，并同时具备丰富的故事架构。在游戏中，你可以扮演一个名闻遐迩的名人侠士，也可以扮演一名默默无名的市井小民；可以是闯荡江湖的英雄豪杰，也可以是经营一方的万元大户。

．打怪练功与生产炼化
角色的成长是游戏中不可或缺的一环，在《飞天历险》中，可以从事各式各样的职业。擅于战斗的职业可透过打怪练功增加经验值和提升等级，而战斗系职业可分为专司主动攻击和负责补血、辅助攻击。擅于生产的职业可透过采集和炼化增加金钱收入，生产系职业中亦可分为负责炼化武器、防具及道具与提供原料。

．副本挑战
除了打怪练功与生产炼化，亦有各式各样的大、小型副本可挑战，你可以当个独行侠挑战小型副本，亦可以与公会成员或三五好友组成队伍一同挑战大型副本。

．每日活动
厌倦了一直打怪的生活吗？在《飞天历险》中，每天都有各式各样的小活动，像是解放双手的泡温泉，眼明手快的飞拼不可等，许多趣味小游戏等着你来参加。

．个人主义与社群关系
在《飞天历险》中，玩家可以成立公会认识各地英雄豪杰，也可以结成师徒、朋友与恋人等特殊关系；亦可以自立更生、特立独行，隐性埋名做个独行侠。

《飛天歷險》是一款經典MMORPG，故事背景發生在「崑崙鏡」所創造的神器世界，由於崑崙鏡世界的秩序失恆，世界的管理者「鏡王」便召喚玩家前來幫忙。獨特的自由轉職系統與天賦搭配，「善」與「惡」主線劇情等，各種特色玩法等著您前來一探究竟！

故事背景
　　崑崙鏡，記載著現實世界中所有一切的上古神器，鏡中世界中亦存在著一個映射現實的世界，而這個世界則是由十二位鏡王共同掌管。
　　不知從何時開始，崑崙鏡世界已經無法完全映射現實，多位鏡王也失去了蹤影，在查明原因為現實世界的人類所製造的「妄想」被映射到崑崙鏡中，「妄想」變成生命且四處干擾崑崙鏡後，鏡王們便開始計劃召喚現實世界中的人們來到鏡中世界，處理這一切的紛紛擾擾……。
遊戲特色
．自由轉職系統
職業間的轉換不再有重重限制，亦無需要新創或重建角色，只要這個職業是你想玩的，完成轉職任務後，隨時都能找轉職仙人轉換職業。

．附掛天賦，變化多端的組合
透過附掛天賦，即使是刀客也能補血，道士也能耍大刀，只要你想得出來，要怎麼搭配就能怎麼搭配，練的職業技能越多，組合也就越多越自由，玩法也越豐富。

．豐富的劇情內容

summary:

IMPORTANT NOTE:
VR SUPPORT IS CURRENTLY LIMITED TO OCULUS QUEST 2 ONLY. THE GAME STILL CAN BE LAUNCHED AS A STANDARD PROGRAM ON COMPUTERS AND LAPTOPS, WITHOUT USING A VR DEVICE.

How to Play the Elevator Game:

1. Start the Game at midnight.
2. Turn off your mobile devices and put away anything that could break your concentration.
3. Make sure you're alone.
4. Invite the Passenger. Once you do that, the Game will start.
5. Don't get out at any of the floors.
6. Upon reaching any floor, check your surroundings. If anything seems off, even the smallest detail, immediately proceed to another floor.
7. Reach the Lobby to beat the Game.

Story Mode ( ~ 2 hours of content)

Kickass Soundtrack

Steam Achievements 

Controller Support

A Definitely Coherent Storyline

Parasite is a roguelike survival horror game about possession set in a modern-day setting. Currently in development, each session is set to be medium length (around 2-3 hours to complete). The game is fully completable to the end but needs GUI work, balancing and polish.

Current features include:

A whole generated modern-day city to explore and survive in.

A single story scenario that starts with the main protagonist alone, scared, and without any memories in a hostile human world.

Sandbox mode that allows you to play at your leisure (or rather, at your peril).

Possession mechanics that is crucial to the player's survival (see, you just die very fast without a host).

Robust host inventory, skills and knowledge system.

Player evolution unlocking new improvements and body features for the possessed hosts.

Building and improving habitats to rest and recuperate.

Separate difficulty settings for all key parts of the game that will be prompted organically during its course.

Event timeline investigation to piece together both what has happened before and what to do next.

A dangerous and proactive group of opponents that is tasked with finding and destroying threats to humanity (you).

 NEW! The ability to have conversations with NPCs resulting in various benefits.

Parasite has been in sporadic development since 2016, with 2022 being the year I decided to devote my full attention to making it release-worthy on Steam. I'm quite proud of the way the game has evolved so far and I believe my original vision will finally be achieved.

summary:
Experience slackline like in real life in this built-for-VR game. Balance over rocks, trees, water, houses and much more. And remember - don't fall down! Can you get across all levels? I warn you, just like in real life, it's not easy.

Slackline VR is a fun and challenging balancing game.
Features

The game has 6 levels:

Canyon

Island

City

Temple

Forest

Mountain

The game has a training mode if you find it too challenging or you just want to practice.
It keeps track of how many times you have beaten each level - both on standard and easy mode.
The game also comes with an optional balance level indicator that lets you know if you're in level before starting to balance. It looks like this:

The game has a set of challenges and cosmetic rewards for completing the challenges. Here are the challenges:

How to play?

Use your controllers to keep the balance. If you for example start falling to the left, raise your left hand and lower your right hand to regain balance.

Keep your arms outstretched for maximum balance. If you hold your controllers close to each other, you will loose your balance.

Press the trigger to interact with the UI.

Press A to start balancing or to try again after falling.

Press B to go back to the main menu.

This is a game under development. Updates will come!

Please let me know if you have any requests and ideas, or experience any bugs/problems!

name: Venice Master
summary:
你是文艺复兴时期在威尼斯的一名工匠。不断开发出一项又一项新颖的业务，尽力笼络资源、研发创造。许多任务只有在你先制造出适用的机器之后才能去完成它们。无需多想，撸起袖子加油干就对了!

 - 在威尼斯大师这款游戏里，你是威尼斯这座极具特色的城市的一名居民 - 它是文艺复兴时期欧洲的金融和文化中心。很多不寻常的任务正在等着你去探索。一切都要从最基础的开始。记住，用赚来的钱投资新的业务绝对有利可图。你付出的所有努力将会有巨大的满足感作为你的回报 - 毕竟你是要在水面上建造出一个城市!

工艺与建造 - 在水上施工的确是一项相当大的挑战，需要一套非常独特的方法，在你决定动手之前，需要尽量做好必要的准备工作。首先，你必须对必要的建筑、冶金方面和木工机械等进行设计，还有专门的运输船及其它一些事项。完成这些筹划，你将有能力承受建造最伟大的建筑的挑战，比如重建里亚托桥或为贵族建造豪华宫殿。

盈利与投资 - 把你辛苦赚来的钱投资到更多的工匠作坊和工厂上。勇敢一点，大胆一点 - 这里有很多生意可以收购!这些生意能让你和城里的大人物达成交易。比如，给著名的威尼斯船队生产枪支和大炮，出售圣马可广场和其他教堂钟楼上报时的大钟。如果业务开展得顺利，你很快就会家财万贯，很快你也会觉得对在那个杂乱的贡多拉船上起步的修理车间不堪回首。

探索与发现 - 威尼斯充满了秘密和奇闻异事，当你完成任务，你将驶过它最神秘的巷子。像威尼斯的贡多拉船夫一样，你将发现新的、迷人的地方。这是世界上唯一以船为主要交通工具的城市，街道被水路所取代。你可能会发现一开始很难适应，但随着时间的推移，你自然会学会识别地标及建筑。也就是说，即使你迷路了，也绝对不必过于担心。威尼斯可能也是世界上唯一一个有这种特色的城市吧。

Become a craftsman in the Renaissance Venice. Develop business after business, be resourceful and creative. Many tasks can be completed only if you construct the most suitable machines first. No need to give it any more thought, just roll up your sleeves and get to work!

In Venice Master, you are an inhabitant of the unique city of Venice - the financial and cultural heart of the Renaissance Europe. There are plenty of unusual tasks awaiting you. You start from scratch. Keep in mind it’s worth investing the earned money in new businesses. A reward for your efforts will also be great satisfaction - after all, you will build a city on water!

Building on water is quite a challenge and requires a pretty unique set of methods, but before you get to it, you need to be thoroughly prepared. First, you have to engineer the necessary construction, metallurgical and carpentry machines, as well as specialized transport boats and much more. This way you will be able to take on the most ambitious building challenges, such as the reconstruction of the Rialto Bridge or the construction of luxurious palaces for the aristocracy.

name: ずっと、君だけを  寡黙な黒騎士は生まれ変わりの元王女を今度こそ手放さない
summary:
幼なじみの騎士ラディウスに想いを告げられぬまま、不慮の事故で亡くなった王女パトリシア。
目覚めたらそこは6年後の世界。隣国の公爵令嬢に生まれ変わっていた!?　
婚約者候補がラディウスだと知り胸をときめかせるも、会ってみると別人のように暗く冷たい態度で…。
「君と結婚するつもりはない」一度は提案された婚約破棄。
しかし以前の公爵令嬢とはだいぶ雰囲気の異なる彼女に何かを感じたのか、ラディウスの物腰は徐々に優しさを帯びていく。
「…リシア」
一つの疑問を確かめるように、不意にかつての愛称で呼ばれたパトリシアは――!?

name: ずっと、君だけを 寡黙な黒騎士は生まれ変わりの元王女を今度こそ手放さない (上)
summary:
幼なじみの騎士・ラディウスに密かに想いを寄せている王女・パトリシア。
身分違いの叶わぬ恋と諦めて隣国の王子との結婚を決意した矢先に、凶刃に斃れてしまう。
それから六年。
なぜか隣国の令嬢・フェリシアとして目を覚ますと、ラディウスが自分の婚約候補の相手だと聞かされ、
しかも彼は以前とは別人のように冷徹な視線を向けてきて…。
こんなこと信じてもらえるはずがない。
想いは秘めておこうとしたのに、突然ラディウスからかつての愛称で呼ばれて――!?

name: ずっと、君だけを 寡黙な黒騎士は生まれ変わりの元王女を今度こそ手放さない (下)

寡黙な人だと思っていたのに、愛を語る彼は想像もつかないほどに甘い表情を見せてきて。
これで幸せな日々が始まると思いきや、フェリシアは自分が転生した理由を探るべく、
山奥に居を構える大魔法使い・イードルに会ってみたいと告げる。
途端に顔を曇らせるラディウスは、かつてイードルに会いに行ったことがあるようで――!?

summary: 無表情なことで“氷の聖女”と呼ばれるアマリリスは、王太子で婚約者のネイトや義妹・カルラに虐げられてきた。それでも民のために聖女の勤めを果たそうと努力していた矢先、ネイトとカルラに嵌められ「偽物の聖女は出ていけ」と敵国・ライズ王国に追放されてしまう。さらにネイトの策略で王国への道中、魔物の巣窟に放り出されてしまったアマリリス。そんな絶体絶命のピンチを救ったのは、ライズ王国一の天才魔術師と名高いヴィクターだった。敵対する国の聖女が受け入れられる訳がない――…。そう思っていたアマリリスを待っていたのは、想像以上の大歓迎で――…！？氷の聖女と呼ばれた少女が、秘められた才能を開花させて幸せを掴む溺愛ラブファンタジー！

name: 偽物だと敵国に追放されましたが、どうやら本物の聖女は私のようです。 (1)
summary:
無表情なことで“氷の聖女”と呼ばれるアマリリスは婚約者のシュヴァール王国王太子と義妹に偽物の聖女だと仕立て上げられ、敵国であるライズ王国に追放されてしまう。

そんなアマリリスの危機を救ったのは、ライズ王国一の天才魔術師と名高いヴィクターだった。
ヴィターの圧倒的な力を目の当たりにしたアマリリスは、彼の弟子になることを決意。

ヴィクターの元で修業を積み、温かく優しい毎日を過ごす中、アマリリスの祖国が不穏な動きを見せ始め??…？

氷の聖女と呼ばれた少女が追放先の敵国で花開くファンタジックシンデレララブストーリー第1巻！

「僕は――君を愛したことなど、一度もない」 18歳のベアトリスは最愛の婚約者に裏切られ、非業の死を遂げる。 胸を貫く悲痛な言葉と刃に倒れるも、目覚めたら7歳に逆戻り!? 死に戻りした先で出会った不思議な魔術師ルカには、 「お前のお父様がお前の死に憤り、世界を滅ぼそうとしている」と衝撃の未来を告げられ…。 前世では冷酷で取り付く島の無いと思っていた父親からの愛情を知ったベアトリスは、 困惑しながらも世界の命運のため、そして自分自身の幸せな未来のために、 愛され直す人生を選んでいくことに! 超超超娘を溺愛する超頼もしいパパと、彼女を守ろうとする圧倒的ビジュの面々に囲まれる ご令嬢(幼女)の死に戻り愛されストーリー。

name: 堅物夫が私（妻）と浮気しています!?
summary:
お見合い夫婦のすれちがい両片思い

大学生の芽衣子が、ずっと憧れていた13歳年上の尊と結婚して半年。大好きな尊との結婚生活は幸せだけど、いまだに初夜はまだ、キスも2回しかしたことがないことに悩む芽衣子。
そんな中、尊が「離婚したい」と友人に相談しているのを聞いてしまった！
離婚したくない芽衣子は尊の心を惹きつけようと、親友の朔太郎にメイクをしてもらい大人美女に変装して接近するが―…!?

name: 堅物夫が私（妻）と浮気しています!? (1)
summary: 芽衣子は13歳年上の旦那様・尊が大好き。だけど彼が「離婚したい」と友人に相談しているのを聞いてしまった!　芽衣子は尊の心を惹きつけようと、大人な美女に変装して接近。思惑通り甘い一夜を過ごすも、尊は美女＝芽衣子と気づいていないようで…?　それって浮気ってこと!?と悩むが、尊は独占欲を露わにし、芽衣子への想定外の溺愛に突入して…!

name: 堅物夫が私（妻）と浮気しています!? (2)
summary:
愛し合う　本物の夫婦になりたい

描きおろし漫画収録!
大好きな尊との結婚生活を守るため大人美女になり会いにいった芽衣子。
甘い時間を過ごすことはできたが、尊に自分だと気づかれなかったため
芽衣子は自分の夫の浮気相手となってしまった…!
ショックは受けたが、それでも芽衣子の尊への愛は揺るがず
芽衣子自身を好きになってもらえるように決意をする。
そんな芽衣子を見て、親友の朔太郎にある感情が芽生える。
また、尊も結婚してからずっと芽衣子へのある想いを募らせていた――。

1926, Chicago. The mob has been dabbling in bio-organic experiments and mechanical implants. In this first person shooter, you play as a federal agent tasked with taking them down! Visceral gameplay, mutational genetics and cybernetic enhancements come together in a fresh take on the genre.

The mob has been dabbling in biological experiments and mechanical implants. After uncovering details during an investigation you are ambushed and setup. Now there is BAD BLOOD between you... and its payback time! 

Visceral gameplay, involving stealth mechanics, silent takedowns, gun fights and puzzles come together into a glorious whole as you follow Franklin on his investigation. As he uncovers more about the sinister plot and the enemies he is up against, he will acquire powers as a result of the mob's experimentation, facing new enemies with similar enhancements. These enhancements might allow you to traverse the world with super speed to complete your objectives faster, or tank up with super strength to tilt the balance of combat in your favour. 

Graphics based on noir graphic novels and 1920s art deco help to create a beautiful, rich world to explore, creating a unique visual style unlike anything seen before, providing a sinister mood and dark atmosphere, capturing the spirit of the criminal underworld of the 1920s.

name: Trident: Naval Doctrine
summary:
Take command of a carrier strike group, a destroyer squadron or a lone submarine in a real-time naval tactics game. Outsmart, outmaneuver or outgun enemy fleet on, under and over the seas.

Join 

Real time naval tactics game with entire fleets, squadrons or single surface combatants at your command. Employ every modern military technology: anti-ship and anti-radiation missiles, airborne early warning, sonar and signal surveillance, stand-off radar jamming and layered anti-air defense. Tailor your fleet composition down to the equipment of a specific ship or aircraft platform. Combine skillful maneuvering, seabed topography, electronic warfare, fake targets and massive strike packages to deceive and defeat your opponent on the sea and in the air.
IDEA
Warships push on to secure superiority at sea, bristling with artillery, missiles and radar systems. 

Devious submarines lurk underwater, waiting for the perfect strike. 
Nimble aircraft and helicopters scramble at a moment’s notice. 
Admirals, captains and sailors forge every victory in a broad range of missions. 
Campaigns consisting of naval blockades, shore defenses, overt and covert landings, convoy hunts, area denials, anti submarine warfare and massive strike missions. 
Single player, coop, multiplayer modes.

With two maximalist goals in mind:

Real Time Strategy genre is stagnating and requires progress and innovation. Instead of rehashing old and proven, this game will learn from great predecessors, take risks and push the limit of gameplay and game mechanics. Put new ideas to test, iterate together with players and look for progress.

Naval warfare gives a great opportunity at complex and often overlooked modern military strategies and tactics: asymmetric battles, electronic warfare, counterinformation and fake targets, battlespace saturated with civilian vessels and natural events, sophisticated weapon systems. All of that is to be turned into easy to learn and difficult to master fast-paced re

name: Mad Murder's Mystery Pie Shop
summary:
FPS game involving finding ingredients and throwing them in the oven. Then bringing cooked pies to customers of Mad Murders Pie shop.

Welcome new employees! This is your first week at my pie shop! My name is Mad! you can call me Mr. Murder (Shakes your hand professionally establishing a business relationship). 

During your stay here you will bake our fine customers pies! You will be given my secret recipe and be expected to make my pies in a timely manner! Customers will throw a fit if you don't.

This is an FPS game that involves finding the "ingredients" of Mr. Murder's wonderful pie recipe. Of course you got to throw them in the oven and bring the cooked pies to the customers outside the compound. Many employees get their minds infected during their shift durations. Battle the foul creatures that add so much stress to all the employees. 

The key to any good food service is efficiency. I have a small machine that will ensure you are moving speedily and don't let anyone catch you slacking off. Slacking off results in immediate termination.

name: Vulnerable
summary:
Embody a displaced therapist in a futuristic refugee camp. Discover the life in the camp and share your everyday life alongside people with heavy pasts. Use logic and your therapeutic skills to solve mysteries threatening both your survival and the camp.

Decades after our age, Mars has been colonized by an elite leaving the vast majority of our population on a tired Earth, devastated by wars, famines, diseases and other climatic throes.
Escaping a certain death, you embody a refugee therapist who joined a humanitarian mission settled on the Moon, the last neutral space, razor edge between life and death for Earth inhabitants.

In a 2D hand-drawn environment, meet your fellow companions, mingle in the rhythm of the camp and build strong links with the other refugees and volunteers. Through your adventure, learn about your friend’s past, the migration system of the Mars settlers and the dystopian world surrounding us.

Mysteries and plots will stand on your way to thwart the humanitarian mission. Find clues, gather testimonies and distinguish truth from falsity using logic and all information at your disposal. Unravel the truth about the strange events happening at the camp to preserve the humanitarian aid. Your survival depends on it!

Dive into the culprit’s subconscious and drive conversational therapies to help your friends. Ask the good question to guide their spirit, find out their most secret wounds and track down their inner demon to defeat them.

Resist an imperfect migration system, understand the stakes and questions revolving around refugee camp. Will you be strong enough to overtake human mistakes or will you feed the list of collateral damages?

name: 眼球大師 Eyeball Master

故事大纲:

"它"既不是人类，也不是恶魔，只是一个能看清世界的微小生物"眼球"

名为...姆姆眼 与它的好友蛋蛋眼 

然而有一天姆姆眼 的好朋友 蛋蛋眼 莫名了捡了一本充满魔物的书本 导致 姆姆眼与 蛋蛋眼的生命 危在旦夕!

游戏内容:

5种不同的随机关卡

40种以上的怪物

40种以上的技能选择 

40种以上的被动技能选择

40种以上不同的特殊武器 

10种以上的神器

10种以上的道具

透过各种数值的上升 技能的组合 被动的选择 武器的选择 神器的选择 来组件各种不同的流派与玩法
收集要素:

在关卡中所击杀的怪物 选择的技能与被动技能将会加入图鉴中

制作要素:
从怪物上掉落的材料 可用于制作物器和建筑物

Eyeball Master is a Light skit Roguelite + RPG game On the way of the adventure, you must see the most suitable moving route, as well as the matching of skills and passive choices to eliminate obstacles ahead!

Outline of the story:

"It" is neither human nor demon, just a tiny creature called "eyeball" that can see the world

Named...Mumu and its friend Dan Dan 

However, one day Mumu 's good friend Dan Dan inexplicably picked up a book full of monsters, putting Mumu and DanDan's lives in jeopardy!

Game Features:
5 different random levels
40+ types of monsters
40+ active skills to choose from
40+ passive skills to choose from
40+ different special weapons
10+ Artifacts
10+ Items

Through the rise of various values, the combination of skills, the passive selection, the selection of weapons, the selection of artifacts, various genres and gameplays are assembled
Collecting elements:

The selected skills and passive skills of the monsters killed in the level will be added to the illustration

Production elements:

Materials dropped from monsters can be used to craft objects and buildings

summary:
A 'poe', steampunk inspired platformer and hack n slash with a poetic story and challenging platforming and stragety based levels with a unique Ghost Phase shift ability! Featuring retro arcade graphics and charming details, this will keep you entertained for hours.

Full Controller Support

Edgar's Poetic Nightmare supports game controllers!

Edgar's Poetical Nightmare is a steampunk-inspired 2D platformer. After being thrown into the pit and the pendulums, Edgar is striving to survive in this mysterious and hostile place that is full of traps, puzzles and enemies. Inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe, the story is told poetically and quotes from his most famous stories. You play through the levels aptly named by them and each level has it's own distinct theme.

Aside from attacking the enemies using his Rapier, he can use his ghost shift ability. This will allow the player to come up with a strategy to solve some puzzles or scout the area ahead without coming to any harm and plan for the next jump.

name: Unlucky Sniper
summary:
Unlucky sniper, it's pixel arcade with a simple, funny story. In this game, you are playing for a bullet, and you should don't hit the target for as long as possible.

If, which playing shooting games, you feel like the bullets are intentionally flying miss the target, then you will like this game. In the pixel game, you play for the bullet, and you should don't hit the target for as long as possible. The task is simple, but the more you're dodging, the more difficult it is. The game also has the "Reverse" mode, in which you must hit as many targets as you can in the specified time.

Enjoy and see how much you can dodge.

name: Wobbl - The Lost Wands
summary:
Wobbl is a charming platformer about editing the level while playing it, to your advantage. The level is your playground - use Edit Wands in a selection of colourful levels to help you carve a path.

What if you could edit a platformer level while playing it? Wobbl is a mix of precision and puzzle platformers, in which you make use of different types of edit wands to complete the level.
Edit Wands

Wobbl is filled with familiar edit wands like the Delete wand, Duplicate wand, Move wand, and more. Use these wands to your advantage to complete levels.
Levels

Complete a colourful selection of beautiful pixel art levels, each one filled with unique mechanics, fun puzzles and challenging platforming sections.
The Level Is Your Playground

No problem has only one solution. Use the wands given to you creatively to carve your path through the level or just mess around with objects and enemies - No matter how you use them, these tools will redefine your expectations.
Free Demo

A free demo is now available! Play through the first zone of the game right now!! do it!!!

name: Ponchoman
summary:
Kill the creatures and upgrade your weapon to survive as much as you can.

Ponchoman is roguelike(maybe not) top down(also maybe not) shooter hack and slash game.

In a world where everything you see is fading away, the ponchoman you'll control
have to shoot and kill the creatures and survive.

But don't worry.
The more you kill creatures, make rifle more powerful.
And before you know it, you're gonna find yourself doing the pleasure of slaughter, not the stupid struggling of survival.

There's no goal for this game.
You just have to kill one more creature than before.
Praying doesn't help at all.

name: Midnight Saturn
summary: A grizzled private eye in a sci-fi adventure takes a murder case no one else will touch. He’s seen it all before, but nothing’s prepared him for a conspiracy that leads off-world. Something big is about to happen. Whatever it is... it goes live at midnight.

name: No Lights 2
summary:
A nightclub bouncer discovers the true meaning of madness in No Lights 2, Surrounded by demons and evil beings, play a man on the brink of insanity, going through various difficulties and discovering more and more about the place and its past

No Lights 2 presents a horror game based on old PS1 games

No Lights 2 is a first-person horror game based on PS1 graphics. The game narrates an account sent to Master Studios about a security guard who witnessed frightening events.
In this game you will have to delve into the story, escape and hide from the demons and solve puzzles to get out of the nightmare. The Game does not contain a save system, as you can finish it in a short time.

name: ARACNIDIUM
summary:
Earth has been invaded by android spiders. BOB's family is in danger. Spiders are getting into houses from all sides. Find the right angle and shoot the spiders. Help BOB in this mission.

ARACNIDIUM is a simplistic platformer “Fast Game” where you will help BOB save his family from the spiders invading his house. The game has 30 levels, each of which you must find the right angle to use the weapon found by BOB, which is the only resource that can eliminate spiders and ensure the safety of the family. You must use the weapon in the right aim so that you can hit all the paths that the spiders pass, thus protecting BOB's entire family: his parents, baby brother, dog, cat and guinea pig. In each level you will find only one, or two or even three possible crosshairs. Will you be able to find the right aim to kill the spiders? Only by playing will we know!

name: Charset Crossfire
summary: A retro maze shooting game with a weird and wacky menagerie of enemies.

name: The Lost Condor - Walking Simulator
summary:
Explore the ruins of Machu Picchu, the ancient city of Peru. Listen to the sounds of birds, wind, and walk under a waterfall. This is a very short walking simulator. There is no story, objective, or interactive objects.

The Lost Condor is a very short first person walking simulator where you can explore Machu Picchu, the ancient city of Peru. Listen to the sounds of birds, wind, walk under a waterfall and explore the ruins. There is no story, objective, or interactive objects. This is a semirealistic, low polygon recreation of Machu Picchu inspired by action-adventure games of the late 90s. 

Note:

The video trailer is outdated, the screenshots were updated Mar 31, 2023.

Seizure Warning:

This video game contains visual effects, including flashing lights and rapid color changes, which may trigger epileptic seizures or other adverse reactions in susceptible individuals. If you or anyone in your household has a history of epilepsy or photosensitive seizures, please consult a medical professional before playing this game.

name: Pickle Clicker
summary:
Click pickle, get pickle, spend pickle, get more pickle, and most importantly... Protect pickle from sneaky Poglins!

IMPORTANT NOTE: 

This game doesn't have any sort of ascension/rebirth at the moment and development for this game is unfortunately going to be on and off.

Welcome to Pickle Clicker, an incremental game based on pickles.

You just click the pickle and get a pickle out of thin air. Not only that, but with your pickles you have the ability to purchase and further enhance your pickle picking empire by buying auto pickles. But watch out! The more pickles you have, the more Poglins eager to come and steal your pickles, so defend and fight back with the purchasing of upgrade pickles.

name: SPE:X
summary:
You are Ilie, an Eastern European Entrepreneur who is starting a new company of building PCs. You love computers and were building them since you were a kid. Now you think it will be a good idea to make your family proud and start your own business with money borrowed from unconventional sources.

You are Ilie, an Eastern European Entrepreneur who is starting a new company of building PCs. You love computers and you were building them since you were a kid and now you think that it will be a good idea to make your family proud and start your own business with money borrowed from unconventional sources. But the business environment is a harsh one and you need to make your own decisions at each step to make it through. 

The game supports two modes: storyline and endless.

In the storyline mode, Ilie borrowed money from loan sharks and has to pay them every day, otherwise, they will close his business. During the relatively small campaign (which takes up to 8 days), Ilie will be visited by various individuals and he will need to make decisions that will affect both the gameplay and endings. 

In the endless mode, we offered a gameplay opportunity with an unlimited number of days. Your only purpose is to make your business survive by paying your loans to the bank at the end of each day, while the gameplay gets harder and harder.

Developer note: This is our first indie game, so, please take a moment to enjoy our hard work. If you have time, please leave your constructive feedback, so we can improve this game in our updates. We are a handful (two) of developers who love games. We want to provide a unique experience to our players.

선배의 괴롭힘에 태권도를 그만둔 남 건과 소리를 듣지 못하는 천재 선수 강이토. 상처투성이 소년들은 다시 정상에 설 수 있을까?

name: Midnight Ramen Shop
summary: 在深夜经营一家温馨的日式拉面店。Midnight Ramen Shop 是一款轻松的烹饪游戏，你将扮演一家小餐馆的主厨。接单、制作美味拉面、服务顾客，并升级你的店铺，解锁新配料，自由定价。

name: Crimson Dawn
summary:
《黎明之诺》是一款具有RPG元素的随机部落生存游戏。招募雇佣兵，对战邪恶部落，在5个游戏地图中生存致胜。解锁更多具有独特能力的角色和武器。闯出你的杀伐之路，彻底粉碎邪恶部落！！

《黎明之诺》是一款受《吸血鬼幸存者》启发的战斗地狱求生游戏。3个独特角色的每个任务都将引领玩家解锁新的技能、武器和各种组合，让玩家随着游戏进度变得更强。马上在游戏中心创建你自己的故事版本，并在5个游戏地图中生存致胜。
游戏特色

具有RPG元素的随机部落生存游戏

升级角色等级，同时升级角色的武器和法术

选择其中一款武器，即可体验其独特的游戏机制

休闲、轻松且满足的游戏体验.

完全无需点击，即可尽情砍杀数千怪物！
所有武器和法术均自动攻击，玩家只需避开敌人并设法生存下去。

高度选择自由
玩家可以决定要执行多少个任务以及愿意冒多大风险。更多的任务可打造更强大的角色，还有更多的关卡头目，也意味着更多战利品。

在游戏中心休闲娱乐 
这是玩家的家园，也是在战斗之余休养生息之所。玩家可在假日酒店酣睡，拜访铁匠或在市场上交换各种资源。

角色成长
在战斗中，玩家可以赢得各种材料和金币。玩家可以使用这些资源获得新的能力，升级武器，甚至解锁新的角色。玩家完成每次任务都可赚取更多资源。
游戏中的每款武器都有唯一的升级树，以及唯一的游戏机制。

Crimson Dawn is a roguelite horde survival game with RPG elements. Recruit mercenaries and survive 5 stages by fighting the hordes of evil. Unlock more characters and weapons with unique abilities. Carve your path to stop the hordes of evil once and for all!

Crimson Dawn is a bullet hell survival game inspired by Vampire Survivors. Each run for one of several unique characters makes you stronger by unlocking new talents, weapons, and combinations. Create your own build in the Hub and survive all 5 stages.
Features:

Roguelite horde survival game with RPG progression system;

Level up your characters and upgrade their weapons and spells;

Choose one of the weapons with its own unique game mechanic;

Relaxing, satisfying gameplay.

Kill Thousands of Creatures Without a Single Click!
All weapons and spells attack automatically, so all you have to do is avoid enemies and try to survive.

Freedom of Choice
You decide how many quests you want to take on and what you’re willing to risk. More quests mean stronger monsters—or maybe even bosses—but also better loot.

Rest in the Hub
This is your home and the only place to take a breather between battles. Rest at the Inn, visit the Blacksmith, or exchange resources at the Market.

Character Development
During fights, you earn materials and coins. Use them to get new abilities, upgrade weapons, or even unlock new characters. Each quest you complete will earn you even more

name: WHY I was Born
summary:
当我注意到的时候，我是自己出生的。这是一个通过滚动球来模拟一个普通人生活的游戏。

"我在一家深夜的便利店工作。

我去更换放在店外的垃圾桶里的袋子。

当我打开垃圾桶的时候，有人吃过的炸鸡骨头的骨髓掉在我的鞋子上。

在黑暗中，我看着自己的鞋子，上面沾满了油渍。

哦，我自己也完蛋了

我早就走了"

本游戏是一款第三人称球类动作冒险游戏，以一个普通人的日记为背景。

玩家可以通过滚球来模拟体验这个男人的生活：他曾经玩耍的公园、他的学校、他独自居住的房间、他在商店的兼职工作以及他的公司。

有些阶段模仿现实，而有些则像一个可怕的梦。

家庭、朋友、工作和梦想、空虚和孤独、社会和关系......

这个男人经历了各种经历，找到了深藏在他心中的答案。

游戏分为动作阶段和冒险阶段。

也有益智和恐怖元素。

预计游戏时间为4-5小时。

游戏视频的传播和传播的货币化可以不经过作者的许可。

操作方法

移动：WSAD

跳跃：Space

技能：QW,鼠标点击

自动保存

"I was born without knowing what to do with my life, and I just rolled with life..." Trace the life of an ordinary man and search for the meaning of life in this ball action adventure.

"At a convenience store late at night, I replace the bag in the trash can outside the store.

When I opened the trash lid, 

the marrow of a fried chicken bone that someone had eaten fell on my shoes

Oh, it was over

I was already over"

This game is a third-person ball action adventure game set in the memory of an ordinary man.

Players can have the simulated experience of the man's life by rolling the ball through various stages: the park where he used to play, his school, his room where he lives alone, his part-time job at a store, and his company.

Some stages mimic reality, while others are like a scary dream.

Family, friends, work and dreams, emptiness and loneliness, society and relationships...

The man goes through various experiences and finds the answer that was deep in his heart.

The game is divided into an action stage and an adventure stage.

There are also puzzle and horror elements.

The estimated playing time is 4-5 hours.

 ジュンとリアは子どもの頃から、F1ドライバーになることを夢見ていました。リアは正確無比なドライビングテクニックでトップリーグ入りを果たしますが、ジュンは持ち前の無謀な走りが裏目に出て夢を諦め、タクシードライバーとして働くことになります。ある日、ミッキーマウスと仲間たちはジュンの恐れを知らない走りを目の当たりにします。そして、崩壊寸前のレーシングチームを救うために立ち上がり、ジュンをチームにスカウトします。プロフェッショナルなレースの世界へと飛び込んだジュンに、夢を叶える最後のチャンスが訪れますが... 新たなチームメイトは、なんと最大のライバルであるリアでした！はたして、ジュンとミッキー＆フレンズは、プロが命を懸けてレースで競い合うF1の世界で勝ち抜くことができるのでしょうか？

そのままナカで達した敦邦に、男は「我が名はオキ、ようこそ神の世界へ」と名乗る。
『オキ様』は家族と共に信仰を続け、敦邦が死の瀬戸際まで祈っていた神様だった。
「生き返る権利をやる」と話すオキに、即答で拒否をする敦邦。しかし、オキは諦めず「ならば代わりに私がお前を産もう！」と言い出して――！？

（何故そこまでして俺を？）疑問に思う敦邦に対して、「惚れているからだ」と話すオキ。
オキには、何万年もの時をかけたある想いがあった――

【過労死した(？)筋肉ゴリラ×稀代のケツ抱き美麗男神】の、蘇りを賭けた子作り新生活スタート！！

阴暗的安提阿市，每天都在冷血地将它的子民生吞活剥。诈骗、吸毒、暴力、谋杀......人们已经见怪不怪，甚至不足以成为茶余饭后的谈资。

一名女人，将整座城市串联在了一起，她身上粘连着安提阿的恶臭，又被这座城市粗糙且微小的善意所照耀，我很想让她给你讲述自己的故事，但很可惜——她是一具尸体。

警探，请你去解开她身上的迷雾。注意，这可能会颠覆你的认知，请准备好。

两名警探

这场冒险并不孤单，一名搭档会伴你左右——一名现实世界的搭档。邀请你的好友，合作揭开迷雾背后的真相。在面对种种局面时，我相信，你们两个肯定会有不同的观点，但请记住，不论如何争论，故事的走向都是由你们共同决定的。

所以，请在争吵中说服彼此，在合作中培养默契，共同揭开安提阿市神秘的面纱。

当然，你也可以选择AI搭档离线游玩。

多个结尾

当这趟旅途走到最后，你将迎来怎样的结局？或者说，你的种种选择，最终会让你走向哪种结尾？

游戏提供了十余种不同的结局供你探索。你的选择，永远会得到安提阿的回应。

无数奇怪的人

漫步于安提阿，你将见到形形色色的居民，他们有着自己的行为逻辑，每个人都怀着自己的目的。探索他们的故事，和他们构建深度关系，会让你的游戏体验产生不同程度的改变。

一位作家

游戏的故事由法国互动小说作家FibreTigre操刀，其主创的游戏《Out There》曾获得多个游戏奖项。

这是一款以第一次世界大战为背景的第一人称射击游戏，玩家可以在战场中通过挖战壕的方式寻找和消灭敌人。你可以与好友组队，并利用可以在战壕中找到的各种武器武装自己。新增了多种武器和地图。

Slipping between the past and present, a child puzzles their way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear.

Chrysalis Inc. is a 2D 3D Horror Adventure Puzzle Side Scroller. Explore the abandoned toy factory, solve intricate puzzles and unveil the deep dark truth behind it. 

Story: 

Waking up in an abandoned toy factory, You realize something is not right. The area is filled with weird machinery and strange imagery. Slipping between the past and present, you need to puzzle your way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear.

As you delve into the depths of the factory, the layered truth will begin to unravel with each horrifying discovery. From the vicious robots left to rot, to the unexplainable residual power that grants time travel, not everything is what it seems. Maybe some truths are best left buried. 

Features & Mechanics: 

Dark, Depressing Irony:

They say that the road to hell is paved with good intentions. One act of goodwill for one person could cause the suffering of many. One child’s glee at receiving the latest toy overshadows the tiny, grimy hands that constructed it. 

Explore a ruined factory:

Traverse through the vast yet lifeless factory, where your only company will hunt you down. With each new location, the story behind the factory's construction and creations will be revealed in fragmented pieces.

Unique Puzzles:

Through innovative puzzles, you will be able to change the past to affect the present. Use this ability well to help you solve the mystery. 

This game is a student project developed over 9 months by 9 students in the Entertainment Arts and Engineering (EAE) Graduate Program at the University of Utah.

name: SOUL JANITOR

In SOUL JANITOR you play as a janitor who was contracted into cleaning out an old thought to be abandoned warehouse. You quickly find out that there is much more to this warehouse than a few dirty bathrooms. Armed with only your spray bottle, you must fight your way through the warehouse to complete your contract and unravel the mysteries of the facility along the way.

Key Features: 

- Explore a detailed environment 

- Fight unique spirit enemies 

- Solve puzzles and find tapes to unravel the mystery

name: Coral Cove
summary:
Coral Cove is a relaxing match 3-like underwater game in which you try to build the largest reef without running out of corals to place.

Azure waters, vibrant corals and busy flocks of fish are what used to await you a few meters under the water surface. But the damages of pollution have extinguished most of this. With only a few corals left, it is up to you to restore the once beautiful ecosystems in this relaxing match 3-like game. But beware of the dangers lingering underwater and your slowly depleting stock of corals.

You start with nothing but a few tiles to build on and a small hand of coral cards to place. Three corals of the same level merge into a new coral of the next higher level. Through clever planning and strategic placement your corals will soon expand into a large, lively reef.

Explore the seafloor to find new challenges, quests and special structures to help you with your run. Expand your reef to unlock different areas and advance to new places. But watch out for the dangers you and your coral reef will have to face.

Short rounds, numerous hindrances to overcome and always new strategies to build and advance encourage replaying again and again.

The expanses of Coral Cove await you!

name: Acclimate
summary:
Explore, gather, and manage resources to develop the capabilities to build and survive. Your survival rests on your ability to cast aside your opposition to technology and become technologically advanced.

In this game, you play as a lone survivor who previously opposed technology on an island destroyed by its technological advancements. As the sole survivor, you struggle to stay alive in a wilderness inhabited by dangerous enemies. Explore, gather, and manage your resources to survive. Your survival rests on your ability to acclimate to your environment.
KEY FEATURES:

INTERACTIVE OPEN WORLD
In this vast open world game, the player can access almost every part of the world. Discover hidden paths and multiple levels as you explore different places throughout the game.
DAY AND NIGHT CYCLE
With features like a day and night cycle, the complexity of the game changes completely, wait until darkness to venture out and the hunter will become the hunted.
DYNAMIC WEATHER & SEASONS
Dynamic weather brings a more realistic aspect to the game. Experience varying difficulties of survival with the changing of the seasons, from sunburn and increased exhaustion during summer to experiencing frostbite in the winter.
CREATIVE BUILDING
You can't have a survival game without building and we have added just that and more. Experience building on a whole new level with multiple combinations of materials and prefabs you can make your base how you want it.

name: 클라우드 하트
summary:
턴제 rpg 어드벤처. 세계를 탐험하고 다양한 이야기를 만나세요.

천상 세계를 휩쓸었던 전쟁이 끝났습니다. 가장 어두운 시간도 지나가고, 이제 세계는 기관총과 철조망 대신 트렌치코트, 황동 축음기, 아르 데코 스타일의 마천루와 밤새도록 이어지는 파티 음악으로 가득합니다.

이 세계에서 당신은 은인의 부탁으로 환상 속의 보물인 클라우드 하트의 행방을 쫓게 됩니다. 존재하는지도 불확실한, 유행하는 모험 영화에나 나올 법한 물건을요. 하지만 보물찾기만큼이나 이 낭만적인 시대에 잘 어울리는 낭만적인 목표가 또 있을까요? 게다가, 당신에게는 그 은인의 부탁을 절대로 거절할 수 없는 이유도 있는걸요...

구름의 바다에는 하늘섬이 떠다니고 비행은 일상적인 일인 이 세계에서 인간은 유일하게 날 수 없는 종족입니다. 하지만 그런 인간도 하늘에 대한 동경만큼은 다른 이들에게 뒤지지 않았습니다. 그래서 비행학교를 만들었죠.

주인공 셀레스틴은 이제 막 캐노피 비행학교를 졸업한 햇병아리 비행사입니다. 후원자이자 최고의 친구인 테라의 의뢰로 무한한 힘을 가졌다는 보물인 클라우드 하트를 찾는 일을 맡게 됩니다.

셀레스틴이 살고 있는 캐노피 시티는 지상에서 가장 크고 복잡한 도시들 중 하나입니다. 호화로운 파티, 전쟁이 남기고 간 마음을 흔드는 선전 포스터, 하늘섬에서 찾아온 낯선 종족들이 이 도시의 심장부에 하나로 뒤섞여 있습니다. 클라우드 하트의 행방을 찾는 동시에... 이 대도시에서의 일상도 즐기세요.

-기본 시스템

클라우드 하트는 턴제 rpg와 어드벤처가 합쳐진 형식의 게임입니다.

게임은 기본적으로 캐릭터 능력치, npc 호감도, 세력 명성을 올리면서 새로운 스토리를 찾아가는 방식으로 진행됩니다.

플레이어는 세계를 돌아다니며 다양한 이야기와 마주치게 됩니다. 몇몇 스토리에서는 선택지에 따라 결말이 달라지고, npc의 운명을 바꾸기도 합니다.

Have you ever wanted to run your own professional wrestling promotion, trying to win the TV ratings war against your rivals by putting on great shows? Championship Wrestling Promoter is the game you've been waiting for!

In Championship Wrestling Promoter you run the show from behind the scenes without directly controlling the wrestlers. summary:
《混沌秩序2》是一款回合制战斗的角色扮演游戏，讲述了托马斯的故事，一个因为残忍的骑士阿斯莫德斯而失去了家人的男人。在像素艺术的史诗冒险中寻求复仇。然而，有一个细节可能改变一切：你的家人可能根本从未存在过。

《混沌之序2》是一款由White Vortex工作室的Renan Barreto创作和开发的像素艺术回合制角色扮演游戏。《混沌之序2》的旅程独特，拥有超过20个小时的游戏时间，数十个支线任务、物品、特殊技能和许多谜题需要解决。敌人在地图上行走，没有随机遭遇。玩家将穿越森林、城市、海滩、岛屿、神庙、秘密地牢、隐藏城市，并与强大的生物战斗。如果玩家不只是想追随主要故事线，他们在游戏中将有很多事情要做。

《混沌之序2》与系列中第一款游戏中展示的事件或角色没有任何关联。

《混沌之序2》讲述了托马斯的故事，一个失去家人的男人，他们被布拉塔尼亚帝国一位神秘而残忍的骑士阿斯莫迪厄斯谋杀。托马斯展开了一段复仇之旅，发誓要摧毁他最无情的敌人。然而，有一个细节可能改变一切，他的家人可能根本就不存在。受到两种可能的现实的困扰，托马斯需要了解所有这一切悲剧背后的真相，来定义他与整个人类的未来交织在一起的未来，即使这意味着他要去地狱。

主要团队中有六个可玩角色。他们都有动力来对抗即将到来的邪恶。

托马斯： 故事的主角，寻求为家人的死亡复仇。
米格尔： 托马斯有趣的朋友，拥有魔法力量，时不时会讲几个笑话。他有能力在战斗中召唤生物。
达伊娜： 一位坚强的女性，厌倦了不得不向她的城镇的人们证明自己。
阿丽西亚： 一个温柔的女孩，希望结束布拉塔尼亚帝国所犯下的暴行，该帝国压迫着她的小镇。
西格蒙德： 一位心碎的男子，他的心也许永远无法恢复到原来的状态。他是一位战斗经验丰富、懂得医疗知识的强大战士。
罗布： 一个强大的战士，有着强烈的正义感，但过去曾经历困扰。

他们将共同对抗过去的幽灵、敌对帝国的军队、来自其他维度的存在，甚至是他们自己的个人信念。

你可以步行、奔跑，跳跃到特定的地方，甚至可以进入水中。

为了能够升级武器和提升团队成员的状态，玩家需要找到散落在世界各地、但存在于另一个维度的光明之点。在游戏的许多区域都有可能找到光明之点。

每个角色都有独特的特点，玩家需要在战斗中正确地安排他们的位置，以发挥他们的最佳效果。但要小心，一些敌人可能会在战斗中改变队伍的位置。

每个角色都有自己的技能图谱。每个被锁定的方块可以用光明之点来解锁。玩家可以自行决定如何提升他们的角色。可以选择学习新的技能，或者打开增加英雄某些属性的途径。

Order from Caos 2 is an RPG with turn-based battles that tells the story of Thomas, a man who had his family murdered by the cruel Knight Asmodeus. Seek revenge in an epic adventure in Pixel Art. However, there's one detail that can change everything: your family may simply have never existed.

Order from Caos 2 is a pixel art turn-based RPG, created and developed by Renan Barreto from the White Vortex studio. The journey of Order from Caos 2 is unique and has more than 20 hours of gameplay, dozens of sidequests, items, special moves, and many puzzles to solve. Enemies walk across the maps and there are no random encounters. The players will walk through forests, cities, beaches, islands, temples, secret dungeons, hidden cities and will fight powerful creatures. The players will have a lot to do in the game if they don’t want to just follow the main story.

summary:
Through the Kill Screen, an Adventure-RPG about 1980s kids discovering what slumbers beyond the final levels of their favourite computer games. Drink a Slushie, win a Thumb War and save Snoring Town from a sinister conspiracy.

Kill Screen
Noun: A level in a computer game that is impossible to win.

1980s kids had it the best. Powered by syrup-ice Slushies, they ran riot, hiding from bullies and plotting with best friends to fill the hours with fun and games. Ringing doorbells before dashing away, between sugar rushes and thumb-wars, life was never dull. With parents glued to the TV, serenaded by the RATA-TATAT of action hero movies, 1980s kids played computer games until friction built blisters on their fingers. But it wasn't all good.

Sometimes 1980s kids were sent to stand in the naughty corridor, awaiting lectures of doom from sadistic Head Teachers. Sometimes bullies cornered their prey with wicked, menacing intentions. And, once, some kids played a computer game so well that they actually broke through the Kill Screen and uncovered a terrible secret.

You are one of those kids. Can you endure what slumbers beyond the final level?

Through the Kill Screen is an Adventure RPG with horror/thriller elements. You take the role of Leon, a mischievous boy enjoying his 1980s childhood. Imagine a bit of The Goonies, War Games and Ferris Bueller's Day Off, mixed with Mother, Undertale and a dash of Lisa and you'll be somewhat prepared for a colourful and sinister quest through small-town Britain. In a world full of curiosities, fun and danger, with multiple endings, Through the Kill Screen is a journey quite different from anything you have experienced before.

Features:

Tense and scary.

Or whimsical and darkly funny.

Explore Snoring Town, where secrets wait behind every corner, in every cereal box, around the u-bend or inside the washing machine. 

Build your CHEEKINESS, IMAGINATION, FINGER SPEED and GOODY GOODY stats to affect your character's final, adult form.

In Pergamon, unlock new abilities and weapons to forge new paths and piece together the planet's hidden history. Every path tempts you deeper with whispers of forgotten secrets. Every locked door demands your ingenuity, every towering foe your resolve. But something is wrong here. Too familiar. The shadows you fight move like you. The faces carved in alien temples resemble your own. And when you finally find the “others” who walk these halls… they are you.

Features:

A vast, interconnected world—organic and mechanical, beautiful and hostile.

Fluid combat and traversal abilities that change the way you take on fearsome bosses.

Discover alien artifacts and augmentations that unlock new powers.

A mystery-driven narrative: uncover the truth of the planet and the countless versions of yourself that inhabit it.

Atmospheric art and sound design that shifts as you descend deeper into the unknown.

You just want to go home. But what if not all of you wants to leave?

name: Valley Dash
summary:
Dash! Dash! Dash as far as you can in this NES inspired arcade take on action command RPG battle action! Pick a dasher, collect gear, build your party and gather upgrades to dash as far as you possibly can.

Just how far can YOU dash?
 In this arcade style NES-like take on an action command based RPG battle system, join Valley and a cast of her friends, allies, and begrudged acquaintances as they challenge hordes of monsters. Each victory rewards you with just a little more distance, and a whole new wave of foes.

Procedural, seed generated gameplay! If you find a seed you particularly like, you can play it again and again!

Play as over a dozen different unlockable heroes, each with their own action commands and attack styles.

Crazy and wild items! Rewind time with a clock! Become an unmovable, invulnerable boulder with the stone mask! Share a bunch of bananas with your entire party! Even hurl a big old rock at your foes!

High scores! Laugh at your friends as you dash farther than them. Rub your victory in their faces.

Diverse cast of monsters, with random upgrades! From ordinary blobs to tricky mimics, from sneaky ghosts to mighty bear chombers, the further through your dash, the more upgrades the monsters will have!

Need some help? Use pine cones to purchase a contract and enlist the help of another hero! Buy upgrades from the shop and feel their power course through you!

Find a hero or monster you're not yet familiar with? Check the bestiary during your turn to get a quick overview, complete with a comment from Valley!

The dash continually beckons. Will you answer its call?

Accessories: use the accessories available in the level.

Bosses to Defeat: face 5 main bosses.

Extra challenge: In each level, collect an emerald as an extra challenge.

Colorful Pixel Art Graphics: unique pixel art style graphics.

Original music: unique soundtrack to pack the adventure.

For the whole family: can be played by adults and children, easy learning, simple controls.

Moderate challenge: some levels can be a big challenge, but it is always possible to overcome them with some dedication.

Use the accessories available in the level

The extra challenge is to find and collect the emerald hidden in each level..

summary:

Doomed to Hell is an action-packed roguelike-like top-down shooter that is a hell of a lot of fun! You play as Rose, and though you've just died, your adventure is just getting started. Battle your way out of hell through hordes of monsters, explore multiple biomes, fight bosses, collect as much loot as you can, and upgrade your weapons and buffs. Your ticket out of hell is killing all of its inhabitants. Face off against many types of enemies and their various unique attacks through various waves. Pick buffs between waves and get ready for more challenges!

After getting all the coins you can, rest easy in the shop. Grab powerful weapons, upgrade your skills, and punch a few dummies to test your new arsenal. Toby, the local shopkeeper, will be there to give you the best deals!

summary:
一款文字冒险游戏。在无数次经历末日景象的地球上带领人类重拾往日的科技，并用战争的方式整合全人类（也许不用战争也行？）

游戏内容

你是一名特工，去执行一项阻止核战争爆发的任务，但是你的任务失败了。在任务过程中，你误入了一个地下设施并将其中的人员当作任务中要消灭的恐怖分子，当你以为目标已经解决时，第一枚核弹早已落入城市中，你所熟知的一切事物都在核大战中化为乌有。尽管如此，人类的历史还远远没到划句号的时刻，地下设施中的AI诺娅将你从坍塌的山洞中救起并邀请你接替她的上一任“操作者”帮助她完成创造者交给她的工作，你们将引导之后出现的人类文明，帮助他们尽快从刀耕火种走向星辰大海，最终将他们送出孕育他们的摇篮。

至于为什么诺娅的创造者要赋予她这项工作？答案恐怕还要您自己去发掘。

游戏玩法

《诺娅计划》是一款文字冒险游戏。它主要由科技获取界面与文明冲突界面组成。玩家在科技获取界面获得新的科技界面中获得新的科技，这些科技能在文明冲突页面中应用。玩家在应用科技时可以选择此项科技是进攻性或防御性，以此达成100%占领星球的目的。玩家控制的文明有多个结局，达成这些结局能增加玩家对剧情的了解，并在最终决定诺娅计划的走向。

游戏特色

1.软科幻故事

2.具有随机性的科技树

3.简化的文明冲突界面

On the earth that has experienced countless doomsday scenes, lead mankind to regain the technology of the past and integrate all mankind in the way of War (maybe without war?)

Game content

You are an agent on a mission to prevent the outbreak of nuclear war, but your mission failed. During the mission, you mistakenly entered an underground facility and regarded its personnel as terrorists to be eliminated in the mission. When you think the target has been solved, the first nuclear bomb has already fallen into the city, and everything you know has disappeared in the nuclear war. Nevertheless, human history is far from coming to an end. AI Noa in the underground facilities rescued you from the collapsed cave and invited you to replace her last "operator" to help her complete the work entrusted to her by the creator. You will guide the human civilization that will emerge later and help them move from slash and burn to the Starry Sea as soon as possible, Finally send them out of the cradle where they were born.

As for why Noa's creator gave her the job? I'm afraid you have to find the answer yourself.

name: Project Impulse
summary:
Project Impulse is a VR movement shooter where you can climb anything and all interactions are physics based. Jump and slide to keep your momentum to gain an advantage over your enemies!

VIRTUAL REALITY MOVEMENT SHOOTER 
Project Impulse is a fast paced VR movement shooter where you can climb, push and vault over everything! Combining the fun of traditional boots on the ground shooters with an innovative climbing locomotion system.
ADVANCED MOVEMENT TECHNICES 
Project Impulse was built from the ground up to reward players who master the movement. We encourage players to gain momentum and preserve it though techniques such as bunny hoping, sliding and surfing slanted slopes.
PHYSICS BASED INTERACTIONS 
Everything you do in Project Impulse is based on physics! When your hands hit a wall the wall pushes back. When you shoot a gun it recoils. By having a completely physics based game we can provide a more immersive and interactive experience.
MULTIPLAYER 
In Project Impulse you're able to join friends server or others using our server console. We provide a cross platform experience connecting players on various platforms such as steam and oculus. We currently feature 3 game modes Team Death Match, Elimination and Free For All. With many more to come in the future.

Story

Something moves through the universe, burrowing through the fabric of spacetime. Whether it is consciously steering itself, mindlessly meandering, or compelled by some force of nature, we do not yet know. When its tendrils broke through to our world, it cast a ripple of energy through our society that sowed confusion, panic, and fear. Amidst the chaos, the necessity of community drew us into guilds.

Through its own corridors, we have traveled. Always, we arrive at a world in ruin. The creatures among these worlds - some of which left behind evidence of intelligence and technology - have been driven to extinction. In their absence, our guilds have discovered an abundance of resources to scrap over.

Master Vulder is an archery shooter with unique mechanics.

You have to play for the god of archery. In the early stages of his rise. While in the native lands of Idalir, you are free to do with your enemies as you wish. Your bow and arrows have served you faithfully for a long time.
Hunt, evolve, collect the souls of enemies. You will need many souls to be recognized by the gods of Asgard as equals. As your character develops, you will be able to make friends with forest dwellers such as foxes, raccoons, wolves, bears, hares, birds. Each of them has distinctive features. For example, enlisting With the help of raccoon thieves, you will not have problems finding arrows. The raccoons themselves will bring them to you. Shoot, run, pull out arrows - all this will help you in the development of the main character. The difficulty of the game increases with each defeated opponent. Each new opponent will be stronger, faster and more cunning than the previous ones. Where one died, new ones will come!

A simple shooting system using crosshairs in the past. Aim with your senses. Keep a close eye on the number of arrows in your body. A large number of arrows can cause bleeding - take them out!
Peculiarities

Realistic Archery System.
Unique body control system based on inversion kinematics
Maneuvering Enemies
Adaptive system to increase the difficulty of the game
Cinematic effect of an arrow flying on a fatal shot
Development statistics management system, become the best player!
Future Features
Increasing the skill and number of souls will increase the number of followers of your god

Discover who you really are on an adventure where choices matter and accuracy is paramount.

5225 is an indie 2D pinball-platformer where your choices matter. Using a "pull back and release" launch mechanic, you'll navigate 5225's sphere through a wide array of environments. Precision is key - one failed launch could send you sliding back down to where you started. Along your journey, you'll collect upgrades for 5225's sphere, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and attempt to beat high scores on "classic pinball" levels.

You'll periodically come across questions during your playthrough and how you answer those questions will alter your experience (visuals, dialogue and more) and ultimately determine the final personality analysis you receive. Who knows...maybe you'll learn something about yourself (or 5225) along the way.

黑帝斗者

name: Divine Combat
summary:
Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. The fights are in top-down view on a grid, much like similar turn-based unit management games. There is no penalty for losing.

Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. Each team is led by a "Divine", or a being of immense power. Your goal is to win every battle and get the perfect team.

In the main hub, walk around in 3rd person and talk to NPCs. You can also upgrade your units and purchase items from the shop in the hub level.

In the combat zone, you will have a team of 6 characters and will fight an enemy team to the death in a top-down grid view. All units will automatically find the best path to a location, so you will not have to manually plan moving out each unit, they will do it automatically.

name: 圣魔争霸
summary:
当动人的情节和唯美的画风成为动作型角色扮演型游戏给人的第一印象的时候，玩家们便开始对此类游戏有了更多的挑剔，诸如故事情节、战斗系统、人物设定、升级系统等方面，都会对一款新游戏的评价加入进自己的看法，希望新的一款游戏能有更多特色。而新瑞狮这款在剧情、美术、人物、音乐等方面都达到相当水准的ARPG游戏——《圣魔争霸》，也许会带给你耳目一新的感受！

开放式的剧情

传统角色扮演类游戏一般使用的是非开放的单线结构，即玩家在游戏中扮演的角色只能依着固定的路线走固定的剧情，否则情节就无法进行下去。而《圣魔争霸》开放式结构剧情则完全不一样，它让玩家在游戏中可以自由的来去，做自己的事，打自己的仗。也就是说，玩家在这种结构的游戏中，自己是自己的主人，而不再是一个傀儡。这与单线结构的游戏相比，自然有更大的好处，并且也更适合于A.RPG这种游戏类型，对于传统局限于单线式剧情的ARPG来说，《圣魔争霸》则完全是一大解放。

独特的主线任务和丰富的支线任务

作为一款角色扮演游戏，主线是游戏进行的前提。但是传统的ARPG往往只是注重主线任务的发展而往往不太重视支线任务，这不能不说是一大遗憾。在今天以玩家为导向的游戏市场，玩家希望主线的精彩，同时又渴望有着丰富的支线剧情。而《圣魔争霸》则很好的满足了玩家这一口味，《圣魔争霸》注重主线与支线的平衡性，在游戏中，寻找传说中神奇水晶来拯救Petera星球是整个游戏的灵魂事件。而丰富的分支剧情则会让玩家叹为观止。分支任务的来源主要是酒馆及事件NPC，其中酒馆中的任务是玩家取得金钱和经验值的主要来源，任务类型主要有送货、保镖、走私、委托购物、刺杀、冒险、寻宝、打劫、刺探秘密、除害、救人等。而且支线任务之间有些会有一些相互的联系，让玩家感觉到看似游戏世界，实则现实人生的感受！
单机版及多人联线版两种模式：

设计者针对网络游戏流行于今天的趋势，将《圣魔争霸》设计成为一款带有丰富剧情的网络联线对战游戏，游戏分为单机版及多人联线版两种模式，玩家即可以选择在单人游戏中体验丰富曲折的剧情，也可以享受在同一剧情中多人联合作战及对抗的乐趣，这样玩家就可兼得两家之长，既经历到曲折的剧情，也享受到了刺激的联线对战。

独特的谎言系统

听说过“众口铄金，积毁销骨”这句成语吗？在《圣魔争霸》中，你会亲自感受到谎言的厉害，《圣魔争霸》中的谎言系统是已往任何一款ARPG游戏所不具有的独特系统，这也是设计者的匠心所在。在《圣魔争霸》中，作为主角的你可能会听到很多传闻，其中有些传闻你很希望它变为现实，如果想要你的愿望得到实现，你必须将传闻传送到城市里的各个角落，将谎言传播出去。但是不同地方的要求的可能不一样，总之，达成条件后慌言就将成为现实。这样以来，也许你的过关任务就简单多了哦～

题材西式化

作为题材，《圣魔争霸》一改传统的以中国历史和神话为题材，而选择类似与中世纪欧洲为游戏历史背景，独创的魔幻故事。故事的发生地是在遥远的而又神秘的Petera星球上。主要的事件是以三个种族间争夺水晶的题材而展开。这对中国游戏永远局限在历史武侠神话中是个大胆的尝试。由中国人尝试做西式化的游戏无疑开了先河。这也给中国游戏永远局限在武侠神话等故事的怪圈之中带来全新的刺激。

制作精美的地图

制作超过一万屏的精美地图，让玩家在游戏的过程中感受到来自遥远而又神秘的Petera星球上的原始风貌。三个种族，三种不同风格的建筑，在玩家感叹异域风景之美时，又不得不惊叹制作组画工的精美！

完美的战斗

《圣魔争霸》是一款ARPG游戏，是介于角色类扮演（RPG）与动作类游戏（ACT）之间的游戏类型。它既结合了角色类扮演的丰富剧情，又可以将动作类游戏的战斗方面发挥得淋漓尽致。战斗中，玩家既可以享受及时战略的快感，又可以享受绚丽多彩的法术效果！

浑厚凝重的音乐：

音色浑厚凝重，很适合游戏的情节；游戏的音效设计的很合理，配合不同的事件都会有不同的配音。注重气氛的渲染，现场环境的烘托，跟现代影视相接近！一改传统绚丽花哨的风格，相信在沉重凝厚的音乐声中，玩家会有身临其境的感受。
