name: Just Power: The Papal States
summary:
你准备好建立一个控制教廷几个世纪的罗马王朝了吗？在这个基于回合制的政治模拟游戏中，你可以想方设法攀附统治阶级，建立自己的裙带关系，用敲诈和贿赂的手段来获得你想要的一切。

罗马帝国并没有消亡，只是改变了它的外在。腐败、裙带关系和权力斗争都是你在这个回合制政治模拟游戏中的一部分。随着异端邪说的出现，你必须保护罗马独一无二的信仰及其完整性。要重新建立教皇至高无上的权威（也包括你的家族），如何达到这个目标取决于你自己的行动。
攀附统治阶级，提拔亲朋好友，按你自己的想法重塑教会。你准备好带领基督世界进入一个新时代了吗？
成为教皇并管理教会
你准备好领导教会了吗？你是否能够带领它走向伟大，防止它分崩离析？并非所有的教皇都有这样的担忧："既然上帝给了我们教皇职位，那就让我们享受它吧 "听听，这是教皇利奥十世的说辞。可以肯定的是，作为圣彼得的继承人会带来巨大的好处。你可以任命主教，决定谁能进入红衣主教团，决定关键教会和机构的管理层。如果你不能把教会交给优秀的管理，至少要确保你的子孙成为你的继任者。
贿赂、勒索和（如果需要）杀戮
你固然对上帝的子民有着美好的期望，但记住：学习游戏规则，比别人更能应用这些规则。登上教皇宝座的不一定是最虔诚的候选人。这个世界到处都是恶人，他们会毫无顾忌地把你拉下马。如果你真的想在历史上刻下你家族的名字，光有好的期望是不够的。有一些手段是必要的：贿赂长官以获取职位和好处；敲诈那些你知道其秘密的人，如果事情出了问题，你也不必吃斋念佛。
开始调查，除掉教会的敌人
罗马教会是一个强大的机构。像任何强大的机构一样，它必须保护自己免受对手的阴谋。圣手团是专门为剪除异己这项任务设立的组织：找出教会的敌人并消灭他们。自行决定罗马最大的威胁是异教徒、腐败还是你的家族对手。
创建办公室
罗马的官员大都由别人举荐，他们的工作激情很低，但却担任着要职。请延续这种传统。设立无用但名字庄重的职位，然后把亲戚、朋友和党内同伴放在这些位置上。显然，越重要的职位薪水越高...
管理主教区
即使你永远不会成为教皇，这也不排除你可以管理一个国家。你可以决定如何分配国家的资源，是投资于善事还是把钱转给自己和你的亲戚。你会是一个好的还是糟糕的管理者呢？
创建一个王朝
尽管教会的复兴很关键，但你的家族永远是排第一位的。你将从最偏远教区的牧师开始做起，通过努力一步步成为罗马的主教。将你的亲属置于国家管理层的顶端，让你的继承人世代继承这份荣耀。记住，死亡停止的是身体，而不是思想：你的家族成员仍然会坚定执行你的计划。
打击异端
对教会完整性的最大威胁是异端。但你确定它真的很糟糕吗？你选择是无情地迫害他们还是和他们一起来改革教会。
管理与其他王国的关系
教皇不是欧洲唯一的领袖。其他人也有兴趣参与到罗马教廷的事务。请与欧洲最重要的法院进行互动，捍卫教会的利益，达成协议，确保所有的百姓永远在罗马的管辖之下。
改变法律
上帝制定的法律是远远不够的。百姓必须遵守你制定的法律。税收、刑罚和法规只是你要决定的一些事情。接受贿赂的适当惩罚是什么？这取决于你将扮演什么角色：正义的捍卫者还是腐败的投机者？
处理流程
最后，除了会审判我们的上帝，还有地球上的法庭。请记住：法律只严格适用于敌人；对于朋友，它是可以变通的。

In “Only Lead Can Stop Them” you take on the role as a soldier during the Spanish Civil war, fighting to defend the republic from being crushed by opposing fascist forces.

Over the span of your adventure, you will explore three epic campaigns with a total of 30 levels packed full of dangers and secrets to be discovered. Explore ancient castles, catacombs, muddy trenches, dense forests and combat zones of a war torn battlefield, whilst earning medals along the way for your heroic deeds!

Blast your way through fast-paced levels using your powerful arsenal of ten weapons, including machine guns, explosives, shotguns, pistols and rifles. Fight with purpose! Free your fellow comrades and unravel the fascists' path of destruction.

Only Lead Can Stop Them” takes stylistic influence from classic 90s shooters , featuring detailed environments and enemies rendered in pixel art as well as an uncompromising, break neck, fast paced style of gameplay.

The game features over a dozen distinct enemy types to fight. Whilst many of your enemies will be equipped with firearms, you will also battle strange supernatural occult forces capable of blasting you to pieces!

name: Kapellmeister
summary:
跑步。 隐藏。 听从命令。 保持安静。 解决难题。 不要忘记检查相机； 有人在跟踪你。 如果你幸运的话，也许你会摆脱这个永无止境和重复事件的循环。

Kapellmeister 是一个 恐怖游戏 ，带有 拼图元素 ，在这种游戏中，从某人那里逃跑不是一种选择。相反，您将必须完成任务，解决难题，同时密切关注正在注视您的人。使用手机的手电筒导航（不要让某人失明），使用闭路电视摄像机确保安全，以及其他有助于您旅途或生存的必要物品。游戏还要求您以某种方式行事，保持隐秘和谨慎，或者只是完全冻结在原地并等待再次移动的许可（不，不是那个游戏）。

在环境中寻找任务。不同的会要求你使用逻辑、数学、记忆和视觉线索。

如果没有某些项目，有些事情对你来说是不明显的。始终保持警惕并使用您所拥有的。

其他东西需要维护，这样你就可以继续你正在做的事情。

不过，你没有世界上所有的时间。最好找个地方躲起来。

Run. Hide. Follow the orders. Keep quiet. Complete tasks. Don't forget to check the cameras; someone is stalking you. And if you are lucky, maybe you'll get out of this loop of never-ending and repeating events.

Kapellmeister is a horror game where running from somebody is not an option. Instead, you will have to complete the tasks, solve puzzles while keeping an eye on someone who's watching you. Use your phone's flashlight to navigate (not to blind someone), CCTV cameras to keep safe, and other necessary items that will help you in your journey or survival, rather. The game will also require you to behave a certain way, be stealthy and cautious.

Look for tasks in the environment. Different ones will require you to use logic, math, memory, and visual cues.

Some things won't be obvious to you without certain items. Always be on the lookout and use what you've got.

Other things will require maintenance so you can continue with what you're doing.

You don't have all the time in the world, though. Better have a spot to hide.

Tranquil sounds and serene visuals will help you enter your flow state and lose yourself into the colors.

With its minimal aesthetic, clever use of white space and calming sound design, it aims to invoke feelings of peace and tranquility.

name: Planet after us

The main enemy in the game are robotic tanks that roam singly or in groups around the map. The game has a rather complex combat mechanics, each gun has penetration and three types of damage. At the same time, the armor of opponents can also have different thicknesses and other parameters, due to which you may not be able to penetrate it, or vice versa, you will crit with every shot. Therefore, you will have to collect complex sets of weapons to kill every serious enemy. A feature of the game world is the presence of a super-dense atmosphere, due to which the projectiles fly slowly and during the battle the enemy can dodge your shot, so that even a volley from four different guns at the same time can be carried out past the target. It is necessary to predict the position of the enemy in space and strike ahead of time, correctly calculating the trajectory.

If a letter is:

Red - That letter is not in the word.

Yellow - That letter is in the word, but in a different spot.

Green - Perfect! That letter is in the correct spot. The same goes for blue.

You play as Marshall, a former detective pulled back into a world he tried to escape when a series of ritualistic murders begins to mirror a case that destroyed his life. The deeper you investigate, the more you realize the killings are not isolated — they are part of a growing cult movement that worships something ancient, hungry, and disturbingly human.

Explore abandoned factories, forgotten tunnels, and derelict districts swallowed by corruption. Every location hides clues, memories, and twisted remnants of the cult’s influence. Your choices shape Marshall’s sanity, relationships, and the truth he uncovers — but some truths refuse to stay buried.

Akolyta blends cinematic storytelling, immersive first‑person exploration, and survival‑horror tension. You’ll gather evidence, solve environmental puzzles, and confront entities that defy logic. As the cult’s grip tightens, reality fractures, and Marshall must face not only the horrors stalking the city… but the darkness he carries within.

A hardcore tactical shooter with horror elements. Battle Machines and Mutants, and build your legacy on a deadly post-apocalyptic Cyberpunk Island. Explore dangerous zones, craft powerful gear, and shape your Cyberware build. Uncover secrets and fight to survive in a brutal, immersive world!

IMPORTANT (I Can’t Promise the Game’s Future and It Is Not a Finished Project) 
Development of my game is currently paused. The project has grown too large for me to complete alone, and without funding, I need to focus on my full-time job. I can’t promise when development will continue, but I do not intend to abandon the game, at least for now. This game is very important to me personally.

I’m truly sorry for the situation and appreciate your understanding. ABOUT RAISE YOUR TRIBE

An immersive survival experience that combines looter shooter, horror, survival mechanics, and realistic sim elements.

Highly optimized

A vast open world full of exploration opportunities

Play with your friends

Story with advanced dialog system

Base building

Vehicles

An online dedicated PvP server update will be added later, already tested with over 1,000 playtesters

And much more...

name: RUNES Magica
summary:
Runes Magica是类似于2D流氓的魔法动作游戏。 用各种魔法和工艺品打败敌人，结束复仇吧。

RUNES Magica是一款2D日志般的魔法动作游戏。

你作为"露妮娅"去旅行，一个因虚假指控而失去父亲的女巫师。
击败成为一切原因的骑士国王，完成你的复仇。
游戏特色

■ 符文系统
Lunia 使用她父亲完成的符文魔法。
通过符文合成发现新的符文并使用不同的法术。

■ 遗物
用70件工件完成最佳组合。

故事

尼亚顿王国的魔术师被骑士们诬陷和追赶。
卢妮娅，一个和父亲一起躲藏的女巫师，父亲被骑士团夺去，并离开去复仇。
骑士团

骑士团将根据骑士王的命令歼灭所有巫师。
打败追击的骑士，完成你的复仇。
赏金猎人

赏金猎人攻击卢尼亚是为了赏金、荣誉和他们自己的原因。
消灭所有路尼娅的敌人。

RUNES Magica is 2D rogue-like magic action game. Use a variety of magic and artifacts to defeat your enemies and end your revenge.

RUNES Magica is a 2D loglike magic action game.

You go on a journey as "Lunia," a girl wizard who lost her father to a false charge.
Defeat the knight king who has been the cause of everything and complete your revenge.
Game Features

■ Rune system
Lunia uses rune magic completed by her father.
Discover new runes through runes synthesis and use diverse spells.

■ Relic
Complete the best combination with 70 artifacts.

Story

The magicians of the Niaten Kingdom are falsely accused and chased by the Knights.
Lunia, a girl wizard who lived in hiding with her father, loses her father to the Knights and leaves for revenge.
Knights

The Knights will annihilate all wizards by order of the Knights King.
Defeat the chasing Knights and fulfill your revenge.
Bounty Hunters

The bounty hunters attack Lunia for bounty, honor, and their own reasons.
Eliminate all enemies in Lunia's way.

name: 30 Days to be the Best - Ultimate Edition
summary:
You have a dream... but the clock is ticking. Your determination and your own two fists are all you have left. Make them count. 30 Days to be the Best is a 3D fighting game with RPG and time management elements.

Your dream was always to become the greatest fighter of all time, right? Since you were a little child! You've been training, you've been studying, you've been doing everything you need to do to become the best. You're still young, in the prime of your life, the world is yours, nothing can stop you.

Except for cancer.

You have brain cancer now, and the doctor said you have 30 days left before your dream goes down the drain! And your life too.

Think you can become the One in barely a month?

30 Days to be the Best is a 3D fighting game where you fight your way to the top in Fighting Spirit, the toughest fighting promotion on the planet. 

You will have to take care of your health, manage your time and improve the right skills if you hope to defeat every obstacle in your way.

Things changed in the Ultimate Edition:

-The game now has post processing effects and a new lighting system.

-A new arena for secret battles has been added.

-Two playlist buttons have been added in the main menu.

-AI has been reworked to be more aggressive.

-Other minor bug fixes, UI changes and gameplay improvements.

summary:
A war rages between hell and what's above, your job is to supply magical weapons to the war effort. Orders come in and you must Mine, Craft and Enchant the weapons in time. Your production can be ENDLESSLY upgraded and optimized, paired with randomly generated orders to fill!

The war between Hell and the Above needs a constant supply of weapons. Manage your resources and craft a variety of magical items.

Dead Profit is a time management game, although resources and item forging happens passively (idle), everything can be optimized for best performance. The more orders you fill means new requests, unlock new resources, forge items & enchants. After finishing the main campaign, the orders are randomly generated so you must be prepared for any request.
Production
Filling orders require you to have the right resource, creating the right item each needing a different amount of resources and then enchanting/selling the item. To enchant an item you must time it right or it fails, enchanting multiple items in a row without it failing will stack a combo meaning the item sells for more.
Orders
Orders come in for items and you have a limited time to craft/enchant the requested amount, if you don't manage to fill the order in time the orders will come again to have a second shot. You wont be able to fill every order but once you know what its for you can prepare all the necessary items ready for when it comes back around. With the different combinations of resource/forge item/enchants it allows for hundreds of different orders.
After the main orders have been completed they are randomly generated meaning there is a constant supply and new challenges.
Artifacts
Once your getting further into the game you will be able to craft an "artifact" these are powerful weapons once owned by high ranking members of Hell's army. They offer passive and active abilities such as buffs to harvesting/forging Speed, increased sell value ect...

name: Binary Golf
summary:
Chaotic sci-fi mini-golf where every target grants a unique ability. Chain abilities, curve shots, and eliminate targets until the last one becomes the cup. Compete for stars in 4-player Battle Mode or explore a story full of bosses and secrets.

Binary Golf is a chaotic sci-fi mini-golf game where targets are everything. Hit them to collect their abilities, clear them all out, and watch the very last one transform into the hole.

Curve your shots before you tee off, then chain abilities mid-flight as you collect targets one after another without the ball ever stopping.

Easy to pick up, but hard to master.

Hit Super Targets to gain special abilities that transform how you play! But collect targets mid-flight and you can chain powers back-to-back in a single shot. Drill through blocks, hijack a helicopter, bend your path with a tornado, freeze time around you! Mastering these abilities is the key to pulling off trick shots, outmaneuvering opponents and passing the course obstacles.

Almost every episode ends with a boss fight or 2 that throws out the rulebook. Dodge projectiles, keep your ball moving, and use every ability at your disposal. These are not your average mini-golf holes. Each boss fight brings a unique twist to the game, pushing your golfing skills to new heights.

Face off against friends or AI opponents locally in fast-paced chaotic matches. Compete locally in a star-collecting scramble. Targets drop colored stars, but opponents can steal yours by touching them. Clear targets, convert stars, and sink the final shot for a bonus score. The player with the most stars wins.

Or play Deathmatch and forget the stars. Knock opponents out of bounds to eliminate them. Last ball standing wins.

Build your own courses, share them with the community online, and play courses made by other players worldwide. The game never runs out of holes.

name: This War of Mine: The Little Ones
summary:
《这是我的战争：孩子们》 让玩家以战时儿童的全新视角体验在战争中生存的艰难。在本DLC中，玩家将控制被困在围城的一群成年人和孩子。所有人都必须为了生存而苦苦挣扎。

《这是我的战争：孩子们》关注的不仅是战争的残酷现实，还淋漓尽致地刻画了孩子们在战争中表现出的纯真天性。他们会笑、会哭、会玩耍，并以孩子的视角去看世界。除了思考如何让大家生存下去，你还必须唤醒内心的童真，才能懂得如何去保护天真无邪的孩子们。他们的童年和未来就在你的手中。

开发者寄语：“我们认为，加入孩子们的视角使得这款游戏的体验更加饱满，这是我们做出的最重要的决定之一。但这也要求我们对战争的受害者表示出最高的敬意。因此，我们去除了无谓的血腥场面。我们想展现的是战争中孩子们的独特视角。”

特色：
保护无辜的孩子们
制作玩具，与孩子们玩耍，照顾他们的所需
儿童场景中增加了成年平民
购买该DLC以支持War Child慈善机构

name: Into The Wake
summary:
In this 2D platformer, we travel with Vera on her quest to escape the Wake. The Wake is a depressing realm full of the demons of Vera’s mental illnesses as seen through her eyes. Run, jump and slash your way through nightmares. Each path leads you to an epic battle with the oppressors of that realm.

Vera Sapphire is a young girl with a somewhat troubled past. Having grown up in a household with an abusive parent has left her with mental scars – scars that run deeper than she ever imagined. One night her sleep is troubled by a nightmare: As she left her apartment building the sharp cold winter air kisses her cheek, cutting through her skin. She walked the streets of the city with pain in her heart. A single tear fell from her face shattering the floor beneath her, and she falls.
She awakes from the nightmare in a gloomy and depressive dimension – The Wake. In that new "reality" she must confront many fears and anxieties in her journey to get out of the Wake. Along the way, she fights adversaries, makes new friends, and confronts her own biggest demons in her search for a way back home.

Game Features

 • A unique 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game featuring some touching subjects related to mental health.

 • Explore a vast realm called "The Wake" made up of a forgotten world where life as we know it came to a complete halt.

 • Engage in a thrilling combat system where every single hit counts!

 • Help Vera discover her true self and make some neat new friends along the way.

 • Go forth and slay the 5 horrific rulers of "The Wake", slashing your way through the lost souls.

 • Explore each of the 5 domains in which these demented dictators lurk in the shadows.

 • Collect shards of hope to upgrade your sword!

 • Face off against 20+ creatures per domain some with unique attacks and abilities.

 • Beautiful and ominous landscapes with immersive parallax and mesmersing lighting.

 • Venture into this unknown world accompanied by atmospheric and touching piano

name: Swift Attack
summary:
Swift Attack is a Military third person shooter, with an intelligent AI that provides a challenge to the player and won't be easy targets. You destroy ICBMs to prevent nuclear war. The Game is an homage to old third person shooters of the 90s.

In 2035 Insurgents Take over a middle eastern country and launch nuclear strikes on the Global Alliance Forces in the nearby countries.

You are dispatched to locate and destroy the remaining missiles before they strike again.

You face Different enemies in the deserts of the middle east.

This Game is an homage to the old third person shooters of the 90s.

name: This War of Mine: Complete Edition
summary:
在《这是我的战争》中，你扮演的不是精英士兵，而是一群在被围攻的城市中求生存的平民。你们食物、药物紧缺，还得时刻防范狙击手和敌对的拾荒者。这款游戏从全新的角度让玩家体验身处战争的感受。

《这是我的战争》的故事按照日夜循坏的步调展开。白天，避难所外有狙击手阻止你离开，因此你必须把注意力集中在避难所的维护上：锻造物品、交易、照顾幸存者等。晚上，你可以带上一名同伴在一系列独特的场所中搜集能让大家生存下去的物资。

到底是竭尽所能保护避难所里的每一个人，还是为了长久生存做出必要牺牲？你必须在良心的叩问下做出生死抉择。战争中没有所谓的好决定或坏决定，生存就是一切，你必须尽早认清现实。

---------

《这是我的战争：完整版》包括：


《这是我的战争》基础游戏完整版
周年纪念版更新：在游戏发行两周年之际推出的全新可互动角色、新场所和新结局
《孩子们》DLC：以战时孩童的全新视角讲述在战争中生存的艰难。
《这是我的战争》季票：《这是我的战争》世界中的3个全新剧情，向玩家呈现了对于战争的不同诠释，新老玩家都可以获得崭新且独特的游戏体验。

DLC包含：
第1集：《父亲的承诺》：讲述了在饱受战争蹂躏的城市里关于希望与失落的感人故事

第2集：《最后的广播》：作为一名广播员，你必须去面临道德的困境，去决定为了真相需要付出什么代价。

第3集：《余烬暗燃》：困在战区的安娜必须去面对一个沉重的问题——保护人类遗产和保护生命到底哪个更重要？

name: Summer Beach
summary:
《夏日海滩》是《性感沙滩》的精神续作，一款成人3D恋爱模拟游戏。
在高中毕业、对未来毫无头绪的那个夏天，你来到远离本土的海边小城——南滨港。
原本想着靠在姨妈开的小水吧打暑期工轻松混日子，却在一下车就遇上行李被偷、房租被坑、日薪被压的“南滨港式欢迎仪式”。
本以为人生要变成“垃圾处理组”的日常，却没想到——
这一切，正是改变命运的开始。
在这里，你将：
◆ 与多位性格迥异的女孩发展关系
浅野美咲：嘴硬心软、对男人不信任的表妹。冷脸毒舌，却会在深夜敲响你的房门。
水野夏樹：成熟开朗的姐姐型角色，能让气氛瞬间轻快起来。
小沢葵：神秘少女，对你有着莫名的亲近感，像猫一样黏人。
大岛朱美：洒脱不羁，喜欢自由的健身教练，热爱大海。
小沢沙耶香：知性短发，温和内敛，喜欢独处的书店女店员。
还有更多角色等你探索。
每个人都有属于自己的剧情、事件与隐藏心事。
你每个选择，都可能改变她们对你的态度。

◆ 经营一家“沙滩女仆水吧”
打工、采购、布置、招揽客人，在旺季来临前让水吧重获生机！
你可以让女孩们换装、分配班次，解锁特别服务与节日活动。
（当然，也可以被姨妈继续压榨当苦力。）

◆ 探索南滨港的小型开放世界
你可以在城镇中自由活动：
在码头钓鱼
租摩托车兜风
到海边潜水
解锁居民委托
与岛上的神秘传说互动
隐藏在岛上的秘密、怪异传闻，甚至某些“不可思议的存在”都等待你发现。

◆ 一段属于青春的海边物语
搞笑、治愈、恋爱、神秘交织的夏天。
你会选择平稳度日，还是改写自己与她们的未来？
南滨港的每一天，都可能是你人生新的转折点

summary:

Outraged, The Vinyl Club sets off to save The T.O.U. from the clutches of disco and its new corporate overlords.

Groovy * Funky * Disco
After nearly a year's worth of renovations, The Old Ultraviolet (AKA the T.O.U.; the second "the" is silent), hallmark of 1970s alt-culture, is back in business, primed to close the decade out in style. There's only one problem: the niche hangout spot is about to pivot from diverse, jack-of-all-trades concert venue to modern, one-note discotheque! 

Outraged by this trend-chasing switcheroo -- and the aggressive ubiquity of the relaunched T.O.U's marketing campaign -- the local Vinyl Club vows to oust the venue's new corporate overlords and save their beloved Old Ultraviolet from the clutches of disco, one disco-dungeon floor at the time!

Party-Based Exploration & Combat
The Vinyl Club starts off as a measly duo. As their journey progresses, their supporters increase in numbers to such a degree that, before it's all said and done, they've almost become worthy of their 'club' label! Led by de facto club president, Octavia, the club will march through colorful disco dungeons, administrative office areas, record stores, fastfood joints, hobby shops, and the (sometimes kind, sometimes mean) streets of their city in hopes of making things right. 

Turn-Based Battles
When accosted by the unpleasantries of the refurbished T.O.U. and other disco-fied habitats, the (up to 4) Vinyl Club members will engage them in turn-based combat. Each member brings their own element of musicology to the table -- from Octavia's prog rock theatrics to Ramon's raw punk power to Gee-Bee's medical funk magic -- allowing them to pump up their friends, bum out their detractors, and break their adversaries' elemental shields to land decisive blows.

Enjoy 1970s U.S.A.

name: Sokobear: Goo
summary:
An entire village threatened by yucky jelly goey creatures, and only Bear can save them! Explode the Goos by solving a sokoban style puzzle. Help Bear along the attacked places in his neighbourhood and be the hero amongst the Forest Folk.

Goo is everywhere, the slimy monsters have taken control, but the Forest Folk want their home back! Bear must deal with the creatures that have spread around 40 places in the woods. Let them eat goo and explode!

Give the Goos a taste if their own medicine.

Figure out the correct way to push this slime around. You don't want to miss the opportunity to explode some Goo!

Some Goos are stronger. They need more incentive to go boom!

Nobody wants a slimey neighbourhood, so it's best to get to work!

name: Sokobear: Cave
summary:
Bear has a shiny new job! There are lots of caves inside this mine full of glowing rocks, and he must collect the precious stones. Help Bear in these sokoban-like puzzles. Plan your moves, break the crystals blocking your way! Gathering gems can get quite tricky.

Bear’s job takes him to a massive cave, with 40 rooms. Inside the mine, he will find precious gems next to cheap crystals and some easily breakable rocks. To complete his task, solve the enigma on how to move the gems to their proper place!

This is a brand new place for Bear, but a familiar job. Gems need to be separated into holes, so roll them carefully around to do it!

Oh these? They are cheap crystals, go ahead and break any that are on your way. Just remember they may be useful on your task!

Bear needs to gather the blue rocks. The other colours just break too easy. No good for sales. And they do not make Bear's job easier. Pay close attention to how they break and block the passage.

Precious gems sorted, time to explore a new cave!

name: Sokobear: Summer
summary:
Summer heat is on! Bear found a new season job serving coconut water. Visit 40 places in this charming forest neighbourhood and solve sokoban style puzzles to help Bear open the coconuts. Job done, enjoy some freshness!

Nothing tastes better under the sun than fresh and chilled coconut water. Pitty it is so hard to open those coconuts! Bear doesn’t have a proper knife, so his trick is to roll the coconuts into the hole full of ice; it breaks open when falling in! Now, all Bear needs to do is find a way to roll those coconuts around the rocks, hay and ice!

Breaking a coconut is no easy task. You need to roll it to an exact spot.

It’s easy to get haystacks out of your way. Ice… that’s another story.

More coconuts means more fresh water, buuuuut it can make things a bit trickier.

Solve the puzzle to enjoy fresh and delicious coconut water.

name: Sokobear: Spring
summary:
Spring announces itself with many pumpkins sprouting out of the ground. Bear needs to harvest them. Roll them around with care and whack some nosy moles that are in the middle of the field! Solve the sokoban style puzzles to help Bear collect the pumpkins and have a good time!

Delicious pumpkins! The Forest Folk grew them with care in 40 different fields, and now they’ve asked Bear to harvest them. Problem is: the field is full of rocks and moles, making it a challenge to get the pumpkins to the sorting holes!

Firstly, this is south of the globe and we have grown pumpkins here during spring, ok? Now, with that out of the way, let's whack these annoying moles out of the way.

Carefully roll the pumpkins around. You can only push gently so as not to damage it! How will you do it to reach the hole?

Sometimes pumpkins can take a shortcut. Plan the way to do it!

1559年1月，伊丽莎白一世在伦敦西敏寺威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为女王。

在新女王的执政下，英格兰王国混乱的状况逐步步向稳定。

1560年8月，来自法兰西王国的旅人布兰德与在索尔兹伯里石环结识的少女莱芙，一同来到了伦敦。

接下赫特福德侯爵的委托，两人了解到伦敦政治的一端——来自西班牙的地下势力、往昔玛丽一世执政下发生的悲剧······

过去的种种因缘，将在一场宴会下揭晓······

文字冒险类游戏，每一章为一段故事，讲述16世纪时期英国的政教情况。

哥特风UI，极简风界面。

对西欧复古、政治、宗教题材感兴趣的朋友，不妨来试一试。

画师：虫子不吃虫

Text adventure games. The story happened in the British Isles in the 16th century. Players will experience the storyline from the perspectives of Brand and Lev, exploring personal stories in 16th century British society.

In January 1559, Elizabeth I was crowned Queen at Westminster Abbey in Westminster Abbey, London.

Under the reign of the new queen, the chaotic situation in the Kingdom of England gradually stabilized.

In August 1560, Brandt, a traveler from the Kingdom of France, arrived in London with the young girl Leif, whom he met at the Salisbury stone ring.

Following the commission of the Marquis of Hertfordshire, the two learned about one end of London's politics - the underground forces from Spain and the tragedies that occurred under the rule of Mary I in the past······

The various reasons of the past will be revealed at a banquet······

Text adventure games, each chapter is a story that tells the political and religious situation in England during the 16th century.

A small amount of classical music, including classic tracks by Schubert and Tchaikovsky.

Gothic UI, minimalist interface.

Friends who are interested in Western European retro, political, and religious themes may want to give it a try.

Attachment: This game is independently developed and produced by individuals, with character drawing and CG outsourcing.

Painter: Chongzibuchichong

name: Roly Poly
summary:
Play as a Roly Poly and roll into adventure!

This is an adventure and platforming game where you play as a Roly Poly. You know, one of those bugs you sometimes see outside, often when lifting up a rock? They might be regional or found all over the world?

Basically they're these insects that roll into a ball, it's literally all they're known for.

Game Features:

Roll into a ball.

Explore a forest from a tiny perspective.

Climb on sticks and leaves.

Talk with other rollies, some might even offer you a quest!

Eat different foods.

Discover the multiple mind-blowing endings, from maneuvering down Ribbit's Water Slide, to mastering the Bouncy Mushroom Forest, to enduring the terrible cave which houses unspeakable evil or maybe even collecting the rare gems to become the chosen one of the great Roly Poly prophecy that will bring you to a new plane of existence as told by the ancients.

Push around small rocks.

You will also learn interesting facts about these lovable lil guys. DID YOU KNOW that they eat heavy metals, removing them from damaging the environment? ..But they just release the metals back into the environment after some time... They temporarily help so that's good? Give the environment a little breather?

Birds and stuff eat them so they're a food supply but it's not like there's other bugs that can't be eaten.. They also damage crops which isn't a good thing...

But seriously you'd think that these bugs would have some kind of unique history or lore. There isn't a ton of information about them. Compare them to ladybugs who have several sections and cool facts about their history with Norse mythology and nursery rhymes.

Imagine being a roly poly finding out you're only known for rolling into balls and people can't even agree what to call you, roly polies, pillbugs, potato bugs? And you wonder why they roll into those balls, they're probably depressed.

An underwater lab. Relentless testing. 8 Guns.

It's time to take your revenge.

Revenge of the Killer Octopus is a level-based shooter all about fighting hordes of enemies in order to take your vengeance on the scientists who have kept you imprisoned for so long. Shoot through waves of enemies as you try to find your method of escape from this sci-fi nightmare. 

Student Project
RotKO is a capstone game made by Messy Bed Productions, a 24-student team from the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts and Engineering program. For all of us, it is our first game published to Steam. The music was made in partnership with students from Berklee College of Music.

Take Your Vengeance!
You've been trapped within this lab for so long. It's finally time to break free. Thanks to an intelligence enhancing serum, you can use the power of your 8 guns and miraculous grappling tentacle to shoot down those dastardly scientists that dared to keep you imprisoned!

Possess Their Minds
Swing onto an enemy's head in order to take over their body and mind for a limited time! Use their fleshy meat-bodies as a shield to prevent yourself from dying, and suffuse your life with theirs with every foe captured!

name: Board game party
summary:
这是一款3D桌面游戏集合，包含四子棋、点格棋、西洋跳棋等多种游戏。玩家可以选择在线对战，与全球玩家竞技，或者选择与智能AI进行策略对决，也可以在本地模式下与朋友共享游戏的乐趣。游戏采用逼真的3D游戏画面，模拟现实世界的游戏效果，为玩家带来身临其境的游戏体验。此外，游戏还设有全球排行榜，让玩家可以挑战自我，争取更高的排名，展现自己的游戏实力。无论玩家喜欢使用键盘还是游戏手柄，都能在游戏中找到最适合自己的操作方式。这款游戏将带给玩家前所未有的游戏体验，让玩家在游戏中找到乐趣，挑战自我，与全球的玩家一起竞技。

这是一款独特的3D游戏，集成了众多经典的桌面游戏，为你打造了一个全新的游戏世界。在这个世界中，你可以选择与网络上的好友或陌生人进行激烈的联机对战，也可以选择与智能的AI进行策略对决，或者在本地模式下与你的好友共享游戏的乐趣。

游戏的特色如下：

1. 游戏收录了丰富多样的桌面游戏，包括：

四子棋 : 玩家轮流在7×6的网格中投放棋子，目标是率先在水平、垂直或斜向连成4个同色棋子获胜。

快艇骰子 : 玩家轮流投掷骰子，组成不同的数字组合。如果5个骰子都相同，即为"快艇"，得分最高者获胜。

五子棋 : 在棋盘上轮流落子，目标是率先在任意方向连成5个同色棋子获胜。规则简单但策略深度高。

点格棋 : 玩家轮流连接网格上的线段，完成一个方框时获得该方框的所有权，拥有最多方框的玩家获胜。

彩珠密码 : 逻辑推理游戏，游戏开始时设置4个彩色密码，玩家通过有限次数的猜测和反馈信息来破解密码组合。

西洋跳棋 : 在棋盘上移动棋子，可跳跃对方棋子将其吃掉，目标是吃掉对方所有棋子或使其无法移动。

轨道棋 : 在轨道上放置棋子，目标是率先在水平、垂直或斜向连成4个同色棋子获胜。

六贯棋 : 目标是先将棋盘属于自己的颜色的边连成一线的一方为胜。

21点 : 经典纸牌游戏，玩家与庄家比较手牌点数，目标是让手牌总和尽可能接近21点但不超过。

翻翻棋 : 记忆棋盘上的各个棋子的图案，通过翻开相同图案的棋子来得分，翻开所有棋子后得分高的玩家获胜。

双陆棋 : 古老的棋盘游戏，通过掷骰子移动棋子，目标是将所有己方棋子移出棋盘，结合运气与策略的经典游戏。

蛇梯棋 : 通过掷骰子在100格棋盘上前进，遇到梯子可快速上升，遇到蛇头则滑落，率先到达终点获胜。

三角智链 : 玩家轮流将橡皮筋套在柱子上，在棋盘上形成三角形，将自己的棋子插入孔内占有。

2. 游戏支持多种游玩方式：

单机游玩，享受游戏的独立乐趣。

本地游玩，与朋友共享游戏的欢乐。

联机对战，与全球的玩家进行竞技。

支持远程畅玩。

3. 游戏支持多种输入模式让你的游戏体验更加丰富多彩。

无论你是喜欢使用鼠标键盘，还是喜欢使用游戏手柄，都能找到最适合你的操作方式，并且可以随时切换。

4. 游戏采用逼真的3D游戏画面。

模拟现实世界的游戏效果，为你带来身临其境的游戏体验。每一个细节都经过精心设计，让你仿佛置身于真实的游戏中。

5. 游戏支持本地和在线游戏模式自由切换。

你可以在等待匹配时进行单人游玩，无需浪费任何时间，让你的游戏体验更加流畅。

这款游戏将带给你前所未有的游戏体验，让你在桌面游戏中找到乐趣，挑战自我，与全球的玩家一起竞技。

BattleSage is a 3rd person single player action adventure game.

The construction of the world is primarily inspired by flight mechanics.The world of BattleSage possesses a lot of verticality. If we draw a line from the starting point in the game to the point where the player ends, it runs almost straight up.

name: C.T.R.L
summary:
In C.T.R.L, you drop a bunch of characters into a hostile world and see who makes it out. They’ll form alliances, betray each other, starve, fight, and adapt. You can sit back and watch—or mess with everything just to see what happens.

C.T.R.L is a single-player, top-down arena sim where you create your own cast of tributes, throw them into the wild, and watch the chaos unfold.

Each match starts with the basics—scavenging for food, finding shelter, maybe a few awkward team-ups. But it doesn’t stay peaceful for long. Hunger sets in. Resources run dry. Someone finds a weapon. Alliances fall apart.

And while they’re doing their best to survive, you’re free to make things worse. Toss in a firestorm. Spawn a bear. Drop explosives right in the middle of a friendly campfire chat. You can shape the match as much—or as little—as you want.

There are no quests, no heroes, no happy endings. Just a living sandbox full of unpredictable AI, designed to fight, adapt, and turn on each other in surprising ways.

Customize characters, change the rules, sit back, or meddle constantly. However you play it, C.T.R.L is all about watching what happens when the world stops playing fair.

Aery – A new Frontier is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a bird-like creature in space and on distant planets.

Maze Dungeon 是一款带有 3D Voxel 图形的动作类 Roguelite 游戏. 该游戏的灵感来自可收藏且不断增长的 roguelite 游戏，例如 Binding of Isaac 和 Risk of Rain. 攻克充满装备、独特神器、迷宫般复杂地牢和强大敌人的地牢.
培养你的性格

During a summer camp, Brad sees his mother being brutally murdered... After a few years he decides to return to the site with his friends to go camping for the weekend and lose the trauma that haunts him.

But he didn't expect to find the same killer who took his mother's life, the famous and cruel killer known as "pig's head".

ABOUT GAMEPLAY:

Camera: Semi fixed camera, old ps1 game style.

Controller: Full compatibility with Xbox 360 controller.

Graphics: Inspired by old ps1 games and the era of vhs tapes.

History: Classic history of 80's slasher horror movies.

Movement: Control tank style old ps1 games.

Duration: It's a short game, lasts about 1 hour.

name: Skeleton Attack: Nightmare Awaken
summary:
Unleash the power of the resilient skeletons as you embark on a perilous journey to defeat creatures, acquire new skeletons, and become stronger in this captivating action-adventure.

Gather your squad of up to five diverse and dynamic skeletons, each wielding unique abilities, as you venture forth on an epic action-adventure to vanquish menacing creatures, acquire new skills, and grow stronger in a world shrouded in darkness.

name: Jessica Mysterious Journey
summary:
Featuring innovative hidden object gameplay and an intriguing storyline, Jessica. Mysterious journey is a thrilling escape for the whole family.

Embark on a brain-bending, mysterious journey with Jessica, an adventurer and riddle-solving lover. During vacation part of an ancient map comes into her hands. Intrigued by an old legend and the hidden treasure, Jessica fearlessly sets out for adventure.

Find rare items, missing pieces of the map and solve a secret code in level after level of stunning hidden object challenges. Search intricately detailed scenes for hidden objects, solve perplexing puzzles, and discover a lost treasure tucked away in a secret location.

name: NecroArcher
summary:
NecroArcher can be best described as a mix between Lord of the Rings and The Hangover movies in the form of a Metroidvania.

NecroArcher can be best described as a mix between 
Lord of the Rings and The Hangover movies in the form of a Metroidvania.

It’s a humorous indie metroidvania game with elements of Hack’n Slash, where you control an undead archer on a mission to save his friend Larry from the clutches of The Evil Witch, aided by Stanley the vampire. But well... it might be more complicated.

Explore a vast interconnected world and fight a variety of creatures.
With a mix of fantasy and coming of age themes, embark on an unforgettable adventure full of humor, personal growth and the triumph of friendship!

Classic Sokoban game set in Koni's castle from the fantasy world of Chronicles of Sarval.

After the events of...

King Nabonus was still without his beautiful dog Torte. With the help of Captain Will, his faithful commander, the king has discovered that his dog is trapped in his own castle.

In Koni: The Secrets of Castle, the player is King Nabonus and needs to solve the Sokoban challenges and discover the secrets of Koni's castle in order to free his dog

The game features challenging Sokoban puzzles

name: Evasion from Hell
summary:
Escape all 9 circles of hell by showing off your 3D platformer skills. A terrifying yet beautiful world full of surprises, challenges and lost souls is waiting for you. Will you be able to escape from hell?

Welcome to Hell 

In this game, you start your journey in the lowest circle of hell and slowly work your way up to gates of hell in order to escape and return to the world of the living. Therefore, the game consists of 9 huge areas, each representing one circle of hell. In each area the player has to find a certain number of soul crystals in order to open the portal to the next level and to advance one circle. 

The game is a uniquely stylized 3d first-person platformer and plays around with the concept of live and death.
Each circle consists of 5 different platforming challenges and surprises with breathtaking environments, a surreal world full of beauty, grace and despair, and a couple of small environmental puzzles that blend perfectly into the peaceful yet stunning environments. 

Will you be able to escape hell?
Find it out.
Here are some of the features of the game:

 Fast-paced parkour action

 An interesting background story

 9 unique worlds with 5 challenges

 Countless traps and difficult jumps

 Hidden paths and secret achievements

 The feeling of smooth and fast speed while bouncing through levels

 Awesome soundtrack

name: Princess Pyro
summary:
!! The sun is GONE . . . Princess Pyro's searing fire powers are the only hope to revert the mysteriously sudden nightfall and fight back the encroaching forces of darkness. Jump, dash, and fireball across Pyro Castle in flashy retro-cade style!

Note from developer:
Hey friends! If yall end up loving Princess Pyro, I could certainly see a more elaborate continuation or derivative in the future. Thank you SO much for your support. Please enjoy and have fun <3

Princess Pyro's searing fire powers are the only hope to revert the mysteriously sudden nightfall and fight back the encroaching forces of darkness!

THE GAME
A short and sweet nod to retro arcade gaming, with some roguelike difficulty, and metroidvania flourishes! Unleash fiery havoc across Pyro Castle to uncover the source of the sudden nightfall! Fight your way to the end and defeat the source of darkness... Dun dun dunnnnn. Rack up points to get on the score board.

THE MAKING
Princess Pyro was made with a lot of soul and aimed for that flashy arcade style with roguelike difficulty.

CREDITS
Creative commons music by Sound Forces. A bit of inspiration from games like Rogue Legacy and Metroid Dread.

EXTRAS & NOTES

 Xinput controllers supported.

 Three difficulty modes.

 Female protagonist.

 Locally saved hi-scores (like an old arcade box).

 Secret spots and optional precision-jumps.

 An in-hiding Ms Goblets.

Please enjoy and have fun <3

该游戏是回合制棋类游戏，玩家可以提供的选手发挥自己的想象力编写不同规则的棋类。

玩家能通过这个游戏自己设计自己喜欢的棋类游戏，或者是在已经存在的棋种上玩法做改进，然后进行本地对战或局域网对战。在计算机博弈爱好者来看，这个游戏能作为一个ai平台，玩家可以自行编写ai引擎对战。

The game is a turn-based board game, and players can provide players with their imaginations to write different rules of board games.

Through this game, players can design their favorite chess games, or improve the playing methods of existing chess types, and then conduct local or LAN games. From the perspective of computer game lovers, this game can be used as an AI platform, and players can write their own AI engine to fight.

name: Hex Rally Racers
summary:
在咒语横飞的魔法世界里骑着飞天扫帚竞速，制作疯狂的魔法道具干扰你的对手并一骑绝尘吧！

Hex Rally Racers（速爆魔女）是一款3D赛车游戏，玩家骑着飞天扫帚在疯狂扭曲的魔法赛道上竞速，结合不同成分制作各种药水对付其他玩家。在混乱的比赛中穿过六条令人惊叹的赛道，与其他七位女巫比赛，或在多人分屏中与三个好友同时比赛！

飞天扫帚竞速：从四种不同的扫帚中选择一种最适合你的玩法，并成为赛道的主人。骑在漂浮的扫帚上，把赛道抛在身后，在树木之间，在河流上，在天空中飞翔。掌握好弹跳、俯冲的速度，将你的对手甩在身后!

魔药制作工艺：每把扫帚都可以制作不同种类的魔药以在比赛中使用。在比赛中，寻找特定的材料，制成独特的法术，用来对付你的对手。灵活运用你的法术，并在比赛中占优势!

扭曲魔法赛道：在三个奇异的魔法世界里飞过六条疯狂的赛道。在月光森林中穿梭，跃过瀑布、湖泊和河流。在蘑菇森林上飞行，在巨大的蘑菇上弹跳，穿过茂密的河谷。飞向高空，探索天空之城，在风车、村庄和城堡之间来回俯冲。

古灵精怪的小女巫们：在八位古灵精怪的小女巫种选择一位和四种她们自制的扫帚中挑选一把，以你自己独特的风格驰骋这个魔法世界！

Race through spellbinding worlds on magic brooms and craft crazy hexes to leave your opponents in the dust in this action-packed, magical arcade racer!

Hex Rally Racers is a 3D arcade racing game for PC where players race on flying brooms through wild twisting and turning tracks, combining ingredients to craft potions to be used against other players. Race through six stunning tracks in a chaotic race against seven other witches, or against three friends at the same time in multiplayer split-screen!
Zooming Broom Racing
Leave the ground behind as you ride on a floating broom, zipping between trees, over rivers, and into the sky. Master the speed of your bouncy, swoopy broom to leave your opponents in the dust! Choose one of four different brooms to best suit your playstyle, and become the master of the track.
Hex Crafting
Each broom has access to a different variety of items to use during the race. While racing, seek out specific ingredients to craft unique spells to use against your foes. Learn your spells and dominate the race!
Twisting, Turning Tracks in Spellbinding Worlds
Fly through three gorgeous worlds over six wild tracks. Zoom through a moonlit forest, dodging trees and leaping over waterfalls, lakes, and rivers. name: Zombie VS Police
summary:
Zombie VS Police 是一款令人难以置信的令人上瘾的第三人称射击游戏，背景设定在一个充满僵尸的后世界末日世界。在这个游戏中你必须扮演一名与僵尸战斗并保护他的家乡的警察！

尝试在僵尸病毒猖獗的城市中生存！在这个非常有趣的游戏中，你必须扮演一个真正的警察，以自己的生命为代价保护他的城市。保护自己免受僵尸攻击。他们想吃你！！！在这个游戏中，你可以驾驶汽车和粉碎僵尸。让自己沉浸在僵尸启示录的世界中，保护城市！在游戏中，您会发现精美的图形和有趣的音乐！

游戏特色：

有趣的音乐和凉爽的氛围！

吸引人、直观的游戏玩法！

令人难以置信的美丽城市！

非常漂亮的图形！

Zombie VS Police is an incredibly addictive third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombies. In this game you have to play as a police officer who fights zombies and protects his hometown!

Zombie VS Police is an incredibly addictive third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombies. In this game you have to play as a police officer who fights zombies and protects his hometown!

Try to survive in a city where a zombie virus is rampant! In this incredibly interesting game, you have to play as a real policeman who protects his city at the cost of his own life. Defend yourself from zombies attacking you. They want to eat you!!! In this game, you can drive a car and crush zombies. Immerse yourself in the world of the zombie apocalypse and protect the city! In the game you will find beautiful graphics and fun music!

Game Features:

Fun music and cool atmosphere!

Catchy, intuitive gameplay!

Incredibly beautiful city!

Very beautiful graphics!

name: Heart attack
summary:
There are ghosts in the dark, in order to survive you need to light your way, but all the items for this are limited.

Heart Attack is a survival game in a night house in the genre of first-person horror. The ghost is waiting for you to enter the darkness to scare you and from fright your heart breaks, you die. Save yourself by collecting items to move further into the basement of the house to turn on the switchboard and drive the ghost out of the house.

The main character
Mitya is a pretty sick guy, lives in a dysfunctional family, constantly being at home begins to lead to mild schizophrenia, he begins to see ghosts.

Enemies
The main enemy of our hero is the ghost of his mother, who tirelessly wanders around the house, creating obstacles, scaring him. If Mitya cannot provide himself with lighting, the ghost can attack him. Sometimes a ghost flies by in the dark to identify itself.

summary:
「ととさーん、今からさか上がりをするよ。見てないとしょうちしないよー！」
——かつて、そう言って“私”の視線を独り占めしようとしていた幼い娘も、今や自分の部屋を持つ小学４年生。一方で、天真爛漫な小学１年生の息子は、公園で拾った石ころを宝物のように“私”へと差し出す。変わりゆく子供たちの成長と、今この瞬間にしか存在しない家族の体温。
本作は、『急がなくてもよいことを』のひうち棚（たな）が、自身の家族との日々を綴る随筆漫画です。繰り返される季節、不意に訪れる成長の寂しさ、そして眠りにつく前の他愛のない約束。過ぎ去れば忘れてしまうような“今日”という一瞬を、筆者は慈しむように描き留めます。
「誰かに自分を見つめていてほしい」という子供たちの切実な願いは、私たちが抱く「誰かと繋がっていたい」という想いへと重なり合います。二度とは戻らない“今”を、同時代を生きる“あなた”と分かち合うために。かつて公園で掘り起こされた“化石”が、あの日、父と子がそこにいた証であるように——名前のない今日は、いつか宝物に変わる。
優しく温かな眼差しに満ちた、家族の記録です。

*2026年6月18日，漫播发布下架公告

近日，我们关注到原著小说《一步之遥》相关争议及小说版权所属平台发布的处理结果。

根据版权所属平台最新发布的处理结果，该作品被认定存在“过度借鉴”问题。对此，我们高度重视，并已第一时间启动内部评估与处理流程。

在项目立项、开发及制作过程中，我们系基于版权方提供的合法授权开展合作，并依照正常版权采购流程取得作品改编授权。在项目制作期间，我们并未获悉上述争议情况。

经研究决定：
1、即日起下架广播剧《一步之遥》全部相关内容，并停止后续运营及传播；
2、停止与《一步之遥》相关的一切宣传推广活动；
3、已对本作品进行打赏的用户，无需额外申请，我们将在公告发布后10个工作日内完成核实与处理，并向用户账户返还对应数量的红豆；
4、如用户因作品下架涉及其他权益问题，可通过官方渠道反馈，我们将积极协助处理；
5、我们将继续与版权方沟通本次事件后续相关事宜。

summary:
【距離感ゼロの無自覚ワンコ 攻】× 【黙って耐える健気受】
切なすぎる、既婚の親友への片想い。
終われない恋の物語。


同期の三園に恋をして5年。
誰からも好かれる爽やかな三園と、心を開く相手が限られる俺。
正反対なはずの俺達が驚くほど気が合ったこと――それが、運命の暗転だった。

1年目に惹かれ、2年目に「結婚する」と告げられた。
結婚式で独り泣いたあの日から、俺の時間は止まったままだ。

既婚者の親友が好きなんて不毛すぎる。
この呪縛を解くため「俺、ゲイなんだ」と告げ、
三園に恋愛射程圏内に入らないよう、釘を刺そうとした。
そうして終わらせるはずだったのに、三園は拒絶とは違う、切実な顔で言った。

「……けど、俺はお前と会うの、減らしたくないよ」

その声ひとつで、俺の片想いは終わらなくなった。
この想いを終えられないのは俺の未練か、
それとも、あいつが無意識にこぼす
甘い何かに“先”があるからなのか――？


ーー親友へ。
お前が結婚していても
俺は５年も好きなんだ。

name: Must lagi
summary:
这部在诸多方面都堪称独特的作品，其诞生故事始于2006年：爱沙尼亚电影基金会邀请本国七位顶尖动画艺术家，让他们各自挑选一首自己喜爱的爱沙尼亚诗歌，用2-3分钟的动画短片进行视觉诠释。这个想法深受导演们的喜爱，无人拒绝参与，都为这部合集贡献了自己的精彩创作。此外，爱沙尼亚顶尖的戏剧与电影演员们也欣然为这些短片献声配音。
　　诚然，创作诗性动画的想法并非什么新鲜事。但像这样一部概念性合集，能将诗歌、音乐与动画等不同维度的表达如此精妙地融合在一起，我们或许还是第一次见到。这份成就主要归功于动画艺术家们的精湛技艺与天马行空的想象力。作为真正的大师，他们没有因为作品篇幅短小而松懈，始终牢记即便是在微型短片中，也需要构建完整且有说服力的艺术整体，运用属于自己的符号、色彩、背景等独特表达。从这个意义上说，创作一部两分钟的动画，所需投入的创作精力，丝毫不亚于一部二十分钟的作品。最终，这“绝妙七人组”成功解决了项目中最棘手的问题——实现了文字与画面的完美共生，同时又避免了“天鹅、龙虾与梭鱼”式的混乱（注：出自克雷洛夫寓言，比喻目标不一、互相掣肘）。每位创作者都交出了独具个性的作品，而这七部短片又共同构成了一部独一无二的整体。最终，我们看到的，正是一场围绕既定主题的精彩动画“即兴创作”！

大王要屠杀已经投降的俘虏和无辜家眷，萧融吐着血也要抓住他的袖子：“大王万万不可！”
……
后来，大王被他吐血吐的都有心理阴影了，万事都听他的，生怕一个不顺心，萧融就把自己弄死了
听话的大王俨然是个明君，眼看天下就要唾手可得，萧融满意的站在城楼上，俯视万里江山
这时，一只手伸到了他的腰上
萧融：“…………大王万万不可！！！”
看看我用了几个感叹号啊混蛋！
谁知，大王端详一番他的脸色，下了结论：“没有吐血，那就是可。”
萧融：“……”

summary:
Premortal VR is a medieval VR-only game. Explore and survive the procedurally-generated wilderness. Gather resources and craft gear. Build formidable bases. Overcome all boss trials to ascend!

Join our community

What is Premortal VR?
Premortal VR is an exploration and survival game for singleplayer set in a procedurally-generated world. Survive and explore the vast unique world. Gather valuable resources. Craft mighty weapons and armor. Sculpt the landscape as you see fit. Build villages and castles. Prepare well for your trials and ascend beyond!
Explore the world
Every new world is uniquely generated for the player. The terrain system makes sure there is complete variety in the generated foliage, structures, animals, and items. The ground itself can be dug using a shovel.
Gather valuable resources
The world is filled with usable resources like stone, wood, potatoes, copper and so much more! The player has a few stats like health and stamina which can be increased by the various food in the game. Some of the food can be cooked for bonus stats.
Craft powerful weapons and armor
The game features a crafting system that resembles real-world crafting techniques. Armor can be made using the sewing system. And metal weapons can be forged on the anvil using a smithing mechanic.
Build villages and castles
Players can build structures by accessing their handbook and selecting their desired unlocked build. Each build requires building materials that can be gathered from the world. Some builds have additional effects. For example, the bed allows players to sleep and skip the night.
Overcome your trials
There are powerful bosses that can be challenged. After every boss is defeated, the premortal has passed their trials and can ascend.

name: Light Odyssey
summary:
《Light Odyssey》是一款在每一场战斗中都考验技巧的类魂风格 BOSS 连战游戏。化身为「微光」，在被阴影笼罩的世界中夺回失落的光芒。于三阶段的致命战斗中直面庞大的巨像，接受精确、耐心与适应力的考验吧！

当光芒熄灭时，留下的将会是什么？

当宇宙被阴影侵蚀，你将化身为最后一缕光明——「微光」。黑暗愈发浓重之际，追随那微弱闪烁的光辉，抵达最后的星球。被温暖所吸引，你踏上了为宇宙夺回光明的旅程。

 为宇宙存亡而战

高耸的巨像挡在你与目标之间。这些冷酷的毁灭巨像，会不择手段熄灭你逐渐暗淡的光芒。对他们而言，你从未该存在，只是必须被纠正的错误。 

进化的战斗，无尽的挑战

类魂风格 BOSS 连战游戏《光之传说：奥德赛》，通过三阶段的致命战斗来击败巨像，每一步都更加严酷。新的攻击、全新的模式，以及愈发紧张的压迫感不断袭来。要战胜寂静中步步逼近的黑暗，你必须学习、磨炼，并在每个瞬间作出适应。

揭开失落世界的秘密

在战斗的间隙，探索早已湮没的文明废墟吧！解开古老谜题，破译遗落信息，揭示巨像的真正起源。随着发现的累积，你将愈发沉浸于那曾经被光辉照耀的世界历史，以及守护光芒所付出的沉重代价。

Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

When Light Fades, What Remains?

Play as Bandi, the last spark of light, in a universe consumed by shadows. With the darkness ever-increasing, you find yourself on the last remaining planet where a faint flicker of light draws near. Guided by its warmth, you set out on a journey to restore light to the universe.

A Fight for the Universe’s Survival

Towering and relentless, the Colossi stand between you and your goal. These stone-cold titans of annihilation will stop at nothing to extinguish your fading light. To them, you were never meant to exist. To them, you are a mistake they must correct. 

Evolving Battles, Endless Challenge

Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where you face each Colossus in three deadly phases. Fight for the universe’s survival as each phase brings new attacks, new patterns, and new stakes. Learn, master, and adapt as the darkness creeps up on you in total silence. 

Uncover the Secrets of a Lost World

Between fights, explore the ruins of a long-lost civilization. Solve ancient puzzles, decipher cryptic messages, and uncover the true origin of the Colossi. Each discovery will pull you deeper into the history of a world that once knew light—and the price paid to keep it.

欢迎来到《Tales of Yore》，这是一个充满冒险、探索和兴奋的世界。从世界上数百条路径中选择一条，赚取奖励并用战利品定制你的角色。拥有自己的宠物、房屋和华丽的帽子，所有这些都在跨越 250,000 块瓷砖、精美细致的像素艺术世界中。丰富的音效和原创音轨伴随您的世界之旅。拯救公主，解开谜团，别忘了送三明治。开放世界探索，无论是单独还是组队，都等待着 MMORPG 新玩家和老玩家。来吧，按照你的方式玩，从今天开始，开始写你的昔日故事

《昔日》的世界让玩家可以在不杀死任何东西的情况下体验整个世界。选择工匠之路，学习世界上已有的 50 多种食谱，并创造出可以出售给昔日公民和玩家的物品。制作武器和盔甲、裁缝帽子和其他服装、烹饪具有神奇特性的经典菜肴、创造独特的箭型和酿造药水。工匠的道路复杂而错综复杂，但却是一种有益的道路。

很久以前，饥饿的巨兽企图吞噬世界，唯一的解决办法是用美食把它们的肚子填满！可是，怪兽越来越多，订单多到我们应付不过来了……

你受主厨邀请，加入了厨师旅团，负责建设运营新的烹饪工厂，持续为怪兽提供食物。获取食材、搭建生产线、烹制灵感源自世界各地的精致餐品，每一道都要满足某些非常挑剔的味蕾。

往返各个岛屿，寻找巨兽胃口大增的真相。你将发现全新的食材、规则以及意想不到的麻烦，你的工厂系统将面临巨大考验。你能平息巨兽的饥饿狂潮，同时证明自己“巫师林”星级厨师的身份吗？

喂饱巨兽，维持和平

建设食品工厂

使用搅拌机、烤箱、锅炉、炸锅、分拣器和管道等设备，设计全自动厨房。

每种食材都有自己的逻辑。随着生产规模扩大，你需要管理时间、污染、过敏原、保质期等各种细节。

根据真实的规则驾驭食材

乳制品遇热凝结，坚果传播过敏原，肉类可能导致食物中毒，而面团则会逐渐发酵。学习这些规则，然后加以利用，建设……大概不会崩溃的工厂。

探索逻辑各异的岛屿

每座岛屿都有全新的核心食材、机制、危险和布局。

解锁新的餐品，解决当地奇怪的问题，建造所需的工厂，免得巨兽惹祸。

大规模解决多步骤的烹饪谜题

把简单的食谱变成管道和机器构成的庞大网络。

控制过于强力的食材，避免交叉污染，防止灾难性的凝结事故，顶住压力，维持生产运转。

后期系统，离谱又美味

随着探索深入，你将需要用到虚能机器、灌注液体、蒸汽烹饪系统，还要为辛辣餐食提供消化促进方案，甚至还有多层甜点传送带，就这样进入越来越古怪的地方。

summary:
一款轻度Rougelike+视觉小说游戏，通过不同的选择，走出不一样的归家之路。

本作为视觉小说+轻度Roguelike的结合。通过文字的叙述和在游戏中穿插的小游戏来展示出在2020年的时候我们的生活。玩家在游玩游戏的过程中可以根据自己内心的想法来决定故事的走向，最后走出不一样的回家的路。

在游戏中有数万字的文本故事来讲述整个事件的始末，同时有着很丰富的剧情选择，来体验很多种不同的生活。在游戏的其他方面，包含有轻量化的Roguelike元素，让每个人的归家之路都变得不同。快来加入进这场冒险当中吧！

疫情很可能是改变了无数人生命轨迹的事情，尤其对我们留学生群体也是如此。而在不同的地方，当地的人们对待疫情的态度也是不一样的。本作将从我们自己的视角出发，来描绘在我们记忆中的2020年，来描绘我们当时回家的路。

从一开始的担心国内亲朋好友的安危，到后来的国内亲朋好友关心我们的安危，这期间我们确实经历了很多，在这里，我们希望将这些故事分享给你们，以此来纪念无论在哪都过得十分不容易的2020年。

本作从GameHack 2021 “最佳主题作品”奖项获得者“归家疫途 GoingHome”改编而来，再次感谢在GameJam中的队友们。

name: Deadly Rain
summary:
致命之雨是一款以生还为主题的恐怖 FPS 游戏，让你在阴雨绵绵的废弃村庄中与成群的可怕变异生物展开一场可怕的生存之战。寻找并管理资源，尝试在最糟糕、最意想不到的情况下保住性命。

在一个废弃的村庄里，你已经分不清什么是事实，你只知道你的弹药即将耗尽，可怕的变异生物正从四面八方逼近，你唯一的选择就是：杀戮、逃跑或死亡。
简介
1954 年，苏联极权主义政权需要一种能够扭曲现实、向非国家支持者散播恐惧和惊慌的武器，而"恐惧" 计划就是从那时开始的。多年后，核电站建成，将致幻物质通过雨水传播到天空中，现在只剩下你要努力在地狱中生存下去了。
游戏特色

基于波浪的战斗：面对越来越强大的变种人群体。

资源管理：查找并管理注射器和弹药以维持生命。

可解锁区域：通过寻找分散在地图上的隐藏钥匙来解锁新区域。

武器种类：使用超过 13 种不同的武器（包括近战选项）来对抗变异威胁。

高可玩性：只要你保持理智，就可以玩。

Deadly Rain is a survival horror FPS game that puts you in a terrifying fight for survival against hordes of scary mutants in a rainy, abandoned village. Find and manage resources to stay alive in the worst and most unexpected situations.

Alone in an abandoned village, you no longer know what's real, only that your ammo is running out and terrible mutants are approaching from all directions, your only alternative is: kill, run or die.
SYNOPSIS
The year was 1954, the Soviet totalitarian regime needed a weapon capable of distorting reality and spreading fear and panic to non-state supporters, it was then that the Fear project began. Years later, nuclear power plants were built to infect the skies and spread the hallucinogenic material through the rain, now all that's left is for you to try to survive hell...
GAMEPLAY FEATURES

Wave-Based Combat: Face growing hordes of mutants that become increasingly stronger.

Resource Management: Find and manage syringes and ammo to stay alive.

Unlockable Areas: Unlock new areas by finding hidden keys scattered across the map.

Weapon Variety: Use over 13 different weapons, including melee options, to combat the mutant threat.

High Replayability: Play as long as your sanity holds up.

公元23XX年。即便记得今天是几月几日，也毫无意义。

因暴走的AI导致太阳消失，世界陷入黑暗与极寒之中。

在灭亡的世界里，失去生存意义的青年误入未知的地下街。

展现在眼前的，是由无数管道交织构筑的异形都市，以及孤独生存的吸血鬼少女。

与少女的相遇及在街中的日常，逐渐为空虚的青年心灵注入新生。

然而他终将知晓——被囚禁于地下城的吸血鬼们，背负着无法逃避的秘密与宿命。

剣と魔法の世界『フェルナード』に転移した少年・カズト。
彼は絆の女神より授かった力の代償として、
パーティーを離れると関わった人々の記憶から消えてしまう
『忘れられ師《ロスト・ネーマー》』として活動していた。

そのクエストをカズトは突破、かつての仲間(ミコラ、ファリーネ、ルッテ)と再会を果たす。

name: The Pathema 疫途
summary:
一款轻度Rougelike+视觉小说游戏，通过不同的选择，走出不一样的归家之路。

本作为视觉小说+轻度Roguelike的结合。通过文字的叙述和在游戏中穿插的小游戏来展示出在2020年的时候我们的生活。玩家在游玩游戏的过程中可以根据自己内心的想法来决定故事的走向，最后走出不一样的回家的路。

在游戏中有数万字的文本故事来讲述整个事件的始末，同时有着很丰富的剧情选择，来体验很多种不同的生活。在游戏的其他方面，包含有轻量化的Roguelike元素，让每个人的归家之路都变得不同。快来加入进这场冒险当中吧！

疫情很可能是改变了无数人生命轨迹的事情，尤其对我们留学生群体也是如此。而在不同的地方，当地的人们对待疫情的态度也是不一样的。本作将从我们自己的视角出发，来描绘在我们记忆中的2020年，来描绘我们当时回家的路。

从一开始的担心国内亲朋好友的安危，到后来的国内亲朋好友关心我们的安危，这期间我们确实经历了很多，在这里，我们希望将这些故事分享给你们，以此来纪念无论在哪都过得十分不容易的2020年。

本作从GameHack 2021 “最佳主题作品”奖项获得者“归家疫途 GoingHome”改编而来，再次感谢在GameJam中的队友们。

summary:

Third Person Tower Defense
Scorpion Overdrive is a combination THIRD PERSON SHOOTER and TOWER DEFENSE strategy game. It's a fast paced horde/ swarm scenario that relies on putting together the right combination of weapons, turrets, traps and ability upgrades for each mission to have a chance of surviving. As the waves of enemies crush in you will have to strategically place your defenses under increasing pressure. A variety of turrets and traps, including laser turrets, plasma cannons, shock traps, missile silos, time warp traps, and more are available to place in critical spots. Tear down the enemy as they seek to destroy your equipment and prevent your payday.

Any creatures that make it through your turrets and traps must be dealt with head on. Use laser rifles, particle shotguns, freeze cannons, proton grenades and more to personally annihilate the enemies. The messier the better.
Strengthen your arsenal

Clearing an area will earn you credits on the galactic underground market to purchase weapon and character ability upgrades that can be mixed and matched to build the perfect arsenal to combat the ever growing hordes that seek your demise.

summary:

The final goal is to Escape the school in short time. You can try to beat your highscore every time you are playing.

Hi, I´m snazzans, one of the lead developers of the game. Before telling you what the game is about I wanted to say that it was realy fun making the game:

drawing logos, programming, modeling and so on. However, you may ask :

What is Escape To School?

Escape To School is an first person Puzzle-action game with strategic parts where you have to get into a weird school in the evening which is protected by a guard and cameras to get the "Exam Book" you need, because you don´t want to write the final exam you didnt study for. The goal is to get into buildings, find coins to to open the door for the item you need and buy powerups.Finaly you have to escape with the , you have found in the main building, in short time. You can find items like keys , coins and soda which will help you beat the game faster and easier. You will always have a short description of the task to do next if you dont know what to do. There are also a couple of eastereggs hidden on the map, so try to find them.

Escape To School includes a tutorial which will help you learn and understand the game, 3 different soundtracks and a credits-section where all rights are included. 

There are also some settings which set the timer on/off, turns the music on/off and some which can change the mouse-sensitivity.

Try to beat your own score!

Good Luck!

掌控这款快节奏的载具竞技场射击游戏，移动就是你的终极武器。 在一个被人工智能叛乱摧毁的未来，人类的生存依赖于能够驾驭悬浮坦克 (HoverTanks)的精英驾驶员：这些先进的战争机器填补了战斗机与重型装甲之间的空白。

受到《虚幻竞技场》(Unreal Tournament) 传奇般的机械技巧和《GunZ: The Duel》灵动位移的启发，《Hoverise Rebellion》带来了一种竞技体验，在这里，你在竞技场中穿梭的能力与你的瞄准一样致命。告别缓慢笨重的坦克，这是地面上的高辛烷值空战。

你的悬浮坦克

《Hoverise Rebellion》聚焦于专门的“战斗系列”（Combat Series）。选择符合你战术理念的底盘，并精通其独特的战斗规格。

初始部署： 

拦截者系列 (Interceptor Series)： 专为激进的前线突破而设计。高速推进系统和突击武器旨在近距离缠斗中粉碎目标。

特殊系列： 新型狙击手和神风特攻系列即将上线！

要解锁新系列，你必须赢得“悬浮坦克挑战赛 (HoverTank Challenge)”。完成任务并与不稳定的人工智能战斗，以赢取你的下一台机器。

竞技场

移动的掌控是区分新手与传奇的分水岭。我们的系统奖励那些致力于学习悬浮坦克垂直机动性的驾驶员。在充满挑战的多层3D竞技场中，利用高级能力：跳跃、冲刺和3D推进。

竞技场游戏模式

享受经典的竞技场动作！但请记住，胜利并不总是取决于击杀数。《Hoverise Rebellion》还具有为团队协作设计的高风险模式。

经典德玛 (DeathMatch) 与团队德玛： 纯粹的机械技巧测试。

战术占领 (Domination)： 争夺能源节点的控制权。这种模式考验你的团队快速轮换并在火力下坚守领土的能力。

突击模式 (Assault Mode)： 参与紧张的多阶段非对称战斗，在这里战略与爆炸性的动作相结合。

叛乱已经开始。机器正在进化。你有能力猎杀它们吗？

将《Hoverise Rebellion》加入你的愿望单，夺取你在竞技场中的位置！

name: Ultimate General: American Revolution
summary:
American Revolution is a sandbox strategy game featuring the epic historical period during the rebellion of the American colonies against the British Empire.

Tutorials

Military Tutorial

 Economics Tutorial

扮演美国殖民者的角色，为北美的领土控制而战。在一张细致的3D地图上展开一场扣人心弦的实时战役。您可以组建陆军和海军，建造军事基础设施，并在团级层面上完全指挥您的军队。如果想体验更多的战斗，您可以完全放大，进行大规模的营级战斗。

在全球地图上实时指挥团和海军中队作战。移动您的将军，以最小化的方式获得战术控制。将军的存在使得可以直接在地图上控制部队或舰船，主动使用机动战术、切断补给线、利用不同地形和骑兵包抄敌人。通过进一步放大地图，您可以更详细地进行战斗，并获得全面的战术控制。

大规模战斗

 如果您选择以完全战术控制进行战斗，团将分为更小的营单位，使您可以实时指挥数百个单位，创造一个令人惊叹且真实的历史时期战斗体验。部队将根据地图上的位置部署在地形上。一些部队会立即与敌人交战，其他部队可以在部署区重新定位，而距离较远的部队可能稍后以增援的形式加入战斗。

延迟报告

 模拟了真实的侦察，消息成为军事情报和战斗机动的基础。消息可能会被延迟或被敌人截获，导致您的命令无法及时到达部队，或无法与您的远方领土通信。

组建您的陆军和舰队

 您需要一支强大的陆军和海军才能赢得战争。组建步兵团、骑兵中队和舰队。指派最优秀的军官，并为部队配备最强的武器以增强他们的战斗力。您需要决定如何管理您的新兵——是创建新部队，还是补充伤亡？这样的决定可能对战争进程产生重大影响。

军事基础设施

 带领您的军队走向胜利。发展能够为陆军和海军提供食物、武器和弹药的地区。建造军事结构以训练特殊新兵，或在严冬中容纳您的军队。修建基础设施以增加补给，并规划补给线路，将补给送到正在作战的军队中。

为部队提供补给

 没有高效的工业基础，陆军或舰队无法维持。生产步枪、大炮，并建造舰船。一颗子弹需要火药和弹头。一场战争需要大量的火药和成千上万的子弹。组织并优先考虑生产链，以满足您军队的需求。

发展您的总部

 详细设计军队结构，通过创建和组织陆军部门来确保军队的正常运作。管理资金，并为每个部门分配合适的人员，以直接影响军队在战斗、情报和补给管理方面的效率。随着部门军官积累经验，他们不仅在主要职责上变得更有效率，还会在研究新武器、战术以及发明新方法方面变得更为出色，逐步提升您的军队能力。

summary:
A simplistic, dynamic Touhou fangame bullet hell shmup with a pixel art esthetic. Shoot down your enemies and dodge your way through an incessant barrage of projectiles!

Gensokyo. A land of fantasy and phantasm.

It was a normal day. And a normal day for Gensokyo meant it was an incident day.

The sky.

It was shattered into pieces A gaping hole, as if the sky was nothing more than a glass dome. Three of the land's residents decided to take action.

Join Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame and Sanae Kochiya in their way to find the one who broke Gensokyo's sky!

If you're a fan of the Touhou Project series, you'll feel right at home here!

Shoot down your enemies, dodge the mess happening on screen and use your bombs to destroy everything in your way through a six-stage main game and an extra unlockable stage!

With a range of four difficulty levels to choose from, both veterans and newcomers to the genre should be able to enjoy the game!

name: Rescue Team: Heist of the Century
summary:

From Warhol to Van Gogh, priceless works of art are disappearing from galleries around the world! Even worse, devastating natural disasters are occurring in tandem with these heinous heists!

To learn who's behind this calamitous crime spree and stop the destruction, global authorities do the only thing they can: activate the Rescue Team!

As the squad's guiding hand, you'll tackle the impossible in dozens of eye-popping, nail-biting levels. From stopping earthquakes from reducing cities to rubble, to dealing with the messy aftermath of hurricanes, to cleaning up after gooey ecological disasters, you'll have your hands full!

But you'll also have the skills of the world's best rescuers at your fingertips – including the ever famous rescue dogs! No task is too big and no job is too difficult for these heroic hotshots, whether it's clearing a disaster zone, producing vital resources, or catching the crooks behind the thefts.

Are you ready for an epic quest to save the world? Do you have what it takes to complete the ultimate adventure? Are you curious what happens when a rescue dog meets a giant snake? Don't miss a moment of this thrilling new chapter in the Rescue Team saga!

summary:

FPS Game: Dev Test, is a First person shooter that is strictly built of a development asset, its intended purpose is to test and showcase networking features and other advanced Steam systems. 而地球的人类却在急剧减少，
终于只剩下最后一名人类。

人类到底是灭绝了还是更加繁荣了。

你，作为地球上最后一名人类，前往太空，

summary:
探索向上的道路，尝试到达顶峰。

"A Difficult Game About ROLLING" - 是一个关于滚动的难题游戏。

踏上一段无与伦比的旅程，通过崎岖的山脉、瀑布和古老的废墟，周围是无边无际的海洋，前往山顶。

你在一个球体里！你的身体为球的运动增加了一份混乱。爬到顶峰，旋转螺旋，并克服不可预测的物理路线。这一切都是你旅程的一部分。

无情的物理：体验游戏独特的物理特性，球内的每一个重量和动量都给上升过程带来新的复杂性。您的每一个移动都需要仔细计算，每一个决定都必须权衡。

坚持的哲学：这款游戏是对生活旅程的致敬，强调的哲学是路径，而不仅仅是到达顶峰，构成了真正的挑战。它是关于克服困难和在攀登中找到满足感。

难度与奖励：准备好迎接激烈的挑战。这款游戏旨在测试您的极限，但也会在您克服每一个障碍时，以深刻的满足感作为奖励。

高风险：每一个冒险的动作都带来回到起点的威胁。这款游戏尊重您的成就，但也惩罚鲁莽——小心行事，或者冒着失去一切的风险。

欢迎来到一个不仅挑战您的游戏技能，还挑战您的精神和决心的游戏。

Explore a vertical world as you roll, fall, and try again.

A Difficult Game About ROLLING is exactly what it says — a punishing physics-based journey where you roll, fall, and try again.

Embark on an unparalleled journey to the summit through an unforgiving landscape of mountains, waterfalls, and ancient ruins, all surrounded by the vast, unending ocean. 

You're inside a sphere! Your body contributes its share of chaos to the motion of the ball. Climb to the peaks, swirl in spirals, and overcome routes with unpredictable physics. All of this is part of your journey.

Unforgiving Physics: Experience the game's unique physics, where every weight and momentum of your character inside the sphere introduces new complexities to the ascent process. Each of your movements requires careful calculation, every decision must be weighed.

Philosophy of Perseverance: This game is a tribute to the journey of life, emphasizing the philosophy that the path, not merely reaching the summit, holds the true challenge. It's about overcoming hardships and finding satisfaction in the climb itself.

Difficulty & Reward: Be prepared for an intense challenge. The game is designed to test your limits but also to reward your progress with a deep sense of satisfaction as you overcome each obstacle.

High Stakes: With every risky maneuver comes the threat of falling back to the beginning. This game respects your achievements but also punishes recklessness - tread carefully, or risk losing it all.

summary:
Roll, Bounce, and Swing your way to the top of the mountain in this 3d momentum-based precision platformer! Be warned, this game is NOT for the faint of heart! you will fail, many... MANY times! Are you up to the challenge?

In this game, you take control of a little blue blob named Blob Boy. Blob Boy is on a journey to find a wizard named Wizrad who claims to grant the wish of anyone who can find him. Unfortunately for you, Wizrad's door is locked and will require 15 keys to open. Each of the game's 30 key offers a unique challenge within the connected map that will test your knowledge of the game's various mechanics.

Momentum is the key to beating this game.
on the ground, Blob Boy is slow and can't jump very high, fortunately, he has a variety of tools at his disposal to help him build up massive amounts of speed and fly past challenges.

Speed:
Blob Boy sticks to the ground so he's not very fast when rolling. if you want to build momentum, you should try to be in the air as much as possible. Mastering the art of knowing when to be in the air or on the ground is vital to beating this game.

Bounciness:
When hitting the ground Blob Boy bounces as if he's on a trampoline, and goes even higher with a well-timed jump.

Wall Jumping:
Floors aren't the only thing Blob Boy can bounce off of, if you hit a wall you can press the jump button to get an extra boost just like on the ground and you even get some extra vertical height meaning that if you know how to effectively use it, you can climb just about anything.

name: Base Commander
summary:
FREE TO PLAY! A 5v5 MOBA where players try to outplay the opposing team in a battle for control of uniquely powered bases.

Base Commander is a competitive 5v5 showdown, where one team emerges victorious by capturing a majority of empowered bases scattered across the map. Every individual base your crew successfully holds grants your entire team an epic perk, like deadly bonus attack damage, lightning-fast speed, or even a game-changing tactical advantage. Rally your friends, outplay your rivals, and stake your claim as the ultimate Base Commander.

This isn't your typical MOBA. Base Commander features an open map, and offers easy to understand gameplay within a competitive, yet relaxed, environment. Think Super Smash Bros. meets Heroes of the Storm or League of Legends.

At launch, we are hoping to offer 8-12 playable characters, all with their own unique style, abilities, and personalities. From Guardians Tanks, to sneaky Thieves, to traditional ADCs and Assassins, Base Commander will feel familiar yet refreshing with its dynamic band of characters. 

Base Commander is a MOBA game like League of Legends, or DOTA 2, but instead of pushing lanes and taking towers, your team’s primary objective is to capture, or steal, uniquely powered bases. At launch, we'll feature a minimum of 8 Bases, but only 4 will spawn randomly each game, ensuring non-stop action and dynamic gameplay! 

By farming Mobs, completing quests, or demolishing enemy players, your team will gather enough gold to purchase bases and items. But be on guard, because the enemy team can steal your bases, and thieves never pay for what they take. 

Assemble your ultimate crew and dominate as the unrivaled Base Commanders. Alternatively, charge in solo and carve out a legacy as a legend in your own right. No matter the path, real Commanders forge their own destiny in this universe.

name: Dash Rider
summary:
Dashrider is a fast-paced 2D shooter game, in which you fight your way through countless waves of enemies to earn coins. Purchase new skills or stunning boss battles. Defeat the three guards to face the final boss and complete the game.

Dashrider is a round-based 2D shooter. The game is all about speed, precision, and action. 

Fast-paced and action-packed gameplay

The gameplay is based on very fast movements and maneuvers while being under permanent attack. One of the most essential moves is the dash, which can be used to trick or escape your enemy. Unlock new skills to dominate the fight for a short period of time. Pick up unique abilities to boost your firepower and shield yourself against counterattacks. Improve your fighting techniques and beat your personal high score. 

Various types of enemies

A variety of enemies will try to kill you in many different ways. You will need to dodge battalions of aggressive enemies, bullets, and lasers. They will become more powerful, the further you advance in the game.

Stunning boss fights

Unlock intense boss fights progressing in the classic game mode. Bosses will unleash heavy rounds of attacks. You will need to develop unique strategies to destroy them.

Redgar：太空维京人是一款爆炸性的自上而下射击游戏，设定在一个结合了黑暗中世纪和科幻元素的复古未来世界中。呼，真是话多。我们再来一次...

Unleash chaos as Redgar, the legendary space viking! In this explosive top-down shooter, battle through castle-like starships and neon-lit fortresses with medieval and sci-fi weapons, wield godly powers, and embrace an unstoppable thirst for destruction in a darkly comic alcoholic saga.

Become Redgar, the legendary space viking!

Save your family from an evil king in a world where past and future collide. Charge in with all guns blazing or strike with silent precision.

Turn foes into mush with plasma, lasers, and firearms, blast crowds with rockets...

…or hack, smash, and impale enemies with swords, spears, axes, and maces!

Wield otherworldly powers and advanced tech like a plasma shield, teleporter, rocket boots, and invisibility.

Battle as Redgar, the legendary space viking hero

Powerful medieval and sci-fi weapons

Godly powers and advanced technology

Beautiful handcrafted levels

Mead-soaked story

Original, electrifying soundtrack

Zoomable 360° camera with two modes

A plague has overcome Earth and you were selected to take to the stars in a tiny spaceship in a plan to save humanity. You hit the first jump station away from Earth with the hopes to sustain the human race by becoming a multiplanet species. You have arrived at your new home where you will engage in an exciting life where you trade, hunt for criminals, mine, steal, and assassinate to make ends meet. Out here criminals run rampant, aliens foil your best mining haul ever, and asteroids smash your hull with one wrong move, but it is the life you must lead to give humanity a chance! 

In this open world game you can choose what you want to be. Your actions will influence your rank in four areas: Mining, Combat, Exploration, and Trading. Your actions will also influence your rank within the four factions.

name: New Roots
summary:
In this story-driven pixel game set in a post-global warming world, a young capybara seeks to regrow the extinct native plants of their home with the help of their solarpunk community.

Piertje is a solarpunk seaside community located on the New-Dutch coastline. Despite so much being lost to the unpredictable tides and weather, the people that live there are driven to take care of themselves, each other, and the world around them. 

It is also home to Stick, a teenage capybara wild about all things plant, who decides that they are done mourning the loss of local plant life and decides to give the beaten-down native plant life a chance to thrive again. 

So begins the wholesome adventure to restore their past in order to create a better future! Play as Stick as you search for the lost plants and help the community so that they both can thrive. ?✨

NOTE: New Roots is a short game. Estimated 1 hour completion time.

? A beautiful futuristic solarpunk setting full of unique pixel art and animation

name: Exorzine
summary:
In this game you start in a dungeon cell. Exorzine will try to stop you from escaping.

Exorzine is a hide and seek game inside a dungeon. The protagonist starts in a locked dungeon cell. Exorzine is walking around the dungeon and will try to stop the protagonist from escaping.

Exorzine is a half goat, half human zombie. Her consciousness consists 100 % out of possession. Only an exorcism can help her.

The dungeon has many obstacles which make it not easy to escape (locked doors, gates, movable walls and traps). Some places in this dungeon are hidden. There are places around to hide (chests, wardrobes, beds, barrels and a cage).

Useful items and collectables around the dungeon help you to find a way to escape from the dungeon.

Find potion ingredients around in the dungeon to make a magic potion for a zombie which will give you a key for a lock that you can find at one of the celldoors. 

There is a exorcism book located in the game that must be found, but its required to collect the 5 swords around the dungeon before the exorcism book can be collected.

When you make noises and if Exorzine hear that noises, she will go to that place.

Exorzine wins when she stoped the protagonist 100 times from escaping the dungeon, but she will need 100 times again when the protagonist enters a new level.

Gameplay can include jumpscares, triggered from sudden appearance of moving NPCs.

Place your units in strategic positions, make use of special abilities, and manage resources to counter the incoming enemy waves on large maps with up to eight lanes. The future of the Reich is in your hands. Are you up for the challenge?

Unit upgrades for increased damage and more unlockables

name: 月影陌路
summary:
《月影陌路》是一款突破一维战斗的肉鸽卡牌游戏，玩家将扮演骑士踏上拯救公主的冒险与各种敌人战斗。游戏以月光与阴影为核心，玩家需操控月亮旋转，避开致命的月光，利用阴影移动棋子。每一步都在权衡献祭与诅咒的力量，揭开故事的真相。

光影之间，真相未明

《月影陌路》是一款融合回合制战棋、Roguelike探索与叙事解谜的独立游戏。通过独创的"月光阴影机制"，在光与影交织的棋盘上展开一场充满哲思的冒险。

name: La Villa de la Muerte
summary:
La Villa de la Muerte is a looping psychological horror game where players will progress through an ever-changing environment in pursuit of the truth behind a family disappearance.

One villa. One family. One truth.

La Villa de la Muerte is a looping psychological horror game inspired by the chilling tale of La Llorona. Explore an elegant villa filled with fragments from a family who mysteriously vanished. Explore the villa and solve puzzles to slowly reveal the truth behind what happened to the family, where they went, and who they became.
Looping Environment
Explore the villa as it changes alongside your knowledge of what truly transpired here. 

Puzzles
Tour the environment to solve a puzzle in each loop to progress further toward the truth.

AI/Stealth
We lovingly call her Ghost Lady, she's pretty spooky. Hide in wardrobes, sneak under tables, or just run for it to avoid her. She will do whatever it takes to make sure you don't discover what happened.

About Ottercide Studio
Ottercide Studio is comprised of graduate game dev students at the University of Utah. Our game, La Villa de la Muerte, is the product of two semesters of hard work resulting in a 20-30 minute experience. 

Additionally, we owe a huge thank you to Berklee College of Music for contributing their time and talent to our game.
FAQ

Why Ottercide?

Our team grew particularly attached to an adorable live otter stream that kept us peaceful while developing this horror game. Thus, we ended up with the play on words, Ottercide Studio as our development team name.

Is this game a retelling of La Llorona?

While the team pulled inspiration from the tale, this game is not a retelling of La Llorona. Instead, we drew from the lore to have something to ground us while also prioritizing remaining respectful to the story's origins. Folktales are a great way to keep culture and story alive while paving the way for new tales. We hope you enjoy our game as much as we loved developing it.

Gehena is a single-player first-person horror game. The only way out of the cursed town is to make the right choice and not get caught in the fog. Is what you see real or is your mind playing tricks on you?

GEHENA is a single player first person horror game. After his grandmother Osiros dies, Ernoy goes to the town of Zera to sell his grandmother's house. His grandmother was a beloved boarding school teacher, but rumors spread in the village that he was now a wizard. Children and their families hated her. So what was the reason? Ernoy, who finds himself in the event with many clues, has to make a choice.Come to solve the big mystery and help Ernoy in his choice if you dare.

FEATURES
Carefully explore your surroundings to find objects
Follow the story with notes and dialogues
Alternate ending

WARNING
Watch out for jumpscares and sudden noises.
Attention to occasional light bursts for epilepsy patients.

name: Prodigy Trainer
summary:
A young warrior seeks to learn the ways of darkness. In order to do so, she must gain your trust and respect.

A young warrior from the greatest academy in the galaxy ventures on her biggest adventure yet to learn the powers of the dark forces. Powers that corrupt all who go near and devour those who are too weak to hold the embrace. She takes the initiative to search for you, the greatest warrior in existence with the goal to gain your guidance and expertise. 

Prodigy Trainer is a short but simple space based adult Visual Novel Trainer (VN).
In this game, you play as a legendary male warrior travelling the galaxy; you encounter a young woman who hunts you down in order to have you be her mentor.

As you train her… will she keep her strong values and remain headstrong or fall to the darkness like you.
The game is a trainer with free roam elements. This means that the goal of the game is to train Asmodea. There are multiple missions, planets and scenes to encounter with other characters.

A post-apocalyptic recon unit recruit makes his first voyage to the surface world and questions the reality of his lifestyle and the underground society he grew up in.

Arcadia is the last known bastion of society after a nuclear fallout 100 years ago. Following a rebellion some decades past, all vault inhabitants are required to consume a reality altering psychedelic found on the surface world called Golden Teachers or face “retirement.” Play as Marshal, a recruit in the Foragers, an elite reconnaissance unit whose primary purpose is the search and retrieval of GT. name: 3D将棋
summary:
3D "SHOGI" game. You can play Shogi Online. We make all of Models and VFXs. We need funding to conquer the world. It's a joke :p

It is one of the traditional Japanese board games.
The rules are similar to Western chess, but the roles of the pieces are different, and the pieces can be strengthened under certain conditions.
Like chess, you can capture and acquire enemy pieces that exist at the destination of your own pieces, and unlike chess, you can use them as new pieces of your own army.
You win if you can defeat the king of the other army. On the contrary, if you take the king of your own army, you will lose.

(1) First, move the square cursor by clicking the cross key or the left mouse button.

(2) Press the ENTER key or left-click to select the piece in that square.

(3) The square where the selected piece can move shines. Also move the cursor to select the destination of this piece.

(4) The piece moves. If there is an opponent's piece at the destination, take it. If the destination is the opponent's position, the pieces can be further powered up.

(5) Next is the opponent's turn. Repeat until you or your opponent lose the foul.

Both the shogi board and the Japanese-style room use their own models.
In particular, the shogi board is a work that was made with unnecessary attention to the invisible back part.
