summary:
Trade Bots is an educational simulation game featuring technical analysis and algorithmic trading. Buy or sell an unknown stock using its real, historic data based solely on patterns and technical indicators. As your profit increases, unlock upgrades that help expedite + automate gameplay with bots.

Trade Bots is an educational simulation game featuring technical analysis and algorithmic trading. Buy and sell an unknown stock using its real, historic data - beginning from a random time in the past, trading the asset using only technical analysis concepts gained along the way. Learn fundamentals of how to trade based solely on patterns and technical indicators, gradually unlocking upgrades which expedite and automate your trading. Borrowing from the mechanics of some "idle" and "roguelike" games, progress is made by banking funds for future runs after you are margin called, and upgrades can enhance the speed of simulation, increase margin equity, unlock advanced indicators, and per its name, engage automation techniques.

In gamifying a process known as "backtesting" in economics, Trade Bots players test their own trading strategies against 5,000+ real, historic stock/ETF/crypto data dating back to as early as the 1950s to present day. Over the course of the campaign, design intricate trading bots using a custom-built visual node editor. The engine is highly flexible and accommodates practically any trading strategy imaginable while requiring no programming background. Advanced unlocks allow for playing with cryptocurrencies, Exchange Traded Funds, and the ability to share your bots with other players.

Features Include:

Support for 20+ Technical Indicators]

100+ Unlockable Upgrades

Stock, Crypto & ETF Modes

Ability to Import & Export Bots

Trade Bots is developed by Cinq-Mars Media, the non-profit known for the hit indie The Devil's Calculator included in PAX's 10 Best Indie Games of 2019.

name: Bombardier
summary:
Bombardier is a quick and chaotic multiplayer game which supports up to 4 players in an arena. Use the environment and bombs to your advantage and battle to be crowned the ultimate Bombardier!

Bombardier is a 2 - 4 local multiplayer game, the players are pitted against each other and it is a battle of wits and mettle to be the last one standing. Each map has a limited amount of space with its own environmental dangers and comes with an assortment of Special Bombs. All levels are hectic and fast paced and if you pay attention you can use the environmental dangers to your advantage and outsmart your friends. Place bombs in strategic locations, kick them to your frenemies or simply use the SharkZooka to give them a taste of what an angry shark can do. 

Play your own way!
Go in bombs blazin' or take the strategic approach and gather special bombs before raining down destruction to be crowned King of the Hill! However be aware, friendly fire is definitely a thing!

Puns and Chaos

name: Terra Forma: Tower Combat
summary:
Terra Forma is a pixelated 2D tower defense, inspired by Flash-age classics. Build a dozen unique towers and create even more fusions by combining shock, ice, fire, and iron. Prove your command prowess one final time, and defend mankind's final hope.

In a far-off future... on a far-off world... you are called out of retirement to command the defense of terraformer installations attempting to convert the hostile environments of this alien planet. 
Strange lifeforms and ancient machines are laying siege to sites all over the planet. Prove your command prowess one final time, and defend mankind's new hope.
With 4 elemental modules (fire, ice, iron, shock), build and fuse to protect essential human installations. 

 Command 12 unique towers and even more elemental fusions to form the ultimate defense. Utilize fire modules to inflict lingering damage, ice modules to slow enemies to a crawl, shock modules to control crowds, and metal modules to inflict massive single target damage. Only the most carefully considered strategies will lead you to victory.

 Face off against 4 enemy varieties and 4 hulking boss enemy types. Slimy Reptyls and burrowing Insectoids sprint towards the terraformers, as ironclad Robots and lumbering Mutants clog your defenses with their slow speed and durability. Bosses also present their own unique challenges and surprises.

 Complete a campaign with a dozen missions, with unique maps and special Challenge Modifiers. Prepare for anything from bigger waves to towers getting frozen in time.

 Custom Scenario Mode allows you to create any mission you can imagine, from overpowered slaughter machines to impossibly challenging boss grinds.

name: Glob
summary:
An online fast-paced multiplayer party experience! Master the stretchy power of Glob to sling around the world and throw objects at your enemies! Compete in many competitive game modes or work with friends to solve puzzles and sling through the world together. Did we mention there are lasers?!

Glob is a fast-paced platformer that really swings into action! Use your gooey sling to pull yourself around, or use it to throw obstacles at enemies!
Exciting sling mechanic
Master your sling as you use it to fly through levels at a blistering pace! The sling allows you to grab onto both terrain and various objects, most likely leading to you flying into a saw blade at first! Once you master the sling, you'll move around levels like a real glob!

Smash your Friends
Race your friends in the time trials or compete in a deathmatch to see who has the fastest sling! Online high scores and matchmaking ensures you'll always have a whole glob of fun!

PvP and Coop
Exciting levels which challenge your platforming and slinging skills as you try to overcome each level by yourself or with friends. It's up to you if you want to be able to sling your friends as you progress through the levels, leading to hilarious moments of betrayal.

Something for everyone
Many varying game modes to cater for everyone - Capture the Flag, Competitive Racing, Arena Battle, Cooperative Puzzles, and more! Group up in teams or try your luck as a lone glob.

Daring leaps and bounds
Featuring gripping sections of daring jumps and swings, you'll need to overcome many challenges to succeed. Did we mention there are lasers?!

name: Sidewards
summary:
A realistic stone skipping simulator with a chill vibe.

Sidewards is a first-of-its-kind stone skipping simulator. Collect and skip dozens of unique stones to unlock new gear, achievements, and levels. Experiment to achieve "the perfect skip": adjust throw force, launch angle, and more to change how the stone skips. You'll need to factor in wind, waves, and other environmental effects, too - if you want to top the leaderboards!

Explore gorgeous, natural landscapes based on real-world locations. Hang out with your friends in casual and competitive multiplayer modes. Enjoy the beauty and tranquility of nature with Sidewards! 

Key Features: 

 Realistic water and stone-skipping physics 

 Lush, waterfront environments based on real-world locations 

 Casual and competitive multiplayer modes 

 All the accessibility options 

 Photo mode

Core Gameplay:

In Sidewards, you collect stones and then skip them to earn points and complete challenges. You can find stones by exploring areas near water - some stones can only be found in specific locations, so you'll need to explore to find them all! Once you've got a stone, you're ready to throw! Pick your spot, adjust your aim, then dial in the launch force, angle, and spin. Release your stone and watch it skip... or not! Sidewards uses realistic stone-skipping physics, so you'll need to get creative to make some throws work. 

Online Features 

NOTE: The online features in Sidewards are optional. You can play completely offline, if you want. 

 Friends list 

 Create parties and invite friends 

 Casual mode with emotes, pick-up games, and... whistling? 

 Exhibition and tournament competitive modes 

 Leaderboards 

 Cloud save and stats

summary:
Shyftrs 是一款风格化的 2D 动作冒险类银河战士恶魔城游戏。 踏上旅程，揭开你血脉的秘密，以及世界彼端隐藏的真相。 挥舞手杖剑，使用手枪，或释放你新觉醒的力量。 挺身而出，拥抱这场冒险。

一个瑰丽而险恶的世界，待你揭晓

《Shyftrs》是一款2D手绘风格的类银河战士恶魔城冒险游戏，你的每一步，都将揭露地表之下潜藏的另一个世界。

扮演声名显赫的探险世家科尔文家族的后裔——布拉姆斯・科尔文。父母在秘密远征中离奇失踪，而你追寻真相的旅程却意外打破了现实疆界，将你从埃索斯抛入光怪陆离的伊卡洛斯王国。

探索遗忘废墟，唤醒失落科技，穿梭于现实与幻象交织的星界。
在这片遗忘之神与禁忌科学并存之地开辟你的道路，揭开血脉中那不该被触碰的秘密。

你将重返埃索斯……抑或让伊卡洛斯永远重塑你的命运？

? 核心特色

? 风格化手绘美术
所有角色、生物与场景皆为画师亲手绘制，打造出一个笔触细腻又栩栩如生的世界。

? 相互连结的广大领域
穿梭于伊卡洛斯与星界两个维度，此处充满了秘密、隐藏路径与蕴藏丰富传说的场景。

⚔️ 动态组合的战斗系统
自由组合在探索、头目战、制作与支线任务中解锁的技能，打造专属于你的战斗风格。

? 暗影之中，皆有秘密
在这个鼓励探索、奖励好奇心的世界中，发掘隐藏密室，解锁稀有遗物，并揭开被遗忘的真相。

? 超过百种独特敌人
你将面对种类繁多的敌人，包括扭曲的不死生物、源于神话与疯狂的奇异魔物等。

? 原创配乐与场景设计
沉浸感十足的原创配乐，结合视差滚动的精致背景，为每个生态区注入了独特的氛围与故事深度，使其活灵活现。

星界探索

启动钥石，即可在主世界与星界之间来回穿梭

星界包含：

• 可供探索的全新关卡设计。

• 全新的敌人与头目

• 全新的隐藏宝藏与遗物

星界敌人

战斗

获得新的技能与能力，克服重重阻碍，向更深处探索。找出隐藏路径，自由应对所有挑战——你的创造力将会决定这趟旅程的面貌。

伊卡洛斯的亚丁王国将是游戏的主要舞台，这是一片魔力丰沛的土地。

此地包含着互相连结的广大生态网络，每个区域都拥有其独特的动植物生态。

欢迎造访我们的网站，在「更新／博客」专区查看游戏的重大更新与未来规划。

开发资助

我们团队孜孜不倦，致力将《Shyftrs》付诸实现。我们的首要目标是取得初期资金以加速开发。在此荣幸宣布，我们已成功获得CODE NZ的支持，分别于2022年12月与2024年8月两度获得资助。
我们由衷感谢CODE NZ团队的持续指导，以及对《Shyftrs》愿景的信任。

Scavengers deep is an underwater 3rd person action roguelike game, with an emphasis on player movement for traversing the game world and encounters.

The player character is among the poorer inhabitants of a flooded future earth and is looking to join the upper class. On one fateful day, Damien heard a rumour about a legendary treasure with untold riches however, a monster lies in the depths. Damien equips his high-power diving suit along with his water booster and dives into the depths to begin his journey. The high-power diving suit allows Damien Jones to descend to the deepest parts of the ocean. The suit is equipped with aqua jets which allows for better mobility underwater to assist against unwanted predators. Damien also carries his knife and harpoon gun to aid against hostile marine life.

Scavenger’s Deep is an action game with a system of permanent death and a loss of items, making the player start the game again with nothing. Belonging to the beat-em’ up or brawler subgenre, the game uses hordes of enemies to give the player multiple targets resulting in an intense, almost overwhelming combat experience.

The roguelike elements exist in the form of a “permanent” death system. This means that in each playthrough or “run” of the game, if the player is defeated (health reaches zero), they will have to begin again from the first level. Upon dying, the player also loses all items and increases to stats they had obtained over the course of that run.

name: Devil's Island
summary:
Devil's Island 是 Zombie FPS 与生存元素的混合体，在一个已经结束的世界中保持着具有后世界末日主题的恐怖氛围。这是一款游戏，其历史结合了早已被遗忘的事物和即将到来的事物。

Devil’s Island是一款僵尸FPS游戏，具有生存和恐怖元素，设定在一个已经结束的后末日世界。你是一个被派往一个神秘岛屿调查其秘密和末日之源的雇佣兵。你将面对僵尸、其他生物、陷阱和谜题，同时管理你的饥饿、口渴、健康和资源。你还将发现人类和外星人起源的谜团，它结合了不同宗教和神话的元素。游戏提供了第一人称模式下的动态游戏玩法，每一个错误和匆忙都可能是致命的。你可以使用近战和枪械，以及通过发展你的基本角色参数来解锁的特殊技能。游戏拥有令人惊叹的图形和声音设计，营造了后末日恐怖和紧张的氛围。Devil’s Island是一款适合僵尸、生存和谜题爱好者的游戏，它将为你提供数小时的刺激游戏体验。

In this horror zombie survival game, set in a post-apocalyptic taiga forest, players must grapple with nature while managing hunger, thirst, health, and resources. They can collect mushrooms, craft items and weapons, cook raw meat, and battle various enemies.

Devil’s Island is a zombie horror survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world that has already met its end. In this desolate landscape, you’ll grapple with nature within a typical taiga forest, managing hunger, thirst, health, and resources. Explore the forest, collect mushrooms, craft items and weapons, and cook raw meat to survive.

Story: As a mercenary, you’re dispatched to Devil’s Island to uncover its secrets and the source of the apocalypse. Prepare to confront zombies, other creatures, traps, and puzzles. Delve into the enigma of humanity’s origin and its connection to extraterrestrial beings, blending elements from various religions and myths.

The game offers dynamic first-person gameplay, where every misstep and hasty decision can prove fatal. Utilize melee weapons, firearms, and special skills. With stunning graphics and immersive sound design, Devil’s Island creates an atmosphere of post-apocalyptic horror and tension. It’s a must-play for fans of zombies, survival, and Anunnaki lore, promising hours of thrilling gameplay.

name: DANGER OF LOSS
summary:
DANGER OF LOSS - This is a side view puzzle game about a boy who got lost in the forest and you need to do everything so that he finds his way home.

You have to help the lost boy to return home, deftly manipulating the objects that are around you. Move the blocks so that your hero overcomes all the traps on your way and stays unharmed.

The basis of the game is quite simple: Rearrange the objects on the location in such a way that the main character could overcome the traps on his way and go to the other side of the location.

name: Nightfall
summary:
Nightfall is a top down sci-fi game with turn based combat. After waking up on a strange world without any recollection of your past, you must explore, fight, and survive in order to rediscover your memories and find out why, and by whom they were taken away.

Nightfall is a top down sci-fi game with turn based combat, the game has a retro art style and is more of a casual game. After waking up on a strange world without any recollection of your past, you must explore, fight, and survive in order to rediscover your memories and find out why, and by whom they were taken away. You will progress through the game with a companion and acquire stronger items, weapons, and armor, these will boost different stats to allow you to combat enemies easier and faster. You will rediscover the characters lost memories by eliminating key enemies or bosses.

This is the roadmap for the game showing the goals for the major updates I have planned. 
This roadmap may change over the development process.

name: Bill
summary:
You are a genius at crafting. He is a stranded Alien baby who crashed in your garden. His survival depends on you! Craft tools and furniture, Upgrade your house, Farm your food, organize, and personalize your home. Help a baby alien to survive on earth and find out more about it

Bill is going through a tough time in his life, he lost meaning and purpose. 
But one night, a UFO crashes in front of his little home in the woods. 
The passenger is an unconscious baby alien.
You are his only chance of survival!
Key Features :

Collect Resources

Plant and grow your own vegetables.
Grow anything you like to cook with an increasing tech system to make farming easier and easier.

Interact with everything

Everything is interactable in the game, lamps, radio, tv, and many other machines

Crafting

Everything you need in the game is craftable.
Collect items in the forest and craft from specialized crafting tables: Woodcraft, Kitchen, Electronic, Forge, Chemistry

Building

Create new rooms or utilities and place them where you want.
Make your house unique and as big as you like.

Buy and sell items
Buy online broken devices, restore them with new parts, and sell them for a better price.

Restoring
Take any broken item and give it a new life using your master skills.

Take care of the baby alien and yourself
Sleep, eat well and entertain yourself, it's not only about work.

Decorate your home
Use plants, lamps, paintings, and posters to decorate your home and make it as cozy as you like.

name: Obsessive Revenge
summary:
After Mike's brother is arrested, victim of false accusations, Mike discovers that Jonathan was responsible for his brother's arrest, and so decides to kill him on a government ranch, where several government agents belonging to the witness protection service are.

PARTNER GAMES

In Obsessive Revenge you will live a story with a lot of mystery and revenge, controlling Mike. You'll play in first person and you'll have several weapons to help you in the main objective, besides, of course, special mechanics that will be used by the protagonist. All this with a lot of action, which when combined with strategy, makes everything perfect.
The game takes place in a rural area, where you can explore the entire area and you have to fulfill some objectives to complete it. You will have a medium-range weapon and a pistol as work tools. You will have to face the area security guards.

George was arrested a few months ago, victim of a false accusation, due to a false testimony by Jonathan, who convinced the authorities with some photo montages and his testimony, in order to hide the real criminal.
After a visit to the prison, George's brother, named Mike, involved with some drug dealers, decides to avenge George's arrest, and then, decides to kill Jonathan, and destroy the montages he made.
However, Jonathan is in a rural area, isolated, with several security guards, protected by the witness protection system. And it won't be easy for Mike to get his revenge.
In Obssessive Revenge you will live the story that Mike stars and you will have some challenges to get his revenge.

Are you with thirsty for revenge? So let's make them pay!

Manage the crew of a powerful warship during World War II. Explore enemy territory, win battles using the strength of a steel giant and reliable tactics, and most importantly - overcome the blue abyss.

Lead the war effort

In the claustrophobic iron coffin that is the deck of a U-Boat, the most important thing is to keep your cool. Manage your crew: captain, officers, mechanics and navigators. Give orders, destroy enemy vessels and don't let your own ship sink. Use torpedo attacks and weapons of various calibres. 

Develop a plan

Carry out the missions assigned to you. Complete side quests to gain additional experience. Develop strategies and make good use of the resources at your disposal. Take risks, but also be aware of the consequences. It is up to you to make the most of your crew's potential.

Look after your crew

It's not easy to stay mentally healthy while trapped underwater, knowing that every day could be your last. Look after your crew's morale, their wellbeing and safety. Prepare meals for them, treat their wounds, manage the watch system and don't forget that every seafarer needs rest too. Decide whether the success of the mission or the wellbeing of your seafarers is more important.

Think analytically

Conduct tactical operations in real time. Think carefully about every order you give and the cost you will incur for it. Deal with random events and difficulties you encounter on your way. Remember that nothing is impossible at sea, and you must act quickly and without hesitation if you want the mission to succeed.

Radio Free Europa is a fusion of a classic arcade game and an action roguelike. The action is relentless. The soundtrack gets your blood pumping. The enemies are brutal and the bosses are massive but that just makes eventual victory feel so much sweeter!

The visuals are crisp, bright and vivid and modern but the game itself is a throwback to a time before microtransactions or day 1 DLC. It will kick your butt at first, even on easy. But you have all the tools to beat it, and the freedom to explore all sorts of different builds and different strategies. There are multiple difficulties, unlocks, and achievements, and there are also secrets waiting to be found!

When we ran out of the ability to sustain mankind on the resources of Earth alone, despite how much it cost to send a person to space, it was of course only the wealthy who could afford to stay and live on humanity’s home world.

Everyone is supposed to be equal under Solar Federation Law, but out on the fringes of colonized space equality is anything but equal.

We need you to make a journey to the Core Worlds, all the way to Earth to deliver our message. We need to be heard and you’re our only hope of that happening.

This game is a passion project, and it’s the first game from Scott McClusky (aka Coffee Puck Games.) The concept was to take a game like Escape Velocity with physics-based 2d spaceship gameplay, and combine it with the increased pace and gamepad controls of a game like Geometry Wars. Add in a hefty dose of ship and weapon customization somewhat influenced by MechWarrior and the ability to choose your path akin to Outrun, Darius or Star Fox, and the result is Radio Free Europa.

summary:
Bradley, an experienced thief aims to achieve his greatest personal goal, to rob an entire village. And then he goes to a military village in order to steal some items that are there. However, it will not be an easy task, given that there are several armed soldiers guarding the perimeter.

In The Thief you will live a story with suspense, controlling Bradley. The protagonist will invade an entire village, entering properties and choosing the most valuable items to earn money selling these items. The village will be surrounded by guards and civilians, and since it is night, Bradley will be able to use several places to pass without being seen, thus allowing him to complete the game in a sneaky way. You can play in first person, and you will only have a pistol with a silencer to help you in the main objective. All this with a lot of suspense, which when combined with strategy, makes everything perfect.

Bradley is a thief who practices robberies at night, and now he's about to face his greatest challenge, robbing an entire village. However, as it is a military village, the place is surrounded by guards, thus making the terrain very hostile. Bradley will have a pistol with a silencer, in case he needs to use it, and also with some bait that can be used as a distraction. However, combat will not be the best option, due to the superiority in armaments and in the contingent of guards.
Bradley's goal is to steal the total amount of $50,000 so it's worth all the risk, and to do so, he'll have to break into various properties and locate items of value.

How good can you be at robbing a village? Find out at The Thief.

你不记得自己从前有什么本领，但你可以通过观察回忆起它们，并再次做到。例如，你可以在看到猴子的跳跃动作之后跳起来，或者在看到别人在战斗中用剑后挥剑。

 观察周围的人和动物，从你的对手那里重新获得能力，如捕鱼、锻造甚至战斗技巧。

name: Blazing Worldstars
summary:
Fast Paced Arcade Fighting, inspired by the likes of King of Fighters and Street Fighter, Blazing Worldstars is a game that seeks to relive the 90s arcade era of classic fighting games!!

Blazing Worldstars is a 2D traditional fighter, using sprite work for animations as a call back to the 90s era of classic arcade fighters by SNK/NeoGeo and Capcom. This game is a 6 button fighter, like every 2D fighter, there are special moves, throws, and super moves. This is enhanced by the mix of fast paced KoF like combat, parries of SF3S, and the Enhance System, somewhat like the V trigger system other than it giving fighters strong abilities and tools special to them, some may have more than one "Warrior Instinct". 

The Enhance System can also radically change a fighter, from a typical damage or movement buff, armored specials, foregoing charge motion requirements, accessing special moves they normally can't, or outright having their special moves change around entirely, it can make or break a fight, especially if you may be in a pinch.

Try out the free demo while you wait for the full release!

逃出生天
始终有一件事让你夜不能寐 — 你是无辜的！你必须离开这个鬼地方。怎么办？收集证据证明自己的清白。或是制定一个精妙的逃脱计划！决定权掌握在你的手中。

管理违禁品，贩卖给其他囚犯

Sentenced for innocence… And now you need to learn how to survive. Navigate the prison life, make deals with guards and gangs alike, manage and sell contraband, and plot your next move. Your goal: to get out.

Survive your sentence in this first-person simulator set behind the prison bars from the producers behind Drug Dealer Simulator. Make deals, sell contraband and collect evidence to prove your innocence… or find a way to escape!

Make connections
First on the agenda – you need to survive. Navigate the prison politics, make deals with gangs, dig for useful intel, negotiate with the guards and prove your worth to everyone who’s watching. Carve up your own position and climb to the top, ensuring your safety.

Deal contraband
How better to make people depend on you than to become a reliable prison dealer? Use your connections to obtain contraband, manage the stock and sell it to your fellow convicts. And remember: don’t get caught.

Get out
One thing still doesn’t let you sleep at night – you’re innocent! And you need to get out of this hellhole. How? Collect evidence to prove your innocence. Or make a brilliant plot to escape! It’s your decision to make.

Features:

Manage and sell contraband to other prisoners

Customise your prison cell

Make deals with prison gangs and guards

Different endings

summary:
"업무는 단순하네. 개가 되면 돼."

부친의 회사가 도산하며 빚더미에 앉은 데일 잭슨.
대공황 속에서 아무런 손도 쓰지 못 한 채 방황하는 그에게 기묘한 제안이 날아든다.
바로 부잣집 아가씨, 샬롯 바스커빌의 '개'가 되는 것.
뉴욕 제일의 대부호, 바스커빌 가에서 일할 기회를 놓칠 수 없었던 데일은 끝내 제안을 받아들인다.

"데일, 좋은 강아지가 되어 줘."
'좋은 강아지 같은 소리 하고 있네. 나는 사람이라고!'

보수적인 청교도 집안에서 자라 난 데일.
그에게 샬롯의 요구는 하나같이 황당하게만 느껴진다.

"착하지? 핥아."
"강아지는 옷을 입지 않잖아. 벗겨줄게."
"데일, 너는 훈련이 많이 필요하겠다."

하지만 데일의 몸은 여자의 명령에 착실히 반응하고,
한 번 배덕감에 젖은 의식은 점점 아래로 가라앉는다.

'샬롯... 나를 더 망가뜨려 줘.'

그 위험한 놀이가 이끄는 끝이 어디인지도 모른 채.

Go head-to-head in a game like soccer, but filled with colorful monsters!

name: Cursed
summary:
A horrific retro point and click adventure with combat

In a small unnamed rural town, a girl has been missing for over 24 hours. She foolishlly ventured down a forbidden stairwell feared by every citizen. Now you have been called to find her and solve the mysteries of the abandoned mines. Is she even still alive at this point? Only one way to find out.

-Venture underground in retro point-and-click style

-Do battle with unholy creatures in real time combat

-Solve puzzles and use inventory to progress into the labyrinth

-Chilling atmosphere and classic pc-indie-game vibes

-Unique blend of action and puzzle solving

This was the first game I made in one week during 2009. Inspired by old horror games such as Last Half of Darkness and Uninvited. Created as a small passion project. Cursed 2 was finished in 2019, and now Cursed 3 is being developed in 2022.

name: Dumb Little Robots
summary:
Dumb Little Robots is a 2d puzzle game where you control robots that each have a single function. Help them work together to solve tricky levels. Meet new robots as you go and learn how they change the possibilities!

Start simply...

Get complex!

Levels play out on grids, and primarily feature pushing, rotating, destroying, and copying robots to solve.

If you find yourself stuck, DON'T PANIC. This game features a hint button! And then panic anyway, as you may find the assistance sometimes less than helpful.

Includes 51 levels, divided between 6 tutorial levels and 45 main levels. Levels are clustered into groups of 9 that can be completed in any order.

Dumb Little Robots is a 2d puzzle game where you control robots that each have a single function. Help them work together through 51 levels. Find new robots as you go and learn how they change the possibilities!

一个人开打很爽，一群人一起上场才是真正的《暴打联盟》!

直接驾驶太空舱、机甲等强力载具加入战斗，在最关键时刻冲入战场，压制敌群，把战斗规模推向新的高度！

name: Remains Of Morrow
summary:
An atmospheric third person game about a wizard's final quest. The game tells the story of the victories and failures of a wizard who was once considered the best. Now in the twilight years of his life he’s asked by a stranger for a favor. Take control of the wizard and complete his final mission.

Remains Of Morrow is a third person story driven game that centers around the final quest for a wizards that was at one considered to be a hero in his prime. The quest is given to him by a stranger whose family he couldn't save in the war against evil. Players are asked to take control of the wizard in go into realms the stranger can't go to retrieve a special item that can reverse his town's fortunes. Along the way you'll dive deep into the wizard's past and find out the choices that brought to where he is today. Then he can remember why this all started, where he may have went wrong and just might find a way to fix the impossible.

Key Features:

 Epic narration with multiple endings and some RPG features

 Includes light fighting and puzzle solving

 Engrossing music and immersive gameplay and environment

 Made by a solo developer

name: Project Xenoflora
summary:
Someone thought it was a good idea to create the world's first sentient plant. It wasn't. Now there's a mildly dangerous and very angry plant making a mad dash for the exit, the only thing that stands in its way is the near-infinite number of mass-produced robot sentries programmed to destroy it.

100% of the plant life on earth was non-sentient, maybe scientists and giant corporations should learn to not mess with the laws of nature.

In Project Xenoflora, you play the world's first biologically created sentient plant. Plants are cool, being able to think it cool, why not just combine those two things? Someone thought it was a good idea, it wasn't. Now there's a mildly dangerous and very angry plant making a mad dash for the exit, the only thing that stands in its way is the near-infinite number of mass-produced robot sentries programmed to destroy it. 

Burrow, shoot, and... tree?... your way through bullet-hell action in this short roguelike experience. 

Make use of randomized abilities and combine them to suit your playstyle.

Most importantly, the enemies are all robots, the dog is a robot dog, specifically a chlorophyll-thirsty robot dog trying to tear you to shreds. Do not feel bad for the robot dog, it has red eyes its obviously evil.

This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

summary:
Bound to the soul of an assassinated emperor and equipped with only one bullet, traverse and fight through the stylized world of Soul in the Chamber as you try to uncover the mysteries of a fallen empire and survive the collision of two dying worlds.

You play as an archeologist exploring through the ruins of the long fallen Khal Empire when you recover a mysterious ancient gun. When picking up the gun, the soul of an assassinated emperor is dragged out of the spirit world and becomes entrapped into the body of the gun. Due to your actions, a cataclysmic collision of worlds has begun that only you can stop by returning the emperor to his final resting place in the spirit world.

With the emperor at your side, you must traverse the chaos of the oncoming apocalypse as you fight through the vengeful and mad spirits of the fallen empire’s bloody past. Save the fates of both colliding worlds as you uncover the mystery of the emperor’s assassination and the story of the empire’s fall.

Heart-Pumping Fast-Paced Traversal
Slide, wall-run, and dash your way through a world designed for agility and flowing movement. Build up your momentum as you dodge opponents, traps, and traverse environments crafted to challenge your ability.

Precise and Creative Combat
With only one shot to take down enemies, use bullet-time and precision to take down your opponents and use their souls to recover your bullet and chain together kills as you move through combat. Gather and use unique modifiers for your shots to creatively take down enemies and use your environment against those who stand in your way.

A Vibrant Stylized World
Traverse through the beautiful ruins of an empire that fell from a tyrannical imperial dynasty and a bloody civil war. Explore the vibrance of a dying spirit world as well as the chaos of two worlds’ colliding. Endure the onslaught of stylized and unique opponents as well as a treacherous environment as you try to reach your goal.

summary:
A growing phenomenon threatens the forest...

Friendly Fox needs an expert like you in this stunning addition to the Edge of Reality series!

It’s been 20 years since your last visit to Redwood National Park, but your love of nature has made you an expert in the field. So, when strange human-shaped plants start appearing across the park, it’s up to you to uncover their source! But there’s much more to this mystery than just fantastical fauna. Between rumors of illegal logging, an order of owl-clad protectors, and a recent series of disappearances, it’s going to take all your skills to win over new animal friends and save the day! Do you have what it takes? Find out in this enthralling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

name: Pasajeros
summary:
Pasajeros is developed through a collection of urban and surreal stories collected in a taxi in Bogotá . It’s a four-night adventure packed with micro-stories of vampires, mariachis, and thugs. In addition to the opportunity to find love or madness in the night magic of a city.

Pasajeros is a narrative video game that mixes visual novel elements to tell the story of a taxi driver who tries to prevent the suicide of one of his passengers, in Chapinero, a neighborhood in Bogotá, Colombia.

But in reality it is much more than that, it is a game of micro stories that take place over four nights that mix everyday stories with fantastic ones, showing everything from robots and vampires to musicians and thugs.

It is an interactive game in which players can vary the decisions of its protagonists and determine the life or death, love or loneliness, of the taxi driver.

It is a game with a duration of two to three hours, which aims to be a tribute to the most important cultural neighborhood in Colombia and rescue some of its myths through anonymous characters on the verge of happiness and death.

Anna Gray, Dorian Brown, and James Blackthorn are back to take on their biggest case yet – with the assistance of the always reliable Agent Shade, of course. When our intrepid investigators each catch wind of a powerful mystical energy, they’re drawn in once again to investigate visions involving a sinister woman, an older man, and a mysterious violin with unthinkable powers! But who are the victims and who are the villains? More importantly, what dark deals could grant such terrible power? Prepare yourself to step into the shoes of three of the most gifted detectives of all time in this exciting new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector’s Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:

• Solve more mysteries as detectives Anna Gray, Agent Brown, and James Blackthorn!
• Earn every achievement, including ones from the Secret Rooms! 
• Collect all the clocks and puzzle pieces to learn more about the Detectives United agents!
• An official strategy guide to help you crack the case!

summary:
Everplast is a unique platforming experience filled with rage, rush, speed, and spray. Continuously collect new items and obtain more power while relentlessly destroying the enemies. With inevitable death, can you make it through without raging?

Feel the adrenaline rush as you plow through enemies, make precise and timed jumps while running through levels.

Everplast is a unique platforming experience mixed with player freedom to allow you to develop refreshing hand-eye-coordination and platforming skills. Choose how you develop your profile be it by obtaining many items and sprinting through levels at double the speed while spraying down enemies with weapons, or by increasing your stats to extremely high levels to be incredibly powerful. Adrenaline

Adrenaline is a unique collection of energy allowing you to rush through enemies and make calculated platforming moves. Also use it to blast ice from the air into the world from the winter environment. Keeping your adrenaline balanced will be vital to your success.

Orbs

Ranks

During your adventure you will find ranks to increase your abilities and potential even more. Your power continues to increase as you progress through worlds.

Discover hand-built environments and worlds through your journey!

I have spent a total of 8 months making this game. For everyone here, for everyone who has supported me, thank you so much! Now I challenge you to make it through!!!

After a rise of missing person cases presents itself in a small quaint town, you must prepare to figure out why.
Many people have mentioned a feeling of fear sweeping over them while in the town, eventually leading to their loss of sanity. 
You are an investigator, tasked with finding the cause for Hollow Points high missing persons rate You travel alone through the town finding hidden clues, and after conversing with the few residents who are left and avoiding the specter's that haunt the town, you must travel to a ghostly ship and attempt to put an end to the misery that Hollow Point has become consumed by. 
Spare batteries, Anti-hallucinogenic drugs and bandages can be found around each location, these items will stop you from becoming another statistic in this intense, story driven horror.

Will you be able to uncover Hollow Point's mysteries' and bring closure to it's residence? Or will you succumb to insanity?

Just Another Day
An Open-World Horror Fishing Game in an Alien Apocalypse

Step into a haunting world torn apart by an alien invasion in Just Another Day. Traverse treacherous, procedurally generated maps as you navigate real-time, ever-changing waters in search of rare fish, legendary loot, and unimaginable horrors. As a lone survivor, you'll fight using an arsenal of fully customizable boats, weapons, fishing poles, reels, lures and throwables from primitive spears and harpoons to futuristic beam weapons and other alien technology. Each weapon is uniquely generated, offering endless possibilities in your fight against colossal monsters, roaming creatures and unpredictable world events.

Robust Fishing Mechanics: Fish for treasure and face lurking dangers beneath, where a rare catch could mean life or death.

Fun Machine - A Fruit Machine Simulator from Robot Plums.

Each play gives you 50 Credits to score as much as possible, and get to the top of the High Score Table.

Just like a real Fruit Machine, you win by lining up 3 of the same symbols on the win-line (from 3 points for 3 cherries, to 50 points for 3 treasure chests.
You can also score 2 points for lining up just 2 of the same symbols on reels 1 and 2.

Scattered across the 3 reels are 3 different types of Jewel.
As these land on the win-line, they help light up the trail (Red = 1 light, Yellow = 2, Green = 3), but the Feature Trail isn't always held between spins.

You need to light up all the "Fun Machine" letters using the Jewels to gain access to the Feature Board.

Once you get to the Feature Board, you randomly choose a Feature from the many on the Board, although there are some not-so-good Features on there too, including "LOSE" in the centre of the Board.
Fingers crossed!

Once you've chosen a Feature, and presuming you haven't selected one of the bad ones, you will play one of the many games of Skill or Chance, all of which vary in how many goes/spins/turns you get, and how many points are up for grabs.

Fun Machine also features regulars like Nudge Pot and Cash Pot, which not only carry over to the next game, but are saved so that they are there the next time you play the game.

With these Pots, selecting the Cash Pot from the Feature Board will add whatever is in the Cash Pot to your score, and selecting the Nudge Pot will start the Nudge Feature, where you will be able to nudge the reels down one at a time, until you either run out of nudges, or achieve a win on the win-line.

name: Running in the Y2K
summary:
Run, Jump and Hunt through procedurally generated levels to feed your family in the post-apocalyptic world of the year 2000 after the Y2K bug occurred. Compete against everyone in the leaderboards to show who is the best hunter in the new world.

Join the community!

This game is an endless runner where every run is played in a procedural level. You will jump and shoot spears to hunt mutated animals. These animals will drop food that, apart from giving you some extra points, will allow you to upgrade different aspects of your character making each run important. The farther you go, the faster you will go making the run an ever rising challenge. Your goal is to go as far as you can.

After the Y2K bug occurred (computers crashed due to not having into account the change of the millennium), catastrophe unleashed causing nuclear reactors to get unstable and inevitably cause mutations all over the world. Humanity went back to a nearly prehistoric way of living, technology was suddenly unusable the only use we can give to it is to throw it at animals or noise neighbours. After some testing the most efficient piece of technology to throw is the newly released Mokia 3210.

What didn't change was the need for humans to eat. In a world where almost every living creature mutated food became the new currency.

You are now in charge of hunting and providing for your family don't worry Turtlbbit is tastier than it sounds. After the nuclear catastrophe animals look.. well.. a bit different.

Anyway, your job is to hunt them and get as much food as you can for your family. 

Food can be used to upgrade your 38m2 two floors primitive cave. These upgrades will give you an advantage when running.

Ohh, and don't forget that you will be competing against other survivors through Steam leaderboards to see who is the best neo-post-apocalyptic-runner.

- Enemies can confuse you. Evil is not always what is expected.

- Split up to cover more ground or stay in a group to increase survivability.

- Trust your instincts. Use items that the spirits like or hate at the right time.

summary:
This game is about farming! Just good ol' planting crops in the daytime, and harvesting them in the daytime with no sinister nighttime gameplay or anything nefarious like that at all.

It's finally here, an honest to goodness game about farming! What will we think of next? Nothing but you and the calming iterations of putting seeds into the ground and taking them back out after they've gotten larger and more vegetable-y. Maybe you'll even discover some new recipes to put them in! No need worrying about how your actions affect anything happening at night, because probably everyone is asleep and everything is fine. No reason anything that happens at night could affect anything happening on your farm because, as I believe I've said, everyone is sleeping at night.

A Wholesome Game About Farming takes roughly 2 hours to complete, and features classic farming mechanics like:

Purchasing and planting seeds

Harvesting and selling crops

A simple crafting system where you can discover new recipes

Spying on people

Sneaking up on your victims

Placing obstacles for your victims

Hiding the evidence

You'll play as a struggling yet resilient and kind-hearted old farmer named Jep, and if there's any such thing as a "vampire" named "Raluca" who you "play as" at "night" I've certainly never heard of her and have no idea what you're talking about.

Happy Farming!

Guppy My Sweet
棒球观测者
summary:
如果能够一眼看出某人作为职业棒球员时，一生能达成多少成就……那会产生怎样的故事呢？

你是这支联盟最弱球队的教练，因为未知的原因，你没有过往的记忆，并且接手了一个烂摊子：球队里充斥着坐领高薪、却早已失去斗志的「不上进球员」。更糟的是，他们牢不可破的保障出赛合约，使其掌握着绝对的出赛权。你需要以各种手段摆脱他们，但即使如此，放眼望去的平凡球员，也难以在短期内让人期待球队的未来。

在绝境之中，你唯一能仰赖的，就是一项无人知晓的神秘能力：「棒球观测者」。

你将在城市里，从平凡上班族、热血学生甚至无业游民中，运用能力，看穿他们惊人的潜力。

独特的角色故事：与多名独特人物相遇，说服他们踏上职棒的道路。

规划球员的养成：观测他们的能力、潜力，计画好把球员们当即战力使用，或等潜力股在赛季后段兑现天赋。

转职的诱因：这些人物都有着自己的生活。在球团支援有限的条件下，你能否仍然准备好他们期望的工作合约，诱使他们赌上一切，成为你球队的全新战力？

这是一款以 类似剧情AVG+文字模拟 为核心的棒球经营游戏。玩家不需操作比赛，而是专注于阵容替换与厚实战力。

拟定方针：在140场赛季中，设定球队的轮换阵容，并完成来自球团的阶段性目标，保住教练职位。

训练计画：你每周的行动力有限，训练或寻找更多球员，以及解决棘手的保障出赛合约。

寻找真相：随着赛季进行，你将逐步揭开前任教练留下的谜团，并抵达故事的结局。

AI 生成内容披露：主要美术资产（如角色头像、背景）和部分代码由 AI 辅助完成。

name: 勇往直前灰姑娘 吾家有犬初長成 (上)
summary:
超人氣少女漫畫家林珉萱（小威老師） X POPO原創網討論度No.1 糖粉系天后作家憑虛
　　似曾相識的場景對白，別出心裁的原創劇情！

　　窮得響叮噹的安凱琳，被超級富豪伏家高薪聘請，工作內容如下：
　　1. 冒充與妳神似的四小姐；
　　2. 為三少爺容星尋找相愛之人，以解開「十八歲前未與心愛之人結合，將永遠變成狗」的詛咒。
　　因此，即使伏容星傲嬌又難搞，安凱琳仍千方百計幫他找對象，就為了拿到四億報酬，順便完成任務。但她高估了自己的能力，更低估伏容星的定力──
　　「妳為什麼要做這種事？」
　　「哪種事？」
　　「幫我相親。」
　　「我要幫你找到真愛嘛……」
　　「這麼熱心？不如妳自己來幫我！」
　　慘遭伏家三少各種鹹豬手攻擊的安凱琳不禁哀號：「這傢伙太討厭了！」
　　但她為什麼就是無法給他一巴掌，叫他滾得遠遠呢？

name: 勇往直前灰姑娘 吾家有犬初長成 (下)
summary:
☆ 超人氣少女漫畫家林珉萱（小威老師） X POPO原創網討論度No.1 糖粉系天后作家憑虛
　　♡ 多糖微酸微色氣＝黃金比例的番外完結篇！
　　♡ 收錄超‧踩‧線 全新4P漫畫

　　「安凱琳！」

　　「凱琳！」

　　安凱琳的墜樓事件，讓伏容星與伏容月緊張不已。雖然她安然無恙，當時在場的容星、容月仍心有餘悸，並承諾她將找出真凶。可是，出現在監視器裡、推安凱琳下樓的人，卻是早已變成狗狗的容日？！

　　另一方面，漸漸恢復健康的安凱琳，沒心沒肺地使喚著伏家少爺們。她一如往常地四處斂財、擔當同學的月老，還得常常抵禦兩個偶爾會變成狗的「哥哥」的騷擾。

　　例如，睡前抱著的是隻吉娃娃，醒後卻成了裸體的男人──

　　「你、我、我會負責的。」

　　「負責？那不如把妳自己送給我吧。」

　　「喂，你們在幹麼啊？」

　　可惡！老是裸著身體在她面前晃來晃去，這樣她以後要怎麼面對其他身材不好的男人啦？！

What is Project Three?

Project Three a psychological first-person survival horror made by one person focused on atmosphere, story and defending yourself with melee and weaponry against several creatures. The story is set in the alternate fan-made universe of Half-Life, Valve Corporation's successful series. 

The story plays with a different idea taking place after a resonance cascade, an innocent trip to work suddenly turns into a fight against an alien race and the entire US army... but what if the truth is a little different.

Who will refill your magazines? Learn about survival elements.

The game also features survival elements that make the gameplay even more engaging. One of them is the crowbar, which allows you to block enemy attacks—reducing or even completely negating incoming damage.

Another key element is weapon reloading. Unlike traditional games, you don’t simply collect ammunition; you have to manually load rounds into your magazine. Your weapons are powerful, but don’t forget to keep them stocked—running dry at the wrong moment could be fatal.

Headcrab

Zombie

Thomas is a young millionaire who gained fame and all his money thanks to the foundation of the Quest rooms network. He has all the attributes of a successful life: wealth, influence, favorite job. 玩家是否能够完成艰困任务或是会成为刀下亡魂？亦或是会不断变强，最终成为最强剑士呢？

玩家需要善用这些技能组合来对抗各式各样的高强对手！

玩家扮演的角色、执行暗杀任务的伙伴。

以XBOX控制器为主

扫描并收集行星的有用矿物信息。你可以在那里建造一些矿物矿。如果您有一些蓝图，您还可以构建工厂并产生所需的资源或销售它们。有许多特殊项目可以建成。例如，太空望远镜有助于发现远方行星。星形可以帮助传送到任何星球的船只。空间探针有助于从深空中检测敌人。

船舶工厂
船舶工厂中可以建立不同的船只。战舰，激光站，货物船和侦察兵。船有不同种类的武器。

邪恶力
来自银河系的邪恶力量正在努力摧毁他们发现的所有行星中的所有文明。一开始，你可能没有足够的力量来与他们斗争。所以要逃避和隐藏是好方法。当您有大船队时，您也可以发挥强制领导者来保护您的联盟。

空间裂缝
您有能力穿过太空中的裂缝。所以你可以走过它，找到一个新的星球来生存。一些裂缝关闭，你必须击败一些老板以重新打开它。

贸易
如果有贸易中心，您可以与每个星球进行交易。您可以交易您需要的一些资源，您还可以购买一些蓝图或技术。如果空间海盗来，你可以与他们交易。他们也可以带来罕见的物品和蓝图。

随机陨石事件
陨石有时会在可以收集资源的行星上。有时，一些空间垃圾也脱离了。您可以从中获得一些特殊材料或船只。您可以构建一些轨道干扰，有助于获得更大的流星。

name: S4Game
summary:
S4Game aims to provide health professionals with an innovative approach to acquire soft skills to foster their professional development. Their main learning objective is the acquisition of soft skills required during work in an operating room, such as communication or teamwork.

S4Game is a serious game. The main purpose of serious games is education and training.

The main features of optimal learning environments are:

-Clear learning goals.

Broad experiences and practice opportunities that continue to challenge the learner and reinforce expertise.

Continuous monitoring of progress, and use of this information to diagnose performance and adjust instruction to learner level of mastery.

Encouragement of inquiry and questions, and response with answersthat are appropriate to the learner and context.

Contextual bridging: games and simulations can close the gap between what is learned and its use.

Another subgenre of the video game is graphic adventure, with interactive elements and decision making. The player assumes the role of a protagonist in an interactive story driven by exploration and / or puzzle-solving.

The perspective of the camera within the game, depending on the practical case that is being trained, will be played in first or third person. First person view means camera is the same as the point of view of the player. On the other hand, the main characteristic of the third person view is that the sceneis seen globally, as an external spectator,and generally from the back.

Regarding the visual style, the elements of the game are realistic 3D with semi-realistic textures.

This is a platformer, 2D MOBA game with shooting robots. 
An 5v5 PvP arena where the goal is to destroy the enemy team's core or capture the base on the center and keep it. 
You can customize your weapon and robot by choosing different equipment, which you can acquire by reaching higher levels.
Capture the base in the middle to support the advance. While you're dead, you control a small but deadly drone.
The matches are approximately 20 minutes long.
The game supports solo, LAN and online matchmaking. (...and simulation games where you only observe bots in spectator mode)

On an icy planet, the robots of two bases fight each other to destroy the energy core of the enemy base.
If the game successfully finds an audience, we plan to add a lot of new content and features to it.
This game is the basis for our later developments with the real goal of creating development solutions to develop our future multiplayer games.
We develop the following functions, maps, or equipment according to demand. You can vote for our next developments on our website.

The game is designed to work with selfhosted sessions, so it will work offline, without servers.

WarBots are designed for WAR at a giant scale.
Humans created a whole planet to produce, test and develop warbots and send them out across the galaxies to eliminate potential threats. name: Dire Fog: Tactical Card Combat
summary:
Deck building and tactics. No random effects, no shuffling, just pure skill and strategy. Victory is only possible if you outplay your enemy.

best strategic elements of turn based tactical combat and deck building card games.

Construct your deck and then play it out on a grid, strategically maneuvering your minions and spells into position to outwit your opponent.

Choose the order your cards are drawn in when you build your deck. There are no random effects in the game and no shuffling.

You can only win through thoughtful deck construction and outplaying your opponent in game.

Dire Fog is designed to be first and foremost a strategic PVP experience. You will build a deck and play it against an opponent selected based on your skill level online.

Unique effects that play into positioning mechanics and offer opportunities to set up and outplay your opponent

Stunning visual effects, hand drawn illustrations, and voice overs that will leave you breathless

Lore and world building baked into every card that will draw you in to the world of Dire Fog

Dire Fog is currently in the closed alpha stage of development. We are welcome dedicated fans of CCGs and deep tactical combat games to join our community and provide their feedback and thoughts!

Join our discord server!

name: Home VR
summary:
潜入 Home 的令人毛骨悚然的世界，西非神话和传说的阴暗深处在这里栩栩如生。在这个令人毛骨悚然的 VR 恐怖体验中，让自己沉浸在 Efe 的痛苦旅程中，Efe 是一名寄宿学校的学生，他的噩梦变得非常真实。埃菲被困在闹鬼的大厅里，必须智取并躲避潜伏在黑暗中的可怕怪物。

存活！

欢迎来到 Home 的噩梦，这是一种 VR 恐怖体验，为西非民间传说中最黑暗的角落注入了生命。 加入年轻的埃菲的惊心动魄的故事，埃菲是一名寄宿学校的学生，他的世界已经陷入了噩梦般的境界。 当你引导埃菲穿过诡异的走廊时，你必须躲避并战胜那些潜伏着、准备从阴影中发动袭击的恶毒生物。

在《Home》中，你在一个对你来说感觉更大的环境中扮演一个小女孩。 忘记反击； 你唯一的武器就是隐秘的艺术。 运用你的狡猾、智慧和古老的juju（魔法）来躲避跟踪你一举一动的无情怪物。 但请记住，他们总是在观察和倾听。 一失足，他们可怕的控制就会收紧。 在你发现的魔法文物中寻找安慰，因为它们让你看到看不见的东西，为你在另一个世界提供暂时的庇护，并掌握利用怪物秘密的钥匙。

准备好被 Home 的噩梦般的视觉效果、令人难以忘怀的声音和令人费解的谜题所吞没，这是一款植根于西非民间传说的开创性 VR 恐怖游戏。 作为第一个从非洲深处出现的同类游戏，《Home》将让您沉浸在一个充满恐惧、神秘和无情恐怖的世界中。 与我们一起踏上这段令人脊背发凉的未知之旅。 立即将其列入愿望清单，以应对您最深的恐惧。

name: 物体凹
幽默三国
summary: 《幽默三国》的作者周锐似乎掌握了一条通向童心的神奇之径，他看似轻巧地把名著人物卡通化、幽默化，但又保留了人物的性格特征。原本我们熟知的三国人物是草莽英雄式的，他们性格鲜明，行事风格与人物个性相互呼应。周锐以一种游戏的口吻叙述他们的生活，将三国故事融入幽默的情境之中。 幽默是一种吸引人的气质，它是生成的却很难造就。大个子周锐难得拥有了这种禀赋，这使得他的小说总是透露出与别家不同的风格。周锐的幽默是新奇怪癖、构思精巧而出人意料的，这源于他的笔触中处处洋溢着一种游戏的气氛。人之初的孩童时代，正是人的游戏精神最为充盈的时期，也是人本性体现的最为充分的时候。在孩子们的生活中，虽然也有“过家家”、小领导、小干部的概念，但不同的是，相对于成年人对结果的偏重，孩子们更注重的也许只是过程究竟“好不好笑”、“好不好玩”。在他们的生活中，游戏是理解、体验、超越生活的方式。所以在他们的考虑范围内，没有大不了的事，也不会有过不去的坎。

Ploc has 35 stages and 6 different game modes, they are:

Normal: Go through the 35 stages, from the first to the last.

Normal Time: The same 35 stages but with a time of 20 seconds to complete each one.

Normal Go And Back: Go to the end of each level, press the button, and go back to the beginning.

Reverse: Where was the end is now the beginning. Start at stage 35 and go all the way to the first stage, and at each stage you will have to take the opposite path to the one you took in normal mode.

Reverse Time: The same stages as in reverse, but with a time of 20 seconds to complete each stage.

Reverse Go And Back: In reverse mode, complete each stage by going to the end of it, pressing the button, and returning to the beginning.

name: 補遺
幽默三国 吉祥乌鸦嘴
summary: 《幽默三国》的作者周锐似乎掌握了一条通向童心的神奇之径，他看似轻巧地把名著人物卡通化、幽默化，但又保留了人物的性格特征。原本我们熟知的三国人物是草莽英雄式的，他们性格鲜明，行事风格与人物个性相互呼应。周锐以一种游戏的口吻叙述他们的生活，将三国故事融入幽默的情境之中。 幽默是一种吸引人的气质，它是生成的却很难造就。大个子周锐难得拥有了这种禀赋，这使得他的小说总是透露出与别家不同的风格。周锐的幽默是新奇怪癖、构思精巧而出人意料的，这源于他的笔触中处处洋溢着一种游戏的气氛。人之初的孩童时代，正是人的游戏精神最为充盈的时期，也是人本性体现的最为充分的时候。在孩子们的生活中，虽然也有“过家家”、小领导、小干部的概念，但不同的是，相对于成年人对结果的偏重，孩子们更注重的也许只是过程究竟“好不好笑”、“好不好玩”。在他们的生活中，游戏是理解、体验、超越生活的方式。所以在他们的考虑范围内，没有大不了的事，也不会有过不去的坎。

While most aliens can enter Earth legally, some alien species are not welcome. Unwanted aliens may choose to trick the immigration authorities and impersonate humans. These aliens must be detected and arrested. However, things are more challenging than they seem.

There are several interrogation methods available to Noah to carry out his work. Some encounters can be scary, some can be funny, and sometimes can feel tedious, but Noah needs this job to make enough money to reunite with his sister, who resides in one of the human colonies in space.

Will Noah choose to do his job, get the money, and leave Earth? Or maybe he has other plans?

"Human or Not" is a puzzle simulation game that puts the player in the shoes of an immigration officer and allows them to decide who can enter Earth. Between shifts, the player meets different characters and makes decisions about Noah's life.

Features:

 Interrogate passengers in your high-tech booth. A glass barrier is included.

 Press the "HUMAN" or the "ALIEN" button for every passenger you inspect.

 Earn cash.

name: 我不是传奇
summary:
来消磨时间的打僵尸游戏，目标简单但有点难度和需要点运气。消灭场景里所有僵尸，但他们隔一段时间按剩余数量翻倍，你是先杀僵尸还是先找物品？技巧策略和运气都重要，你能接受挑战吗？

游戏介绍

《我不是传奇》2.0版本延续1.0的主要玩法：目标是消灭场景里所有的丧尸，而丧尸在一定时间内会翻倍生成，你在场景里搜集物品和武器来完成目标。相比于1.0版本，2.0版本有了更多的改进。包括游戏前和游戏里，在游戏前可以选择不同的角色，选择场景和大小（这功能后续补上），难度设置更为细致（可以选择初始丧尸数量、再生时间设置、物品丰富度、难度因子、开始是否持有武器），还有可以设置日夜轮换和是否在黑夜开始。在游戏里，场景设置更为真实和丰富，角色武器更丰富，近战可以连击和锁定丧尸，可使用的物品功能更多等等。而且游戏做了较好的优化，2.0版本内容更丰富更好，但游戏大小比1.0版本更小，而且硬件性能的要求更低。

游戏目标

消灭场景里所有的丧尸，玩法很简单

核心矛盾
丧尸在一定时间后会翻倍再生，初始丧尸越多，翻倍越多，会越来越艰难，而是用更多时间搜集物品还是杀死丧尸是需要平衡的策略。每次开局结果都不会一样的。

游戏设置
1、游戏可选择不同的场景和小大，不同的场景氛围和建筑物不同，场景越大物品和丧尸分布越散，物品越难搜集，丧尸越难找到。
2、游戏可以选择日夜轮替和是否在午夜开始，白天视野更清晰，氛围相对没那么可怕，但丧尸的行动能力更强，跑得更快。黑夜视野不清晰，氛围更可怕，经常需要用手电，但丧尸行动能力更弱，跑得更慢。
3、场景里每个建筑物内都会生成一定数量的物品，包括武器、子弹、配件、功能性物品等等，物品通常只在刚开始时生成一次，用完就没了。而且物品生成有一定的概率，是否生成足够的适合的物品需要一定的运气。
4、物品生成的种类和丧尸分布是不确定的，需要一点运气。物品随机生成如果足够多并种类符合需求，丧尸分布集中，那可能很快就能完成挑战。
5、场景里随机分布了特别设定，女鬼，你如果遇到了，会为你带来协助，你遇到就知道了。

summary:
Slap triangular tiles down in this cause and effect, chain reactive, radically funky puzzle experience! Collect as many golden triangles as you can to unlock new levels, but don't sweat it if you aren't a triangle-brained genius: Each stage has 3 goals ranging from casual fun, to extreme puzzling!

Triga is a funky, out of this world, short and sweet puzzle experience for everyone from casual thinkists looking for a bit of fun, to extreme puzzlists looking for a challenge. The game is go at your own pace and beat with your own style: If you get stuck on a puzzle, you can simply leave and come back later, or continue to advance through other levels that suit your thinky style instead!

In Triga, each level has a few golden triangles. Your goal is to destroy or knock any number of them off the board (See if you can go for 100%)! You are given a set of triangular tools, each type has a unique effect when placed on the board such as causing a destructive explosion or pushing adjacent tiles away. Try to create chain reactions in order to pull off more complex maneuvers. It is not as easy as it sounds though, as the triangular board spaces make for some interesting and unexpected motion, and obstacles abound in each increasingly difficult level!

Triga is part of the CosmOS 9 bundle.

name: Athemore
summary:
Explore the underground ruins of Athemore and learn about the forgotten past. Will you make it out alive?

Story

You play as the professional treasure hunter Jerome, who’s recently left the guild, because the other members benefited too much from your hard work and experience. You have finally realized that you are far better off working alone.

The scene takes place in an abandoned ancient dungeon. The word around town says the dungeon is haunted and without any details about the place, no one ever dared to set foot down there. Luckily you have managed to get hold of a map of the place.

After arriving at the ruin, your main goal is now to locate and grab an exceptional artifact. Unfortunately, others share the same goal as you

How to play

During gameplay, you are going to make some choices and sacrifices, which affects the outcome of how the game progresses. There’s no right and wrong.

The dungeon holds many clues about the dark past. You will find some interesting objects. Some objects are collectible and some are readable. The crosshair turns green, if you look at objects of interest. 

Also, watch out for dangers such as traps, pits and enemies. You will die instantly if you aren’t observant. Luckily there’s several checkpoints across the dungeon.

Survive the fallout in a world scorched , cut off from the off-world colonies. Uncover the truth as you struggle to survive the hordes and locate supplies needed to live. Find the evidence you need to expose SynCo as you work your way through the last standing city on earth. Fight your way across the galaxy to help liberate the off world colonies from the tyrannical rule imposed upon them. Can you help to free all of humanity from a corporate conglomerate with a choke hold on every single human? 

Fight and sneak your way through each stylized act as you follow the story through multiple (semi)open world beautifully detailed environments. Face off against humans infected with a maddening bioweapon, corporate assault forces, and aliens on your journey to save humanity.

Augments apply diverse modifiers to your arsenal: Imbue attacks with lightning damage, cast your heals as team-wide spells, and guarantee your buffs trigger before anyone else moves. With millions of Primary-Augment combos available in-game, the sky’s the limit!

Trailthread's story follows a blacksmith, baker, and bandit on their journey to scale Anvite Mountain and slay the bitter Obsidian Drake. Rekindle enchanted forges, meet strange friends, and tumble across the timeline with the mysterious Timestitcher. Can you reach the summit?

Fly. Deliver. Poop.

Dovy has been kidnapped! She was taken to the top of the highest skyscraper in the city. Now you, Chester, have to rescue her. To rescue her, you need to help the people in the city and use the rewards they give you to fix a ventilator so you can fly high enough. Quibungo - Terrible devourer of children, especially disobedient ones.

Werewolf - Human able to turn into a wolf on a full moon night.

Sylvans - Human-animal hybrids, like the pig-faced woman.

Striga - Female vampire-like demon.

Djinn - Creatures made of smokeless fire that live in a parallel dimension.

Lamia - Female succubus-like demon.

Set up the jigsaw puzzle scenes at five different levels of difficulty.

Beautiful illustrations created especially for the game by artist Alexandre Rocha (@semdizer).

Play this game if you like monster stories, you will surely love to know a little more about these creatures!

Composed of newly initiated men and women, your team is sent by the private company Archrebel to prove its worth. What begins as a routine mission quickly turns into a fight for survival, as the squad becomes entangled in skirmishes against an unexpected totalitarian enemy. By joining forces with the colonists, looting resources, researching technologies, and building and capturing powerful droids, you will gradually assemble a force capable of repelling the intruder that has secretly seized control of the planet’s colonies. 

Types of missions: 

Elimination – eliminate all hostile forces.

Exploration – gather intel and locate assets.

A series of disappearances of research ships sent to the center of the galaxy leaves the Earth government and scientists in disarray. Sent to investigate, your ship crashes and you find yourself on a mysterious alien base from which no one has ever escaped. Explore the base's perilous inner mazes to uncover ancient secrets, escape from this hellish trap and warn humanity of the impending danger. 

Ahead of you are many randomly generated levels filled with a strange ether gas whose nature and purpose are unknown. Clear the mazes of the ether to earn points and ensure timely detection of dangerous organisms, the number of which is growing rapidly over time! Each time you make a decision - explore the level thoroughly to find important alien artifacts, make useful discoveries and get bonuses, or escape faster, because with every minute the level space is filled with dangerous creatures.

More than a hundred randomly generated maze levels, involving different ways of passing.

Your electronic partner - AI girl Elise will help you explore alien technology, understand what kind of place you are in, and get out of it.

name: AI Roguelite
summary:
World's first RPG in which all entities are AI-generated and all game mechanics are AI-directed.

Introducing AI Roguelite, the world's first text-based RPG where every location, NPC, enemy, item, crafting recipe, and game mechanic is 100% determined by artificial intelligence.

If you've ever played other AI "games" such as AI Dungeon and were frustrated by how they didn't feel like a game, then AI Roguelite might be the perfect game for you.

AI-generated entities: What weapons might you find in an underwater city? Which enemies might you find? Where else can you go from there? All these questions are answered by an LLM, so you can explore a truly infinite world.

AI-generated crafting recipes: What item could you make if combining a wooden stick with a rock? What about a computer chip with a zombie brain? The AI decides which item should be produced, based on the names of the ingredients.

AI-generated combat: What happens when you try to attack a "terminator robot" with a "raw salmon"? Instead of traditional item stats, the success/failure of an attack depends heavily on its name and description, the AI-determined plausibility of your proposed action, and a dice roll check on your attributes and skills. The AI then generates a plausible story for what happens when you use it against the enemy. Finally, the AI is fed its own story, from which it tries to figure out whether the enemy was killed, injured, or unharmed.

AI-generated illustrations: Every entity gets an AI-generated image using either your GPU or the cloud.

Various options for text and image gen models: Choose from free cloud (works out of the box), paid cloud, custom via API (works with OpenRouter, LMStudio, etc.), and more.

name: SEARCH ALL - CRABS
Истории ужасов: Воскрешение
summary:
Хоррор от первого лица, рассказывающий историю отчаявшегося мужчины потерявшего свою жену при загадочных мистических обстоятельствах. Потратив долгие месяцы чтобы связаться с женой в потустороннем мире он отправляется на поиски книги мертвых.

ИСТОРИЯ:
«Книга Мертвых» – это не книга о смерти. Это книга о жизни, победившей смерть.
Сюжет повествует о некоем писателе Алексе, который потерял супругу при загадочных мистических обстоятельствах.
Терзаясь этой утратой, герой хочет связаться с женой в потустороннем мире, чтобы узнать обстоятельства её смерти.

Потратив долгие месяцы безуспешных попыток, Алекс узнает о Книге Мертвых, которая поможет осуществить задуманное.

ОСОБЕННОСТИ:

Находите вещи чтобы добавить их в инвентарь.

Решайте загадки, взаимодействуйте с предметами и окружением чтобы разгадать тайну дома...

Характеристики:
- От первого лица. Игроки примут на себя роль Алекса.
- Атмосферное погружение в кошмар.
- Участие в смертельно опасной схватке с безжалостными демонами, среди которых ЧЕРНОГЛАЗЫЕ ДЕМОНЫ и КРАСНОГЛАЗЫЕ ДЕМОНЫ.
- Поиск предметов и решение жутких загадок.
- Состояния психической напряженности.

ИГРОВОЙ ИГРОВОЙ ПРОЦЕСС:
Вы играете за Алекса который узнаёт о месте хранения Книги Мертвых. В небольшой заброшенной деревне есть древний дом. В этом доме должна быть хозяйка, которая хранит Книгу Мертвых (старая женщина, обладавшая экстрасенсорными способностями).

Приблизившись к дому Алекс ,наблюдает, как хозяйка дома спрыгнула в колодец. Ужасное зрелище!.

Приветствую всех любителей Indie Horror Games!

Cubic Neon Nightclub is a single player futuristic nightclub simulator where you can import your own DJ mixes and music. Immerse yourself among pretty lights, lasers and visual effects while you dance the night away! This VR experience was made by ravers, for ravers during a time where we just need to have a good dance in our isolationist world.

- See your body in the scene for that extra immersion factor

Please enjoy and have fun in your own personal nightclub! 

Notes on importing music:
Must be in .ogg file format - place in the project folder: ...Cubic Neon Nightclub_DataStreamingAssetsMusic.. ). There are plenty of free music file converters (from mp3, etc) to .ogg on the web.

FOR AVG VIRUS PROTECTION USERS:
AVG and perhaps other virus software tends to throw a false positive for an "IDP.Generic" malware for this application despite our best efforts. The .exe file should simply be added to your exception list. Apologies for the inconvenience.

summary:

You are a patient of a psychiatric clinic. You don't remember anything about your past. A certain orderly helped you escape, because he knew that you were here by mistake. 

Who is this orderly? Where to run? What exactly had the main character done? What's going on? Why doesn't he remember anything? Maybe somebody helped him to forget something important?

summary:
一款等距拼图游戏，让你像程序员一样思考。

ALAN-13 Reformation:

作为我们新开发的欢乐益智游戏，ALAN-13 REFORMATION注重于考验你的逻辑思维能力。游戏中，你会面临各种挑战，并需要为我们的自走机器人（ALAN-13）进行接线，以此完成各式各样的任务。在此过程中，你会逐渐学会如何像程序员一样思考（但无需编写任何代码），并熟悉一些编程的基本工具。如果你对编程逻辑感兴趣，你可以把这游戏看成是你成为软件工程师的第0步。当然了，即使没有这种打算，你也可以完美地享受这段旅程。
你的任务：

2177年（在首个机器人出现的30年后），金星的殖民改造正紧锣密鼓地进行中。然而不知为何，最近的太阳活动开始变得十分不寻常。太阳耀斑愈发频繁，日冕物质抛射现象的规模也大到史无前例。这几乎完全摧毁了我们在地表设置的电力基础设施，而持续的电波干扰也使得常规的通信手段变得不可靠。
 为了克服这些挑战，并恢复基础设施的运行，我们的机械工程师更新了我们的通用型机器人（ALAN系列），为其配备了重型机甲和可能需要的额外硬件。
作为我们在现场唯一有自动化背景的工程师，你的任务是将这些机器人单元自动化，使其可以有效地自主巡航及自我续航（因为我们还不能保证远程遥控的信号质量）。对于这项任务，你可以利用已经十分成熟的GENESIS™组件为ALAN-13构建微控制器。此外，你还须学会为机器人安装和配置适合特殊任务的外接硬件设备。
Linux系统兼容性：

正式来讲，我们目前只支持Windows系统。不过，据说只要在游戏选项菜单中打开兼容性功能的话，游戏就能通过PROTON运行。
反馈：

如果您对我们的游戏有任何的反馈或建议，您可以在我们的网站上找到我们的联系方式，又或者，您可以在社区中心分享您的想法。

In a post-apocalyptic island city, it's your mission to ensure the safety and rescue of the last few survivors. Just days before, there was a severe virus outbreak, resulting in most of the citizens becoming mindless zombies bent on devouring human flesh. Fortunately, these zombies are averse to bright lights!  Epicenter VR is based on a project spawned out of a flat-screen game of the same name. The original was fairly small in scope and was built in a month for a college course. 在中世纪的欧洲，做弟弟可不容易。哥哥通常会将他视为威胁，因此一旦获得了头衔和土地，他便会试图除掉弟弟——有时甚至会杀死他们。

被流放的弟弟们往往过于骄傲，不愿意在村庄中劳作或沦为无助的雇佣兵。于是，他们联合起来，掠夺商人并袭击周围的土地。他们训练有素，装备精良，雄心勃勃，成为了强大的对手，被称为“Raubritters”或强盗骑士。

你的故事从不同的角度开始。你会成为骑士美德的典范，还是成为邻里的威胁？选择在你手中。

《强盗骑士》结合了RPG和4X策略，生动展现了中世纪欧洲封建领主的生活。从一座破旧的小屋开始，逐渐将你的领地发展为一个庞大的庄园。通过激烈的战斗、战略战争和根据你的选择而演变的引人入胜的故事，沉浸在中世纪的世界中，同时扩展你的领地和影响力。

RPG/Strategy. Lead your army through intense battles, make decisions that influence the story, and conquer vast lands. Play solo or fight side by side with up to 4 friends.

In medieval Europe, being a younger brother was a nasty business. The older brother often saw the younger brother as a threat, so as soon as he got his title and lands, he would get rid of his younger siblings or even kill them.

Exiled brothers were often too proud to work in the villages or as destitute mercenaries. Therefore, they banded together to plunder merchants and surrounding lands. They were well trained and equipped, and were characterized by ambition, which made them formidable opponents. They were called: Raubritters, or robber knights

Your story begins a little differently. Will you be a paragon of chivalrous virtues or a threat to your neighborhood? This choice is yours.

Robber Knight combines such genres as RPG and 4x strategy. The game is designed to depict life, a feudal lord in medieval Europe. The player will have the opportunity to develop his domain from the level of a single crumbling hut to owning a magnificent castle. 

Immerse yourself in the medieval world by building, fighting and expieriencing an interesting story that changes due to your choices.

Are you looking for a job that would be fun and exciting? With each new day bringing new and unexpected events? Well, look no more! “Surreal Deal” is hiring! 

Mention cut hours and health insurance, that’s the most important part.

It’s like your regular old salesmanship, except no more annoying human customers!!! Now you’ll get to see some abstract and extravagant beings from a parallel dimension!!! To be honest, the store itself will be positioned in said dimension!!! Renovations every day! Be sure not to leave any valuables behind!!! 

That’s how I lost my watch on the second day. Hope the store won’t be covered in clocks next time I enter.

Find a way out in this horror/time loop Game. Hide, run, and uncover the mysteries of the "EOS Complex" as you are pursued by the automated security bots gone rogue. They only move when you do, and you have limited steps before the loop restarts.
So tread carefully, every step could be your last.
Make Every Step Count
Every step you make counts down to 0, solving the mystery of the facility before you run out is essential to your survival. If you do run out, you will be forced back to where you began, you'll keep any items and knowledge, but the world resets.
Tread Softly, Tread Tactically

You are being hunted The security of EOS can only move when you do, use this knowledge to tactically evade, hide and strategize your way out of certain death. You can peak around corners, hide in lockers and sneak out of line of sight, as you gain more tools and knowledge of their behavior you'll become more and more adept at avoiding their pursuit.
Shadow Step
The Shadow step technology allows you to instantaneously move from one point to another, allowing you to move safety from cover to cover, or to location you would otherwise not be able to reach. Use it wisely though, your uses are limited each loop and you wouldn't want to be cornered without it.
Messages from the past

The halls of EOS tell a story, if you listen closely you can uncover the true intentions of the facility and what's really transpired. Escaping is one thing, but how you escape will determine the fate of the facility and people you leave behind. 

Make every step count, you never know when it will be your last.

name: Age of Empires IV: Yue Fei's Legacy
summary:
亲历岳飞的传奇，率领宋军为生存而战，抵御凶残的金朝侵略者。当北方陷落、宋廷被掳，岳飞与将领韩世忠护送年幼的宋皇子逃离金军追击，并集结力量，为王朝存续展开一场对抗看似不可阻挡之敌的激越抗争。

战场上，你可以扭转乾坤；但朝堂之上，背叛或许比任何敌人都致命。

这是一场拯救摇摇欲坠帝国及其子民的传奇抗争，现以《帝国时代 IV》史诗战役的形式重新演绎。

全新文明：金朝

女真金朝作为一个迅疾无情的文明登场，建立在三大支柱之上：

• 牧马草原：与马厩协同提升军事产能，为源源不断的骑兵洪流提供动力

• 使者：占领中立聚落以建立藩属，从而获得经济与军事优势

• 火药：将后期战役化为火光与硝烟交织的攻城风暴

利用游动作业的骑马村民与占领的藩属将帝国扩张至全图，再以猛安谋克要塞固守疆界，当敌人胆敢越境时给予迎头痛击。

新增独特单位：骑马掷弹兵、铁浮屠与爆破手

释放这支阵容，其凶残程度与外观一样令人胆寒：

• 骑马掷弹兵：远程重装骑兵，可向敌人投掷爆炸性手榴弹，可对敌人造成范围伤害。

• 铁浮屠：身披重甲的精锐骑兵，可对敌军阵型造成毁灭性的范围伤害。

• 爆破手：近战火药单位，手持原始的爆裂手炮，可迸发出毁灭性的散射弹幕。。

为多人游戏与遭遇战而生

除了战役模式，金朝文明还将加入小规模战斗与多人游戏的文明列表。将牧马草原、骑马村民、铁浮屠与爆破手带入你喜爱的游戏模式。

4 张全新地图与 2 种全新生物群落

在四张新地图和两个新生物群落之在中为自由而战。在狂风肆虐的草原、郁郁葱葱的河谷与冰封的沙漠高原上展开战斗，地形将决定你的一切决策——在何处筑城、在何处劫掠、在何处背水一战。

金朝带来全新音乐与精通挑战

建立你的帝国，伴随着金朝专属的全新游戏音乐冲锋陷阵。

完成金朝专属的精通挑战，精通骑兵冲锋之道、强大科技与高效经济——赢得标志你成为真正金朝统帅的奖励。

*本扩展包灵感源于历史事件，并为了游戏性进行了艺术加工。掷弹兵

summary:
気づくとそこは、見知らぬ異世界だった。
そこで主人公・加奈が出会ったのは、冷徹な雰囲気をまとった公爵・ダリウェル。
街を歩くダリウェルに向けられるのは、怯えを含んだ視線。
彼はこの国で、“近づく者を不幸にし、7日で記憶が消える呪いを受けた公爵”として恐れられていた。

だから誰も彼に近づかず、
彼自身もまた、誰にも心を許さなかった。

――彼女に出会うまでは。

人々が距離を取る中で、加奈だけは、決して彼の傍を離れなかった。

彼の何気ない言動、噛み合わない証言、そして時折見せる、ひどく傷ついたような表情。
触れるほどに、加奈の胸に小さな違和感が積もっていく。
――この人は、本当に“呪われている”のだろうか。

呪いの真実を解き明かしながら、冷徹公爵の心を溶かし、やがて二人は惹かれ合っていく。甘くも切ない、異世界ロマンス。

name: 遗愿清单
summary: 在一座即将被风暴吞没的欧洲滨海小城，摄影师Canis收到已故恋人Oryon留下的延时信。循着遗愿清单，他穿行于天台酒吧、旧影院、码头与医院，在回忆、幻觉与城市残影中重走两人相爱的旅程。风暴逼近，真相逐渐显现:她留下的是一场温柔而残酷的告别。

Eager to escape him, the two lovers set out for the land of Love where, they were told, clouds never obscured the sun. On the road stood a dragon that sought to lure travelers into its cave.

name: 劇場版 忍者部隊月光 オリジナル・サウンドトラック
summary:
TV版と同じスタッフ・キャストが結集した夢の劇場版『忍者部隊月光』!
映画のために作曲・録音された劇中音楽を完全収録!

劇場版『忍者部隊月光』は、1964年1月から放映されて人気を博していたTVドラマ『忍者部隊月光』の劇場作品として東映が制作し、1964年7月28日に公開された長編映画。TV版と同じスタッフ・キャストが結集した夢の劇場版である。

音楽はTV版を手がけていた渡辺宙明が担当。劇中音楽はTV版音楽の雰囲気を引き継ぎながら、全曲、映像に合わせて新録音された。主題歌「忍者部隊月光の歌」と「忍者部隊のマーチ」もこの映画の中だけで聴ける新アレンジ・新録音版である。この劇場版主題歌はこれまで一度もレコード・CD化されていない幻の音源だった。

本アルバムは、その幻の主題歌を含む劇場版『忍者部隊月光』の音楽を完全収録した初のサウンドトラック・アルバム。全曲マスターテープからの初商品化となる待望の1枚だ。すでに発売中のTV版音楽集とあわせて聴けば、渡辺宙明による『月光』サウンドの進化をたどることができる。
ブックレットには作曲者・渡辺宙明の最新インタビューを掲載した。

※全曲モノラル録音。古い音源ゆえお聴き苦しい部分もありますが、ご了承ください。

name: Fading Echo
summary:
《Fading Echo》是一款以创意为战斗核心、节奏感极强的元素动作冒险RPG。 化身为年轻传奇“壹”，从悖论污染体的魔爪中，拯救这片正走向毁灭的荒漠之地。你可以自由操纵水元素，触发连锁反应，并穿梭于超现实的世界之中。请与个性迥异的伙伴们并肩作战，共同守护这片正在崩溃的现实之地。

主宰万水
化身为灵动的水滴。

你可以顺着管道疾驰，穿梭于狭窄的缝隙，甚至从空中向敌人发起致命的俯冲。

掀起惊涛骇浪，凝聚能量发射威力惊人的水炮。

机动性将转化为速度，而速度终将蜕变为惊人的破坏力。

水，绝不仅是移动的媒介，更是你最强大的武器。

将水与熔岩、有毒废弃物以及“悖论污染物”混合，触发爆炸性的连锁反应。

彻底湿润、导电、或让敌人石化凝固。粉碎他们的一切阴谋。

所有元素皆有反应，

战斗将愈发激烈。

请将系统推向极限，去迎接那惊涛骇浪般的疯狂反击。

创意并非选项，而是生存的必需。


不同的现实，不同的规则
《Fading Echo》的世界——科莱尔，存在于支离破碎的现实之中。

跨越至平行维度的空间吧！在那里，资源会变质，威胁会进化，甚至连战斗规则都将被彻底颠覆。

曾经奏效的策略或许会折戟沉沙，

原本安全的地带也可能危机四伏。

请迅速适应。

反向利用这种不稳定性。

将瞬息万变的环境转化为你的绝对优势。

为了在这个瞬息万变的战场上生存，请与同伴一起不断进化。


阻止悖论
“悖论污染体”正在扭曲现实，吞噬眼前的一切，将科莱尔撕成碎片。

化身为年轻的传奇“壹”——虽然身怀强大力量，但留给你的时间已所剩无几。

穿梭于敌影重重的浮空岛与崩塌的世界之间，在“悖论”吞噬剩余的一切之前，彻底阻断它的魔爪。

直面统治科莱尔的冷酷领袖——麦德克。

不要指望这会是一场公平的对决。

最重要的是，在能够改变剩余的世界之前，不惜代价地活下去。


与伙伴并肩作战的单人冒险
独自战斗，却绝非孤身一人。

在科莱尔的旅途中，一群看似乌合之众却异常可靠的伙伴将与你同行。有人源于忠诚，有人背负罪疚，而有人仅仅是因为无处可去。

他们的存在构建了科莱尔的世界，决定着任务的成败，也左右着失败的代价。

拯救破碎的世界，不仅仅是力量的比拼。

更是关乎在最后一刻，谁还能伫立在你身旁。

全剧情由豪华声优阵容倾情献声，为每一位角色与每一场战斗注入灵魂。

name: AstroNOTs
summary:
Evil A.I. Space Bots are attacking Earth, You and Your team of Good A.I. Bots must stop them !

Form Your Rag-Tag Team of A.I. Misfits, who are NOT Astronauts and Defend the Earth from Evil A.I. Space Bots,

who are also NOT Astronauts.

Fly different Space Vehicles with up to 99 A.I. Bots on Each Team.

** NOTE: Use the Slider Bars in the Menu to set the # of Bots. **

Use Laser Guns and Missiles to defeat the other team to win !

Climb Your way to the edge of Space, shoot and hunt enemies.

You will be challenged to determine the best pilot who destroys the others, You or the A.I. Bots.

Take Your Ship to new heights, Boldy shooting Your way to the Top of the Scoreboard.

name: Rallygator
summary:
Rallygator is a physics-based platformer game where you control a multi-functional, ever-transforming monster truck. Tackle clever puzzles and perform tricky stunts along the way!

Are you ready to take an adventure with an alligator and a fox inside a transforming monster truck? Does the alligator even have a driving license? The destination is unknown, but Rallygator will surely reach it!

In this physics-based platformer game, you control a multi-functional, transforming monster truck. Solve puzzles and perform tricky stunts.

Hop and drive around in car mode, dive into the deep waters in submarine mode, or turn into a mini-truck to navigate tight spaces. Rallygator is full of surprises!
Features

 Ever-changing and challenging gameplay
 Physics-driven gameplay, including character animations
 Adorable cartoon graphics
 Support for both controller and keyboard play."

name: CellSar
summary:
一个关于细胞的沙盒游戏，你可以收集细胞、用细胞建造机器和器官，并喂养它们。

CellSar 是一款关于细胞采集、摆放、建造和生存的沙盒游戏。你可以尝试着用细胞建造各种机器和器官，在微观的细胞尺度上进行活动和创造。

游戏特色：

• 14个移动/建造方向：可以在 14 个方向（ 6 个垂直方向和 8 个斜向方向）上连接和移动细胞。

• 探索：沼泽中丰富独特的多面体细胞：游戏收录了超过90种细胞，每个细胞由表面是规则多边形的多面体组成。

• 建造：用各种细胞单元，搭建各种机器和器官。在各种细胞单元中，肌肉细胞能输出伸缩和移动，结缔组织细胞能提供粘结作用，神经细胞能提供信号传输，巨噬细胞能吞噬敌对的细菌。

• 生存：从沼泽中采集营养和脂肪细胞，用于喂养自己和采集到的动物细胞，防止它们因为饥荒和疾病而凋零。

name: Frequency Dissonance
summary:
Uncover all of the endings by listening to the radio frequencies while solving puzzles on a mysterious space outpost.

The Plot
You've been stationed on planet Omega for 24 years now, guarding, observing and maintaining the station. Finally, a signal is picked up by the radio. The empire calls. Your cooperation will decide fates.
The Features

Enjoy a 30 minutes calmingly anxious experience.

Puzzle out 8 different endings by decoding instructions from 3 different radio signals.

Become at home in a small and cozy planet by operating a myriad of machinery.

Frequency Dissonance is part of the CosmOS 9 bundle, a set of 9 puzzle games discovered on a mysterious video game console drifting in outer space.

name: Tick
summary:
一款第一人称恐怖游戏，玩家将扮演一名进入梦境的角色，在梦境中凑齐逃离所必要的道具，期间还要小心怪物的追逐，如果实在无法逃离，可以试着进入更深一层的梦境(但那里可能不止你一个人) 在追逐中逃离，并寻找生机

深入内心的阴影

第一人称逃亡游戏，在游戏中你将扮演梦中角色，小心逃离各种怪物，躲藏在阴影之中，沉重的脚步声给你最好的提示，若是实在无法逃离，也可以使用技能潜入另一片黑暗中(但那里可能不止你一个人)
层层递进的难度

随着层次深入，怪物会有不同的特性，之前看似安全的躲藏点将变得不那么安全，难度也会不断上升
注意聆听钟声

钟声可不止是提醒时间，同时他也提醒怪物的变换，之前常用的躲藏点或许该换换了
