name: DarkTide
summary:
您将带领一个三人小组在茂密的森林，雪山，洞穴，沙漠和其他地方冒险，以保护那些地方的营地。 消除遇到的敌人，了解当地的奇特动物和植物，并获得强大的武器和装备，在不断地面对困难和战胜挑战之后，逐渐组成一个能够适应各种环境和挑战的小队。

基本玩法
您在游戏中的每次冒险将从一个个营地开始，以营地为出发点，每次冒险出发时您都可以在十多个可控制角色中选择出您喜欢的三个，配备他们的装备和技能，向营地周边探索，消除那些地方的威胁确保营地安全，之后，您的队伍将回到营地，物资得到补充，各项状态得以恢复，并准备下次冒险。
在营地中，玩家可以调制药剂，烹饪食物，打造装备，和营地中的商人交易。不同的营地由不同的商人组成，如矿业营地可能会有出售稀有矿石的商人，而手工业城镇周边的营地则很有可能贩卖项链等装饰品，除了使用营地中各种便利的权利，您所控制的小队还需要担负起保护营地的职责，当某个营地周围的威胁过大时，他们可能结成小股的军事力量对营地发起攻击，这时候玩家于营地处布置的防御力量就能发挥用处。
在冒险中，小队会遇到各种不同的生物，有些能够为冒险提供帮助，有些则会给冒险造成阻碍。击败他们后，小队有可能会获得他们所使用的装备，或者他们肢体上有价值的部分。在经历一定的冒险之后，玩家会积累大量的独特装备，技能等，因此便可以出发前往更为困难的区域，帮助那些地方的营地抵御攻击。
装备系统
游戏中将会有大量装备，除特定类型的装备外，所有装备都能提升穿戴者的某项或几项能力，其中一些装备还能赋予穿戴者独特的技能，当不装备时这些技能变得不可用；特定装备的组合将使穿戴者的能力呈现出某种特定倾向，这有可能会使穿戴者变得非常适合应对某种情况，另一方面，不合理的装备技能也可能极大削弱穿戴者对特定环境的适应能力。
天赋系统
每个角色都有各自独特的天赋系统，角色的天赋系统由三组各有侧重的能力提升路线，玩家可以使用有限的天赋点数来激活一部分天赋，可以集中力量选择其中一条提升路线取得路线终点的巨大优势，也可以自由地分配到每条路线，取得平衡的能力提升。天赋系统中有许多种类的天赋，有些是全新的技能，有些是对某项能力的提升。
技能系统
从冒险中遇到的各种生物到玩家可以扮演的角色，他们都有技能。每个角色可以拥有的技能数量是不设限的，但是每个角色只有三个主动技能栏位，因此需要巧妙地安排哪些技能对本次冒险是关键的，哪些则不那么核心。对玩家可以控制的角色来说，他们都有自己初始就掌握的技能，这些技能往往符合我对角色身份的设想，但是如果不搭配其他天赋或者装备，则他们也许并不能在冒险中发挥巨大作用；要获取更多技能有两个途径，1天赋系统，选择某些天赋会给角色额外的技能，装备某些装备也能给玩家额外的技能，但是请注意，当选择别的天赋或者卸下带有技能的装备时，这些技能也将不可用。
团队配合
在三人小队中，玩家同一时间只能扮演一个角色，而另外两个不受玩家控制的角色的行为逻辑则需要玩家在出发进行冒险时进行指定，如更加富有攻击性的攻击策略，更加倾向于维持团队的保护策略等；更具体地说，玩家需要为三个角色都指定行为逻辑，因为在战斗中你可以随时选择控制哪个角色。当你控制一个角色时，他的行为逻辑会被暂时抑制，控制权完全交给玩家，如果玩家脱离对角色的控制，那么该角色又会重新被自己的行为逻辑控制。
除了为角色分配行为逻辑，还有一种方式可以不切换到某个角色也能够对他有较弱的控制，这种方法叫团队指令；在控制任何角色时，玩家都可以通过发出团队指令来控制另外两个队友，团队指令往往非常简单且数量有限，如聚集，分散，冲锋等；团队指令有最高的优先级，这意味着不论这些队友正在进行什么行动，他们都会马上按照团队指令改变自己的行为。
营地防守
即将推出

name: 哈哈时光
summary:
《哈哈时光》，正如名字一样，是一个让人轻松快乐的小游戏，暂时不支持多人在线，简单的规则和轻松的操控，让您在收获的过程中享受童年般的兴奋与满足。 我们设计的这款游戏，力图为朋友们提供轻松愉快的休闲体验，无论您是大人还是孩子，或者是大人陪着孩子玩儿，都能得到小小的欢乐，祝愿所有的朋友们生活愉快！

 １、 游戏设置为三个关卡，收集够一定数量的宝贝即为通关。 ２、 宝贝有金币、音符、精灵球三种，精灵球是比较难收集的哦，只有触碰到正背面才能收集成功，否则精灵球会逃跑，哈哈，与精灵球的追逐是《哈哈时光》的一大乐趣。 ３、 当然，游乐场里也有捣蛋的家伙，就是这些机器人，你被他们看到，就会追过来打你哦。

一、 游戏规则：
１、 游戏设置为三个关卡，收集够一定数量的宝贝即为通关。
２、 宝贝有金币、音符、精灵球三种，1金币=1分，音符分为9种类型，所以1音符=相对应的1-9分，1精灵球=1000分。精灵球是比较难收集的哦，它的笑脸方向是正面，只有触碰到正背面才能收集成功，否则精灵球会逃跑，哈哈，与精灵球的追逐是《哈哈时光》的一大乐趣。
３、 当然，游乐场里也有捣蛋的家伙，就是这些机器人，你被他们看到，就会追过来打你哦，被打中1次，能量和积分都会被减1，累计30次，玩儿家就会被迫瞬移到可能比较远的随机位置哦。
４、 还有哦，专职捣蛋的机器人，每隔10-20秒就会增加1个，玩儿的时间越久，难度就会越高，哈哈，还是有些难度吧。
５、 剩余时间和能量值降到0都为通关失败。
６、 每一关预设时间为120秒，每收集1个音符，可以增加相应分值1/10的时间，每收集1个精灵球，增加10秒。
７、 每一关预设能量为1000，被打中1次减1，瞬移1次减1，收集1个金币或音符加1，收集1个精灵球加10。
８、 嗯嗯，还好还好，毕竟《哈哈时光》就是用来休闲娱乐的，哪能设计得太难玩儿呢，不过，要想打出高分破纪录，应该还是有些难度吧，不信就来试试吧！
二、 游戏秘籍：
１、 场中有4棵树，靠近会有金币落下来。
２、 外围有很大的音符，靠近会有音符落下来。
３、 金币和音符不要过早的达到通关数量，这样可以多收集一些精灵球，得分可以高一些，但要把握好时间，时间越长，机器人越多，难度越高，要量力而行哦！
三、 游戏操作：
１、“W”“S”“A”“D”，4个按键控制角色前后左右跑动
２、暂时不支持：“T”键切换聊天窗口的隐藏和显现
３、按下左键移动鼠标，可以调整方向和视角
四、 游戏设置：
输入自己的名字和选择一个头像
暂时不支持：建立游戏房间，
暂时不支持：设置游戏人数
暂时不支持：搜索已经建立的房间，并加入游戏
然后是选择一个喜欢的角色，这里有４个小男孩儿和４个小女孩儿，并且衣服的花色不同，便于在游戏中相互区分。
各位玩儿友都准备就绪，《哈哈时光》即刻开始！

name: Starshard Brigands
summary:
『Starshard Brigands（スターシャード・ブリガンズ）』は、グリッドベースの3DダンジョンクロウラーRPG。あなたは名もなき傭兵として、滅びた帝国の遺産をめぐる争いに身を投じる。忠誠、反逆、そして何者にも与しない自由──選ぶのは、あなた。


鍛冶屋で装備を鍛え、酒場で飯を喰らい、ギルドで依頼を請け負う。

深淵を暴き、秘宝を掠め、迷宮の主を粉砕する。

手にした遺物を派閥へ捧げるか、己の牙とするか。

築いた絆、買った怨み、競い合うライバル。

自らの選択で塗り替わる勢力図。

すべてを力に変え、さらなる深淵へ――。


決断が「敵」と「味方」を決める――勢力図の変動（Dynamic Agency）
遺物の献上: 遺物を派閥に捧げて信頼を買うか、秘匿して戦力にするかで物語と報酬が分岐する。

ライバル部隊との遭遇: 迷宮内を独自に探索する他パーティとの接触が、予測不能の展開を引き起こす。

勢力拠点の拡張: 特定勢力への貢献度に応じて、強力な専用装備の解禁や拠点の施設アップグレードが行われる。


予測と判断が戦況を変える――戦術的コマンドバトル（Tactical Command Battle）
ブレイク ＆ 追撃連携システム:  敵の弱点を突いて盾を砕くことで、仲間の追撃が入り、敵の行動を完封して一方的に撃破できる。

カウンター & パリイ:  敵の攻撃に合わせた入力でダメージを無効化し、即座に強力な追撃へと転換する。

探索と強化のハクスラ・サイクル: 迷宮で得た素材で装備を作ったり、拠点で強化・鑑定したり――次なる探索をより有利に進めるための戦力へと変換する。


己の限界を超えつづけろ――果てなき強化（Build & Loot）
自由なキャラクターメイキング：4つの種族、能力値、容姿、得意武器、そして来歴の自由な組み合わせが、職業の枠に縛られない独自の戦術を生む。

広大な星図スキルツリー: 非線形なスキル習得ルートの選択により、自分だけのビルドを組み上げる。

ランダムな性能をもつ装備: 装備ごとに異なる能力が付与され、同じ名前の武具でも性能が大きく変化する。

name: 赤旗：解放战争
summary:
《赤旗：解放战争》允许你在全面爆发的解放战争中，指挥中国人民解放军转战于大江南北。从1946年的中原突围开始启程，你将运用你的指挥艺术，顽强防御并粉碎国民党军的全面进攻。随后于决定性的三大战役中扭转乾坤，歼灭国民党军的主力兵团。最终打过长江去，解放全中国！

本作的玩法框架沿袭自优秀的入门级战棋游戏《统一指挥》系列，并在此基础上进行了深度适配和改进。如果你是追求历史真实感与硬核策略的玩家，这款为中国视角而生的作品，正是为你准备的！

主要特色
中国视角 - 燎原之火，终成大势
你将首次在steam上发布的策略兵棋游戏中，体验到波澜壮阔的中国人民解放战争。唤起工农千百万，将腐朽的国民党反动派扫入历史的垃圾堆！

步兵艺术 - 围点打援，千里奔袭
你将指挥这支人类历史上最巅峰的轻步兵部队，善用其灵活的机动能力和不畏牺牲的顽强精神，在运动战中引出顽敌，加以分割歼灭。尽管你的装备往往劣势于强敌，你仍有机会使用灵活的战术击败他们。

养成体系 - 缴获敌人，壮大自己
在漫长的战争中，你指挥的战士们将越战越强，歼灭敌人后缴获他们的装备，吸纳弃暗投明的解放战士们。你将把懵懂的新兵战士培养为百战精锐，让他们成为这场解放全中国的斗争中的重要力量。

不可撤回 - 当机立断，落子无悔
你的每一次指挥决策都至关重要，很多行动无法撤回（如改变了战争迷雾、发起了攻击等），你必须有勇气做出行动并承担其结果。

后勤补给 - 兵马未动，粮草先行
你不能完全只关注前线战斗，你还需要在游戏中关注你的后勤补给线，保护己方的补给并切断敌方的补给。失去补给的部队将逐渐孱弱不堪，利用这一点来调整自己的策略，以确保自己的胜利。

战争迷雾 - 虚实莫测，兵不厌诈
相比于桌面版的兵棋游戏，电子游戏还赋予了游戏动态战争迷雾的能力，因此你不能再于上帝视角一览无余，你将只能利用已有的情报和信息，做出最正确的判断。当然，你的敌人也不是全知全能的，他们很难察觉你在阴影中的行动。

无内鬼AI - 步步杀机，伺隙而动
我们的AI深谙用兵之道。它会利用战争迷雾设下埋伏，会因你的后勤薄弱而长驱直入，更会在你兵力分散时集中突破。你必须时刻保持警惕，因为敌人永远在寻找你的破绽；当然，我们的AI还会尽可能遵循其历史轨迹，如果你熟悉这场战役的历史，你将会更容易取胜！

name: 艾比斯物语
summary:
在大陆的中央地带，有着名为艾比斯的巨大深坑，传闻其中充满了无尽的知识与财富。你作为误入艾比斯的旅客，将和各式各样的伙伴一起，攻略迷宫，探索深层，发掘艾比斯真正的秘密。。。

招募队友一起探险吧~
在维克托领的各处招募性格能力各不相同的同伴，共有九位富有特色的角色可以和你一起踏上旅程。

前往艾比斯探索吧！
艾比斯有着各种危险，记得先要做好食物，补给，各种冒险道具的准备~

丰富的地下城探险
享受探索的乐趣，通过不同的关卡障碍取得宝藏~

跑团风味的JRPG
加入了简单的技能鉴定机制，不会大失败的，学习各种技能来让探险变得轻松吧。

name: Tulips & Windmills
summary:
请确保你的风力厂始终如一地运行，你的图利普场已经收获。这个点击游戏将使你更接近于图标上的荷兰文化。 期待随机事件并使用升级来增加你的财富！Veel 成功！

Tulips & Windmills is a charming and lighthearted clicker/idle game that immerses you in the iconic Dutch culture! ?✨

Grow your tulip empire as you upgrade your windmill, cultivate vast tulip fields, and unlock the true potential of the Netherlands' most beloved exports. Choose between manually harvesting tulips or hiring skilled gardeners to do the work for you.

Join our server to help design the game further and stay updated. The link is on the right!

You start with a manual multiplier but get ready for much more! From autoclicker speed and effectiveness over fields and gardener upgrades, make sure to spend your tulips wisely!

At some point, your automation may exceed your manual labor skills, watch your empire flourish while silently expanding and upgrading. See your progress as the tulip fields in the background get populated.

Gardeners will help you harvest your fields, they become quicker and quicker! I promise! They will speed to your fields.

Boost your production with unique Dutch-themed events like King’s Day or brave the infamous Kut Weer! (bad weather) to turn challenges into opportunities. Upgrade your windmill to increase its speed and efficiency, and watch your tulip fields flourish with ever-growing profits. With every decision, you’ll get one step closer to creating the ultimate Dutch tulip dynasty!

Multipliers: Upgrade your windmill and tulip fields to maximize profits and speed.

Dutch Events: Celebrate King’s Day, endure bad weather, or embrace the holiday spirit with Sinterklaas.

Up for a challenge? Change the language to Dutch and see if you can still find all the buttons.

Steam Achievements: Unlock fun and unique milestones as you grow your tulip empire.

Save or Reset: Choose to save your progress and continue where you left off before or reset your progress and start from the beginning. Supports Steam Cloud Saves.

name: Directorate Novitiate
summary:
在这款惊险刺激的第三人称动作角色扮演游戏中，您将扮演水星——一位强大的魔法黑帮分子——来对抗超自然威胁、追查洛杉矶的连环杀手、在战争爆发时选边作战。

2006 年的洛杉矶：乌烟瘴气的超自然地下世界正处在战争的边缘，而水星被卷入其中——直面难以抵御的压倒性魔法力量，发掘光天化日之下隐匿的恐怖，追踪心狠手辣的连环杀手，迎接艰难的抉择和危险的秘密。

卡纳·露娜（又名水星）回到了曾经的家园，但却深陷联合会的黑暗财团科斯特姆塔掀起的漩涡之中。卡纳必须以水星为代号隐姓埋名磨练自己的技巧，才能从新手队伍中脱颖而出，保护她所熟知的世界。

枪炮、魔法与混沌

紧张刺激的动作战斗将传统第三人称射击和强大的法术有机融合。您可以在提升技巧后用绚丽的枪斗术、强力的特技解决敌人，成为耀眼的动作明星。玩家的攻防两端都有角色扮演的升级系统，包含各种技能和升级选项。

利害攸关的故事情节

Supercow caught wind of his dastardly deeds. Resolute and merciless to all the evil in the world, Supercow immediately set off to help the poor residents of Sunny Valley.

Supercow is a dynamic arcade game, but much more friendly to the casual gamer than the average game in the genre. Being quite addictive, this game will keep the whole family happily occupied for several hours.

All Supercow has to do to defeat various enemies (snails, dogs, moles, crows, spiders etc.) is to jump on their heads. Bonuses can be achieved by collecting coins, gold bars and other precious items. Shooting In Different Body Parts

A variety of weapons will make you feel like the king of the beasts. If you are a defenseless chicken, then a large arsenal of weapons and additional stuff will give you confidence on the battlefield.

 Up to Four Players Local Or Online

summary:

Clive vs Hives 2 is a fast paced sci fi top down shooter inspired by games like Half-Life and Halo. Fight your way through hordes of vicious aliens as a mighty super soldier and tear apart the infectious hive that keeps them alive.
SPRINT
Use your crushing sprint to move at blinding speed and tear your enemies limb from limb.

DASH
Use your swift dash to dodge incoming peril or advance through the environment.

PICK UP AND THROW
The very objects around you can be used to crush the bones of your opponents, or build barriers.

Fight your way through a singleplayer campaign with 9 unique action packed chapters, and uncover the secrets of both humanity and the aliens.

Utilise your special combat abilities to add an extra layer of awesomeness and personal flair to a battle.

Stand back and enjoy the show as the 3 AI factions settle their differences.

Refuse to fight and be forgiven by your enemies.

Enjoy the tactical benefits of the top down perspective and plan your attacks from behind corners.

Feel the awesome power granted by an epic vehicle sequence.

Use your skills to achieve victory in the endless Horde Mode with customisable difficulty.

Herbheim's mine is a hybrid game between tower defense and survival. You protect the entrance of a mine using resources found in the world or on enemies.

Managing your time efficiently and taking advantage of the seasons is key to bringing in the most customers and biggest yields. Time is money after all and you only have so much of it!

Run your own shop! Choose your own stock and prices and experiment to sell as much as you can. As your popularity grows, you’ll meet new customers while different seasons will bring new trends.

Forage for materials. Anything out in the wild is free game, whether it be seeds, fruit or anything in between. 

Grow your own garden. Do I pick the flowers now, or wait till they turn into fruit? Raise your own crops and choose when to harvest them for the highest quality materials.

summary:
Cluck is an extremely fast-paced fps arena shooter. Spawn with only a pistol and find weapons, armor, health and powerups such as the Quack and Speed along the map. Jump pads and portals are also around the map, enabling you to get to your destination. And customize your own chicken!

Do you miss the old simple fps games? Well we got you! Cluck is all about extremely fast phase shooting. So expect to die a lot! Unless you're a god of course. Spawn with only a pistol and get those pickups. These pickups are all around the map waiting to get picked up. Pickup armor, health, weapons ammo and get some kills. We can't forget the ultimate pickups though, the quack. Giving you 4x the damage, wrecking your opponents. Or pickup the Speed, making you faster at everything, including fire rate to shred your enemies. There's also jump pads you can use to get to your destination, the same goes for the portals. Be careful to not be on the other side of that portal for too long, as you can shoot grenades through the portals! Master the bunnyhopping and fly through your enemies with high speed, making you speeding around the map! If you're close enough to an enemy, punch them with your weapon for a quick kill and call out their humiliation. Remember to punch with your rocket launcher if you're too close to an opponent, as you don't want to kill yourself at the same time.

Customization

Customize your character with the in-game currency you get by playing the game itself. Get new colors, patches, face expressions, hats, and more! New updates will also come with even more customization options for you!

Max is a twenty-something trying to make a living in the big city. He shares a little flat with his messy friend Mica, he finished his degree too long ago and still can't find a job. Time passes and the day to pay rent is approaching… again!

Up to now, these were some of his most common problems. Now let's say he has a much bigger one: he becomes giant everytime he hears the word 'FUTURE'.

Everyday situations, social relationships and the efforts to move forward will be intertwined, with this peculiar problem, in a contemporary adventure set in a city whose resemblance to Madrid or Barcelona is just a coincidence.

Meet Max -and a bunch of charismatic characters- and find out what's happening to him in this story about growing up and realizing things aren't quite the way we expected them to be. 

But first, you should find a way to pay rent...

Renewed point & click mechanics in a peculiar graphic adventure about growing up (too much).

Detailed and colorful hand-crafted scenarios filled with pop culture references.

Contextual puzzles! Use your surroundings to help Max get out of the craziest situations.

Fun and varied mini-games that refresh the gameplay. Each one is different!

Narrative spiced up with humor in a world where it gets harder to find reasons to laugh.

Charismatic characters full of life and completely animated (although this doesn't mean they have happy lives).

name: Space Maxwell: Arcade
summary:
Shoot your enemies and try not to let them multiply themselves and turn the game into a chaotic space battle! Space Maxwell is an arcade shooter where your spaceship has the ability to destroy or to multiply your enemies. Climb the leaderboard and try to survive as long as you can!

Born from a Game Jam, Space Maxwell is an arcade shooter videogame and your mission is to shoot the right laser to the right enemy.

Your spaceship has blue and red lasers, each one for a type of enemy. Shoot them at the wrong enemy and they will multiply. It's chaotic!

Challenge yourself, climb the leaderboard and try yourself to unlock all the achievements that this crazy, exciting experience has for you.

We have updates coming soon. We'll post the upcoming updates as soon as we have the dates!

name: ...Knew the Beginning
summary:
A world you don't recognize anymore. You wake up inside a bar after the apocalypse. The barkeeper of said bar is in trouble. Do what you can to help him, after all he is all you remember.

Frequently asked questions

Why does this guy only walk backwards? Is that a glitch?

It's not a glitch. It's a feature.

In this Point&Click - Adventure you find yourself in the post-apocalypse and help the bartender in whose bar you wake up. To help him you're going to have to solve puzzles and talk to several NPCs in order to get them to help you in your quest.
You'll be meeting many new friends and other not so friendly interesting characters on your way in this strange world, littered with remnants of the world that it once was. Now it's your turn to fit in in this new strange hierarchy, that has been built by a gang calling themselves Survivors. 
Depending on your humor, this game may also tickle your funny bone.

name: Polyhedron: Tales from Krasnoslavia
name_cn: 多面体：来自克拉斯诺斯拉维亚
summary:
多面体：来自克拉斯诺斯拉维亚的故事 - 是一款设定在东欧赛博朋克环境中的动态第一人称射击游戏。你可以期待酷炫的枪械、众多独特技能、多样化的游戏玩法等等。

游戏发生在“克拉斯诺斯拉维亚共和国” - 多面体 多元宇宙中的一个维度，曾经是其主打。过去它是叛乱者的真正天堂，与克拉斯诺斯拉维亚相连的人们可以在大街上肆意妄为，偷车，感受无边无际的自由。如今，克拉斯诺斯拉维亚看起来相当暗淡。修复它的任务就落在了你肩上，你需要使用枪支和超能力，让你能够入侵 多面体。

特色：

许多独特的技能，使游戏玩法更加有趣和多样化。

忘记大量相同的枪支，游戏中的每种武器都是独特的，为不同的情境而创造。

沉浸在东欧赛博朋克的氛围中，酸性黄瓜和超级伏特加让你沉浸其中。

多样的地点和游戏情境 - 首先，你可以同时用三把枪射击士兵，然后地板变成熔岩，一只巨大的鸭子用眼睛的激光烧灼你。

个人策展人将在你旁边，帮助你，振作你，并通过他的故事让你大开眼界，你不容易摆脱他。

summary:
Ella, a study in realism

Ella, a study in realism made in Godot Engine. Basically a technology showcase for Godot, you can watch it for a few minutes and look at the graphics and performance on your computer. A frames per second monitor is included (press Escape to open the menu) and you can also tweak the many graphics options. It includes 4 presets (Ultra, Quality, Performance, and Low Spec) and also allows you to change individual settings (for example, full screen mode or changing the render scaling, as well as visual settings like reflection and ambient occlusion).

The experience features a cinematic camera that runs and loops by itself, so can be watched as a real time music video, a 3D graphics benchmark, or control the camera and fly around the environment. You can press the Space Bar to enable the camera control. The free camera control is like a spectator camera in games (with collision detection) and allows you to fly around freely and explore the environment and the graphics.

Uses global illumination in Godot to achieve realistic lighting and shadow, all in real time (no baked lightmaps). The character model and some assets were made with photogrammetry for the highest possible quality. Press Escape to view the options. Space to toggle cinematic camera (be sure to close the menu before flying around). WASD or Arrow keys move around. Mouse to look.

name: MECH PUNK
summary:
法律规定，死亡之波会不时地在每个星球上产生，目的是杀死大多数当地人。武装你的所有枪支，把无政府状态带起来，在这个酸性空间的西方子弹地狱中把总统先生拿下。

设置你的枪，朋克。你要下地狱了。360度空间子弹地狱，疯狂的快节奏战斗。

奇怪的，酸的其他东西

name: Smithy Shop
summary:
Combine materials and create countless swords combinations for your clients at the ever burning forge in Smithy Shop. Manage your materials and choose your swords bearers wisely, as every sword counts towards a cause, and you'll soon discover their repercussions, good and bad.

Combine materials and create countless swords combinations for your clients at the ever burning forge in Smithy Shop. Choose your swords bearers wisely, as every sword counts towards a cause, and you'll soon discover their repercussions, good and bad.

Smithy Shop combines your knowledge of materials with the consequences of your actions, and you can bet they'll be knocking on your door sooner rather than later. Contribute to rid the kingdom of an evil witch, hunt the dragons, save the princess or support cheese over turnips. Your choice matters, and the world will never be the same. Influence the world through your weapons from the comfort of your Smithy Shop!

name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection One
summary:
The Forgotten Realms Archive - Collection One allows you to journey through the set of adventures: the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, a collection of first-person, real-time role-playing games.

The Forgotten Realms world of Dungeons & Dragons has been home to many a hero and imagination since its publication, producing adventures and stories to be retold and enjoyed for years to come. The Forgotten Realms Archive - Collection One allows you to journey through one such set of adventures: the Eye of the Beholder trilogy, a set of first-person, real-time role-playing games. 

EYE OF THE BEHOLDER
A new evil is plaguing the city of Waterdeep, stalking the streets and preying on its citizens. Though initially thought to come from afar, this great evil, known only as Xanathar, instead resides within Waterdeep and, if not stopped, threatens to overwhelm the city. The Lords of Waterdeep believe that the evil lurks in the sewers below and have commissioned a party of adventurers to investigate and foil this nefarious plot. Granted full rights of marque and ownership of any treasure, artifacts or valuables you find on your quest, you must venture into the chasms, discover the nature of this evil and destroy it by any means necessary.

EYE OF THE BEHOLDER II: THE LEGEND OF DARKMOON
Following your quest in the sewers beneath, you and your party are recovering with Waterdeep’s finest healers, when a letter arrives from Khelben Blackstaff, mystic advisor to the Lords of Waterdeep. Trouble is brewing in the Northern and Western regions, and he has tasked you with exploring the land and investigating these incidents. Although nothing has been confirmed, renowned but troublesome archaeologist, Wently Kelso believes the disturbances are related to an evil uprising and the presence of a powerful ancient artefact. These troubles could, of course, simply be the work of unruly bandits, but since Kelso’s previous findings in the sewers of Waterdeep proved true, one would be wise not to easi

name: Forgotten Realms: The Archives - Collection Two
summary:
The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay.

The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two brings a healthy mix of “Gold Box” and nostalgia goodness to your PC, along with a combination of adventure builders, turn-based and real-time role-playing gameplay. Composed of RPG classics that premiered the Forgotten Realms to video gamers, The Forgotten Realm Archives - Collection Two contains the following titles: Pool of Radiance, Curse of the Azure Bonds, Hillsfar, Secret of the Silver Blades, Pools of Darkness, Gateway to the Savage Frontier, Treasures of the Savage Frontier, Forgotten Realms Unlimited Adventures.

POOL OF RADIANCE
Located on the northern shore of the Moonsea, the fabled city of Phlan has been overrun by monsters led by a mysterious leader. Your quest: uncover the identity of this evil force and rid Phlan of its scourge, restoring the city to its former glory. Along the way, you hope to find the legendary Pool of Radiance, said to glow with its own mystical power. Does it really give tremendous strength to the warrior who bathes in its magic waters? Or is that just an elfin myth? Before you meet the challenges ahead, you must create your characters and choose their races and battle skills. Then, set off on your glorious quest to drive out the monsters and let civilization reign once more!

CURSE OF THE AZURE BONDS
After you saved the entire city of Phlan and located the Pool of Radiance, a simple trip to Tilverton should have been as easy as a noon-day stroll. But it wasn’t… Ambushed, captured and knocked unconscious, you awake with no idea who attacked you or how you arrived in Tilverton. You only know that five azure-blue symbols are imprinted under the skin of your right arm. The mystical power of the azure symbols ensnares your will like metal bonds! And when the bonds glow, you must

name: Creators
summary:
Creators is a first person shooter where users participate in massive battles either online or locally with AI. The game comes with a powerful in game scenario editor, ensuring that the only limit for what is possible is your imagination. Creators was meant to be fun above all else so enjoy!

Creators is a first person shooter where users participate in massive battles either online or locally with AI. The game comes with a powerful in game scenario editor, ensuring that the only limit for what is possible is your imagination. Customize your character with cosmetics you earn not by paying for them but for playing the actual game. Prepare your favorite loadouts consisting of 3 weapons and not the 2 you see in similar titles. Utilize advanced movement to outplay your opponents and dominate the battlefield. Creators was meant not to be a competitive shooter but to be fun above all else, so please enjoy!

name: Ranchlife
summary:
In RanchLife, build your farm alone or with friends, raise animals, sell products, and help expand the town. Over time, you can open your own store and sell your goods directly.

In RanchLife’s Multiplayer Mode, the focus is entirely on cooperative gameplay, with no PvP or competitive elements. You and your friends (or other players) work together to build and develop a single shared farm, creating a peaceful, collaborative farming experience. The emphasis is on teamwork, creativity, and enjoying the farm life together.

Features of the Cooperative Multiplayer Mode:

Shared Farm Building: You and your friends start on a shared farm and work hand in hand to expand and improve it. Whether it's planting crops, taking care of animals, or constructing new buildings, every task can be done as a team. You share resources and make collective decisions on how to grow your farm.

Task Specialization: Each player can focus on specific areas of the farm. One person might focus on crop production, another on animal husbandry, and a third on crafting processed goods like cheese or jam. This division of labor helps you progress faster and make the farm more efficient.

Resource Sharing: All resources earned on the farm are shared between the players. Whether it's crops, animals, or building materials, everyone has access to the collective pool of resources. This allows you to complete larger projects more quickly and support one another.

Collaborative Planning and Decision-Making: You and your team can discuss which buildings to construct next, what crops to plant, or which animals to raise. Every decision is made together, allowing you to customize the farm to your group’s vision.

Cooperative Town Development: Together, you’re not only working on your farm but also helping to develop the nearby town. You can take on quests from townspeople to unlock new buildings and features. Each completed task contributes to the town's growth, and you’ll share in the rewards as a team.

name: Sweet Surge
summary:
Navigate the unending ocean of Cioko. Build, direct, compose and customize your crew. Overcome the greatest crews and challenges on your rise to ultimate juicy sweetness.

In Sweet Surge you control the fate of a small ship crew made of sugar cubes. This crew navigates the unending ocean of Cioko in search for the ultimate opponent. Well, this and the greatest treasure ever glimpsed by any sugar cube. Sometimes your crew casts their ship's anchor near a mythical construction. This building shall be the site where you meet your next encounter. Usually this is the time when you meet opposing crews, but on rare occasions you meet something greater.

Key features:

-Orchestrate your cubes in various ways to overcome challenges. Essentially, for each cube you set a sequence in which they attack.

-Customize the attacks by detailing their effects. Each cube knows a limited number of attacks. Assign effects to each attack to customize their actions to your crew's needs in the field.

-Customize the base stats of each cube by equipping various items. Go all-in on one set, or mix and match equipment to your liking.

-Set a formation for your cubes for each round of battle.

-Then watch your team and the opposition duke it out.

-Each encounter may consist of various rounds and multiple matches depending on which and how many crews arrive on the scene.

-Collect rewards based on the outcome of the encounter and how your team is ranked at the end of these ad-hoc tournaments.

There are various encounters to be played, currently counting over 30. Additionally, there are numerous random encounters which shake up gameplay. And a moon made of sugar spices things up with random modifiers to refresh the experience.

name: ELEVATED
summary:
ELEVATED is a multiplayer (8 vs. 1) thriller action game where eight death row inmates try to complete the given tasks to gain their freedom while being chased by the 4th horseman of the apocalypse, "The Death".

There has been a substantial increase in crime rates in the not-too-distant future, and states have implemented new and experimental methods of execution against this increase.

Authorities have initiated a pardon program known as ELEVATED to reduce crime rates and reintegrate death row prisoners into society.

The ELEVATED Project was classified as a stand-alone treatment aimed at the convicts to become law-abiding citizens of the society.

The players must complete the tasks assigned to them after being divided into two teams of eight death row inmates and an executioner.

While the prisoners are trying to reach the safe room by completing all the tasks without being caught, the executioner must prevent the prisoners by using the strategies he had developed.

Using the items left at specific spots within the facility, the inmates can distract the executioner and protect themselves when they are stuck in a difficult situation.

While the tasks are waiting to be completed behind closed doors, the executioner is alert in the corridors, corners, and shadows.
PLAY AS CONVICT

PLAY AS EXECUTIONER

The main game mode that you can play in early access, for now, is complete, and the key features of the mode are as follows;

 “Apocalypse” Game Mode

The convicts try to reach the safe room by completing three main tasks without dying.

Must find the paper that shows the door number,

Must activate 1 to 6 electrical switches, the number of which varies according to the difficulty of the game, to enable the password panels,

Must find every piece of the four-digit password to unlock the safe room,

Can protect themselves from the executioner with the tools they will find at different points on the map.

Can blind the executioner with the flare

name: Rockstar Life
summary:
Rockstar Life is a casual life simulation game. In this game you get to write songs, organize tours, record singles and albums while you deal with the everyday drama of a wannabe Rockstar through random events.

Wanna be a Rockstar but missing the skills or the time? No worries, I got you!

Rockstar Life is a simple and fast, casual life simulation game with hand drawn graphics, in which you, through random events, deal with everyday decisions and dramas in a Rockstar's life. Everything from which drugs to use, to dealing with groupies and deciding the details of your upcoming tour; in this game you have to deal with every aspect of the Rockstar life!

This game is heavily inspired by old classics like Rockstar and Rockstar Ate My Hamster!

HUMBLE BEGINNINGS
Start as a wannabe Rockstar in a basement flat and work your way up to becoming the most successful Rockstar.
You don't get to decide your band members, but still you have to deal with problems caused by them. You don't get to choose the genre of Rock Music you want to perform, but you still have to deal with fans who don't think the sponsor you got fit your style.
Yes, life is unfair, but the road to becoming a Rockstar is even more unfair and random.
GO ON TOURS
Decide where, which concert halls, how long and go on a tour. Earn popularity and money depending on
the tour setup.
Maybe some bigger band (for now) will offer you a support tour with them so you can become more popular, faster. Let's just hope that the tour doesn't end abruptly after an unlucky accident...
WRITE SONGS
Write songs and wait for the right moment to record and release them.
You don't like the song you've written? Maybe some other band will, so you can sell it to them.
Did you always want to write a song and give it the name of your dog? Now it’s possible!
RECORD
Choose songs, the studio you are going to record at and how many copies you are going to make.
Deal with the opinions of your record label or your band mates during a recording.

该作是一款以中国神话逐鹿之战为背景的横版3D射击冒险游戏。

name: Krek Da Frog
summary:
Funny and relaxing game, player can control the frog he choose in menu select unlocked level and complete eating missions on multiple locations. To achieve all achievements player must eat at least 500 butterflies and open all levels.

Hi! Yo, you there!

Are you tired beeing human? Do you want to try be something else? How about to be a frog for a while? Yes? Then this game can be for you! 

This game has been developed by one man army - Bl0ckDave Studio, this is my very first published game ever, and it all started as new years eve 2021-2022 stream challenge. Challenge was about that I suppose to finish easy achievement game untill new year come. To be honest I didnt make it so my friend could pick up the name, so here comes "Krek Da Frog" ! 

Whats the game about?

Whole game is about eating butterflies. Player controls frog which can move and jump around environment. Player must eat nearby butterflies to reach next level, if player eats enough butterflies magic doors are opened and player can continue. Water in environments is toxic to Krek and his friends, if player falls to it, he looses one of his three lives. If player has 0 lives and dies game is over and player must start again. In game are no time limits, game suppose to be funny and relaxing. 

So, what can you expect by buing this game?

Game is very simple, from begining you will have 2 frogs available, after pressing Play button you will get to the "season map overview", where you can choose level to go. In leveles player have to eat enough butterflies to get to next level. Water is toxic (!!!) so watch your steps! On most levels you have get over obstacles. Main goal is to get to the finish to open next (season if season is available). At this moment is only one season opened. Also by eating butterlies you will get achievements, by unlocking achievements you will get more frogs, more frogs, more fun! 

By purchasing this game you will support the creation of Bl0ckDave Studio!

name: Heard of the Story?
summary:
Forge a medieval community with intelligent and quirky villagers. Gather resources and transform the village into a town, or simply listen to captivating stories from various simulated and evolving lives. All in a beautiful, relaxing, and immersive fantasy world.

Heard of the Story? is a cosy medieval city-building simulation game with intelligent and quirky villagers who think, reason, and tell their own unique tales. 

The game is about forging your own medieval town, community, and relationships with procedural characters that really feel alive, self-aware, and grounded in your world. Embark on an adventure with them to transform a few sticks and pebbles into a beautiful prospering town from the ground up. Alternatively, simple sit back and watch as your townsfolk discover their passions, spread rumours, or divulge captivating stories with you and between each other. 

 Explore the landscape to find and gather the resources you need in order to build your town. Craft your way up to an expert, perhaps you can be their blacksmith?

 Develop a town organically by architecting your roads or structures without a grid. Beautify the surroundings with decorations whilst your villagers spice up their gardens.

 Each building changes the life of your villagers one step at a time. Could the Lion & Crow be your friend's next favourite tavern? Or the Chiselled Bellows the smithy they discover themselves in?

 Strengthen your reputation by constructing the right amenities, enough fields and accommodation, and entice foreigners to join - grow without a limit!

 Villagers are autonomous and independent. Apart from starting new construction projects, they can do anything you can. Each has their own interests, goals, achievements, needs, and traits.

 Talk to villagers to discover their lore, (sometimes) get helpful advice, or learn about their conspiracy theories. Your learnings are jotted down in your journal as you uncover more.

name: Am I?
summary:
After being sent into space, Laika find herself exploring some asteroids, meeting weird characters and solving puzzles to figure out what the hell is happening to her. She will lose herself in time, space and even in herself, if that makes some sense for you. The big question is: is she dead?

When we talk about outer space is there something cooler than an astronaut? 
Someone could have said a space marine, but where are we, in the first decade of the 2000s?

name: ボクロボ ~Boxed Cell Robot Armies~
summary:
The game is an auto-battler game with voxel robots that is both comically and tactically challenging.

*We allow strategy clips, revenue-generating streaming, etc. Feel free to play!
Game Overview
Boxed Cell Robot Armies is an autobattle-style game in which players place Boxed Cell Robot Armies on a grid-like board and battle against enemy teams.
Unique "Bokurobo"
The game features a wide variety of "Bokurobo," ranging from the rugged robots that look like they are meant for combat to the cute mascot-like robots.　Why do they fight? What are the goals of the Bokurobo? How were they born in the first place? These mysteries will gradually become clear as the game progresses.
Each Bokurobo has a different behavior pattern and has its own strengths and weaknesses depending on the battle situation. By understanding their nature and placing them appropriately, you will be able to take advantage of the battle.
Changing Bodies, Growing Cores
The "Core" of a Bokurobo starts to move when a "body" is attached to it. Since the body is gradually damaged, the core periodically replaces the body.
The basic performance of the Bokurobo is determined by the body, but as the battle progresses, the core itself is upgraded according to the characteristics of the body.
By systematically switching bodies, unique Bokurobo can be created, such as "an offensive Bokurobo that opens up the battle with high firepower" or "a support Bokurobo that is strong in the face of a battle.
Powerful Power Overclock
While the battle of the Bokurobo proceeds automatically, the player is the only one who can intervene with the command to activate the "Overclock".
Overclock, as the name implies, is a trump card that, by placing a high load on the Bokurobo , can produce powerful effects such as a general attack or a significant increase in its status. Although it has the disadvantage of significantly damaging the body of the activated Bokurobo , it is powerful enough to change the entire war situation.

name: Covid Carl
summary:
Covid Carl is a Metroidvania/Contra-style 2d side-scrolling shooter. It will feature a brief story, 10 levels, and boss fights

Covid Carl is a Metroidvania/Contra-style 2d side-scrolling shooter. It will feature a brief story, 10 levels, and boss fights. 

The story follows the player as they attempt to stop a super soldier from a government project to vaccinate everyone. In typical fashion the government project goes awry and he starts mutating people instead. That's where you come in to shoot or burn almost everything that moves. Shoot stuff, burn stuff, blow stuff up, and have fun doing it. That's the game in a nutshell. Not really much to sugarcoat. There's no planned DLC. There will be updates as needed for bugs and maybe a feature addition or two down the line. 

Covid Carl was born out of frustration in dealing with certain societal elements during the Covid-19 pandemic. It has a pretty heavy dose of satire(is it, though?), some self-awareness about how bad it (the game) is, and hopefully more fun than frustration. Let's be honest, though. I'm not producing something that's AAA. You can run, jump, shoot, go prone, and die. Mostly die, in my experience, but I also might be getting too old to have good reflexes. There may or may not be a flamethrower involved. Who knows? I fully expect that the end product will be a mostly well-functioning dumpster fire. Clearly, I am not made out to be a salesman, as I am being honest and probably underselling this beast I've worked on for the last couple of years. But if it provides whoever pays a pittance for it with a modicum of entertainment, then I'll consider this endeavor a success. This isn't going to be a work of art, but it is my magnum opus.

summary:
Decay, a real time interactive experience.

Decay, a real time interactive experience made in Godot Engine. Basically a technology showcase for Godot, you can watch it for a few minutes and look at the graphics and performance on your computer. A frames per second monitor is included (press Escape to open the menu) and you can also tweak the many graphics options. It includes 4 presets (Ultra, Quality, Performance, and Low Spec) and also allows you to change individual settings (for example, full screen mode or changing the render scaling, as well as visual settings like reflection and ambient occlusion).

The experience features a cinematic camera that runs and loops by itself, so can be watched as a real time music video, a 3D graphics benchmark, or control the camera and fly around the environment. You can press the Space Bar to enable the camera control. The free camera control is like a spectator camera in games (with collision detection) and allows you to fly around freely and explore the environment and the graphics.

Press Escape to view the options. Space to toggle cinematic camera (be sure to close the menu before flying around). WASD or Arrow keys move around. Mouse to look. Supports 3D glasses. To experience Decay in stereo 3D, you'll need red/cyan anaglyph 3D glasses. The ones from Pro-Ana or BIAL are the best quality.

底层就不一样的角色系统
《杀戮尖塔》粉丝基于《杀戮尖塔》的底层设定，而做出不一样的底层设定的作品。
因为我主观觉得《杀戮尖塔》的角色其底层并没有什么区别。
因为每个角色都是以护甲作为防御手段，每个角色都是每回合获得固定费用。
于是在此基础上，本作是以每个角色的底层设定都不一样作为设计理念。
当然，为了玩家快速上手，第一个角色-战士的底层逻辑跟《杀戮尖塔》是一样的。
但第二个角色-法师就大不一样了，法师拥有初始99点魔法值，但只有在章节开始时才会回满。
于是法师需要依靠卡牌和神器来进行回蓝，是一个更注重长线运营的角色。

第三个角色虚空行者更是全球首个独创回合制游戏中加入即时战斗元素的设定。
虚空行者的能量是时间，所以每回合都拥有25秒初始时间，当时间自然流逝完，回合会自动结束。
我们需要在25秒内做出策略判断，并使用卡牌。
注：你的卡牌消耗的费用也是时间哦！
并且虚空行者拥有在敌方回合时也可以使用的特殊卡牌，在敌人攻击的瞬间使用【时空守护】，可以实现类似于弹刀的效果。
当然，如果你不喜欢这种考验反应和操作的流派，还可以尝试虚空行者独有的挂机流，站着不动，就可以实现成吨输出和恢复。

ペットたち! : お気に入りのペットを選んで名前を付けましょう！色も異なる7種類のペットから選べます。
好みにデコレーション！ : 50以上のデコレーションを使ってあなただけの島にカスタマイズ！あなたとあなたのペットの好みに合わせて自由にアレンジできます。
遊びましょう！ : ペットが退屈しないよう、色々なおもちゃやミニゲームで遊んであげましょう！
ペットのお世話！ : ペットに十分な食事を与えて清潔にしてあげましょう。そうすれば、アイテムショップで使えるコインを獲得してペットを生かすことができます！ゲームを閉じている間にペットはお腹を空かせてしまうので、こまめに島をチェックしてあげてください！
他のアプリ上に表示 : ウェブブラウザのように、バックグラウンドでゲームをプレイしたり、他に起動中のプログラムの上に表示させることが可能です！
島を保存 : 島は3つまで保存して、ペットのために切り替えて使うことができます！

name: End of the Line
summary:
A VHS and PS2 aesthetic experience with heavy influence from classic horror games and movies of the 80s and 90s. With detailed environments, gory first-person action and a claustrophobic atmosphere, witness the horrors lurking beneath the streets of Northern England

August 12th 1992
Aaron Jacobs, a student from the North West of England was on the 01:52am train home after a drink with friends. After falling asleep on his journey, we find Aaron awaking unattended at the end of the line late at night. Dazed and confused, he exits the carriage unaware of his surroundings or what is yet to come. The station is closed for maintenance, the lights are dim and Aaron is alone… For now.

Guide Aaron through the train station and beyond in an attempt to make an escape, solving puzzles and unearthing grotesque discoveries as he attempts to avoid the lurking horrors surrounding the station. With limited resources and a heart-pounding atmosphere will Aaron survive or succumb to the ever increasing threat residing right beneath our feet?

What to expect
- Tense first person exploration
- Spine-chilling environments
- Resource management
- Classic PS2 style graphics with a VHS aesthetic
- Heavy 80’s/90’s B-movie and classic horror game inspiration
- Blood, guts and gore
- Fully voice acted characters

name: Furry Girlfriend Simulator
Fractured Worlds
summary:
《Fractured Worlds》是一款设定在破碎现实残骸中的黑暗奇幻动作角色扮演游戏。掌握讲究技巧与精准的战斗系统，探索多样的领域，单人或与其他玩家一同挑战强大的首领

《Fractured Worlds》是一款黑暗奇幻风格的动作角色扮演游戏，故事发生在因人类野心而四分五裂的现实世界中。现在，在神秘声音的引导下，你必须踏上探索破碎世界的旅程，拼凑过去的真相，并直面导致这场灾难的幕后黑手。

深思熟虑、精准为本的战斗

每种武器都有其独特的重量、速度和动作组合。从攻击缓慢但能击晕敌人的双手巨锤，到适合控场的灵活长矛，再到掌控以太流动的魔法法杖——每种武器的手感与玩法都大不相同。无职业限制的成长系统允许多次重置加点，让你轻松尝试各种战斗风格，或围绕你获得的强大传奇装备打造专属角色构筑。

邂逅其他玩家

现实的扭曲意味着其他玩家的世界可能会与你的短暂交叠。你可以选择与他们互动，或者独自前行。你可以入侵或支援，帮助或欺骗，分享一处丰富的战利品，或引诱他们进入致命的怪物群中，并在战斗结束后收割成果。

探索多样破碎的世界

踏入由过去世界碎片构成的独特程序生成环境。穿越中世纪地牢、神秘魔法森林、火山地貌与未来工业城市。寻找记忆碎片，揭示灾变中受害者的故事，帮助你理解真相并修复这个支离破碎的世界。

分享你世界的一部分

地图碎片是强大的神器，可让玩家将自己世界的一部分与他人共享。地图碎片会生成一个带有随机词缀的合作实例，能以不可预测的方式改变怪物属性，并提升他们守护的战利品质量。当你与他人共享地图时，还可以留下评论，让其他玩家了解该区域的情况——是满地宝藏，还是异常凶险的战斗。

挑战强大首领

面对阻挡你前路的强大首领。挑战宝藏魔像、精神扭曲者罗尔施、威严的幽灵骑士，以及更多恐怖敌人。每场首领战都是严峻而致命的挑战，一次失误就可能让你损失大量生命值。但这些战斗都经过精心设计，攻击前会有清晰的预警信号，只要多加练习，即使是最强敌人也能被你击败。

《Fractured Worlds》带来一段穿越破碎现实的旅程，专注于爽快的战斗与重建失落世界的使命。

name: Chopped Up
summary:
一款温馨治愈的恐怖烹饪游戏，暗藏致命杀机。为奇幻生物烹制暖心美食，并以街头小贩的身份为掩护，暗中铲除目标——但要小心那些反咬你一口的家伙。

你将扮演一名伪装成街头小贩的刺客。在这个黑暗的奇幻世界里，你要为古怪的顾客们烹饪暖心的餐食。用热腾腾的菜肴引诱目标上钩，伺机而动，在卫兵——或某种更可怕的东西——嗅到你的气息之前，销毁一切证据。在这片怪物与人类共存之地，每一班岗都可能是你的最后一程。

summary:
A steampunk roguelike with a unique fighting mechanic. Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne.

Iron Mandate: A roguelike with a wholly original fighting mechanic!

Master the piloting of giant mechanical worms, lay waste to all that stand in your way and reclaim your rightful place on the throne.
Defeat great foes
Learn the subtleties of Juggernaut piloting in order to better destroy your rivals. Iron Mandate has over 30 weapons to both fight with and learn to fend off. 

Forge your own path
Every attempt to reach the throne is unique. Different path, different arsenal, different upgrades. You will need to learn the intricacies of the Juggernaut and its many variations in order to survive your climb to the top.

Prove your worth
Iron Mandate includes 20+ unique challenges to prove your Juggernaut piloting skills. You can also play local multiplayer in the versus mode with up to 4 players.

name: MEARTH II
summary:
Dangerous roads, magical battles, ruthless bosses – get ready for new adventures. Join Princess Asteria !

ABOUT STORY
Having completed her education at the monastery, Princess Asteria returns to her country and finds that her Virtuous Kingdom has been destroyed.
The sorcerer of the Saban Kingdom named Dragos invades the kingdom with his army. 
The Sorceress invades the Virtous Kingdom and traps Astreia on her own continent.
Asteria embarks on an adventure to get her revenge and her kingdom back. Mearth II is the sequel to the first game.
An adventure awaits you, be prepared for difficult challenges and roads.
Key Features

 Spells and magical weapons : Use your magical powers and weapons to beat enemies and bosses, as well as pass levels 

 Stealth executions : You can sneak behind some enemies and kill them also kill enemies with finishing execution hits in some fights 

 Fight your way : Define your own playstyle, and prepare for the challenges that await in your own unique way 

 Brutal enemies and bosses : You will not get bored while fighting bosses with different characteristics. While battling ruthless enemies, you can dodge their attacks with your skill 

 Majestic structures and dangerous roads : Get ready for spectacular and atmospheric maps that will keep you in the game, but beware of the traps on the roads you walk 

 Obstacles and puzzles : Solve puzzles and dodge obstacles to progress through caves 

 Witness a story : Explore the dark and magical story of the Mearth universe with Asteria.

name: Sensory.
summary: “Sensory” was a mess! My aim for the project was just to make an album that I’d want to listen to — meaning sounds, features, artwork, and overall vibes that I enjoyed (at least at that time), something that my younger self would’ve been hooked on. There was no real inspiration outside of “I want to make something better” when compared to my previous work, NEURA BURST! I had a LOT of free time after graduating high school, so I just delved into creating whatever I wanted. Starting with Sensory, I really tried pushing my video and visual skills a lot more in promotion.

name: eimi
summary: eimi is the longest I’ve worked on a project and it’s completely solo made. I spent a lot of time trying to build a little world out of my sounds and I’m happy to have this world now on cassette and CD. It’s a glitchy, ethereal mix of art pop and electronica that moves through a story of grief and loss.

法力现象（即异能）是该系列的核心，贯穿故事始终。

与薇莉塔一同踏上旅程，追寻法力的过往。

游戏总时长约30小时，共6章。

玩家的推理将决定每一章的结局。


跟随流程找到超能力相关的文档，以及留有痕迹的地图。

整理文档信息，逐步揭开尘封于过往的真相。


依靠对话和探索收集信息，以推理改变故事走向。


超过21个活灵活现、栩栩如生的动态角色

这些高质量角色渲染图组成了多达35种不同的动作和姿势，来一睹为快吧。

대부호 트라벨 백작이 집 나간 차남을 찾게 되며 달라졌다.

우리 아빠가 귀족이라고? 나한테 부자 할아버지가 있었다고?!

친척들은 6년 만에 어린 딸과 함께 돌아온 아빠에게 뜨거운 환영…이 아닌 싸늘한 눈빛만 쏘아댔다.
그때, 머릿속에 이상한 장면들이 폭우처럼 쏟아졌다.

- 베리, 친척들을 조심해야 해. 트라벨은 가주 후계자 자리를 노리는 짐승들의 소굴이거든.
- 베리 아가씨! 레이탄 도련님께서 전사…하셨다는 소식이…….

일곱 살, 열 살, 열여섯 살, …….
모두 나였지만, 내가 모르는 기억들.
그리고 그 기억 속에서 아빠는 허무한 죽음을 맞이했다.

***

설마, 이게 진짜일 리 없어.

“집사장님, 최근에 폭삭 망할 잉크사 주식을 다량 사셨습니까?”
“그건 절대 안 망한다고……. 예? 제가 주식을 산 걸 어떻게?”

끄악! 이것도 다 맞잖아.

이 기억이 진짜라면, 이번에는 반드시 아빠를 살리고 말거야.

혼자만의 힘으로는 아빠를 살릴 수 없다.
가장 큰 뒷배가 되어줄 조력자가 필요한데….
물론 나만 아는 보석이 하나 있지-.
지금은 진흙 묻은 돌멩이처럼 보여 견제받을 일도 없는.

‘테온 필 이그셀로나 황태자.’

내 첫 번째 계획은 어린 그를 우리 편으로 만드는 거다.

name: Traumada
summary:
Welcome to the horrific altered memories of my childhood home.

As we revisit our memories, they change. How do we know what is real? How do we know who we can trust? Our seemingly peaceful neighborhoods house monsters disguised in human skin. These monsters live on the innocence of our children, leaving them wandering confused in the afterlife, forever alone and afraid. Our minds give the monsters a place to live, even after they are gone. Sometimes, we become the monsters.

Is there really a mystery to be solved? Or is this all in my head? I have no plan. I have no place left to hide. Am I the missing? Or am I the taker? I'll let time find out for me. It will unfold with or without me.

Explore the nightmare version of my childhood home. Uncover clues to the disappearance of a local girl in the 1950s or descend into madness trying.

Plays in the style of a PS1/PS2 game with modern controls. First-person 3D perspective. Exploration and puzzle solving. Atmospheric horror and the occasional jumpscares to satisfy your indie horror desires.

name: Social Moth
summary:
Social Moth is a charmingly beautiful narrative platformer where you play as Aletris, a socially anxious moth trying to find their place in a daunting world. Navigate conversations, solve creative puzzles, and enjoy satisfying platforming as you help Aletris contend with their social anxiety!

Social Moth is a narrative platformer where you play as a small moth contending with social anxiety. Set in a close-knit community on the forest floor, the game allows the player to explore themes of mental health, relationships, and finding a sense of belonging.

Play as Aletris, a moth, struggling through interactions with other community members through dialogue choices that alter their anxiety level. Platform through the area surrounding your lantern home, finding collectibles and helpful friends throughout the environment that will lower your constantly rising anxiety. If Aletris gets too anxious and is unable to find any way to ground themselves, they'll come face to face with a manifestation of their anxiety...

Our goal is for players who have experience with social anxiety to find a comforting and relatable story in Social Moth. For those unfamiliar with social anxiety, the game offers a compelling lens into ways anxiety can manifest itself even in seemingly mundane interactions, in hopes of inspiring more compassion and support for those who struggle with social anxiety.

Features!

- An endearing narrative that acts as a lens into how some may experience social anxiety

- Dynamic platforming with fully configurable controls

- A beautiful hand-drawn art-style that brings the world to life

- Fully voice acted dialogue from a talented cast of professional actors

- Dynamic music layering that responds to Aletris' level of anxiety

- Two distinct endings that depend on how you guide Aletris through a pivotal encounter

- A wonderful community full of bugs of diverse gender-identities including our non-binary lead, Aletris!

summary:
Design computational circuits which defy restrictions of our universe in this open-ended puzzle. Your completed creations become components to solve future challenges. As you design a circuit and can place your design within it, where there is a smaller you doing the same, and so on to infinity.

You are but a cog in infinite machine. Yet you are all the cogs. There is no end and no beginning. Only computation.

There are only a handful of base components to master. Clone replicates a token. Filter redirects a zero or Nul token to another path. A lock will not allow a token through until it has been unlocked from the side. Switch directs tokens left or right, which can be selected by supplying a token at the other end. Increment and decrement units add or subtract one from the token. And finally a nullifier converts a zero to a Nul and vice-versa. All other units in the game are ones made by you.
User Interface
The design interface has plenty of quality of life features making construction as painless as possible. Copying and pasting between designs, moving and flipping components, comments, and custom colors to help you.
Testing
Testing allows you to view the operation of your design while inspecting the inner workings of subcomponents. Skipping steps where no activity can be seen makes visualising your algorithm easier.
Community
Your designs can be exchanged with friends or shared with the public using strings. There are global leader boards as well as being able to see your friend's scores.

Voltaire:The Vegan Vampire 是一款动作农场 roguelite 游戏，故事发生在德古拉和他叛逆的小儿子伏尔泰的故乡特兰西瓦尼亚。恍然大悟让这个年轻的吸血鬼改变主意:为了向他的父亲证明咬脖子不是吸血鬼茁壮成长的唯一方式，他放弃了血液而选择了素食。

老吸血鬼并不喜欢这样的想法，但在叔叔弗兰克和斯坦的帮助下，伏尔泰从父亲的视线中溜走了。一旦独自一人，他就会开始一场令人毛骨悚然、可爱的奥德赛，充满了素食食谱、素食生活方式和手绘艺术，庆祝光荣的恐怖!

夜幕降临时要小心。德古拉将派他的爪牙摧毁伏尔泰的庄稼，让他恢复“适当的”、充满活力的饮食。

 保卫庄稼不受德古拉的恐怖爪牙的军队攻击，坚决不让伏尔泰享用他辛苦赚来的燕麦奶昔。

 拥抱吸血鬼的黑暗力量，在德古拉的小爪牙失败时，击败他派来的首领。

战胜德古拉的力量，通过更环保的方式继承他的统治。

由于他的饮食计划充满了许多新的能力，将伏尔泰进化成更高的吸血鬼模式。

完成弗兰克和斯坦叔叔的赏金任务，同时击败特兰西瓦尼亚的神话生物，并获得奖励继续播种。

summary:
《安魂战棋》是一款将经典战棋与Roguelike融合为一体，暗黑风格的策略回合制战棋游戏。每个职业有数十种发展路线，搭配上百种装备特效，每个玩家都可以打造自己不同风格的队伍，享受极致的回合制战棋游戏的快感

安魂前作有完整的结局，EA阶段承诺内容（关卡长度、英灵数量、装备数量等内容）全部兑现完成。
通关至少也要10+小时，平均24小时往上。
目前为止，我们收到的BUG依然在修复。

如果真要说前作有什么坑，那就是英文版仅翻译了一半内容（那么到底为什么只翻译了一半呢...），所以英文版才确实是有鸽的嫌疑！
PS：如果有人愿意用爱帮我们翻译（文本量巨大），我们非常乐意补足前作英文版内容。

关于刷？
游戏发售的第一天，确实存在一些问题（目前已修复，请放心食用），好评率一度跌倒36%！如果刷好评能刷成这样，呵...
--------------------------------------
现在回过头来，前作确实有不少可以做得更好的地方，这些我们都把它总结到了《安魂战棋》中。
诚然《安魂战棋》也有诸多不足，即便是某些带着情绪输出的差评，我们也耐心看了。而好评我们更是前进的动力，其实不少好评中也存在一些批评，我们也看到了，通常也在第一时间做了相应的调整。

官方身份嘛，有些话不太好讲，就这样吧。
《安魂战棋》之后会解锁后续的英灵，另外将会对关卡做一次大的更新，是对玩法的一个比较大的扩充，大家可以期待一下。
--------------------------------------
如果您有建议或在游戏中遇到任何问题，可以随时加群或在 Steam社区 上留言联系我们。
玩家一群: 954398250
⚠️提醒：Demo的游戏进度会继承到EA版本中，您无需从头开始游戏。⚠️

游戏介绍
《安魂战棋》是一款将传统战棋与Roguelike融合为一体的硬核策略游戏，多种职业的发展方向与丰富随机的装备属性词条，衍生出多种的不同流派的策略战法，同时，在关卡和难度的设计上花费了大量的精力，我们希望能打造一种全新的"魂"版战棋游戏的玩家体验。在这信奉黑暗丛林法则的世界之中，即便是作为最高统帅你也必须要谨慎，你的每一步抉择都将直接影响到部下与敌人的命运。我们的目标依然是打造最好玩的战棋游戏，希望大家能够喜欢。

游戏特色

硬核战旗 险死还生
首先要强调的是，本游戏是一款难度十分硬核的战棋游戏，只有灵活运用每一种属性词条，充分了解职业特性，甚至有些时候不得不做出一些弃车保帅的战略抉择才有可能战胜强大的敌人。不要抱有任何的侥幸，这款游戏绝对没有等级碾压的捷径可走！我们对游戏的热爱是认真的，但对难度的平衡和系统的设定也是十分认真的！所以对于策略战棋玩法感觉陌生的玩家请您务必要再三考虑一下，险死还生绝对不是说说而已！您真的是否能够接受挫败感很强的策略游戏？

自由搭配 万般变化
Roguelike玩法最大的乐趣便在于未知，而作为策略智慧最大的难点同样在于未知。四大职阶，13种职业分支，多重成长选择，搭配丰富神兵，让你每一次进入世界都是一场全新体验，选择你最喜爱的玩法，用万般过关方式，挑战无限可能。

多重职业 战法争雄
四大职阶，多重职业成长分支，每种职业都具备独特的战略价值，并且天赋技能强化还可以将角色往不同成长方向上进行特化培养。想要克服难关你需要一只团队，一只作战适应性强且符合你作战风格的团队。是肉坦协作强力单兵突入？还是召唤人海围歼？亦或者远程控制拉风筝？总有一种流派适合你。

平衡难度 重生机制
每一次成功通关或战败重启都将基于玩家金币奖励，玩家可以以此在奖励配置中解锁全新装备。为你之后闯关中可能获取的装备调配最适合的名单，打开实现更多战法的可能。当然这获取的也仅仅是稀有装备出现的可能性而已，想要通过战败继承瞬息变强？不存在的！强者封神容不得一丝水分！

name: Cracked
summary:
Frustratingly difficult egg-centric physics-based 3D platforming obstacle course. Try to make it to the end without getting cracked.

Some say that "Cracked" is too hard, that it's impossible to beat. Those are probably the same people who would say there's no way that some nerdy kid who was captain of the debate team and drove a Dodge Omni with 183,467 miles on the dash could ever outshine Johnny Redmond and his perfectly waxed cherry red C3 Corvette to become homecoming king on that cool October night in 1982.

They probably also claim that his slow dance with Jenny—the head cheerleader, homecoming queen, and mayor’s daughter—never happened, and insist that it couldn’t possibly have unfolded into a passionate night of romance and rebellion.

They’d probably also say crazy things like, "James, please stop lying about what happened at homecoming; you're embarrassing yourself. We were all there. We know you had one sip of the punch then ran out to the dance floor and started wobbling around like an off-balance egg and yelling 'Someone must have spiked the punch; I'm usually never like this,' until eventually one of your wobbles went too wide and you accidentally smacked Jenny in the face. Then you curled up into a ball in the middle of the dance floor and started crying, begging Johnny not to hit you in retaliation. Nobody spiked the punch that night, James."

Well, maybe they were right about everything else, but not this time, not about "Cracked." This time I'm the master of my own destiny and no egg's wobble will stop me. I will beat this game, and in doing so, become fulfilled.

Buy "Cracked" today!

骷髅大军正入侵世界，而你手上唯一的武器只有一台烤面包机和一只鸡！在这片被扰人骷髅占领的土地上来一场异想天开的冒险吧！将不同的武器相互结合以产生意想不到的效果，并通过它们击退这些骨头小坏蛋。途中将会有一群来自四方的英雄加入你的队伍，并帮助你完成之后的任务。你有足够的勇气来阻止死灵法师的计划并拯救世界吗？
超乎疯狂的武器组合
探索各种意想不到的武器组合，从爆炸吐司到追踪机器鸡，根据你的游戏风格自定你的装备，并用它们对敌人进行毁灭性打击。

全员登车，准备出发
将你的火车变成一个强大的行动基地，同时为你沿途遇到的朋友提供庇护。

结交意想不到的盟友
与一群有趣的角色交朋友，每位角色都有自己独特的能力和动机，招募他们一同完成任务，击败死灵法师。
无尽的可玩性
程序生成的关卡将给你带来意想不到的惊喜与挑战，并确保每次的游戏体验都有所不同。在奋力击退进逼威胁的同时，测试您的游戏技巧和适应性。

Battle for love as a gladiator in this epic romance of swords and sandals!

Heart of Battle is a 220,000-word interactive gladiator romance by Fay Ikin, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

As a prisoner of Coritan City, you had two options: rot in a dungeon or battle in the gladiatorial arena. You chose to fight - and as a star gladiator, you have the power to sway public opinion as nobody else does.

The city is divided, ruled by the glittering Illustrious who use their wealth and status to maintain their power over the struggling masses. A lucky few have access to magic as well: it can be used to heal, but it can also be used as a weapon, or to reinforce the bars of prisons.

Below them, rumors of revolution simmer - and nowhere more strongly than among the gladiators. Former soldiers, political prisoners, and prisoners of war now bide their time, plotting to rise up. Some just hope to escape to their own freedom; others want to bring down the entire oppressive system. Yet others seek to work within the hierarchy, currying favor among the Illustrious in the hopes of having their freedom bought by a wealthy patron.

name: The Delusions of Maximillian Wurst
summary:
The first chapter of a loop-de-loop platformer in which you control Maximillian Wurst, silver-tongued poet and abject moron, as he pursues a fantasy that wants nothing to do with him. Escape Father Time! Shoot as many Chadwicks as you can! Stumble along with poison coursing through your lily liver!

About

You're so much prettier when you smile. And here is something that I know will make you smile: the opening chapter of an idiot's odyssey! Play as Maximillian Wurst, a grandiloquent poetaster who is in pursuit of the resistant, fiesty Fialova (and by "fiesty" I mean "understandably outraged"). Fialova cannot stand Max for the simple reason that he is, as the Spanish would say, a douchebag. Does that deter Max? Only you can decide! It's all up to you! But actually, no.

The Delusions of Maximillian Wurst constitutes about 20-30 minutes of gameplay. The game so far is free, and I would love to hear your feedback!
Features

Loop-de-loop platformer levels.

Artwork derived from classic paintings and sculpture.

An original score by the inimitable composer Elizabeth Legierski.

A rather uncomfortable anecdote told by father whilst you are intoxicated.

Purple prose up the old wazoo.

summary:
Live2D，动作丝滑！　人渣囚徒的观察游戏！　在被称作垃圾堆(Dump)的监狱中，危险的囚徒们的赌注纸牌游戏即将开始——输了就要接受惩罚游戏！？　揭露异常者们隐藏的过去，和他们犯下的猎奇犯罪吧！

想不想将危险的囚徒玩弄于股掌之间，让他们品味败北与屈辱，挖掘他们内心的黑暗呢？
『Romp of Dump』最适合想要享受这种不道德感的你！

玩家作为被冤枉为连续杀人狂魔的死刑囚徒，通过“赌注纸牌”尝试与其他身为异常罪犯的囚徒们进行沟通。

输了的人要接受“惩罚游戏”！？　战胜危险的囚徒们，践踏他们的自尊，通过他们在惩罚游戏中讲述的过往，解开他们引发的猎奇犯罪的谜团吧。

这是一部让您体会公开处刑一般的不道德感的，充满好兄弟情谊的以角色为卖点的游戏。
体验版的存档可继承至正式版。

游戏内包括以『Black Jack（21点）』为首的赌场常见的4种小游戏。
您的输赢取决于能否发现充满个性的角色们的些微举止表情和台词变化。面对CPU对手仍能感受到心理战的刺激。

进行直播的话，您可以与观众一起猜测对方的点数，炒热气氛！

使用Live2D的高范围可动立绘，为角色带来多彩的表情动作，让对话更加妙趣横生。
所有角色的动作总数超过200种，每个角色有100多种表情变化！

剧本超过20万字，量大管饱。
您可以浅尝辄止，也可以收集无数的剧情分支，深入地挖掘这个世界的秘密。

主线剧情为以猎奇犯罪为主题的悬疑故事。
您可以收集案件的信息与假设，亲手拼凑出真相。在此过程中，您能通过思考，获得无数乐趣！
【游戏配信饭绘指导方针】
在『Romp of Dump』中，欢迎游戏配信和饭绘的投稿！
无论是个人还是法人，都可以在没有许可的情况下发布，收益化也OK。
没有剧透的限制，可以发送到故事的最后。
视频投稿时，请写明作品名，链接到官方网站或Steam商店页面。
饭绘投稿的时候，最好使用作品名的写明和散列标签「#RompOfDump」。
【STORY】

1992年——享乐与亵渎的城市，丹皮尔。
当时，这片被杀人狂魔所威胁的土地，还仍被称作乐园……
在这不夜城，那些过度淘气的家伙便会被丢进垃圾堆里——那就是丹皮尔监狱，通称“Dump”。
监狱之中，有一个死刑囚正感到无所事事——

你好，我是『亚兹·K·奈特梅亚』。你也可以叫我“奈特”哦？
我乃是无辜之身，老实等待死刑也不合我意，
所以，我打算和各位囚徒一起玩玩扑克牌，下下注。
输了的人，就要接受惩罚游戏——没错，就讲些有趣的故事吧。
比如，告诉我你犯了什么罪，才来了这里……怎么样？

胜利的关键在于仔细观察Live2D的动个不停的角色，找到角色的习惯。
和人渣囚徒们来一场全新的纸牌游戏吧。
【CHARACTER】

亚兹·K·奈特梅亚
「我确实和谁都会睡……但唯独不记得自己睡过法律女神哦？」

罪行：连续杀人　量刑：死刑
虽然不像，但确实是这个故事的主人公。因莫须有的罪名被判了死刑。
散发着能够俘获人心的危险性感香气的魔性之人。

路克·古德曼
「那、那、那个！我叫路、路、路克！　啊！不、不是“路路路克”，是“路克”哦……！」

罪行：杀人抛尸　刑期：2年零6个月
总被欺负的模范囚徒。怎么看都是毫无危险之处的样子。
虽然命运多舛，却仍努力表现出开朗样子的『37岁小朋友』。

飞
「我是飞大爷！！　我就是塔玛尤兰黑手党“ACIDD”最强最恐怖最差劲的杀手，给我牢牢记住了！！」

罪行：杀人、重伤害　刑期：70年
外表看起来中性，言语举止却极其过激，总是惹麻烦。
空空的脑袋中堆满了不能再多的杀意和残忍。

杜拉尔姆·德·米洛
「我们是只配被狱警以号码称呼的存在。都是垃圾袋里的垃圾……哪里需要更多的联系。」

罪行：伤害、监禁　刑期：22年
不喜欢与他人交流，沉默寡言的独行侠。
看似很有常识的样子，但字里行间之中总让人窥到深邃的黑暗。

弗兰贝尔·瑞普斯坦
「——我只是遵守自身的信念，行了正义之举。这就是我与你们这些人渣决定性的不同所在……」

罪行：破坏遗体　刑期：3年
冷静沉着，自尊心极高，有洁癖。
被捕前曾是优秀的医生，看不起其他囚徒，当他们是“低等生物”。

德雷克·欧·莫希塔
「……嗯，你想尝就尝吧。早晚有一天，我会让你明白这是剧毒……」

罪行：贩毒、杀人　刑期：25年
被称为“恶魔小矮人”的商贩。
看起来贪财又轻浮，但据说他性格冷酷，头脑聪慧。

name: Kaiju
summary:
Kaiju is a collection of 2D and 3D audio visualizations that uses your system audio to drive its effects in real time.

Kaiju is a collection of 2D and 3D audio visualizations ranging from calming waves to clinical spectra and psychedelic fractals.
It makes waves.
Kaiju listens to your system audio to drive its visualizations in real time. 
This means music and video streaming services, games, movies and even human voices from VOIP all work to power the effects; it hears what you hear.
Alternatively, your microphone can be used to make your voice and the ambience of the room drive the system.

Kaiju does not record any audio or require special permissions. It makes use of Windows' audio APIs commonly used for noise cancellation.

 Real time 2D and 3D visualizations

 Works with streaming services, VOIP, games and more...

name: The Golden Eyed Ghosts
summary:
《Golden Eyed Ghosts》是一款像《塞尔达传说》系列致敬的黑暗幻想类魂系游戏，背景设定在分崩离析的安德罗梅达王国。玩家操控被流放的战士奥里恩，寻找恢复记忆并揭开可怕阴谋的方法。

《黄金眼幽魂》是一款黑暗幻想类魂系游戏，受到《塞尔达传说》系列的深刻影响，背景设定在分崩离析的安德罗梅达王国。王国表面下隐藏着古老而恐怖的秘密，威胁着王国的存在。扮演被流放的战士奥里恩，勇闯王国的危险、找回四把传说中被盗的剑，并拯救整个王国于水深火热之中。

但是，安德罗梅达王国的情况并不是表明显露的那么简单。地下深藏着无数秘密和该被遗忘之事物。如果不小心……奥里恩可能会陷入一个由秘密、谎言和谜团构成的迷局之中。因为……

决策决定前进的方向。你是否要大杀四方？还是寻找避免不必要的屠杀的方法？你是要用从斩杀的敌人中汲取生命能量来治愈自己？还是撤退，在陌生而熟悉的战场间找到片刻的宁静？也许种种选择都有，调整奥里恩的装备，面对任何的敌人。但无论你是试图穿过邪恶的森林、闪烁的冰原、混浊的沼泽还是腐败的城市……

在战斗中做出的选择相比于真正令人痛心疾首的、改变世界的决定而言显得微不足道。追踪一个卑鄙的小偷；结交一位受苦的少女；或者帮助一个绝望的父亲。他们会信任你吗？你能信任他们吗？也许好心会有回报；也许背叛已经酝酿。

也许最好放任这个分崩离析的王国自生自灭，让疯狂和古怪的怪异吞噬这个它。毕竟……

奥里恩有任务要完成，但他不是英雄。他只是安德罗梅达帝国下落不明的许多荒废居民之一，在一个停滞的世界中挣扎求生。在此类银河战士恶魔城游戏中加入他的旅程，寻找前进的方法。面对看似不可逾越之困难，努力存活过古老世界的腐烂野兽、骇人阴谋和深渊恐惧……

name: Plumpy Uprising
summary:
Plumpy Uprising is a roguelite tower defense game featuring unique elders, random upgrade choices and a constantly shifting map. The difficulty increases every time you beat the game!

Choose Your Elder
Choose which unique elder you will use to stop the Plumpies! Each elder has unique skills, a special tower, and passive bonuses that will change the way you play and the strategies you use to win.

Strategize as You Play
Each wave you get to choose from randomized tower upgrades. Complete an optional challenge and receive an extra upgrade. You’ll need to choose what makes sense in the moment, and decide each wave if you want to push your luck or play it safe.

Outsmart a Shifting Map
The map will move every few waves and your towers in the older part of the map will be destroyed. Choose wisely! You will get limited tower tokens, making each tower placement important.

Increase in Difficulty
Each time you beat the game, a tougher difficulty will unlock. How far can you push it?
FEATURE SUMMARY

Uniquely designed enemies 

Game changing elders

A shifting map that keeps you thinking

Escalating difficulty as you beat the game

name: Trouble of Tabu
summary:
Take up the challenge and aim your sword to the ground in this true precision platformer. Struggle through the various challenges and try to finish the game in one go.

Step in the shoes of Tabu the sultan with his magical bouncy sword and overcome various traps and challenges. With practice you'll be able to jump, swing, climb and reach new places. Finishing this game won't be easy! Do you think you have it in you to go all the way? 

Key Features

 Test Your Skills!

 Feel new types of frustration, anger and euphoria you didn't know you were capable of.

 Become better with each attempt!

 Become the best sultan in the leaderboards!

 This game has no save option! Finish or die trying.

 4 game modes, each more challenging!

 Beautiful scenery.

 Full of different type of traps to challenge you.

 Challenge yourself by finishing the game in one go.

name: 危险岛
summary: 危险岛是一个弹幕射击游戏，需要合理使用技能和闪避躲避弹幕，游戏总共只有5关但是难度曲线有点陡峭，有时候小兵比Boss更可怕，但我相信这并不会难到你。

name: My Trainer is a Futanari
summary:
You decided to make the commitment of signing up for a full membership at your local gym. Your personal trainer, Kendra, has abs of steel and she's full of surprises!

Futa on Male

"New year, new me!"

You decided to make the commitment of signing up for a full membership at your local gym.
You went the extra mile and got a personal trainer to help you along and hold you accountable.
Kendra comes highly recommended and with her abs of steel, she's often touted as:
"THE REAL DEAL".

Get ready for the workout of a lifetime!

Read through some pretty raunchy(erotic) dialogue, accompanied by spicy nude depictions.
Gameplay
Kinetic Visual Novel

H-Scenes
Sexy Voice Acting
~6K words

Immerse yourself in the story by typing in your own name, then proceeding to read through a raunchy story from the first-person perspective.

name: TERROVOX
summary:
Explore a huge world. You can go in any direction. Get resources. Craft weapons and items. Create buildings. Use your imagination to the maximum.

Terravox is a 3D sandbox video game.

features:

 - Big and open world

 - Procedural world generation

 - The world consists of destructible blocks (voxels)

 - Resource mining (coal, copper, iron, etc.)

 - Resource processing (iron to iron ingots, etc.)

 - Crafting items (picks, shovels, doors, anvil, etc.)

 - Creating blocks that don't exist in the world

 - Changing the time of day

 - First-person view

You appear only with a set of simple tools - a pickaxe and an axe. Everything else will need to be obtained independently.

You can create new blocks from the collected ones. For example, you can create planks from logs and steps from planks.

With blocks collected and crafted, you can build buildings that are only limited by your imagination.

To create weapons and items, you will have to extract resources using a pickaxe and a shovel. To build a house, you need to use an axe.

There are no mandatory goals to achieve in the game, which gives players a lot of freedom in choosing how to play the game.

name: Revenge Master
summary:
复仇大师是一个3D动作游戏，你扮演一个国王谁决定报复他的叛徒。 在壮观的战斗中与你的敌人作战，在每一步都可能是最后一步的条件下生存，并将叛徒送到地狱。

复仇大师是一个3d生存动作游戏，你扮演一个国王背叛他的顾问和他的人民诽谤。 带你上绞刑架后，敌人留下你死，但你答应回来报仇。 在这个游戏中，你必须与一波又一波的敌人作战，与叛徒作战并采取残酷的报复。％每一波敌人变得更加困难，你必须使用不同的策略和战术才能生存。 你坚持的时间越长，你要送到地狱的叛徒就越多。游戏结合了武术和战略生存的元素，每场战斗不仅需要你的力量，还需要你的智慧才能生存并达到一个新的水平。 在整个游戏中，你会发现20个级别充满了危险的对手和困难的挑战。主要特点：在动态的战斗中与一波又一波的敌人作战。是一个活跃的模拟器，你的每一个决定都是生存的关键。每个级别都充满了新的敌人和挑战。 
魔法和战术

使用魔法和战术机动来击败敌人。一个黑暗的气氛，你必须报复。％
复仇大师

是一款游戏，适合那些在残酷的复仇和魔法世界中寻找具有挑战性的战斗，黑暗氛围和生存挑战的人。

name: Dungeonrite
summary:
Dungeonrite is an old school First Person Dungeon Crawler with card game combat, deck building, and card collecting. Craft a powerful deck that will get you through expansive dungeons filled with enemies and loot. Escape intact and take your riches with you to rebuild a once forgotten town.

Dungeonrite is an old school First Person Dungeon Crawler with card game combat, deck building, and card collecting. Craft a powerful deck that will get you through expansive dungeons filled with enemies and loot. Escape intact and take your riches with you to rebuild a once forgotten town. Dungeonrite is inspired by the classic RPG's of the 90's. Begin with nothing but a deck of cards to defend yourself. Explore long forgotten dungeons with grid based movement. Collect gold and resources to help rebuild the abandoned town of Molden. Along the way, sell, buy, collect, and build your deck. That is, if you make it out of the dungeon alive in the first place.
Features

Deckbuilding: The key to success is crafting a strong deck from 100+ cards to choose from. Start with a deck that can get you by, but when you construct the Card Shop, you'll be able to buy, sell, and manage your deck how you see fit.

 Card Combat: You never know what or who you'll find lurking in the dungeons below. Play your cards carefully in challenging combat that can either end your run or make you rich. 

Card Collector: As you manage your deck, you'll be able to keep the cards you aren't using. Every single card is displayed to easily build your collection.

Old School Dungeon Crawling: The grid based first person dungeon crawling is inspired by the classic RPGs from the 80's and 90's. Explore expansive dungeons as the game auto maps where you've been. It also shows how many areas are left unexplored.

Loot: You'll find resources while exploring dungeons, and if you make it out alive, you'll keep what you found. If you die, you'll lose everything you found, even the gold.

Rebuild The Town: The long abandone

name: Mapstermind
summary:
Compete with your friends in this 3v1 asymmetrical party game. Team up as one of the piecelings or wreak havoc as the Mapster in an exciting race against time!

Experience a new take on the party game genre with Mapstermind’s array of cute characters, two unique game boards with exciting mechanics, and one evil pair of floating hands!

Choose Your Character
Pick from 9 uniquely adorable Piecelings or don the white gloves of the Mapster!

Complete Cooperative Tasks As the Piecelings
Be a giant clam’s stylist, catch a home run, bring a mermaid her crown, and much more!

Unleash the Mapster’s Devastating Attacks
Utilize the Mapster’s custom control board to set traps and launch attacks to delay the Piecelings! 

Compete On Two Unique Game Boards

City
Take a tour of the city and explore its many famous landmarks. Avoid the hustle and bustle of this urban environment and return order to the city!
Seafloor
In this underwater stage, Piecelings help the Mermaid recover her lost items. Beware of the sea life and other aquatic hazards!

name: DefenceOrder
summary:
When monster troops flocked to the kingdom, which was troubled by the king's tyranny, the king, who had been tyranny, abandoned the kingdom and left. May you be our king and guardian and protect the kingdom. Hire archers, artillery, wizards, and develop their abilities, and save the kingdom

"Revolutionary forces" trying to save citizens from the tyranny of kings.
Just before its success, monsters began to attack the village, and the "Bad King" fled with soldiers to protect his life.

Become a new king and save citizens from powerful monsters!
Protect the King!
The monsters are aiming for the king. Protect the king from evil monsters!
Check out the fence!
When the wave starts, the fence opens, and monsters flock to the open fence only.
Check out which fences open!
Deploy your troops!
Troops can be deployed on each stepping-stone.
Deploy fast-attacking, archers capable of deploying up to 3 people, artillery capable of wide-area attacks, and wizards that cause very powerful damage!
A growing troops!
Attack speed, damage, attack range, effect range…. There are many ways to make a back soldier powerful.
Upgrade my soldiers, and stop the increasingly powerful enemy!
Who's the next monster?
Identify the characteristics of monsters, such as flying monsters, self-destructing monsters...
and enemies who block arrows, and come up with effective strategies!
Experience that changes every time
We don't know where the stepping-stone will be added.
Also, your enemies' abilities grow differently each time, changing their strategies accordingly.
The emergence of a powerful boss

Record your ranking!
Every time you renew your highest score, then your score and military funds go up.
Challenge higher scores!

name: Loathful
summary:
Dive into a bone-chilling horror experience with PS1-style graphics. Step into the shoes of a Neural Net Solutions employee testing a virtual reality vacation system. Brace yourself for an immersive journey into terror, where the past meets cutting-edge fear.

EPILEPSY WARNING

Step into the world of Loathful, a first-person Psychological Horror game that immerses you in a vintage, retro-style universe featuring PS1 graphics. Where, What was meant to be an escape turns into a relentless nightmare. 

Main characteristics:

Step into the shoes of a young employee at 'Neural Net Solutions,' a cutting-edge technology enterprise on the forefront of innovation. They've offered you a unique opportunity to test their groundbreaking technology, allowing you to upload your mind into the cloud, whether temporarily or for eternity.

Immerse yourself in a world filled with subtle mechanics and intricate puzzles, where your primary objective is to explore an unfamiliar realm that constantly push you to your limits.

Inspired by beloved games of the same genre, 'Loathful' distinguishes itself with its retro design and straightforward yet highly effective gameplay

Features:

A bone-chilling experience where you are the vulnerable one, hunted by everything and everyone around you

Explore five distinct worlds set in a ever-changing virtual reality vacation resort

Encounter a variety of enemy types, each with unique mechanics to keep you on your toes

Immersive first-person gameplay with a retro feel

Solve various intricate puzzles and riddles

In-depth story which expands upon itself with videos and documents.

name: WE ARE BEING HUNTED 2
summary:
WE ARE BEING HUNTED 2 is a dark, survival-horror, resource-management game set in 1690's America. Gather resources to keep your survivors alive, tend to their wounds, and sooth their broken minds. We are being hunted...

The year is 1697, in the Massachusetts Bay Colony, deep in the forest lies the small farming village of Haleford. Guilt still weighs heavily on the minds of the colonists, a grim reminder of the witch trials just years before... Just as life begins to return to a state of normalcy, Haleford is attacked in the dead of night by something unexplained...

As the sun rises, a bleak sight is revealed... 

Mutilated corpses litter the ground, the smell of blood in the air, and homes covered in deep scratches. The few survivors that remain, gather in the meeting house, trying to not fall victim to the same fate... 

After all, we are being hunted too...

A bleak look into humanity - Terrible things WILL happen to your survivors in your playthrough, try your best to mitigate their suffering. No character is safe.

Gamble with your life - Do you prefer to take chances in pursuit of a greater reward, even if it means losing it all? Minigames allow you to leave with the supplies you've collected or you can keep going and risk your health, sanity, and provisions.

Death does not mean failure - An in-game progression system encourages replayability with roguelite elements. As you survive, experience is earned and you will unlock new things for returning playthroughs. Who knows what you'll unlock?

Strategize with professions - Select professions for your survivors that will allow them to collect more items, craft new ones, or survive better depending on their job. Discover new strategies to help you survive.

Low-res digital artstyle - Reminiscent of old flash games, a depiction of brutal gore drawn in a digitally painted style.

Brutal sound design - All sounds are crafted with the intention to shock, disgust, and horrify you. Realistic sounds of death and gore

《银河饭馆》(Galactic Diner) 是一款以烹饪为主题、充满欢乐迷你游戏的角色扮演游戏。探索一个遍布朋友、美食和谜团的星球，一路烹饪，问鼎银河之巅！

一款内容爆满、以烹饪为主题的角色扮演游戏，目标是赢得一场全银河系的烹饪大赛……为外星人举办的大赛！

你被突然卷入全宇宙最火爆的电视节目——《银河饭馆》的比赛中。服务顾客、探索外星世界、结交新朋友，从薄煎饼到饺子，烹饪各式美食，一路过关斩将，争夺冠军！ 

……但这真的会那么容易吗？ 

?️ 一路烹饪，问鼎巅峰！

这只是一个普通的真人秀烹饪节目……或许并非如此？与看似不可能的新伙伴们并肩作战，击败“诺瓦公司”，拯救整个银河系！

? 令人垂涎的疯狂迷你游戏

 精通超过50种独特的烹饪主题迷你游戏。在从海滩到火锅等各种主题的关卡中烹饪，与银河系最顶尖的厨师们展开生死对决！

? 探索内容丰富的奇异外星世界

银河度假村超——级——大！在游戏厅一决高下，在温泉中放松身心，在美食广场大快朵颐——或者深入地下隧道，看看你能发现什么…… 

? 把目之所及的一切都吃掉

品尝来自银河系各地的100多种不同食物和商品。你尝试得越多，就能探索度假村越多的区域！向美食家进发！

?和伙伴们打成一片

从火爆脾气的厨师“蝎子”到沉着冷静的“番茄”，你可是有很多粉丝呢。

结识幽灵、流行偶像、顶级大厨以及其他各怀秘密的客人。经营牛排馆、挫败太空黑手党，还有更多精彩内容等你发现！

name: Hanafubuki
Cyber Bay
summary:
Cyber Bay是一款2D节奏动作roguelike游戏，您可以通过摧毁僵尸和人工智能在后世界末日的世界中生存。 随着音乐的节奏战斗，升级武器和技能，探索随机生成的位置并击败老板。

Cyber Bay是一款动态的2d节奏动作roguelike游戏，您可以在其中扮演僵尸启示消耗的世界中的最后幸存者。 决定人类不配存在的人工智能导致了一场全球性的灾难。 你必须生存，对抗僵尸，提高你的技能，摧毁这个噩梦背后的AI。游戏结合了节奏游戏和roguelike游戏的元素：你需要与敌人战斗，并通过遵循决定一举一动的音乐节奏来探索世界。 每个级别都是随机生成的，白天和黑夜的周期会影响遇到的敌人和事件，创造出独特的游戏情境。％战斗强大的老板，收集资源和芯片，升级武器和能力在这个危险的世界中生存。％
主要特点：
％
节奏玩法

打击僵尸和敌人的音乐的节奏，一举一动都很重要。 
Roguelike元素

随机生成的位置和随机事件提供独特的游戏时刻。升级武器、芯片和技能，在充满危险的世界中生存。 
日夜循环

一天中的时间变化会影响世界上的敌人类型和事件。％
强大的老板

与需要特殊策略的巨型敌人作战。 
像素艺术
↑强调后世界末日мир的大气视觉风格。％
Cyber Bay

是一款适合那些喜欢快速动作，音乐节奏和百吉饼风格的硬核挑战的游戏。

name: J-Jump Arena
summary:
J-Jump Arena 是一款免费游玩的回合制淘汰派对游戏，你很可能会把自己炸飞——但保证玩得很开心！你觉得自己能在这场混乱中幸存吗？

注意！游戏服务器位于欧洲，因此许多中国大陆玩家可能无法连接在线多人模式。

我是这款游戏唯一的开发者，无法控制中国大陆的网络限制。真的非常抱歉！

跳、预测、智取！

所有动作同时发生，在这款节奏飞快、免费游玩的回合制派对游戏中展开一场彻底的混乱！这就像剪刀石头布……但加上火箭加速器！

在 J-Jump Arena 中，你要先规划动作，然后看着所有人同时出手，混乱瞬间爆发。混乱保证。 仔细预测对手的行动并灵活反应，才能撑到最后。说实话……你大概会把自己炸飞，但嘿，那正是乐趣的一半！

多种游戏模式，让你时刻保持警觉

准备好迎接疯狂挑战吧！在混乱的 Last Man Standing 模式中成为最后幸存者，或在 Deathmatch 中以最多击杀称霸战场。想证明谁是老大？挑战刺激的 1 对 1 决斗！在 消失的平台 模式中随时注意脚下——地板可不一定还在。想边跑边炸？那就试试 武器竞速！如果你喜欢炫技跳跃，寻宝模式 等着你——跳得比别人高，抢下最多宝石！

用疯狂武器释放混乱！

拥有超过 20 种武器，每一种都比上一种更离谱！用 Quacknator 9001 发动攻击——那只橡皮鸭不是爆炸，就是每回合都滑稽地膨胀。用冰冷的 Frostcore 冻住敌人，或者直接把一个 蚊子罐 砸到他们脸上——报仇超痛快。喜欢老派风格？左轮手枪、手榴弹 和 火箭筒 都已经上膛，准备好摧毁一切。不论你是战略型玩家还是“炸弹狂人”，这里都有你的混乱风格！

探索多样环境

从危险的 沼泽 到炙热的 地狱 深处，每张地图都有独特的危机与疯狂。想挑战重力？上 月球 试试低重力的疯狂吧！或在 末日废土 竞技场中挣扎求生，让辐射成为你的新好朋友。每张地图都迫使你随机应变、临场发挥，否则就等着被甩在尘土中吧。

疯狂自定义系统

解锁荒谬的装备与搞笑的外观，让你的角色成为焦点——或者笑柄。不论如何，你都会帅气登场！

特色：

简单易上手的游戏机制。

支持最多 10 名玩家的多人混战。

单人模式可与机器人练习或轻松游玩。

多种模式，乐趣不断。

解锁物品并自定义你的角色。

获得 Steam 成就，展现你的实力。

觉得自己能在混乱中活下来吗？那就证明给我们看吧，小天才！

name: Collapsed
summary:
挑战你的大脑，这是一款基于3D物理的解谜游戏。掌控大炮，利用有限的炮弹让每个关卡崩塌。运用重力、动量和逻辑，计划如何击倒每个结构，不留一物！

利用你对物理的直觉理解，挑战自己完成50个关卡，让结构崩塌，在这款解谜逻辑游戏中大显身手。

从三种炮弹中选择——普通弹、抛光弹或火球弹。

普通弹： 只是个沉重的金属块，用来轰击堡垒。

抛光弹： 以极高速度发射——非常适合对付坚固目标。

火球弹： 做你所想——点燃木材！

每个关卡包含由众多独立部件组成的结构。摧毁房屋、城堡等，通过多样关卡与构件体验崩塌快感。只要所有部件都被摧毁或落地，关卡即完成。剩余炮弹越多，得分越高！

summary:
