A rich player movement system

101+ levels across 11+ distinct worlds

Challenging platforming and intricate puzzles

Unique enemies and bosses

Several unlockable player characters

Zero microtransactions (of course)

A fantastic soundtrack featuring dozens of memorable pieces of music

The secret to immortality (results may vary)

What are you still waiting for? The world of Throwing Hands awaits!

name: TNR Battles
summary:
Infiltrate. Survive. Battle. Explore. The New Resistance is a colourful, dystopian third person shooter with fast-paced multiplayer game modes.

Revolution is Evolution.

Change is needed - but without action, there is no progress. Ask yourself, if you're looking for change, will you join the fight?

Who are The New Resistance

The New Resistance was born of necessity; from a desire for revolution; and to free a society from the tyrannies of governmental restraint.

Driven by revolution, The New Resistance are vigilantes. Distinguished by their relative strength, dexterity and speed, they strive to overhaul the system from within. Inhabiting Krupt City, they fight the very embodiment of societal structure as enforced by the Crypto-Correctional Command AKA Triple C (CCC).

Are you ready to rise up?

Play as either the Blue or Red team and fight multiple battles online, against other like-minded players.

Features (Early Access)

 Online competitive multiplayer with a team of up to 4 players

 Host and join private/public multiplayer matches

 Weapon class system (alpha)

 Character customization (alpha)

name: Notmads
summary:
你的家园是一头活生生的伴生兽。饲养它，在其背上建造，并探索世界，因为它将成为一座移动堡垒。在这款快节奏的动作角色扮演游戏中，与它并肩作战、收集资源、共同成长，游戏包含进程、制作和探索元素，可单人游玩或与朋友合作。

你的家园是一头活生生的巨兽

在其背上建造，将你的家园带往世界各地。一路战斗、收集资源，并升级你的装备、魔法和基地。

《不羁者》是一款开放世界动作角色扮演游戏，拥有快节奏的战斗、建造和战利品系统。你可以选择第一人称或第三人称视角游玩，让你的基地随你而动。

随身携带你的家园

你的巨兽将你的家园带往世界各地。你可以与它同行，或在需要时独自先行。它会一直伴随你，你也可以随时独自探索。

一个魔法家园

你的家园不仅仅是庇护所。由其核心供能，它让你能够建造魔法工作站、精炼材料，并随时调整你的配置。添加设施和防御塔，将其打造成一座移动堡垒。

无需工具即可采集

你通过魔法光束采集资源，而非斧头或镐子。随着时间推移提升它，解锁新的采集方式，并利用你找到的材料来精炼资源、酿造药剂、组合装备，以及改进你的配置。

塑造你的魔法

你是一名法师，但并非只能遵循一条道路。专注于一种风格，或融合多种风格。运用火焰、冰霜、闪电、奥术力量或物理力量，并寻找拥有不同阶级、属性和变体的法术。你的装备、专长和选择将决定你的战斗方式。

探索世界

这个世界是手工打造的，旨在让你按照自己的节奏探索。你将遇到城镇、洞穴、营地和隐秘之地，始终寻找更好的战利品、新材料和前进的下一步。

单人游玩或与朋友同乐

单人游玩或与最多5名玩家在线合作。共享同一头活体巨兽，在同一个移动家园上建造，共同探索，并在共享世界中进步。

核心特色

在活体巨兽背上建造家园

带着你的移动基地穿越世界

以第一人称或第三人称视角游玩

在你探索时，让你的巨兽移动并跟随你

建造魔法工作站和防御工事，壮大你的要塞

使用魔法光束而非工具收集资源

随着时间推移提升你的魔法光束，解锁新用途

酿造药剂、精炼材料，并自动化基地部分功能

提升并自定义你的装备，以契合你的游玩风格

搜寻具有不同效果和强度的战利品

使用不同类型的魔法，并以你的方式组合它们

探索一个拥有城镇、洞穴和地牢的精心打造的世界

name: Flag Defense
summary:
Participate in an action loaded platformer-realtime-strategy-game. Build yourself a superior base and be prescient about the enemy's next move.

Participate in an action loaded platformer real-time strategy game. Build yourself a superior base and be prescient about the enemy's next move.

The battle currently takes place in one arena. You protect a flag, so does your enemy. It has no real value, but it should be irreplaceable for you, so be careful that the opponent doesn't knock it down! To prevent this, you build yourself a base consisting of cheap wood, until you end up with durable metal. Of course, you want to win, so you have a number of different weapons at your disposal. From light artillery to devastating missiles. If you want to play around with the unique building system or if you want to try out every weapon, the sandbox mode is the best fit!

name: Overstrike Arena
summary:
Welcome in the overstrike arena, a fast-paced competitive 2 versus 2 simulation where your only goal is to take control of the Overdrive and bring into your opponent's goal. Punch your adversaries, wall-ride, destroy and hack the various evolving arenas to get the advantage.

Overstike Arena is a fast-paced FPS competitive multiplayer game in 2 versus 2.
Your goal is to get the Overdrive at the center of the arena and bring to the opponent's goal. Cooperate with yout teammate, score 3 points before your adversary and victory is yours. 

Move swiftly through the arena with various capacities like wall-riding or the punch-rush.

The arenas in which you play change regularly over time or at your will! Modify the environnement at your advantage and adapt to get the upper hand.

The close combat is at the heart of the experience and the best user of the punch will easily send his foes out of the map.

name: Horse Club™ Adventures 2: Hazelwood Stories
summary:
Saddled, up and away! Ride together with the girls from Horse Club™ and discover a colorful world full of adventure. In Horse Club Adventures 2 – Hazelwood Stories you can plunge once again into the colorful world around Lakeside and experience adventures on horseback!

Are you ready for more adventures together? It’s autumn in Lakeside and the Horse Club™ is waiting for you! Ride off with the friends Hannah, Lisa, Sarah and Sofia and let them show you the small town of Hazelwood. The loveliest photos are wanted for a contest there – will you find the best photo motifs together and on your horses? 

It’s not so easy, but luckily you meet up with lots of friends who help you, and afterwards you can play out a wide variety of stories with them: helping out at the riding stables, taking photos of birds, finding hidden treasures – apart from the thrilling main story, diverse experiences await you, too. 

Demonstrate your skill at elegant dressage, on the dusty Western riding grounds, in fast-paced obstacle-course races, at herding stubborn livestock, or at “Pop & Gallop” while trying to improve your high score! 

Enjoy rides out in the open, lovingly designed world: Hazelwood, sunny beaches, autumn forests and dusky swamps, all the way to snow-capped mountains. 

Tend to your horse: feeding, washing, scraping out hooves or simply just an affectionate hug – your friendship and abilities will steadily grow. 

Design yourself and your horse to please you: With over a hundred unlockable pieces of clothing and customizations you can find a style all your own. 

Including completely dubbed texts in English and an original soundtrack by Winifred Phillips.

売れない俳優━━「松本リョウ」は、もうじき３０才を迎えようとしていた。
オーディションは受からない。バイトは続かない。おまけに彼女も居ない。
そんな中、松本の所属する事務所の社長から
「これからの人生、もう少し考えてみないか？」と提案され……松本は葛藤する。

夢を見ることだけなら容易い…
そして、夢を諦めることも同様。

けれど……夢を見続けることは非常に難しい……

時が経てば経つほど、取り返しがつかなくなっていく。
職歴には空欄が増え、若い才能がどんどん参入してくる。

努力をすればその分だけ、自分の才能のなさを自覚していく。

焦りの中、努力を積み重ねても“成功を掴み取らなければ”後には何も残らない━━━

それでも夢を見続けることが出来るのか。

周りから笑われても…
友人から「諦めろ」と説得されても…
親から「現実を見て働け」と言われても…

１０年間オーディションに落ち続け、脇役続きで…
自分に才能がないことを“自覚”した後でも

果たして、夢を見続けられるのか……

松本は、今、その選択を迫られる━━━

在游戏中玩得开心！如果你喜欢/接受下面的元素，可以尝试购买这款游戏：

基于卡牌的轻量级策略游戏

像素风格

故事模式时长预估 30 分钟左右, 无尽模式时长由你来定!

登山题材

isomertic 的美术风格

name: Subsequence
summary:
《子序列》是一款以探索与发现为核心的故事驱动型冒险游戏。游戏融合轻度逻辑解谜与幽默元素，玩家将操控维姬在地下实验室中揭开隐藏的秘密，试图逃离一场神秘事件的余波。

✅  游戏是什么

• ~2 小时的、自成一体的、氛围感十足的叙事体验，设计为一口气在一次游玩中通关

• 专注于探索与发现，仅包含轻量的逻辑解谜

• 极简操作 - WASD 移动，E 互动

• 轻松的基调 - 游戏不把自己看得过于严肃

 ❌ 游戏不是什么

• Subsequence 不是传统的、以谜题为主的冒险游戏

• 如果你在寻找复杂的逻辑谜题、较长的游玩时长或分支对话树，这可能不是适合你的体验

 ? 试玩版

• 提供免费试玩版，体现了正式版的基调与核心机制

• 建议佩戴耳机游玩，体验最佳

你将穿越地下研究设施、燃烧的电梯井、被水淹没的补给通道，甚至是厕所或外太空。由于一次偶然事件，女主角 Vicky 被困在地下实验室。事情迅速失控，Vicky 必须为生存而战。紧张刺激的时刻与幽默元素巧妙平衡，带来独特体验。

揭示秘密

探索神秘的地下实验室，揭开与你哥哥 Vincent 的研究相关的奇异事件背后的真相。在生存旅程中，你将克服环境障碍，解决引人入胜的谜题，并收集散落在设施中的有用物品。隐藏的收藏品等待你发现，解锁新功能并揭示更多关于 Subsequence 世界的秘密。

探索世界

探索充满活力的世界 —— 从秘密实验室和燃烧的电梯井，到未来感十足的太空船内部，以及 Vicky 温馨的家中，一只可爱的动物正在“占领”地盘

解开巧妙的逻辑谜题 —— 无论如何，千万不要穿过激光束，它会把你一分为二

收集并使用物品，克服障碍并努力生存

沉浸在深入的对话中 —— 无需任何选项选择

发现隐藏的收藏品，解锁新功能，深入了解 Subsequence 的世界

使用 WASD 键或游戏手柄，享受直观的操作体验

紧张与幽默完美结合，带来最大乐趣

始终享受乐趣

Subsequence 并不严肃，它是一段轻松的冒险旅程，没有高难度谜题 —— 只需享受旅程，最重要的是：玩得开心！

游戏操作

使用 WASD 键移动，E 键互动，或使用你喜欢的游戏手柄。互动区域标识清晰，无需像素级搜索。任务目标显示在屏幕左上角，完成后即可进入下一个区域。

name: Dickie A Cumming: The Prequel (Part I)
summary:
Anti-woke pornographic visual novel where your choices matter! This animated 'choose your own adventure' uses animation, audio effects, visuals, voice and text. Scenes present up to four choices, each opening a unique branch. This is how visual novel meets open-world like never before seen!

From the author who brought you the critically acclaimed paperback book, "Dear Celebrity", comes an altogether different beast as he turns his talents toward the digital medium of visual novel...

Snowflake Warning

If you are easily offended, please be advised this is not the game for you. It is widely anticipated to become the most controversial game on Steam!

Overview

In this star-studded third-person interactive visual novel, you play Dickie A. Cumming; a decorated war hero who has recently been discharged from the British army. As Dickie, you must come to terms with a new life on 'civi street' and a brave new world of 'wokeness', 'social justice warriors' and 'cancel culture'.

But Dickie is rather an old-fashioned chap who will struggle to understand these new concepts. As he naively grapples with this new era and the challenges it presents, Dickie inevitably comes into conflict and encounters hostile resistance. And, as if things weren't complicated enough, he finds himself afflicted with a severe sex addiction!

This is an erotic comedy that refuses to take itself (or the craziness of modern Western culture) too seriously! It represents the author's (often flawed) attempts to understand what is a rapidly changing political and societal landscape.

Real influence - your decisions will truly influence the story. Up to four choices may be presented in a typical scene and each may lead to a new branch of the story.

Dynamic and animated scenes - many scenes feature moving images, special effects and animations.

3D Sex - most of the many sex scenes are presented in 3D and animated (with audio).

name: words
summary:
A slow-paced, story-driven, first-person game that offers an abstract and surrealistic exploration of a troubled mind in its journey towards acceptance.

"words are potent weapons for all causes, good or bad."

- Manly Hall

Step into the mind of a troubled artist as she discovers her relationships and responsibilities to accept her role in a tragic death.

 Discover a mysterious and mature story that rewards exploration and interpretation.

 Solve unique puzzles that represent relationships and an emotional journey.

 Explore grim and claustrophobic environments filled with small details.

'words' is a story-driven puzzle game where you will explore various interior environments that reflect the theme of the narrative. While exploring, you will also solve diverse puzzles that are directly linked to the theme of the story.

Each time you open a door, there will be new environments and puzzles with unique challenges waiting for you. The abstract, surrealistic, and symbolic approach to storytelling will require you to pay close attention to small details scattered around the environment along with puzzles and their solutions to uncover a dark mystery.

name: DownTheDead
summary:
DownTheDead is a zombie horror first-person shooter that takes place in a once-secret government research facility. Get armed, and get out alive!

Introduction to DownTheDead
DownTheDead is a first-person shooter (FPS) game that places players in a high-stakes scenario: an outbreak in a government research facility. As the player, you must navigate through the facility, uncover the truth behind the research, and ultimately prevent a zombie apocalypse from sweeping the globe.
Gameplay and Progression
In DownTheDead, players find themselves waking up in an unfamiliar room with no memory of their past or the facility’s purpose. Armed with only their wits, players must explore the facility, encountering various threats and obstacles. As they progress through the game’s multiple chapters, players will discover more about their character’s background and the events leading up to the outbreak.

The game emphasizes danger and discovery, with new threats lurking around every corner. Players must rely on their keen eye and quick reflexes to stay alive and uncover the truth behind the research. Along the way, players will also need to find and equip weapons to defend themselves against the ever-present danger.
The Demo and Game Features
To experience DownTheDead for yourself, download the free Demo and dive into the action. The game offers a variety of features to enhance the player’s experience, including a gripping story, intense action, and a suspenseful atmosphere.

As players advance through the game, they will encounter various challenges and puzzles that must be solved to progress. Additionally, the game features a dynamic difficulty system that adjusts to the player’s performance, ensuring a challenging and engaging experience throughout.

name: Milf Toys 2
Radon Break
summary:
Radon Blast is a classic Brick Breaker style game. Break bricks by using the ball. Get items like speed, ball splitter and paddle resize to make the game more challenging. Some specials like gun, power ball or block wall helps you while playing your game. 

Radon Blast is full packed with randomly sorted stages. Jump from stage to stage, collect bonus items for a better higher score.

Features

 40 action stages

 Retro game play with a modern twist

 Clean 3D graphics and nice effects

 Stunning chip tune enhanced music track

 Specials Items: paddle resize, power ball, speed, glue, gun, ball splitter

 Bonus Items: block wall, extra score, next level, extra ball

Gameplay Description
When you start the game, you see a playfield full of colored bricks, a ball and a paddle which you can move up/down with the gamepad.
Within the playfield, there is the current stage and your ball count. Below you can see the current score.

The player must break the bricks by using the ball. By moving the paddle up and down, the player must try to keep the ball in the current playfield.
The goal is to remove all bricks from the playfield to go to the next stage.

Depending on the collision angle between the ball and the paddle, the ball direction can be changed. While playing, the speed increases and the game will become more challenging. Hidden Items like speed, ball splitter and paddle resize to make the game more challenging. Some specials like gun, power ball or block wall helps you while playing.

name: One Last Memory - Reimagined
summary:
One Last Memory is an emotional story-driven 3rd person exploration game with a lot of adventure game elements. You re-discovers your own past and lost memories on this incredible journey through the nature while also exploring the sad background story and fighting your own inner demons and fears.

One Last Memory is an emotional story-driven 3rd person exploration game that heavily utilizes adventure game features. You play as an unknown man who re-discovers his own past and lost memories on his journey through the beautiful and diverse nature. On your way you will not only explore the intense and sad background story of the protagonist but also fight against his literally materialized fears. 
A great combination of a relaxing exploration and an exciting adventure game filled with joyful, sad and breathtaking moments awaits you.
What should expect to find in the game?

 A heart-breaking story 

 A Journey through all 4 seasons 

 A ton of secret locations that only a careful explorer will discover

 Collect life energy to fight against your materialized fears 

 Surreal elements like giant toys that are references to the story are hidden along the way 

 A giant underground cave system full of surprises and little environmental riddles

 Many small events, like an exciting boat ride or a maze build out of elevators are waiting for you

 A story filled with twists and emotions

 And a lot more…

name: 湖畔往事
summary:
以穿越为主线的架空世界剧情向单机RPG游戏，开放世界，轻度肉鸽及轻度赛博。支持键盘及鼠标操作。未来可能的开发方向包括开放世界玩法及塔防、建造、生存以及社交元素。三个时空场景中，基于现实世界的场景来自于真实存在的现代都市--杭州，亦想成为宣传这个美丽东方都市的载体。

·游戏介绍
富二代刘川在西湖边遛狗，突然遇到了奇怪的天象，天降火雨
他与一名中二少年一起，穿越到了1134年的南宋
在那里，他们遇见了生命中最重要的女孩
也开启了一场未知且浪漫的时空之旅
无数的时空相互交织，但都指向了一个方向
曾经幻想中的巨龙，亦出现在了战场上
等待主角们的，是一场无处可逃的宿命

·游戏特色
·主线故事大约10个小时。从令人魂牵梦绕的南宋盛世，
到繁花似锦的现代都市，再到充满科幻色彩的未来都市，
主角一行人冲破时间的枷锁，为了人类共同的命运而战

·故事纯属虚构，但是结合了部分中国历史人物加以改编
现代世界部分尽可能还原天堂杭州的风貌
南宋和未来都市则充分发挥想象力

·像素风格的剧情向RPG游戏，带有轻度的肉鸽及赛博朋克的元素
·狗子和猫咪会不断加入游戏
·巨型缝合怪，你可以在任何地方发掘到作者埋藏的彩蛋
·后续可能加入种植、建造、派系、开放世界玩法

name: REMOTE LIFE 2: Fearless
summary:
《遥远的人生2》是一款科幻动作游戏。与可怕的外星人作战并逃离怪物蜂巢。在第一款“Remote Life”游戏大获成功后，现在您可以享受到更多疯狂的武器、炫酷的车辆以及马里奥·马拉格里诺杰出而独特的艺术。

该游戏是一款动作平台游戏，拥有许多武器和多种车辆，您可以使用它们来完成每个关卡。
关卡设计不是线性的，因此您必须发现可以解锁门和武器的物品。
每个级别的 15 个任务，包含许多要战斗的敌人、一个中型 Boss 和一个巨大的最终 Boss。您可以只使用键盘，也可以使用键盘和鼠标（瞄准），或使用游戏手柄。每种模式都给你不同的游戏感觉。

name: Potato Arena
summary:
Potato Arena is a Party Game in which you are playing with total of 4 players. Lots of fun and challenging parkour maps are waiting for you to discover and overcome! Grab your keyboard or favourite gamepad, and join the party!

Fun and challenging minigames are waiting for you and your friends. Play and compete to destroy your friends in this unique collection of minigames. This game is a "Multiplayer Party Game". You can play local and online multiplayer. Against 3 of your friends! And offline against Bots.

Gameplay Mechanics: Unique gameplay mechanics in each arena ranging from football to dogfighting in air.

Co-op & Online Competitions: Dive into a series of challenges and uniquely created parkours with 3 of other potatoes online. Compete in leaderboards!
Challenge your friends, Earn higher points. Became the best in the world.

Competitive & Cooperative: Mostly you will find yourself alone among other players; however there will be a map that you should work with your teammate to win! Also don't forget the old saying: "Enemy of my enemy is my friend!"

Customizable Character: Isn't playing with same outfit again and again boring? You will be able to change your clothes and exhibit your sense of fashion to other players!

Note: Local Multiplayer game mode is only possible with multiple controllers.

name: 暗花夜綻
summary:
《暗花夜绽（NOIR BLOOM）》是一款张力迸发的2D枪武动作游戏，在肾上腺素飙升的枪战与招招碎骨的近身搏杀之间，谱出一部新黑色狂想曲。 你为一个承诺，踏上一场疾速戮途——快拳、夺枪、挟敌反制。每一次出手，都是枪火与鲜血交织而成的精密杀戮之舞。

" 孤胆疾行闯龙潭，枪火交错舞生死。"

暗花已开，至死方休
那个点燃你残破人性的女孩，被黑帮巨擘无情夺去。

为了她，你将再次化身「白头鬼」，清算过往的血债。

这里没有英雄的故事，只有久荣的血色诗篇。


血光四溅，瞬息决断
以双拳铁腿开局，夺敌之枪破局，挟敌反制收局。

将缜密精算的脑内杀阵，舞成现实的枪血芭蕾。


东洲龙目，不夜之城
厦影林立，霓虹交烁，罪恶与欲望在「久荣」这座东洲巨城肆意滋长。

夜奔于城寨、闹市及华厦之间，在荣城的烟火气中——殊死搏杀。

name: Bunker 2322
summary:
A visual novel in a post-apocalyptic setting. Find out what happened to humanity, traveling through the deserted world in search of the main character's family.

"Bunker" is a visual novel set in a world where human civilization has been almost completely destroyed.

The main character wakes up from cryosleep in a secret bunker. She doesn't remember anything about herself or what happened to the world. 

Explore the deserted land, meet the few survivors, find the family of the main character!

In this adventure you are waiting for:

Multiple endings

Multi - faceted characters

The developed world

A melancholic story about the search for loved ones

Illustrations in a unique author's style

name: Drifter's Tales
summary:
Drifter’s Tales will fulfill needs of adventures for board & narrative games lovers thanks to its unique cards / board combination. In this game, your decisions and actions determine the outcome, but with the added excitement of collectible cards that give you unique abilities and strategies.

Drifter’s Tales will fulfil needs of adventures for board & narrative games lovers thanks to its unique cards / board combination. Imagine a story-driven game where your decisions and actions determine the outcome, but with the added excitement of collectible cards that give you unique abilities and strategies.

Our game immerses you in a rich dark fantasy world with a compelling plot, while also challenging you to build the ultimate deck and outsmart your opponents. Whether you're a fan of story-driven games or strategic card games, Drifter’s Tales has something for you.

Join us on this journey and see where your choices will take you.

No random enemies with endless gameplay, only strategy.

Battle against your opponents using dark creatures, great artifacts & deadly spells! Each enemy has it’s own patterns you have to memorize to ensure you victory. Your cards have its own strength, defense and capacity that you will have to chose carefully. Put and move them on a board to reach your enemy!

Well, it’s not yet another endless roguelike.

During your journey you will travel in strange world through seven stories, inspired by game books (yes, we love Lone Wolf & Fighting Fantasy). But it's not as easy as it is: the total of stories that you can experience is doubled, because your choice between each story determines where you will go next!

Passing the night in a cave, going through a temple or running out of a village are some stories you can fully live in Drifter's Tales. Each story as uniques mechanics and surprises!

Here you won’t Have 1500+ useless cards.

We offer you 80 cards, each one is unique, with the possibility to customize them with 10 different modifiers.

name: Glory's Fools
summary:
A retro RPG set in the mythic Age of Greece. Find allies, choose your path to glory, fighting monsters, men, or even Gods and become a true hero!

Long ago, in the dawn of man, before the world could be shaped as it is today, the path to becoming a legend was laid bare for all comers. Monsters freely roamed the land and the Gods gave blessings daily. Truly, it was a hero’s haven, if you knew where to go. Recently, there have been tales of a true monster god roaming the land, Medusa. She is said to have the ability to turn anyone foolish enough to challenge her to stone. Are you foolish enough to test this tale? Or will you let glory slip from your grasp?

Featuring:

A diverse cast of quirky characters with unique dialogue based on how you play the game!

Hours and hours of gameplay

Dozens of dungeons to explore filled with mythic beasts, spirits, and slimes.

Multitudinous spells, armor, and weapons to find and master throughout the game 

Over 100 enemy types! 

Multiple endings based on your decisions!.

name: Mara's Quest
summary:
Take command of Mara's Mercenaries in this turn-based isometric strategy game. Guide your party across 20 levels of combat, facing enemy soldiers, orcs, undead, and worse. Outfit your party with nearly 400 different pieces of equipment to come out victorious. Create and share your own maps.

Take command of Mara and her group of mercenaries as they battle their way across the land. Mara leaves everything behind to find her missing husband after he is possessed by a mysterious artifact and attacks her, leaving her for dead. On her quest to find her missing husband, Mara soon finds herself intertwined in a much larger scale conflict involving a kidnapped prince and an ancient monster. Guide Mara and her party of mercenaries across 20 levels of combat against enemy soldiers, orc troops, undead forces, and more in this turn-based isometric strategy game. Grow your party size up to 14 characters all with their own 6 unique abilities and roles. Equip them with over 320 different weapons, 40 sets of armor, and 30 trinkets. When not playing through the campaign, create your own maps from scratch using the map editor. Share your maps with other players and play through other player created maps.

name: Haunted Hotel: The Thirteenth Collector's Edition
summary:
No good deed goes unpunished…

Elephant Games cordially invites you to visit another sinister Haunted Hotel!

An act of kindness has unspeakable consequences in this exhilarating hidden-object puzzle adventure game! After pulling over to help a stranded motorist, you are murdered, and the killer kidnaps your son! Follow them to the dilapidated Baker’s Hotel, where you’ll soon learn that that roadside encounter was in fact a trap set specifically for you. But who set the snare? And why are they obsessed with wiping out your family? Investigate from beyond the grave to learn the answers!

This is a special Collector’s Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:

• Continue your father’s quest to defeat the Sons of Dusk in the bonus chapter!
• Replay HOPs and mini-games, and earn achievements.
• Find collectibles to gain access to the secret room!
• Enjoy original art, soundtrack, and other extras!
• Never get lost with the helpful strategy guide.

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

name: HoopsFPS
summary:
HoopsFPS is a first person multiplayer basketball game. You take control of the player from the first person perspective and play head to head with your friends. This game is meant for those of you who like basketball games but want a more casual and fun experience.

HoopsFPS is a first person basketball game where you play head to head against friends and strangers. Attempt to score, steal and dribble across the court without the enemy team stealing the ball from you. It is a first person take on a regular basketball game. In future iterations we would like to add a campaign and bots ranging in difficulty, though the game as it stands is a online multiplayer experience.

We are in the process of growing the online community. Indie multiplayer games tend to have a smaller player base and require time to build that base up.

Join the "HoopsFPS Games" to find games easier.

name: The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle
summary:
Hired to babysit in a strange house, you soon realize nothing is normal. The baby is a doll, the silence feels heavy, and mirrors reveal a figure that doesn’t belong. A psychological horror experience focused on tension, puzzles, and atmosphere.

THE CHAPUT'S CHURCH

The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle is a first-person psychological horror game set in a remote countryside house, where you are hired to babysit under strange and unsettling circumstances. What begins as a quiet night quickly turns into a disturbing experience, as the environment feels wrong, the baby behaves unnaturally, and a silent presence seems to watch from reflections and shadows.

As Samantha, you must explore the house and its surroundings, piece together fragmented information, and survive a night filled with tension, paranoia, and fear. The game focuses on atmosphere and slow-burn horror rather than combat, encouraging players to observe, hide, and make sense of unsettling events through environmental storytelling.

The world is small but interconnected, gradually opening up as the story unfolds. Each new area deepens the sense of dread, revealing subtle contradictions and disturbing details that challenge what you believe is happening. Mirrors, sounds, and unexpected encounters play a key role in building tension, while a mysterious figure known as the Raincoat Man looms over the experience.

Inspired by classic psychological horror and PSX-era aesthetics, The Raincoat Man: Chaput’s Cradle delivers an intimate and unsettling journey where fear is created through suggestion, silence, and uncertainty rather than constant confrontation.

Key Features

Psychological Horror Experience
A slow-paced, tension-driven horror game focused on atmosphere, paranoia, and emotional discomfort.

First-Person Gameplay 
Explore environments from a first-person perspective, enhancing vulnerability and spatial awareness.

Stealth-Oriented Survival
No direct combat — survive by hiding, avoiding threats, and carefu

name: Office Elevator
summary:
Today might be just a regular workday, or you might end up in a complete alternative reality. Office Elevator is a survival horror game with puzzles that takes place in a dark universe.

STORY

Your boss has just asked you to go grab some coffee powder for the office, but your plans might take a turn for the worse.
There were rumors regarding people disappearing in this building right after taking the elevator, but somehow the cameras could never register what really happens, they just turn off. Are you able to find out what has been happening to these people and save them?
WILL YOU BE ABLE TO SAVE YOURSELF AS WELL?
GAMEPLAY

- Office Elevator focuses on solving puzzles and exploring a dark office building.
- Walk through this world while being chased by an unnerving monster, and having to hide and dodge him to to survive.
- Get items like keycards, screwdrivers or keys to interact with objects and puzzles and find a way out of this place.
- Talk to NPCs and replay the game to further understanding the connections.
FEATURES

- The game uses retro 3D graphics to recreate a 90's/2000's game, with low poly models, pixelated textures and VHS effects.
- A very interesting short and linear storyline.
- There are clues and puzzles to be solved in order to progress through the linear storyline.
- Get ready for a dark ambience, constant tension and stress.

name: Largescale Warfare alpha
summary:
Large scale PVP First person/third person shooter, upto 32 players on massive maps with loadouts, tanks, helicopters and more!

Largescale Warfare is a first-person and third-person shooter that is set slightly in the future, ongoing wars between nations has split the world in half. You will battle it out in large 32 player games set around the world, From deep forests to white out snow bases. They'll be plenty of weapons to choose from and a large supply fo vehicles. 

Teamdeath Match
This original and well loved gamemode will make up most of the battling you'll do on Largescale Warfare, With two teams fighting over who gets the most kills.

Conquest large
This gamemode will be added in the near future, Where two teams will fight to capture points on the map, Controlling teams will bleed tickets from the other team in order to win the game, Vehicles and large scale maps will make up this gamemode.

Deathmatch
Built on smaller maps where you'll fight it out in 16 player free for all. Most kills will win the game when the timer drops to zero.

Please note that Largescale Warfare is in early access, Everything is subject to change!

name: Cowboy Hell
summary:
Cowboy Hell is a top-down, bullet hell shooter following a recently deceased cowboy and his horse as he adventures through a vibrant open world. Shoot cows, dodge bullets, collect guns, solve puzzles, and befriend characters as you work towards defeating Jeff Bezos himself!

After The Cowboy is killed in a duel, he wakes up in a western-themed underworld.
Cowboy Hell is a top-down shooter and adventure game. Explore a densely packed world full of challenges and collectibles. Talk to friends, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and defeat multiple varied bosses. Build your munitions and skills as you work up towards defeating the final boss and main overlord of hell, Jeff Bezos!

Key Features

Explore the world how you want! Some sections are more linear, but most of the world can be explored in your own order!

Difficult action! Some fights, puzzles, minigames, and sections aren't as casual as they first appear!

Collect coins and buy more gear in the Hell Shop™ (including fancy boots and soylent), and find new and unique items around the map!

Solve puzzles with the unique lasso! Use it to pull levers and blocks from a distance, maybe enemies too.

Fight Jeff Bezos (very hard). He has like, 4 stages

We don't take ourselves too seriously. Prepare for silliness and just like, have fun! alright nicee

P.S. send your horse to heaven <3

name: Bard Trainer
summary:
After her father goes into hiding due to massive debt to the local mob, a bard has to take over the family tavern and pay back the debt. The game contains turn-based tactics and graphic sexual content with animated adult scenes.

A young bard gets into trouble when her father disappears and leaves her with a massive amount of debt with the local mob. Desperately to protect her father, the bard offers to pay back the debt through the tavern her father left behind. Having helped her father her whole life with the tavern, along with being a skilled bard, she manages to convince the mobster boss of giving her a chance. Of course, running a tavern alone isn't easy, and it's especially not easy with the debt having over her head as well as well as the mob. Will she be able to save her tavern and father? Will she be able to save herself from the mob?

Game contains VN style plot progression paired with turn-based tactics where the player serves the needs of the customers while combatting their complaints.

The game also contains graphic sexual content with animated adult scenes.

name: Planet Conqueror
summary:
Planet Conqueror is FPS science fiction game where you have to collect minerals exploring different planets. The main goal in the game is to upgrade your gear up to be able to defeat the Alien boss. Each planet generates randomly, making the possibility to explore 10 000+ different planets!

Planet Conqueror is FPS science fiction game where you have to collect minerals exploring different planets. The main goal in the game is to upgrade your gear up to be able to defeat the Alien boss. Each planet generates randomly, making the possibility to explore 10 000+ different planets! Also, the side quest is to find the 3 lost astronauts.

In the random planets, you can find 5 different minerals which could be sold.

-coal

-sodalite

-emerald

-ruby

-gold

Each mineral is higher in value.

In the space stop, you can upgrade your gear to make exploring the planet easier. In the space stop you can upgrade:

-movement speed

-jump height

-laser power

-mineral drop rate

-ultimate powers

-space ship fuel

Be careful because on each planet there is a chance of aliens! By dying on the planet you will lose half of your minerals.

Also, you can Conquer the planet by raising the flag in a certain spot.

You can play 2 challenges and submit your score to Steam leaderboards.

- 20-minute planet conquer challenge (Conquer as many planets in 20 minutes)

- 20-minute mineral challenge (Collect as many minerals in 20 minutes)

Also, you can submit your total conquered planets and mined minerals score to Steam leaderboards.

name: 一念成仙
summary:
《一念成仙》是一款很难的游戏。在无数次的失败之后，您有可能尝到一次成功的喜悦。

《一念成仙》是一款以滚轴转动、随机出现、组合增益为基础玩法的，需要您的大局观、明智判断和过人的运气，才能继续修仙的漫漫长路。

游戏特色

幸运：每次修炼转动后都能获得随机不同的道具，每次渡劫成功能随机抽取各种强力法宝！所以也许提高增加高品质物品概率是个不错的主意

策略：根据自己已有的道具和法宝，作出当前最合适的选择，才是最优策略

成仙：不断的获取更好更合适的道具和法宝，才能在修炼的道路中砥砺前行

name: Wirm
summary:
Take a worm on a tiny adventure through this delightfully wiggly physics platformer :)

Wirm is a delightful physics climbing game about being a worm on a tiny adventure.

Use your soft squishy body to wiggle over obstacles.

Monch your way through the dirt, and find hidden objects underground.

Bring your friends and wiggle together in local multiplayer, or online through Steam's Remote Play Together!

hello there i am a wirm

come with me and watch me squirm

i would eat through dirt all day

climb rock, find shell, that's how we'll play

bring your friends — they'll be wirms too!

nice day for me and fun for you

:)

name: Memory Novel - Mile High Club
summary:
Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of 2 flight attendants on a private jet. Flip two cards, and if the words on them match, they will be removed from the board, revealing a unique image. All words are popular airport codes.

Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of 2 flight attendants on a private jet, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.
Flip two cards, and if the words on them match, they will be removed from the board, revealing a unique image.
All words are popular airport codes.

Features:

12 different adult images to reveal.

Cards are shuffled randomly at each game, for maximum replay value.

Timer, to see how long it takes to solve a puzzle

Gallery where you can view all the puzzle images you have solved.

Relaxing music.

Be among the fastest players to achieve a top spot in our Leaderboards and unlock various achievements.

name: Pinzzo
summary:
Pinzzo is a minimalist pixel art casual puzzle game where you need to rotate the obstacles correctly and shoot the ball that is in the cannon. Its objective is to find the trajectory that the ball will have to go through, to collect the key and open the portal to the next stage.

Have fun with a pixel art puzzle game. and minimalist with 100+ levels.
Play and discover all the paths the ball will take to pass the level.

Click on the cannon to shoot the ball.

To rotate the obstacles just click exactly on top of them.

You need to place all the platforms correctly, if not, the ball might get lost on the way. One click can make a difference!!!!

You will have several challenges throughout the game.

Not everything always follows a single path, sometimes if you think a little more, you can find other paths.

name: 驯龙物语
summary:
《驯龙物语》是一款治愈系，新生代轻策略回合制游戏，玩家作为“驯龙师”被召唤前来，邂逅冒险伙伴，育成可爱萌宠，共战七罪暗王…展开一场充满友情与治愈的奇幻异世界冒险之旅！游戏在丰富的宠物系统基础上还添加了伙伴羁绊系统、坐骑技能和翅膀系统。让玩家以更轻松的状态，体验爽快的回合策略玩法。

【游戏特色】
1. 真正的回合制战斗
- 回合制策略战斗，战斗过程实时计算，你在战斗过程中的每一次操作，都将真实的影响最终结果
- 独立AI，每个士兵有自己完全独立的AI计算攻击、移动等动作，更真实的体验

2. 还原最经典的回合制控制和操作
- 多种操作回合制的经典操作实现，编组， Hold和Attack模式，包围与集火，堵路口与绕后战术，手动施放英雄与兵种技能！
- 灵活的分组控制，你可以对每种生物/士兵进行单独编队和控制！
- 远程与近战，法师与物理，输出与控制，你需要精细的操作，才能在战斗中大获全胜

3. 多种玩法
- 以回合制为核心玩法，我们实现了多种经典的回合制衍生玩法
- 击杀BOSS、随机地下城、护送玩法、塔防玩法、推水晶玩法、无尽模式……
- 更多玩法类型，即将推出

4. 策略性成长
- 花更多的钱和时间，固然会使你变得更强，但我们认为这缺乏游戏乐趣
- 游戏中隐藏了很多炼金的知识与魔法关联，更多的探索与交流可以让你花更少的资源，变得更强
- 通过神秘的炼金术，收集游戏中的资源，解锁新的魔法种族的生物

VR Archery is an exciting fast paced arcade / shooting gallery style game that delivers on a truly immersive approach to experiencing archery in virtual reality.

Please note:

This is an indie (independent/solo) developer game, so the level of quality and graphics is lower than that of most commercial games. Your feedback and bug reports are strongly appreciated and will quickly be used to make this a better game.

Play through several arcade style shooting galleries, after completing a tutorial level that will guide you through the basics of how to play VR Archery.

This game also features a defence (capture the flag style) level, and a practice level.

name: Souldead
summary:
地狱觉醒唤醒了你。 穿越不同的世界，抓住地狱弥赛亚，夺回从你身上被夺走的东西。 死灵（Souldead）是一款快节奏具有现代风格游戏玩法的黑暗奇幻FPS射击游戏。

两百年来，你的尸体已安息，被魔法深深地封印住，你周围的一切都被诅咒了。但是那个叫做地狱弥赛亚的人来了，带走了你死去的邪恶灵魂的最后一块。 了解对方。

弥赛亚知道他不是唯一的存在。

跟随敌人，杀死成群的对手，摧毁你所到之处的一切。 碰见你后，回到地狱则是一种解脱。

你已不再是人了。
你不想再这样了。 使用魔法燃烧敌人，从高处跳到他们身上，以各种方式将他们送回死亡世界。

- 他是你要佩服的人。

但他还不知道。

认识死灵（Souldead）。

死灵（Souldead）是一款非常注重动作和探索的第一人称射击游戏。水平和垂直攻击，并从上方进攻敌人，使用魔法践踏地面，将恶魔送回地狱。 跳上壁架并使用你的魔法向对手投掷物体并摧毁墙壁，在墙后通常会有奖励。

在周围搜索故事项目，你可以使用其创建下一个位置的钥匙。

主要特点：

- 新游戏机制快速动作
- 充满神秘地点的美丽环境
- 探索元素和时间旅行游戏
- 探索古老的黑暗城堡，消灭罗马成群的敌人，探访维多利亚时代的英格兰
- 前所未见的武器

name: Drifting Kings
summary:
漂移之王(Drifting Kings)是一款风格化的街机离线/在线漂移/盘山公路/竞技赛车游戏, 在俯视角视图中拥有丰富多彩和风格化的环境设定. 游戏易于上手, 难于精通.

侧身驾驶的艺术
在超过14个赛道中挑战AI和网友, 其中包括最著名的惠比寿赛道组合(东部, 北部, 盘山公路, 南部, 西部).

在人与机器的终极测试中, 驾驶赛车冲进蛇行下坡地形
受日本山路启发, 拥有6多个标志性地点(富士, 赤城, 妙木等)

在终极的竞技场比赛中, 尽可能快地调整赛场布局.
30多个具有挑战性的地形布局, 这你和你的机器与时间的抗衡, 快速驾驶, 避免撞到障碍物,但要记住赛道布局

每种模式都有自己的赛车. 根据你的需要找到最好的那一个.

通过照片模式展示你的虚拟摄影技能.

在单人职业模式漂移/山路赛中挑战AI, 并收集所有点数.
在单人职业竞技场模式下挑战自我, 收集所有点数并在排行榜上击败其他玩家.

游戏有支持控制器和方向盘控制, 允许在游戏中手动更改按钮映射.

name: Auto Cast
summary:
Auto Cast combines elements from action rogue-likes, RPGs, and Shoot 'Em Ups into a 2D top-down world. Unlock new spells, level up existing ones, equip unique items, and find special events to maximize your chances of survival while cutting through hordes of enemies and bosses.

Spells
Unlock and master various self casting spells with unique talents and masteries to slay the horde of never ending enemies!
Bosses
If the hordes weren’t enough, your increase in power attracts formidable foes. These bosses will way the hero down with powerful debuffs, dispatch them quickly, before you become overwhelmed.
Items
In efforts to aid your journey, chests with build defining items have been scattered across the lands. Anvils can also be found and used to forge ancient relics, which can be activated for boosts in power.
Talents
Defeating bosses garners the attention of Soul Forgers who will mend the hero’s fragmented soul and grant boons, but beware, the being that stole it in the first place still roams the lands.
Unlocks
Failure is still progress towards success. Unlock new spells, items, and more as you gain prestige. Coins can also be spent in the shop to boost the hero’s power, or to further line your pockets.

Can you make it past level 35?

name: Madville+
summary:
Madville+ is a rogue-lite / arena shooter with ridiculous upgrades. It is designed to have short play sessions (30-40 min) and replayability.

Madville+ is a rogue-lite / arena shooter with ridiculous upgrades. 

Upgrade your character with cards and combine different decks to boost their effects!

Game is designed to have short play sessions (30-40 min) and replayability. 

7 unique classes with different abilites:
 ---> Bouncer, Carpenter, Scientist, Farmer, Survivalist, Gambler, Indie Game Developer!
- Lots of guns
- Lots of add-ons for your guns
- Lots of passive effects
- Lots of aliens
- Lots of dice and random effects
- Ridiculous challenges

Game includes an auto-aim&shoot toggle, so you can play it like a straight twin-stick shooter or a more modern/casual arena survival game.

summary:
Joshua's Legs is a unique game with devious controls about a two-legged arachnid hoping to find his long lost prosthetic legs collection. Venture in a world that will only reveal its secrets to the true hardened climbers.

Learn the elegant art of spider acrobatics in this curious game in which you control a two-legged arachnid with your joysticks. Try to stay zen while surmounting some of the hardest obstacles ever encountered by a spider. Achieve absolute finesse, precision, speed, and consistency in order to find all of Joshua's prostheses.

Rewire your brain
 Crawl, climb, and jump like a biped. Control the legs individually with the joysticks. Will you be able to learn how to control this cutie? 

Explore a mysterious lair
 Explore the lair however you want and at your own pace. You can follow the linear path or branch off to discover mysterious areas and secrets. 

Unlock new skills
 Find prostheses to unlock new skills, dragonflies to trade at cloning centers and spider webs to increase your web shooter capacity. Learn to jump, climb, and shoot webs to swing or prevent free fall. Discover new secret areas with your improved reach.

Test your skills 
 You will need speed, finesse, precision, and consistency to reach the final climb, which is procedurally generated and always different with each try.

Long playtime 
 Learning, discovering, and finally completing the game takes about 15 to 20 hours, if you even finish it

Ominous original soundtrack 
 Listen to an original soundtrack by author Danielle Tremblay. It will help you find your inner peace around this strange world.

Controller strongly recommended

name: PARTICLE OF GOD
summary:
上帝之粒是一款末世独立RPG游戏，具有生存元素、开放世界和战术战斗。

灵感和气氛来自于《辐射》、《荒原》、《歼灭联盟》、《Kenshi》等项目。

几千年前，那些被现在的人视为神的人，对这个星球进行了地球化改造，拿走了必要的资源，然后抛弃了它。我们这个时代有影响力的人发现了一个神的机器，意识到它能给人带来什么力量和威力，也意识到它隐藏着什么技术，就把它拆开来研究。

之后，灾难性的事件袭击了世界：地震、海啸、洪水、龙卷风和冰冷的温度。无论人们如何努力抵御这场灾难，结果都是注定的。只有在有其他神的机器的地方，生命才得以生存，现在以紧急模式运作。

在其中一台机器中，一个名为 "粒子 "的协议被触发了，这是一个你将控制的人造人。在这个全新的未知世界中，如何处理坠机的后果并生存下来，就看你的了。

在游戏中等待你的是什么。

- 一个具有后发制人的火热精神的宇宙。有机会参观另一个现实的沙盒，并写下你自己的故事。

- 一个开放的、完全无缝的世界，充满了荒地、洞穴和交战派系的定居点。探索它而不被加载屏幕和边界所干扰。

- 数十种人物技能和特征。它的变化是为了适应你的游戏风格。

- 一个对你的行动有反应的活生生的世界。在不知道接下来会发生什么的情况下，你被深深地吸引到它的氛围中。

- 战术战斗系统，用于令人兴奋的近距离和远距离战斗。

- "死亡 "这个角色让你对危险有敏锐的感觉，并教你如何适应一个新的世界。

你的一举一动都有后果。每一个决定和偶遇都能改变故事的进程。你探索世界，一连串独特而令人惊讶的事件在你身边展开。

name: Unbridled: Horse Designer
summary:
You have the power to craft your ideal equine companion from head to hoof. From choosing coat colors and intricate markings to styling majestic manes and tails, the Horse Designer offers a myriad of options to bring your unique vision to life.

Unlock the artistry of horse customization with the Horse Designer, a feature within the world of "Unbridled: That Horse Game". You have the power to craft your ideal equine companion from head to hoof. From choosing coat colors and intricate markings to styling majestic manes and tails, the Horse Designer offers a myriad of options to bring your unique vision to life.

name: Fury Life
summary:
Fury Life is a Conway's Game of Life simulator where cells are visualized as animated creatures called "Octos".

Fury Life is a Conway's Game of Life (CGOL) simulator where cells are visualized as animated creatures called "Octos". The rules of the game are that: (1) Each turn an Octo produces eight seeds for its neighbours. (2) When three seeds come together a new Octo is born. (3) An Octo needs to eat at least two seeds per turn or it starves. (4) If an Octo eats four seeds it becomes overfed and explodes.

Features of the simulator:
- Create New Colony (either Blank or Random)
- Click to Add or Remove Octos to/from the colony with Flip Tool
- Pause/Play/FastForward/UltraFastForward to advance turns.
- Skip backward/forward to last turn where modification was made.
- Select groups/patterns of Octos with the Lasso Tool.
- Capture selected groups of Octos by clicking a Cage Tool
- Add a caged pattern to by clicking the board with Cage Tool selected.
- Zoom in to a few Octos on the screen or zoom out to one per pixel
- Scroll sideways/up/down - the board is infinite.
- Four load/save slots for colonies.

Experiment with different patterns and see what amazing colonies you can come up with!

name: Dance of Decapods
summary:
An arena shooter where your space insect must survive waves of enemies. Evolve to fight back with more than 30 different parts, from bio weapons to bullet enhancement.

Dive into the lore
You are a space insect that migrates to reproduce within its colony, but the journey is tough. You need to go through a special zone in space where common logic is not applicable. Asteroids follow strange patterns, and you encounter other colonies of space insects also seeking to evolve. Feast on their parts to become the most majestic insect and insure your lineage.
Quick gameplay overview
In this arena shooter, you need to survive a determined number of waves to complete a run. Your space insect is automated, firing at regular intervals, but you control the movements during the waves.

You start with a set of unlocked parts to build your insect, then get new parts when defeating enemies. Those parts drop randomly from the defeated enemy’s parts.

You manage your health through life cores. Your insect will always have at least one core, but you can earn more if you get lucky through a run. A core and all its attached parts will be destroyed if something hits it, and they are essential for your survival. 

You’ll face more complex enemies as the waves go, and the number of waves to go through to survive will increase after every completed run.
If you read until here...
The creation team is composed of 3 developers with more or less video game development experiences. We focus on delivering a simple yet interesting and fun gameplay. Hopefully, we will bring more simple and original quality games in this already diverse ecosystem.

name: Astria World
summary:
Astria world is an open world where the only limit is the imagination and where all actions have consequences. Illegal or legal, the choice is yours.

Astria World lets you choose who you want to be. Do you have more a penchant for illegality or legality? What job is for you? It will be up to you to decide. You have a multitude of choices available to you, will you be able to make the right ones?
Economy:

The economy will have a smart system to reward professions, if the player chooses a raw material profession (Miner, lumberjack..) and the stocks are low the resale price of the raw materials will be increased and therefore lowered if the stocks are full.
Jobs

illegal trades:

Buy, grow, harvest your own plants and make a profit with quality plants or use them for your personal consumption but beware the police are never far away!

legal professions:

You are an honest citizen and you want to do a job that you like without having any problems with the law, so choose from a multitude of jobs (lumberjack, miner, policeman, taxi driver, cabinetmaker, restaurateur...).
Others

Astria world will include a multitude of vehicles which will allow realistic roleplay for professions (Ambulance, taxi, gendarmerie, army, etc.) but also for the city or off-road (City car, super car, motocross, 4x4. ..).
Weapons will also be present from the smallest to the largest caliber but you will be free to use them only with a license or illegally.

The city of Astria World will include shops, different business buildings but also houses that will be on sale and that allow you to live your life and manage your character such as: changing clothes, cooking, eating, you wash and many others.

As you will have understood, Astria World is a realistic open world that you will never have seen, so join the community and start your adventure!

name: 폴라 펭귄 포스트
summary:
우당탕탕 펭귄 택배 대작전! 눈의 땅 윈터마운틴에서 택배회사로 살아남기! 펭귄들이 무사히 물건을 배송할 수 있도록 가방 안에 배송품을 요리조리 배치해보세요. 도시 사람들의 부탁들 들어주고 신뢰를 얻으세요. 윈터마운틴에서 폴라 펭귄 포스트가 자리 잡고 펭귄이 주민으로 인정받을 수 있게 도와주세요.

폴라펭귄포스트는 얼어붙어가는 도시국가 ‘윈터마운틴’에서 펭귄 택배회사 ‘폴라펭귄포스트’를 운영하는 퍼즐 시뮬레이션 게임입니다.
주인공 ‘민’은 자신의 친구 ‘펭귄’들이 윈터마운틴의 가족으로 받아들여지게 하기 위해 동생 ‘아워’와 함께 펭귄택배회사를 설립합니다.
PPP는 무엇이던 배달합니다.

PPP의 배달리스트에는 항상 많은 배달 주문이 쌓여있습니다. 배달리스트를 보고 펭귄의 가방에 올바르게 물건을 담아주세요.
배달해야 하는 물건들은 저마다 다양한 크기와 모양을 가지고 있습니다.
가방안에 몇십개던 넣을 수 있는 물건이 있는가 하면 혼자서 가방 절반은 거뜬히 차지하는 물건도 있습니다.

모든 배송품을 가방 안에 넣을 수 있도록 가방 안의 공간을 잘 활용해 주세요.
깨진 머그컵과 더럽혀진 편지를 받고 싶은 고객은 없습니다

벽돌 옆에 유리를 넣으면 유리는 깨져버리고, 낫 옆에 편지를 두면 편지가 찢어져버립니다.
석탄이나 오일 옆에 물건을 잘못뒀다간 가방안이 온통 검댕과 오일투성이가 될 수도 있습니다.
하지만 시멘트 포대 위에 담요을 둔다고 담요가 망가지진 않습니다.

이렇듯 무사히 배송을 완료하기 위해선 물건의 특징을 생각해서 가방을 싸야합니다.

아무도 깨진 유리컵을 받고 싶어 하지 않고, 펭귄들은 자기 가방에 뭐가 들어있는지 모릅니다.
다양한 거래처와 교류하세요

폴라펭귄포스트를 시험하고, 함께 연구하고, 도움을 주고받는 다양한 거래처들이 있습니다.
거래처의 부탁을 들어주며 이들에게 신뢰를 쌓으세요. 인간관계가 당신을 다양한 미래로 이끌어 갈 것입니다.
눈 내리는 윈터마운틴에서 살아남으세요

‘폴라 펭귄 포스트’의 배경이 되는 윈터마운틴은 알 수 없는 이유로 점점 얼어붙고 있습니다.
윈터마운틴의 미래는 이대로 끝나는 걸까요? 멸망해 가는 세계에서도 어딘가 유쾌한 폴라펭귄포스트의 이야기를 즐겨보세요!

name: IDF-ASD
summary:
Intense one or two player bullet hell a call back to the arcade shooters of the past.Not an easy bullet hell, but once you beat a mission the next mission stays unlocked and you can replay missions already beat to get points and parts for upgrades.

Intense bullet hell. Upgrade your ships unlock capabilities and push against difficult design. 

One or two player game with both players being on the same screen. Think of the old arcade top down shooters. 

There are a total of ten ships, you can select one of the first four when you start a new game after that the other nine can be rescued during missions. 

Ship 1 can be rescued in mission 1 ship 2 in mission 2 etc. 

There are eleven researchers that can be rescued, they unlock upgrade research that goes across all the ships.

- Speed, Fire Power, Fire Rate, Missiles, Bombs etc. 

I am designing the game so that the end missions will be close to impossible with out upgrading the capabilities of your ships.

- During beta testing mission 2, it drove me crazy because I designed it's difficulty to really push the player from what they experienced on mission 1.

Game is progress based once you beat mission 1 you get access to mission 2 etc, but secret missions 1 2 and 3 will require conditions to be met, such as beat mission 5 with out taking any red health damage.

name: Nirmita: The Fantasy Survival RPG
summary:
Nirmita 是一个充满神秘、幽默和意外发现的神话般的世界！ 生存的艰巨任务将照亮许多热闹的生物、可爱的 NPCs、各种构建、练级、制作和家居装修，以及寻找具有多个结局的主要反派的引人入胜的故事情节！

游戏的动作发生在一个特殊的魔法世界—— Nirmita ，——那里不仅有当地居民（由于某种原因都是女性），还有动物、环境物体，甚至界面细节能够与玩家交流。玩家在一个狭窄的空洞中开始他的旅程，什么都不记得，也不知道怎么做。但是与环境交流，获取食物和材料，制造工具和衣服，制作内部细节和建造结构 - 他会学到很多东西并发展成为真正的英雄。那么他就准备好揭开主要反派的身份，与他面对面
游戏特色

 7 种属性会根据所选择的动作而升级——你可以沿着力量和灵巧的道路发展，使用你的魅力，成为一名强大的魔术师……或者同时拥有这一切！

 25 种技能，通过向当地角色学习而获得，让您可以选择专攻什么，或者成为多面手。

 由于需要监控角色的饥饿程度、能量和健康状况，生存困难。每天起床的时间是有限的，你需要学习如何提前计划那些不会让你在早上饿死的行动。

 一个不同寻常的回合制战斗系统，刺激使用各种武器、药水和敌人的攻击序列。

 6 个明亮独特的地点 - 洞穴和草地、沼泽和森林、山脉和湖泊。

 5 位迷人的女性角色，她们准备教给玩家许多有用的技能，以换取新的、更显眼的服装。

 70 种（原文如此！）独特类型的对手，玩家在生存斗争中必须与之抗争。

 被击败的生物可以被驯服或杀死，被驯服后它们会获得奖励并可以用于战斗。

 通过渐进式制作系统创建的数十种不同类型的武器、建筑、药水、菜肴和设备。

 对“家”进行了许多改进，增加了装饰性和舒适性，并影响了玩家更好地放松和保持清醒的能力。

name: 永夜长安
summary:
“长夜虽苦，唯有诗篇永恒闪耀。” 长安陷落，万物凝滞。你扮演未成名的公孙大娘，以杜少陵破败的草堂为唯一据点，展开一场绝境求生——你需要深入废墟搜集诗歌残骸，亲手打造舞器以构建卡组，在资源匮乏的倒流时空中，击碎妖魔，揭开真相。

【关于这款游戏】

群星：“公孙，这件‘霓裳羽衣’竟如此之重。它上面绣的每一根金线，都嵌着一个饿死的灵魂。” 公孙大娘：“那就更应该穿着它跳，跳到这衣服变轻为止。”

公孙大娘：“少陵先生，草堂的火又灭了。”

杜少陵：“无妨。且让这漫天风雪进来吧……反正这长安城里，早已没有能被冻死的人了，剩下的都是还在喘气的鬼。”

在这座死去的城市里，你不是英雄，你是拾荒者。

你是公孙大娘。 此刻，这四个字还代表不了盛世的剑器之圣，只代表一个混迹街头、为了生存什么都肯练的野路子舞者。 长安不知何时已被阴影吞噬，街巷扭曲成怪诞的迷宫。你没有神兵利器，只有一双长满老茧的手，和活下去的渴望。

逆流而上的旅人

你唯一的路标，是一个叫杜少陵的老人。 他那间“八月秋高风怒号”的【茅屋草堂】，是这无尽长夜中唯一的避难所。 但他的时间是坍塌倒置的。你需要从凄凉晚景的草堂出发，逆着光阴的洪流向上攀爬。每一次出门探索，都是为了给这个漏风的家带回一片瓦、一碗饭。

神秘的观测者：“群星”

你并不孤单，一个自称“群星”的神秘女子始终伴你左右。 她告诉你，解开这一切诅咒的唯一方式是唤醒老者的全部回忆，用他的诗篇点亮太阳。但她不能直接出手，只能借给你的洞悉因果的眼睛，这是你在这残酷牌局中唯一的筹码。

盛世的画皮

这里的怪物，不长在阴暗的角落，而站在光天化日之下。

它们是燃烧的“祥瑞”，是披金戴银的“盛世”。 你会看到浑身喷涌烈火的神明，高歌着皇恩浩荡；你会看到满身珠光宝气的雕像，演绎着倾城绝恋。它们威严、神圣，仿佛是这漫漫长夜中唯一的救赎。

但表象越是华丽，现实往往越是残酷。 若你挥起舞器，斩碎那层不可一世的金粉与神光—— 从那破碎的躯壳里滚落出来的，究竟是什么？

【核心玩法与机制详解】

这不是一款让你爽快重来的游戏。你的每一次死亡，都意味着资源的永久流失。

?️ 生活残骸的重铸

废墟中没有垃圾，只有死去的生活。 在这座死去的城市里，探索的核心驱动力是搜集那些被遗弃的“碎片”。 回到草堂，在微弱的烛光下，你可以将这些早已被人遗忘的生活残骸，重铸为传说中的“舞器”。

万物皆为卡组： 在这里，没有固定的职业，也没有锁死的技能树。每一件舞器，都封印着一套独一无二的卡牌逻辑。 你手中的兵器，决定了你的战斗方式。当你换下手中的重兵，披上一件轻盈的羽衣，你的攻击手段、防御姿态乃至整个战术体系都将瞬间改变。

破碎的代价： 凡物皆有裂痕。舞器会随着激烈的战斗而磨损、断裂。 这是一场关于“损耗”的博弈——是透支这件兵器的最后一点锋芒去终结强敌？还是在它彻底崩坏前收手？一旦舞器破碎，你将不得不赤手空拳，直面这无尽的长夜。

?️ 资源生存

草堂不仅是家，更是需要维护的庇护所。

修补：杜少陵的茅屋在风雨中摇摇欲坠，你必须分配带回来的木材和茅草修缮屋顶，否则“家园”功能将逐渐失效，无法进行合成与治疗。

补给：食物、药品、磨刀石。每一次出门探索都需要精打细算。带多了占用背包格数，带少了可能死在半路。

? 三元舞步博弈

战斗是心理与资源的双重博弈。 你的手牌分为三种舞步属性，你需要根据“群星”的提示（预知敌方意图），打出克制的牌面：

【刚舞】：雷霆重击。克制【奇】（以力破巧）。

【奇舞】：诡谲变招。克制【柔】（撕裂防守）。

【柔舞】：卸力闪避。克制【刚】（以柔克刚）。

每一次出牌都在消耗舞器的耐久，是全力爆发还是保留实力？这是每回合都要做的决策。

? 剧情化BOSS战

你面对的不是怪物，而是被具象化的“盛世”。

【红尘驿使】

形态：它是一道永不停歇的猩红飓风，一匹生着无数条腿、血肉与机械融合的畸形骏马。它不知疲倦地在废墟中狂奔，背负着一只散发着诡异香气的“锦盒”，为了博得那云端之上的一笑，它被设定为必须踏碎沿途的一切阻碍。

质问：那锦盒里装的真是甘甜的荔枝吗？ 还是说，那是被这一路狂奔所溅起的“红尘”，凝结而成的万民血泪？

【石壕铁吏】

形态：他是一座由黑铁盔甲与囚车缝合而成的移动堡垒。他手持一本永远写不完的“功德簿”，不知疲倦地叩响每一扇紧闭的柴门。他的咆哮声中夹杂着无数老弱妇孺的哭喊，但他将其称为“为国尽忠”的荣耀合唱。

质问：当所有的“子”都变成了战场上的灰烬，这“国”还剩下什么？ 究竟是为了保卫家园而征召，还是为了填饱那战争巨兽的胃口，连这最后的喘息声都要掠夺殆尽？

【圣天子】

形态：他伫立在朱红的高墙之上，浑身散发着如烈日般的光辉。在这寒夜里，他就是行走的神迹，向世人许诺着永不熄灭的“皇恩”。

name: Jeu de Tarot
summary:
Jeu de Tarot vous permet de jouer au tarot français (le jeu de cartes), à 4 joueurs, 5 joueurs, en multijoueur ou contre l'ordi, mais aussi aux variantes à 3 et 6 joueurs, moins connues.

Jeu de Tarot vous permet de jouer au tarot français, à 4 joueurs, 5 joueurs, mais aussi aux variantes à 3 et 6 joueurs, moins connues.
Ce jeu vous propose de jouer en Tournoi et en Duplicate, en solo, ou en multijoueur en ligne.
Il est possible de chatter en jeu, et d'échanger sur le forum.
Dans le jeu, utilisez les flèches du clavier pour changer d'angle de vue.
Il est possible de chatter en jeu dans les modes multijoueurs en éloignant la vue.

Le Tarot se pratique avec un jeu de Tarot. Il se joue à 3, 4, 5 et 6 joueurs.
Le jeu de Tarot est composé de 78 cartes.
· 4 couleurs : (Coeur), (Trèfle), (Carreau), (Pique).
Chaque couleur est composée de 14 cartes.
Dans l'ordre décroissant de force et de valeur :
- le Roi, la Dame, le Cavalier et le Valet constituent les Honneurs (ou les Habillés),
- le 10, le 9, le 8, le 7, le 6, le 5, le 4, le 3, le 2, l'As.
· Vingt et une cartes portent un numéro : ce sont les Atouts (ou Tarots) qui ont priorité sur les couleurs. Le numéro indique la force de chaque Atout, du plus fort, le 21, au plus faible, le 1 (appelé Petit).
· Enfin l'Excuse, une carte marquée d'une étoile et représentant un joueur de mandoline, est une sorte de "joker" dispensant de jouer la couleur ou l'Atout demandé.

Le 21, le Petit et l'Excuse sont les 3 Oudlers (ou les 3 Bouts).
C'est autour de ces 3 cartes que s'organise toute la stratégie du jeu de Tarot.
Les annonces

L'un des joueurs, appelé le preneur ou le déclarant, sera opposé aux trois autres, les défenseurs.
La prise, qui s'appuie souvent sur l'espoir de la découverte d'un très beau chien. Appelée aussi la petite.
La garde peut être une surenchère après la prise d'un adversaire.
La garde sans le chien, le preneur estime qu'il peut réaliser son contrat sans incorporer le chien à son jeu, donc sans effectuer d'écart. Mais les points du chien lui sont comptés à la fin de la donne.
La garde contre le chien, le preneur s'engage à réaliser son contrat sans l'aide du chien dont les points seront comptés avec ceux de la défense.
Les contrats

Le preneur s'engage à atteindre un certain nombre de points en jouant seul contre ses trois adversaires. Le nombre de points minimal que le preneur doit obtenir pour remplir son contrat dépend du nombre d'oudlers (le 21 et le 1 d'atout (le petit), et l'excuse) qu'il compte dans ses levées à la fin de la partie :
Sans aucun bout, il faut 56 points
Avec un bout, il faut 51 points
Avec deux bouts, il faut 41 points
Avec trois bouts, il faut 36 points.

C'est pour cette raison que les trois bouts constituent les cartes les plus importantes du jeu, et le fait d'en posséder est un avantage considérable. Le 21, en tant que carte la plus forte, ne peut changer de camp car il est imprenable. L'excuse reste dans le même camp à condition qu'elle ne soit pas jouée dans la dernière levée, faute de quoi elle change de camp. Le petit, lui, est vulnérable puisque tous les autres atouts le battent. C'est pourquoi cette carte est très convoitée par le camp qui ne la possède pas et qui souhaite la récupérer (ce qu'on appelle la chasse au petit).
Les enchères

Le joueur placé à droite du donneur parle le premier.
S'il dit "Je passe", la parole passe alors à son voisin de droite et ainsi de suite, jusqu'au donneur.
Si les quatre joueurs passent, le voisin de droite du donneur procède à une nouvelle distribution.
Un joueur peut lancer une enchère s'il estime que son jeu lui permet de jouer seul contre les trois autres joueurs.
Il dit alors "Je prise", "Je garde", "Je garde sans le Chien" ou "Je garde contre le Chien".
Les autres joueurs, placés à sa droite peuvent éventuellement couvrir cette première enchère par une enchère supérieure.
Chaque joueur ne peut parler qu'une seule fois.
Déroulement des levées

L'entame (c'est à dire la première carte jouée) est effectuée par le joueur placé à droite du donneur, puis chaque joueur joue à son tour. À l'atout, on est obligé de monter sur le plus fort atout déjà en jeu, même s'il appartient à un partenaire. Si on n'a pas d'atout plus gros, on joue un atout de son choix. À la couleur, on est obligé de fournir la couleur demandée, mais pas de monter. Si on n'a plus de la couleur demandée, on est obligé de couper. Si on doit couper, on doit monter sur l'atout le plus fort dans la mesure du possible. On défausse (on joue une carte de son choix) si l'on ne possède ni carte de la couleur demandée, ni d'atout. Si la première carte d'une levée est l'excuse, c'est la carte suivante qui détermine la couleur jouée. L'excuse ne permet pas de réaliser une levée, mais elle reste la propriété du camp qui la détient.

Si l'adversaire gagne la levée où se trouve l'excuse, son détenteur doit la remplacer dans la levée par n'importe quelle autre petite carte (couleur ou atout) prise dans les levées réalisées par son camp. Si l'excuse est placée au dernier pli, elle est perdue par son propriétaire et elle est prise par le camp adverse.
Valeur des cartes
1 oudler (1, 21, *) + 1 petite carte = 5 points
1 roi + 1 petite carte = 5 points
1 dame + 1 petite carte = 4 points
1 cavalier + 1 petite carte = 3 points
1 valet + 1 petite carte = 2 points

2 petites cartes à la couleur ou à l'atout : 1 point
Les points

Pour gagner son contrat, le preneur doit réaliser un nombre de points minimaux nécessaires selon le nombre de bouts qu'il possède dans ses levées à la fin de la partie (en cas de garde sans le chien, un éventuel bout au chien est acquis au preneur). Si le nombre de points est exactement réalisé, le contrat est juste fait ; si le nombre de points est supérieur, les points supplémentaires sont des points de gain ; si le nombre de points est inférieur, le contrat est chuté et le nombre de points manquants correspond à des points de perte. Tout contrat valant arbitrairement 25 points, on rajoute 25 points au nombre de points de gain ou de perte.
Ce nouveau total est assorti d'un coefficient selon le contrat demandé :
en cas de prise, ce total est inchangé,
en cas de garde, ce total est multiplié par 2,
en cas de garde sans, ce total est multiplié par 4,
en cas de garde contre, ce total est multiplié par 6.
Chaque défenseur marque un même nombre de points : en négatif si le preneur gagne, en positif si le preneur chute.
Le preneur marque trois fois ce total, en positif s'il a gagné, en négatif s'il a chuté.
Coups spéciaux

Le petit au bout
Si le petit est amené jusqu’au dernier tour sans être perdu, il rapporte 10 points de plus à l’équipe ou le preneur qui le gagne et est multipliable selon l’enchère choisi.
La poignée
Un joueur possédant une Poignée peut, s'il le désire, l'annoncer et la présenter, les Atouts classés dans l'ordre décroissant, complète et en une seule fois, juste avant de jouer sa première carte. L'Excuse peut remplacer un Atout manquant mais la présentation de l’Excuse dans la Poignée implique que l'annonceur n'a pas d'autre Atout.
Poignées possibles :
- Simple Poignée (10 Atouts) : prime de 20 points
- Double Poignée (13 Atouts) : prime de 30 points
- Triple Poignée (15 Atouts) : prime de 40 points

Le chelem
Réussir un chelem signifie gagner toutes les levées.
Le Chelem se demande en plus du contrat :
- Chelem annoncé et réalisé : prime de 400 points.
- Chelem non annoncé mais réalisé : prime de 200 points.
- Chelem annoncé mais non réalisé : perte de 200 points.
Le joueur ayant annoncé un chelem obtiendra de droit l'entame de la partie, indépendamment du donneur.
En cas de Chelem, le preneur doit obligatoirement jouer l'excuse en dernier, et celle-ci prendra la dernière main.
Il peut arriver également que la défense inflige un Chelem au déclarant, dans quel cas chaque défenseur reçoit une prime de 200 points.

FIRE STATION RENOVATION is a renovator simulator for abandoned and forgotten fire stations. Buy old hovels, repaint, redecorate, clean and even build rodent traps and bring the firehouse back to life!

Buy old hovels, repaint, redecorate, clean and even build rodent traps and bring the firehouse back to life! Become a hero in one of the cities in the United States and keep residents safe.

Clean up the scrap metal and sell valuables at the junkyard.

Take on the role of a mechanic, cleaner, rodent and insect control expert, decorator, and firefighter himself, whose mission is to repair all fire trucks, check the correctness of the firefighting equipment, buy new equipment and equip the entire fire station!

Make the local community feel safe through your hard work. The game will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your skills in operating firefighting equipment while fighting dangerous fires. Roll up your sleeves and get to work, future Firefighter!
RENEW A FIRE FIGHTING HOUSE

equip the exercise room

stock the canteen

prepare a warehouse

decorate the day room

keep the whole station clean

MANAGE PEST CONTROL

investigate the problem with pests

prepare mechanical and chemical traps

get rid of the intruders

UNIQUE FEATURES

Clean the dirtiest mess that You have ever seen

Recruit Firefighters to eliminate staff shortages

Replace all broken fire engines/station equipment

Deliver energy, water and other utilities

Clean station and fire engines

name: Spellers
summary:
Spellers 是一款 2v2 的对战游戏，玩家需要通过战斗夺取区域并赢得胜利。通过在键盘上输入名字来施放法术——速度和准确度是关键 ！掌握超过 15 种法术，自定义你的魔法师，占领战场 ！

Spellers 是一款 2v2 对战游戏，玩家需要通过战斗夺取区域以获得胜利。你将使用在键盘上输入名字来施放的法术与对手作战。打字速度和瞄准准确度同样重要！游戏中有超过 15 种不同的法术可供掌握。

占领区域

在以占领区为中心的地图上，与敌方队伍展开对决。通过待在区域内来填充你的进度条！如果有一个或多个敌人进入，该区域将进入争夺状态。你必须奋战，确保只有你的队伍留在其中。

法术

通过组合超过 15 种法术来攻击或防御，占据战场优势。你可以通过在键盘上输入法术名称来施放它（当然，别打错字！）。

燃烧、下毒、致盲，甚至隐身……这些法术都将帮助你赢得战斗！

魔法衣橱

用在战斗中解锁的长袍、帽子和魔杖来自定义你的角色。无论你是指挥官还是魔法小丑，一切都必须靠实力获得！

name: DIRTYBLOCK
summary:
In DIRTYBLOCK, the user needs to control a small platform. It moves across the entire lower part of the game space. The platform needs to constantly hit the ball to prevent it from falling. The main purpose of the application is to destroy all the bricks.

The platform needs to constantly hit the ball to prevent it from falling. The main purpose of the application is to 

destroy all the bricks.

name: Cardopolis
summary:
Cardopolis is card based city-builder, where you take on the role of Cardopolis' Mayor. Build up your city card by card, law by law, sector by sector and avoid meeting your investors' ire by reaching your goals in time!

Welcome, Mayor ! And congratulations on obtaining this much revered position! Sadly, after your predecessor mysteriously disappeared, it is now your job to achieve greatness in Cardopolis.

Take control of the city!

As Mayor of Cardopolis, you will be given full authority to control both the design and laws of the city. 

Reach the expected population goals!

Your investors expect a lot from you, and they are especially interested in you reaching the Population target of each sector. Be careful though! If you fail to reach it, you might join your missing predecessor!

Features

Design a city with an ever growing population, sector by sector!

Find and use up to 50 different Legislation Cards!

Use up to 150 Building Cards to populate your city!

Play with 5 completely different themed Building Decks!

Completed your city? Enjoy the endless mode and build the biggest city you can!

name: WAR OPERATION™ : Full Contact
summary:
2003年4月，伊拉克，美军与伊军激烈冲突之中，选择你的职业和武器，穿越巴格达街头，接近停留在萨达姆时代的费尔多斯广场，享受前所未有、沉浸感十足的独特战斗体验

早期测试资格

The first version of Early Access sends you straight back to April 2003, in the heart of Iraq, in the midst of a frighteningly intense confrontation. Scoot around the streets of Baghdad, near Firdos Square, frozen in the days of Saddam Hussein's regime. A unique and exceptional experience never seen before.

2003年4月，伊拉克 —— 美国及其盟友发动了“伊拉克自由行动”，声称目的是消除大规模杀伤性武器并推翻该国的独裁者。在毁灭性的“9·11”袭击之后，美国总统乔治·W·布什誓言要对他所谓的“邪恶轴心”进行历史性的报复。

从战火中的巴格达街头，到托拉博拉崎岖的山脉，WAR OPERATION™：全面交火将你带入现代战争最激烈的战场中心。

对巴格达历史悠久的费尔多斯广场以及其他重要地点的博物馆级还原，将为你带来一场前所未有、沉浸感十足的体验。

加入战斗

WAR OPERATION™：全面交火在其首个抢先体验版本中，提供多种16对16模式：团队死斗、区域占领、救援任务和推倒雕像模式。游戏场景设定在震撼真实的现代环境中，呈现出紧张刺激的第三人称射击体验

立刻加入愿望单！

name: Chucky: The Road To Heaven
summary:
Chucky:TRTH is a 3D, action-adventure, jumping puzzle game. You a cute demon trying to reach heaven all the way from hell. Travel through many different locations, filled with monsters, puzzles, traps, hidden objects etc. Will you reach your goal or fail? That is for you to find out.

Take the roll of Chucky, and help him find his way to heaven all the way from hell.

Chucky is a happy demon, who don't feel like he fit in. Chucky gets the opportunity to flee from hell and try to reach heaven. This is however not an easy journey. Avoid traps, fight off monsters, solve puzzles, discover hidden areas, but make sure to enjoy every step you take in this beautiful world filled with different areas.

On your travel you will counter different puzzles and riddles, that will let you continue your journy, or even open secret areas.
Find and Collect Good and Evil Essence.

name: 动武林
summary:
《动武林》是一款自由动作武侠游戏，玩家将扮演时空管理局的特派武者，穿梭古今修复破碎的时空。2045年量子实验引发时空错乱，各朝代武林高手齐聚现代。游戏采用全自由战斗系统，赋予玩家武器操控权，挑战不同时代的敌人，体验一招定乾坤的武侠对决。

《动武林》—— 古今穿梭武侠动作游戏

【世界观：破碎的时空，交错的武林】

■游戏内容

这是一款以武林为题的动作战斗游戏,玩家化身为武林人士,挑战不同的敌人,并提升自己的能力.

■故事简介

"时空裂隙现，古今武者聚；一招定乾坤，万界归一途。"

2045年，量子实验意外撕裂时空，导致各朝武林重叠于现代。你身为"时空管理局"特派武者，需穿梭不同时代.挑战不同的敌人,修复时空。

■游戏特色

[动・武林] 采用全自由战斗控制系统，将武器操控权完全交还玩家！

• 创新动态格挡： 敌人的刀锋来袭？举剑横挡、侧身闪避，或借力弹反！系统即时判定武器碰撞与受力方向，格挡成功与否取决于你的反应与技巧，而非数值机率。

name: 推推炸
summary:
一款靠推石头和水果来战胜怪物的游戏，你需要非常风骚的走位来躲过怪物的追击和技能攻击。并通过合理的推动石块来消灭怪物。玩家通过按键WASD来移动和K键推石头来攻击消灭怪物。 战斗非常紧张刺激，画面可爱有趣。在轻松的画面中战斗又非常的紧张刺激。 游戏的主人公爱丽丝，误入异世界，发现所有喜欢的美食变成了会吃人的怪物。爱丽丝一边要躲避怪物的追击一边要通过自己的智慧战胜怪物并回到自己的世界。

如何移动
通过键盘WSAD来对应移动的上下左右，点击后角色会对应的移动，当移动一格后会停止，如果你依然点击着对应方位的移动键，角色会继续移动而不会停下来。
如何战胜怪物
通过推地图中的方形石块和水果是主要的攻击手段，也可以在变成婴儿状态使用尿不湿炸弹来消灭怪物，地图中也有一些火龙果也有炸弹的效果同样可以消灭怪物，注意有些特殊的怪物是无法通过推石块和水果来消灭的，但是尿不湿炸弹却是都有效的。当玩家被怪物接触到则玩家失败。一关卡可以通过生命力药水复活一次。
如何过关
每个关卡都有的特定的要求，要求显示在左上角，要求显示消灭怪物的数量和销毁水果的数量，同样会显示当前完成的数量。再越短的时间完成任务就可以获得越高的通关评价。
游戏水果道具等
为了玩家能更轻松的通过关卡，游戏中有水果道具可以使用，道具的作用为一些减速怪物，眩晕怪物，甚至直接消灭怪物等。最重要的是游戏中被怪物靠近会死亡，但是可以使用复活（需要使用生命力药水5点）
如何获得道具水果
大部分的水果道具来自商店购买，但当你完成一些成就，可以获得成就系统的奖励，也是可以获得少量的水果道具的。也包括生命力药水。
如何获得金币
通过关卡中消灭各种美食怪物，可以获得金币，注意当关卡得分越高获得的金币也会越多，当一个石块碾压多怪物的时候，积分会翻倍
此版本获得的游戏内容
此版本可以获得50关卡的游戏内容，玩家可以通过游戏获得金币，购买游戏道具。

name: Agent 01
summary:
Laura, the daughter of a renowned businessman, hires Markz to rescue her father from a kidnapping. Markz then discovers the captivity location and devises a strategy to safely rescue the businessman.

In Agent 01 you will live a story with action, controlling Markz. The protagonist will go into captivity. The captivity will be surrounded by criminals. Markz will be able to use several places to pass without being seen, thus allowing him to complete the game in a sneaky way. You can play in first person, and you will have a medium-range weapon and a pistol as work tools, to help you in the main objective. All this with a lot of action, which when combined with strategy, makes everything perfect.
The game takes place in a rural area, where you can explore the entire area and you have to fulfill some objectives to complete it. You will have a medium-range weapon and a pistol as work tools. You will have to face an area full of armed men.

Michael, a famous businessman, very rich, is kidnapped by a gang that asks for millions of dollars for his ransom. Laura, his daughter, not willing to pay the amount demanded by the kidnappers, meets Markz, a former secret service agent, very skilled in combat. Then, Laura hires Markz to rescue her father and get Michael out of captivity safely.
Markz, after a few days, finds the location of the kidnapping, through tracking a call, and now has the difficult mission of rescuing Laura's father, from a place surrounded by bandits, in the middle of a thicket.

Will you be able to rescue Michael and bring him safely back to his family? Find out in Agent 01.

summary:
A simple yet challenging geometric puzzle game

Duline is a pure and simple logic game, expressing unexpected complexity through its level design.

31 unique levels. The game is quite challenging so be prepared.

Rules:

You can place blue or orange blocks anywhere except white tiles.

The goal is to cover all the green tiles on the board with the least 'chains' used.

name: No Creeps Were Harmed TD
summary:
在一个扭曲、超立体、令人心神迷乱的领域里，运用各式致命的炮塔、陷阱和各式装置来抵御逐渐进化的怪物！在不断升级、增强防御中一步步地成为迷宫大师并收集奇特的神器。当你希望藉由急速击杀怪物以获取丰厚的奖励时，要小心阴沟里翻船！

五花八门的炮塔
解锁、建造、修改和升级各种特殊炮塔和建筑物。远距离的迫击炮和狙击炮可以带来毁灭性的打击。将战场围成一个绞肉机迷宫。用榴弹炮和霰弹炮将怪物粉碎。用加速器和魔法炮塔来减缓怪物的速度。用雷射炮、火焰涡轮等武器炸毁你的敌人！

无所不在的怪物
忘记你对塔防游戏的既有认知。在这里，怪物的存在就是为了打破你的先入为主。建造了长长的走廊？运送者会瞬间从中传送，轻易地越过你那些美丽的炮塔！建立了完美的集火点？融合者将结合成超强大的怪物，给你带来无法抵挡的力量！更别提还有具有隐形能力、适应性装甲、泡泡护盾或能够制造更多怪物的怪物！看着自杀式的爆破者和残暴者摧毁你的炮塔，将你的堡垒变成一片废墟。 

三维思考
进入一个奇异的空间，到处都是用桥梁或平台缝合的破碎行星，形成了令人费解的样貌。无论要从上方、下方、墙上，甚至天花板上打小兵都可行！重力在此并非一定。 

射击！
每颗子弹、炸弹、光束和爆能枪都在此三维空间中射击！炮塔需要视线才能开火，所以在炮塔前面的人蹲下！迫击炮能将炮弹随意射出很远的距离。溅射枪则将子弹射的到处都是。狙击炮塔则躲在后方射击。黑洞炸弹做……黑洞做的事。 

不入虎穴焉得虎子
如果您觉得自己够强悍，可以通过加速来加快产怪速度。加速产出的怪物会奖励您更多资源，您可以使用这些资源建造更多炮塔并应付更多加速产出的怪物！但若怪物产生的太快太多，小心你被自己的贪婪毁灭。

开始战斗吧！
您可能没有思考就在游玩，但这不是偷懒的借口。把你想象成一个移动的超级炮塔！随时战略性地重新定位自己。升级自己和个人武器。召唤毁灭性的特殊能力，例如种族灭绝空袭，或漩涡炸弹以吸走小兵。 通过修理、调整和最小化您的炮塔来照料您的死亡迷宫。

你的朋友厉害吗？
与你的朋友(即将成为前朋友)的合作游戏。在他们为了几个信用点卖掉你最喜欢的炮塔后，发誓再也不和他们说话。又或是无力地尝试与另一个人建立一个复杂的迷宫。享受把朋友拖下水浪费一整个下午的机会。
无穷的神器
随着越来越上手，您可能会发现一些可以扭曲物理定律的奇怪神器。 每件神器都是独一无二且永久的。神器可以影响的范围从从信用点收入率、装甲、子弹速度甚至是爆炸力！您表现得越好，您获得的神器就越强大。 在无尽模式下游玩任何地图，赢取威力无穷的神器！您的力量仅受有限神器槽的限制，但别担心，多的神器有储存空间可以放。

OctaRace is an explosive racing video game, it pays tribute to the good old multiplayer titles like MicroMachines, offering fun and intense races.

name: The Conqueror of Battles
summary:
Be ready to join epic multiplayer battles PVP or PVE. Create your team of heroes and improve them to annihilate your enemies and win battles. Discover also a unique and exciting progression system. Join the arena now!

About This Game
Be ready to join epic multiplayer battles PVP or PVE. Create your team of heroes and improve them to annihilate your enemies and win battles. Discover also a unique and exciting progression system. Join the arena now!
PREPARING FOR BATTLE
Before starting the fight, you must select 3 characters who will fight for you, they differ by their spells, their cards and their attack range. These differences allow you to create many associations between the characters and define your gameplay.
THE BATTLE
The goal is to eliminate all the enemy characters and the boss. When all the enemy characters are dead, the boss appears, your goal is to deal him the most damage to kill him.
THE ITEMS
The items allow you to increase the power of your characters, you get them after the battles or against gold from the store. Gold is obtained after the battles as a reward. You are limited to 6 items per character. You can increase many characteristics and create your gameplay. You can also improve items to make them even more powerful.

After the rescue mission of Grandpa Jenz was accomplished, Emiko decided to join Anzu, the niece of Grandpa Jenz as well as the daughter of one of the members of the Tri-Demon boys group. Anzu shared her story with her and they together decided to start their journey for Simon village. Emiko, being a temporary member of the Tri-Demon girls team, decided to help her out with the mission. During their journey through the Ettaze ruins and the Zanzoi forest, they came to know about The Penta-Demon tribe who infiltrated into the territory with the mission of destroying the Ettaze state. Meanwhile, Eiko, the second member of the Tri-Demon girls team, appeared in the scene when they reached the Simon village. But during the exploration, Emiko got separated from Anzu and Eiko and ended up in the Oclatus cave alone where she came across the third formidable member of the Penta-Demon tribe unexpectedly. 

You play as Emiko and will you be able to exit the cave alive and reunite with the members of Tri-Demon girls team? Her fate is in your hands now.

name: Car Quest Deluxe
summary:
Hit the road to epic adventure in Car Quest Deluxe: drive, collect, explore, solve, discover.

GET YOUR CUSTOM PLATE!

Can you find all the golden wheels and unlock the "Unlimited Rocket" car? Everyone who does gets a custom in-game license plate with your world ranking. Will you be #1?!

Hit the road to epic adventure in Car Quest Deluxe: drive, collect, explore, solve, discover.

Buckle-up for an epic road trip through a colorful world of puzzles and adventure. Use driving skills and puzzle solving abilities to find missing artifacts and piece together the broken world of Blocktaria.

DRIVE everywhere: it's like your favorite kart racing and platforming puzzle adventure game all wrapped up into one.

COLLECT batteries to unlock portals.

FIND 100+ artifacts to unlock new realms and paths on the road to discovery.

EXPLORE more than 15 unique visually striking realms.

SOLVE physical puzzles, push obstructions, jump off ramps, or skillfully navigate challenging mazes.

DISCOVER the secrets of Blocktaria and recover the lost memories of your helpful but very forgetful guide, Lord Blockstar. What is his story? What secrets will be revealed?

Featuring:

- No damage, no time limits
- Intriguing story to discover
- Soothing visuals and soundtrack

name: Ubel
summary:
A visual novel where eight participants are forced to play a death game where they have to vote every two hours. Who will survive? Who will betray? Who are the masterminds behind it all?

Ubel is a mystery/thriller/sci-fi Visual Novel Game. The game follows Player, who wakes up in his cell without his memory. The occasional flashbacks he's having do more harm than good in the grim state of affairs. The facility contains many rooms filled with puzzles, which he and the others must solve to get more information about their whereabouts.

The gameplay consists of three different elements. In the regular visual novel section, the player reads dialogue and occasionally inputs choices that can change the course of the story. Basically, what you would expect from a visual novel game. But there's more!

In Ubel, it's possible to roam around the facility by choosing a direction on the background. What are the others up to? Search for them and talk to them! Events will be triggered when the player finds himself at the right place at the right time. But be careful... Don't get yourself stuck in a room!

In the escape room section, the player tries to find a way out by exploring and solving a sequence of puzzles and mini games in the room. Hurry up and get out before the voting starts!

好好教训一顿失控机器人！

简单操作。移动、跳跃、近身攻击、射击、冲刺

name: No More Fathers
summary:
展开一场高空冒险，探索神秘的岛屿，解开谜题。在云端之上，你将面对黑暗的灵魂、隐藏的洞穴、拥有故事的人们，以及一个寻求父爱真相的男孩，他的旅途由古老的风引领。

《无父之旅》（No More Fathers）是一款冒险游戏，讲述一个男孩的旅程，他将探索世界、飞翔、解谜、帮助他人，并最终寻找真相。

翱翔

学习新的技能和长笛乐曲，在风的陪伴下自由飞翔，展开一场奇幻的冒险！

帮助他人

揭开浮空岛屿的过去……同时，也揭示你自己的身世。

探索与解谜

踏足被黑暗侵蚀的森林和失落的岛屿，解开谜题，帮助恢复风的力量，让岛屿重新焕发生机。

追随神秘而古老的风，踏上一场充满魔力的旅程，寻找关于父亲的真相。旅途不仅会让你直面自己的过去，还将改变自己与浮空岛上的人们，即使有些村民可能并不认同你的选择。

name: Crazyness: Weird Village
summary:
第一人称, 动作, 射击, 悬疑, 解谜

《Crazyness: Weird Village》是一款第一人称游戏，您将在其中扮演雅各布。

雅各布是圣曼努埃尔市一家俱乐部的运动射手和射击教练。

他习惯参加射击比赛和锦标赛，过着平静的生活……直到与米莉结婚后，这对夫妇决定搬到一个更安静、更偏僻的地方。

他们没想到，这次搬家可能会让他们丧命。不久，雅各布和米莉将发现，他们的新家可能并不像看上去那样宁静。
