A VR action-adventure 3D platformer in the spirit of the N64 era. Run, leap, dive, and climb through a rich, colorful world. Collect items and discover unique abilities that expand your movement and exploration.

To And Fro

To And Fro is a vibrant VR action-adventure 3D platformer where you navigate a colorful world filled with challenges to overcome and pathways to discover.

Guide the hero Joe, a miniature man who could fit in the palm of your hand! He happily tends to life inside his lush terrarium, never suspecting that his vibrant world is only a clever illusion. To Joe, the painted walls are the edge of reality itself, but clues and evidence abound that there is something more. Join him on a spirited journey to uncover what lies beyond and help him find a way out.

A Miniature World, Full of Life

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric quest, featuring impressionistic, low-poly graphics reminiscent of the N64 era.

Discover the unparalleled depth and immersion that only VR can offer, allowing you to effortlessly gauge distance, dodge and fight enemies, maneuver around obstacles, and hop between platforms with pinpoint accuracy.

Throughout your adventure, collect and master eight unique power-up abilities that grant new ways to move, explore, and interact with the world. Each ability is integral to progressing through the environment and uncovering hidden pathways.

Unlike a joystick limited to two-dimensional input, the tracked 3D position of the controller enables true three-axis movement, letting you physically shift your perspective in all directions anywhere around the world.

name: Blocknator
summary:
In this game, your objective is to fit the pieces on the board to accumulate points. When you complete one or more floors, the pieces are destroyed and you earn points. It’s that simple!

Welcome to Blocknator, a simple, colorful and challenging game!

Blocknator is a game of building blocks and accumulating points.

When you complete one or more floors, the pieces are destroyed and you earn points.

It’s that simple!

There are five game modes and three different boards for you to choose and play.

modes:

Practice: The mode for you to learn or play quietly.

Competitive: Time is not your friend! Put the pieces on the board before it's too late!

Time Attack: Score as many points as possible in three minutes of play.

Teacher: You need to think fast and have a good memory! In this mode the parts are visible for a short time.

Time Attack + Master: Score the most points in three minutes. Watch out! The parts will be visible for a short time.

Test each mode on different boards and find out which one you are the best at!

name: JellyMen
summary:
果冻人是一款本地分屏即时射击游戏，目前支持最多4人同屏竞技，拥有众多游戏模式，利用大量武器射击、爆炸打击你的敌人，同时避免环境危害和可破坏地形，通过将你的对手撞到水中或炸断他们的果冻四肢来取胜。

果冻人（JellyMan）是一款本地分屏即使对战射击游戏，其拥有许多玩法与模式，通过击飞肢解其他果冻人活动胜利，游戏目前注重于本地分屏所以此，游戏对于派对活动时与好友的即时竞技是一个不二之选，游戏里拥有大量的武器，包括各种枪支，陷阱武器，近战武器，和不同增强物品，游戏还拥有完善的物理，破坏，已经布偶系统，您可以击碎冰面使得其他玩家掉出平台或者使用大锤击飞其他玩家，利用各种武器击碎其他果冻人，让他们肢体横飞，果冻四溅，在疯狂的爆炸和欢笑中与好友度过快乐的时光！

目前游戏拥有四种模式，果冻人大战，果冻竞赛，夺旗，炽热土豆。
果冻人大战模式：平台上会有大量的武器掉落利用这些武器击飞或者击碎其他果冻人，最后站立在平台上的果冻人胜出。
果冻竞赛：会有少量武器，果冻人需要通过大量的障碍物第一个到达终点的果冻人胜出。
夺旗：有大量武器掉落且果冻人可以无限复活，第一个拿到旗子送回终点的果冻人胜出。
炽热土豆：游戏开始时随机一名玩家会携带土豆，土豆会在一段时间内爆炸，在爆炸前通过近战将土豆传给其他果冻人，最后活着的果冻人胜出。
每种模式都拥有其独特玩法，总会有一种满足您的胃口。

果冻人拥有很多有趣的皮肤，您可以根据您的喜好搭配出属于自己的果冻人。

目前游戏支持最多4人同屏竞技

果冻人拥有许多有趣的物理效果包括，破坏，冲击，击退，打击，肢解，布偶，这些效果为游戏带来了极大的乐趣，不时会让玩家捧腹大笑。
社区与讨论
您可以加入我们QQ社区：691059065

您可以提供意见帮助我们改进我们的游戏，甚至可以要求我们为您定做专属皮肤。
我们目前正在考虑制作线上模式如果我们建立了足够庞大的社区。

杰克·怀廷侦探在他试图揭露的凶手手下失去家人后，被绑架并锁在一个充满令人痛心的谜题、令人心碎的决定和地狱般的牺牲的地下室。生存需要付出巨大的代价。

睁开眼睛，杰克。

1965 年，一连串谋杀和绑架事件席卷了小镇雷隆。似乎警方无能为力，因为凶手总是比他们领先两步，直到最后，他绑架了他们自己的一个人，杰克怀廷。杰克最近在一场车祸中失去了他的妻子和女儿，他必须利用他在 Relon 作为一名侦探所学到的一切，以及他在战争中的所有经验来逃离令人痛苦的地下室的谜题和恐怖。

是时候把事情看清楚了

一个看似精神错乱的撒旦门徒给杰克留下了离家太近的线索和物品，看起来你是最后的受害者，到目前为止一切都只是开场白。即使你能活下来，一切都不会是一样的。

name: Z-STOP
summary:
You are the last human, abandoned on a zombie infested island. There’s only one thing you must do, escape alive. Scavenge through what remains to acquire weapons and tools to help along the way. Outrun the horde, stay inside at night and discover what horrors led to the island’s downfall.

Looting and Scavenging
Lucky for you, the population was heavily armed. Weapons and useful tools can be commonly found. However, if you're looking for something better, there are plenty of high-risk/high-reward locations including; A Supermarket, A School, A Gas Station, A Water Treatment Plant, A Power Plant and many more.

Day-Night Cycle
Make sure to keep an eye on the light. As darkness falls the island becomes ravaged by the hordes of the night. Stay inside where light is plentiful. Vision is important, it’s suicide to try to make it outside blind.

The Horde
Time is always ticking. A massive horde of infected is on your trail. Stay in one place too long and they will arrive.

Military checkpoints
The D.O.D in an attempt to contain the infected and help survivors escape set up checkpoints and quarantine zones. Make your way through these zones to get to the bridge and escape.

The Titans
The D.O.D lost control because of other factors besides the infected. Fear the Desecrator, Fear The Despoiler and Fear The Hive.

The Factions
Explore what remains of the factions. The D.O.D’s failed attempts to maintain order, the Bandit’s attempt to make a new order, or the mysterious S.L.A.Y organization and their actions.

Gladiator mode
Test your combat skills in a close quarters, cover-less, post-apocalyptic gladiatorial arena against wave after wave of infected along with other human gladiators.

name: CyberScope
summary:
CyberScope is a hybrid first-person shooter and puzzle platformer where you create, code, jump, and hack your way to defeat the rogue AI who is planning to eliminate humanity. Will you stop the rogue AI? Or will you join their ranks?

*Want to play CyberScope down the road? Add it to your wishlist today!!*

Your Identity; An AI created by your overlords, the Concil, with the ability to hack drones, create platforms, and battle your way through a cybernetic world.

Your Mission: Find the source code snippet at the end of each level and move closer toward the rogue AI who's overtaken his creator--and now plans to overtake humanity itself.

Your Options: Succeed... or die.

name: Jewel Match Origins 2 - Bavarian Palace Collector's Edition
summary:
Travel back in time to the Romantic Era and build a magnificent castle in this royal match-3 adventure! Explore 200 huge levels and collect resources to construct a majestic palace for the Bavarian King. Enjoy 3 different modes: timed, relaxed, and moves limited!

Travel back in time to the Romantic Era and build a magnificent castle in this royal match-3 adventure! Explore huge levels and collect resources to help architect Daniel van Arras build a majestic palace for the Bavarian King. Enjoy an ethereal soundtrack as you discover new power-ups and explore each level for hidden stars that unlock special decorations. Visit the shop to explore the myriad items available for purchase to assist Daniel in his quest to construct the kingly monument.

Features:

- Explore 200 huge levels!

- 60 additional bonus levels with new game features!

- 3 different playmodes: timed, relaxed, and moves limited!

- 3 difficulty settings: normal, advanced and insane.

- Construct a majestic palace and design its rooms.

- Buy dozens of upgrades and power-ups from the shop.

- Replayable mini-games games, including jigsaw puzzles and hidden object scenes.

- Beautiful wallpapers.

- Ethereal soundtrack.

name: Dreamsettler
summary:
梦境寐网系统作为新式睡眠联网系统，令你在睡眠期间可以安全联网。我们第二代硬件不仅能够提供最快的睡眠联网体验，同时配有“梦界网页设计工具”！打造属于自己的梦境分区，体验前所未有的乐趣！

梦境寐网系统作为新式睡眠联网系统，令你在睡眠期间可以安全联网。我们第二代硬件不仅能够提供最快的睡眠联网体验，所有系统事先均已安装“梦界网页设计工具”！打造属于自己的梦境分区，体验前所未有的乐趣！

《梦界索隐》是一款21世纪初期互联网模拟游戏，你会遇到形形色色奇怪的角色，需要帮他们解决问题，从而成为寐网最优秀（而且唯一？）的私家侦探。你可能需要寻找汤料食谱，也可能需要揭破牵涉全球的惊天阴谋，同时可以探索一个细节丰富的平行世界。

数字侦探：帮助寐网的网民找到他们需要的文档和链接，就能赚到Z。

改变剧情走向：只让某些客户看到你想给他们看的资料，即可改变这里的未来。

设计你自己的网页：可以用“网页精灵”快速配置网页，也可以用拖放操作形式的“梦界网页设计工具”完全自行设计。不要随便发布内容，大家都在看着喔！

改造时间：随心配置完全实现的梦境寐网系统的操作系统，尽情享受海量原创音乐、动画、游戏等各种内容。

name: What The Coffin
summary:
In What The Coffin, you and a friend face the wildest challenge: hauling a wobbly corpse through a chaotic world of physics-based obstacles! It’s all about coffin-cooperation. If you drop it, you're both going six feet under! Can your friendship survive the madness?

What The Coffin is currently in development, and we’re hard at work making it the wobbliest, most chaotic co-op experience possible! Everything you see is a work in progress and subject to change as we fine-tune the physics, levels, and sheer ridiculousness. Stay tuned for updates as we bring this coffin-carrying adventure to life!

Deliver Kevin To Heaven!

What The Coffin follows the ridiculous journey of Kevin ... who is very much un-alive ... as you and a friend attempt to deliver his coffin to heaven. Working together, you’ll each hold one end of the casket while navigating wild obstacles, tricky climbs, and even discovering hidden gems along the way. Just try not to drop Kevin… he’s been through enough!

Customisable Chaos!

Along the way, you’ll unlock a variety of cosmetics to customise your characters, all earned through gameplay, including:

Hats ? – From classy to downright ridiculous!

Tops ? – Dress up or dress questionably!

Trousers ? – Because running around in just a top would be weird…

Full Outfits ? – Go all out with themed sets!

Earn your style as you stumble towards the afterlife!

Coffin-Carrying Champions!

Think you’ve got what it takes to be the best undertaker in the business? Compete with friends and players worldwide on the leaderboards! Race against the clock, keep your coffin steady, and prove you're the ultimate coffin-carrying duo.

Fastest Times ⏱️ – Who can ascend to the top the quickest?

Flawless Runs ? – Less stumbling, more style!

Hidden Collectibles ? – Discover secrets and climb the ranks.

Will you carry Kevin with grace, or will your journey end in disaster? The leaderboards will decide!

name: Manly Mines
summary:
1-4玩家健身合作生存恐怖游戏。收集战利品以换取食物和补充剂，以增强实力，挑战强大的测试门。

《男子矿山》是一款4人在线合作的心理恐怖游戏。你的主要目标是增强实力，以面对矿山中日益困难的测试门。这些门是进步的标志，每一个都需要更高层次的力量和准备来克服。

最终目标？在矿山的许多挑战中生存下来，成为力量和韧性的典范。

合作游戏
《男子矿山》从底层设计为合作游戏，要求玩家共同计划、收集资源并面对等待着的恐怖。沟通和策略是你生存的最佳工具。
力量与生存
与传统生存游戏不同，你的进步不仅仅通过你收集的资源来衡量，还有你发展的体力。通过举重、搬运和生存来增强肌肉，每个玩家的体型直接影响他们面对游戏挑战的能力。
程序生成
没有两次探险是相同的。矿山的布局、资源放置和潜伏的危险每次游玩时都会改变，要求适应性并鼓励重复游玩。
测试门
这些强大的障碍考验你的团队力量和资源利用能力。只有通过集合你们的集体力量和智慧，你们才希望克服它们并解锁更深、更危险的矿山部分。

Placidie, a young woman in her twenties, is living in a small settlement where its inhabitants harvest and breed the local fauna.

name: Pogan
summary:
Embark on a journey to bring peace to Wyraj in this Slavic mythology-inspired adventure. Explore endless, generated lands as you strive for victory over powerful gods and demons. Alone or with friends, embrace the unknown yet to come.

Waking up in the Sacred Grove, you realize there is little time to waste. With gods and demons roaming freely and peace to the world disturbed, you have to do anything in your might to restore order to your homeland. Set out on an adventure that is about to decide on the fate of Wyraj.

THE WORLD IS WAITING

Swing right into the action in an procedural generated world of Pogan, where every nook and cranny has a story to tell. Day and night, progress in your adventure while on a constant lookout for undiscovered territories. Prove your strength in combat, deal with hordes of enemies, and conquer new lands.

MARK YOUR TERRITORY

To experience rare, peaceful moments in the wicked world where danger lurks in every corner, you will be able to use your equipment to set up countless bases. Given you successfully conquered enemies’ territories, you might even settle down for a while, building villages filled with various structures beneficial to your growth and journey.

IT’S YOU VS THEM

The world you explore is filled with mythological creatures that won’t always act in your favor. If powerful gods and demons stand in your way, will you be able to conquer them all and victoriously move forward?

KEY FEATURES

- Play single or multiplayer up to 50 players via user hosted servers
- Travel the procedurally generated worlds full of mysterious places to reveal and conquer
- Explore the secrets of crafting by acquiring unique items with special properties allowing you to upgrade weapons, clothes and other props
- Develop your fighting skills by deciding which combat style you want to broaden with the advanced abilities leveling system
- Tame animals and grow plants, use them to cook better dishes for you and your friends

You can perform realistic magic chanting using the voice recognition system, attack with weapons, and perform any other free actions.
You will indeed feel the possibility of a new type of game.

The distributed scenarios are online multiplayer for up to 5 players (4 players and one game master).
All players except the game master participate via VR.

We are including an introductory fantasy scenario called “Dragon Descendants.”
We hope you will experience the fun of Xpraize through this scenario first.
The additional scenarios will be updated regularly after the game’s release and distributed as DLC.

The “Game Master” version is offered free of charge, so you can discuss it with your friends and decide who will be the Game Master before you start playing.
Or you can go into a game and find a Game Master looking for players to play together.

"Xpraize Beta for GameMaster"

name: A Weekend in Puzzleburg
summary:
A Weekend in Puzzleburg is a cozy slice-of-life role-playing game with over 180,000 ways your weekend vacation can play out. No need to fight monsters or save the world from impending doom - you've merely booked a relaxing weekend getaway in a quaint resort town. Welcome to Puzzleburg!

All around town, each person needs your help with something, if you can first puzzle out what item they need and where to find that item. So in between reading a book, taking a selfie of the town's welcome sign, or any other vacation activity you get up to, see how many random acts of kindness you can fit in. Because you can take a break from your workaday life, but one should never take a break from being kind to others.

With A Weekend in Puzzleburg, you're not buying a video game - you're buying a whole vacation. One that you can play over and over again whenever you want, getting new experiences each time. All that for under $20

"Open-Town" Rather Than "Open-World"

Experience an "open-world" game set in a cozy resort town. Get to know the townspeople, and you'll soon find your way around like a local

Experience The Joys of Traveling

A new town means a new you. Define your character's backstory, get your hair dyed a crazy color, or even get a hint from the hotel concierge if you ever get stuck on a puzzle. Anything goes while on vacation

Simple Controls, Complex Characters

Immerse yourself in deep, character-driven quest lines that rely on brainpower, not how fast you can press buttons. Supports controllers or keyboard + mouse, or if you want a point-and-click adventure game feel, try going mouse-only

Short and Sweet

The free demo is about 30 minutes, and the full game is about 2-4 hours fo

name: Crusader: Dungeon Series
summary:
Crusader: Dungeon Series Dungeon of Dagginor is the first in the series and is a simple dungeon crawler.

This game is my first deep dive into game development. I am a solo developer that has dreamt of creating games since I was 12. So I wanted to pay tribute to the very first game I owned as a child, but also creating something of my own. The first game I owned as a child was for the Tandy Color Computer 2 called Dungeons of Daggorath. It was a very basic dungeon crawler with simple line graphics. Crusader: Dungeon Series - Dungeon of Dagginor is the first in a series of add-ons.

Game Play:
Movement is done via WSAD (Forward, Backward, Left, Right) with Mouse Button 1 as Primary attack, Mouse Button 2 as Block, and Q, E, R as secondary abilities. The game starts in a small village outside a castle (where the entrance to the dungeon is located. The player will start here at the beginning of each session, but will enter the dungeon on the first uncompleted level

Player will be able to advance skills/abilities via Gems gained by killing monsters in the dungeon. There are 3 styles of weapons for use (Weapon/Shield, Two-Handed, Dual-Wield).

Tutorial:
There is a tutorial level that explains the basic game play, however, this level is intended to be played once.

Story:
The Prince of the Keep of Dagginor has been down in the dungeons mastering dark magics and summoning fowl creatures from dark planes. One such creature turned against his summoner killing him and taking over the dungeons. This creature is a powerful demon called Raijin Master of Storms. The villagers have fled to safety in the mountains and the King has hired you to rid his dungeon of these fowl monsters.

name: 隐秘任务
summary:
你刚刚结束一次秘密任务，但是你所属的总部发生了事故。你现在作为一个经验丰富的特工，将解决总部出现的泄露危机。在这里你将遇到各种敌人，他们可能蠢笨，但有些也异常狡猾。那么，祝你好运，特工。

加入DLSS

本游戏现在已经加入英伟达DLSS技术，您可以在“游戏设置”里调节DLSS，让您的游戏体验更进一步。

《隐秘任务》是一款由个人制作的独立的第三人称射击游戏。该游戏剧情紧凑，难度适中。非常适合所有喜爱独立游戏和射击游戏的玩家。
该游戏虽然是个人制作的独立游戏，但相关功能完善，且运用了面部捕捉技术，以及Metahuman以及虚幻引擎对于演出的强有力的加持使得游戏的CG更加出色。
游戏背景
本作背景发生在近未来，某超政府秘密机构-UNBSEPA因为对未知外星科技研究不足而导致意外事故，造成外星种族小规模入侵。玩家扮演的该机构的特工将消除事故所带来的危险。你将有足够弹药面对不同的敌人，记住，有些敌人非常狡猾，他们知道躲避在阴影中。
游戏场景
本作游戏场景大体可分为5大区域，分别是“办公区”，该区域是文职人员办公区域。通常是档案管理，作战部署和会议区域。由一条秘密地铁线负责所有人员的进出。
第二个区域是“科研区”，该区域是逆转工程区域，将外星科技转换为地球文明可应用的科技。
第三个区域是“实验区”，该区域是对于某些非正常文明发现进行研究的区域。
第四个区域是“武器研制区”，该区域是研发可应用于生成的武器装备，以便应对突发灾难。
第五个区域是“核心研究区”，该区域埋藏了一个秘密，玩家在最后将亲自发掘。
你遇到的敌人
第一手资料显示，这次泄露事故中出现四种不同的外星种族。有两种没什么太高的智商，而后面两种非常聪明。它们制作躲避你的追踪。

name: Pixel Petkeeper
summary:
A pet-collecting battle game with light RPG mechanics. Enter dungeons to battle, tame pets, collect treasure, and unlock new areas in this pixel art indie game

A pet-collecting battle game with light RPG mechanics. Enter dungeons and fight creatures, tame pets, and collect items along the way. Raise your rank and collect prizes in the arena to unlock new areas
Enter Dungeons

Select the path you want to take in a dungeon by choosing which room to enter. Some rooms have obstacles, treasure, travelling merchants, fields, and more.
In battle rooms, fight creatures using an autobattling system or use your pets' skills in real time. Encounter treasure rooms where you can collect loot: money, gems, or items to aid in your travels. Come across obstacle rooms that test your pets' stat points, and possibly get some useful perks when they succeed. Special rooms may also come up with healing fountains, traders that have discounted items, or gamblers inviting you to a minigame.
Train Your Pets

Use the training room to increase your pets' stat points. You can also use the clinic to recover their HP if they are injured. Participate in the arena to gain experience and rank up to enter new areas, or go for prize competitions that offer cash and items! As pets gain experience through dungeons and arena participation, they gain new skills that you can choose for them to use. Elemental pets can have special elemental skills that can prove useful for higher level dungeons!
Specialized Pets

Your pets can die T_T But you can use the Laboratory to temporarily freeze or even merge them with other pets!
The Laboratory is also the place to create artifacts. Artifacts can select specific parts of pets and save these characteristics for you to use on existing pets.
For example, you can take the highest stat of a dying pet and convert it into an artifact, and then transfer that stat point into a new pet to immediately get it to a higher level. You can also transfer over skills, passives, and

name: Super Spy Academy
summary:
Join Leo in Super Spy Academy! Uncover a mysterious plot at a prestigious university, solve puzzles, interact with unique characters, and explore diverse areas to save the school from a perilous fate.

Embark on a thrilling adventure filled with espionage and intrigue in Super Spy Academy, a captivating narrative-driven game set in a prestigious private university overtaken by sinister forces. As Leo, a determined freshman, players must navigate through a series of challenging puzzles and obstacles to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of his brother and the infiltration of the academy by the villainous "Super Villain Academy."

With the help of QBear, an AI companion, players will explore a rich 3D world teeming with secrets and surprises, interacting with unique characters along the way. From navigating through six diverse areas with their own distinct themes to solving over 15 puzzles scattered throughout the academy, every step taken brings players closer to unraveling the gripping mystery at the heart of Super Spy Academy.

Featuring fully voice-acted dialogue, captivating visual novel-style storytelling elements, and engaging mini-games to test your spy skills, Super Spy Academy offers an immersive gameplay experience unlike any other. Whether playing with a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad, players will find themselves immersed in a world where every clue leads closer to the truth. Dive into a world of suspense and embark on an unforgettable journey to save the academy from its perilous fate.

Key Features:

Lots of characters to interact with

Explore 6 diverse areas, each with its own theme and challenges

Solve over 15 puzzles to progress through the story

Fully voice-acted cast brings the characters to life

Experience visual novel-style storytelling elements

Navigate a rich 3D world filled with secrets

Engage in mini-games to test your spy skills

Compatible with mouse and keyboard, as well as gamepad controls

name: Tanxl
summary:
平静的日常被打破，森林深处的秘密，正将她引向命运的门前。

这是一款使用C++/OpenGL独立开发的小游戏，目前的开发工作尚未完成。游戏采用2D上帝视角，类似RPG Maker开发的游戏，玩家可以在精心构建的广阔世界中探索。

在迷雾笼罩的森林深处，19岁的林小雨日复一日地往返于学校与家之间。这个独居在森林边缘的女孩，八岁那年失去了母亲，而"远在海外工作"的父亲，只通过冰冷的邮件与她保持联系。直到某天，好友小夏在森林中发现了一扇神秘的铁门，平静的生活开始出现裂痕。

与此同时，跨国生物科技巨头Tanxl公司正在小镇进行着某项秘密计划。这个以医疗研究闻名的企业，在森林深处建立了一个不为人知的地下实验室。随着时间推移，小镇开始出现种种异常：枯萎的树木、失踪的居民、诡异的天气......而这些，似乎都与Tanxl公司有关。

当林小雨决定揭开真相时，她发现自己的命运早已与这个神秘组织纠缠在一起。在这个被封锁的小镇里，一场关乎生死的冒险即将展开......

name: logik
summary:
A minimalistic, stylized puzzle game where you have to move the striped block through a maze of cubes, out of the puzzle area. Progress through cute, colorful sections of puzzles as you try to uncover the solutions.

Solve Puzzles!

In logik, you can solve many chill & challenging puzzles of varying difficulty. Puzzles are organized into sections, each with unique color schemes. 

Puzzle Types

There are two types of puzzles that are playable: regular and slide levels. Regular levels have scenarios where the player must move the striped block out of the puzzle area. Slide levels start with the striped block being mis-aligned to the exit, allowing the player to slide the striped block, with other blocks, in line with the exit.

An Extra Challenge

If you’re looking for an extra challenge on top of the rest of the challenging puzzles, there is Challenge Mode! Challenge Mode is a way to escape the main sections and try something…well, a little more difficult

Is this game for you?

If you are unsure if this game is for you, take this quick test below!

1. Puzzle
2. Challenging
3. Chill/Relaxing
4. Stylized Graphics
5. Atmospheric

If you like some of these genres, you will probably like logik!

(Note: This game and descriptions are subject to change. Nothing is final yet.)

name: SOOT

SOOT 是一款策略模拟游戏，您可以在其中控制 Ziggurat 的地球化工作人员，这是一个环绕小行星运行并利用其资源的漫游空间站。 跟随克里斯托弗·梅森上尉和费迪南德·麦肯中尉，他们（和你）掌握了地球化改造的艺术。

The world has lost its balance and a great danger looms humanity with the impending destruction of a cataclysmic event. The only hope resides in the technology to terraform the planet and reinstate the right conditions to avoid the tragedy.

The technology has been lost to the ages, mysticism, and superstition have taken over; but the key to the secret of terraforming lies in the hands of Laura McKenzie, a brave scientist determined to save her homeworld at all costs, and the ancient encoded manuscript that reached her hands in a fateful hour.

In SOOT the player takes control of that scientist learning about terraforming through a strategy simulation game with a delicate system of balances and counterbalances and a thrill-filled story with more than one secret about the world and the nature of the coming doom.
Each level of SOOT is a different planet, with specific conditions and a particular set of objectives.

An ancient journal falls into the hands of scientist Laura MacKenzie, with it she relives the experiences of Captain Cristopher Mason and uncovers the secrets of The Federation, a powerful and forgotten space-faring civilization that used advanced technology to terraform planets. 
SOOT features a dramatic story filled with mysteries, conflicting interests, and a complex political agenda, all while struggling with the technological challenges of two eras clashing through the pages of the journal.

Experience SOOT's story through interactive comic books and in-level dialogs.

SOOT features 17 different planets, over 20 structures, and 14 interactive comic book scenes, all of them developed with special care and attention to detail. With a unique steampunk aesthetic, complex 3D modelling, and detailed illustrations, each moment in SOOT is a beauty to behold.

 Deep thought provoking gameplay that promotes problem solving with a complex simulation syste

name: 詩與命
summary:
在一切开始之前，有一座庭园。 在一切结束之后，她仍在那里。

她见证了每一次开始，也见证了每一次终结。

从未缺席，却无人记得。

这是她的职责、她的命运、她永恒的独舞。

而她仍在等一个不会到来的结局。

《诗与命》是一部叙事驱动的 2D 探索游戏，讲述一位生灭之神在无尽轮回中的孤独旅程。

在高维空间的三座庭园之间行走、聆听、阅读。生命从一座庭园中苏醒，在另一座中诞生，又在最后一座里化为灰烬。你将随着她经历这个过程。一次，又一次，又一次。

但每一次轮回都不尽相同。

曾经被忽略的角落开始显露意义，曾经以为理解的对话在重新听见时变了味道。散落在世界各处的诗篇碎片，记载着那些被时间遗忘的声音。收集它们，你将逐渐拼凑出一个远比表面更深邃的真相。

name: 高考移民：常安转校生
summary: 《高考移民：常安转校生》是一款中式校园题材的视觉小说。你将跟随主角何为的视角体验县中高三理科实验班的真实生活。从省会重点中学转来的学霸突然成为你的同桌，性格孤傲游离于整个班级之外的她却与你有着相似的志趣，这样的她会与你碰撞出怎样的青春火花......她一直回避谈自己转学原因的理由又是什么......

name: 青鸟
summary:
跟随少年秋序，去遇见那个总是在阳光下冲刺的少女，并结识其他三位性格迥异的女孩。在市立第二中学的日常生活中，您将见证一段无法回头的青春——那是一个注定要走向某处的故事。

♢故事描述-story ♢

“少年不止热血和爱情，更多的是说不出口的执拗和愿望，以及那个急于被证明的自己。”
秋序的17年人生活得顺顺利利——顺到几乎没有形状和任何可以留得下的记忆。直到那个日复一日在操场上飞驰的少女递给他一块旧秒表。
他开始每天去操场，坐在同一级台阶上，看着她在跑道上不断地画着圈。
他开始逐渐明白一个道理：那些执拗和愿望，一旦从手中飞走，就再也不会回来。
而我们现在能做的，就是在那块秒表停掉之前，帮她数完该数的每一步。

name: 量化情绪
summary: 《量化情绪》是一款近未来科幻二次元风格的文字冒险游戏。故事发生在2036年的墟光市，可以精确衡量人类情绪指数的「量化情绪」系统已经被开发出来。「我」是一名普通的高中生，某日意外获得了查看和调节他人情绪的权限。不久后，转校后的「我」遇见失联已久的青梅竹马柔歌。柔歌对「量化情绪」有着不一样的看法，她背后似乎隐藏着系统下不为人知的秘密。而「我」的选择，或许将影响到一切的结局...... 游戏有极具特色的近未来世界观和情绪系统设定，单女主线，玩家需要通过名为“铃铛视界”的小游戏，获取其他角色的情绪查看权限和调节权限，并做出选择，导向四种不同结局（沉默线、殉道者线、行尸线和希望线）。

name: 怪奇工作介绍所
summary:
这是一款聚焦于【怪谈小说】世界里底层NPC日常的视觉小说游戏。你将扮演一家迷你工作介绍所的老板，为那些生活在K市的“背景板”角色们安排工作。游戏以单元剧的形式展开，共同描绘出一幅生动有趣的群像剧。

欢迎来到K市，一个活生生的超自然小说世界。在这里，你经营一家为拥有自我意识的NPC服务的职业介绍所。在这部充满元幽默的视觉小说合集中，做出关键选择，体验各种古怪的冒险。

关于这款游戏

踏入K市这个奇特且自我意识过剩的世界——它也被称为终点之城。这座大都市是一个超自然故事的舞台，居住着低阶NPC们，他们完全清楚自己只是故事里的角色。他们的日常挣扎不仅在于对抗困扰生活的怪异现象，还包括打零工来维持生计。

在这座光怪陆离的城市里，你扮演一家小型职业介绍所的老板。你的任务是为这些“觉醒”的居民找工作、提供支持并确保他们的安全——同时，你也会被卷入构成他们日常存在的各种奇妙事件中。你遇到的角色会不断打破第四面墙，评论自己所处的荒诞世界，为你的旅程充满元幽默。

你的对话选择和关键决定将塑造剧情走向，引向不同的故事分支和结局。游戏采用“故事合集”结构，包含五个独立的章节。每个章节都提供一个完整而令人满意的体验，时长约2.5至3小时，非常适合喜欢紧凑、精良故事的玩家。

name: 光与影之恋
summary:
“再后来，她成为了你的影子。” 一部略有些伤感的百合AVG，讲述着那些崩塌，遗憾，以及尚未说出口的爱。

《光与影之恋》是一个过于关于记忆，创伤以及爱的故事。

你将以楚鹤白的视角踏入这个正在逐渐崩塌的世界，在记忆与现实的漩涡中一步步寻回早已失去之物和尚未失去之物，并在最后，你会惊奇的发现——

“这个世界比你想象中的更温柔一些。”

== 故事内容 ==
当“我”，楚鹤白，失忆十一年后，世界早已沧海桑田。

全球都在大崩塌中摇摇欲坠，而本家的家族企业因此富裕，也因此纷争不断。而“我”，也只有“我”，旅居海外，度过了十一年的平静时光。

但这样的日子注定不能长久，直到爷爷去世的消息将“我”呼回故乡，而等待着“我”的不仅仅是亲人的离去，还有尘封已久的记忆，以及十一年都没能说完的道别。

“人人都爱楚鹤白，唯独我不认识楚鹤白。”

你将体验到
* 以文字与情绪驱动的叙事体验。
* 多结局的游戏分支。
* 精美的CG，19张差分CG

summary: The King of Ancient Armenia Vachagan fell in love with Anahit. And to gain her love he must become something more than a king.

name: 南海トラフ巨大地震 (5)
summary:
累計10万部突破の話題作!

2025年 2月11日 15時07分、「南海トラフ巨大地震」発生。
名古屋港で被災した主人公・西藤 命(さいとう めい)。

ショッピングモールに辿り着き、一時の安息を得た命。
しかし、まだ「死」の脅威は去っていない。

そのときのために知っておきたい、生死を分ける知識――。


「いままでは他人事だった震災がリアルに感じられた」
「子どもと一緒に読んで、防災のことを考えるきっかけになった」
とSNSでも話題沸騰!

綿密な取材に基づいて描かれた「いつか起こる震災のリアル」。
これは、「そのとき」が来る前に知っておかなければならない「現実」。

name: The Talos Principle III
summary:
发人深省的第一人称解谜游戏《塔罗斯法则》系列迎来了终章《塔罗斯法则 3》，带你踏上宇宙之旅，走过十数个世界，用全新的挑战考验你的思维。

你仿佛从一场纷乱的梦中醒来，发现自己身处一个奇异而矛盾的世界：神殿摇摇欲坠，科学前哨已被废弃，这里就是“异域”，物理法则在这里已经完全失效。你的记忆支离破碎，但你知道自己来此必有缘由。

你需要面对一系列愈发复杂的谜题，回想起自己的探险家身份，寻回人造世界的历史。

有人说“异域”是天堂，有人说这里是地狱。但有一件事毋庸置疑：审判在等待着你。

终极谜题
不仅可以运用熟悉的机制，还可以体验全新巧思，解决一系列棘手谜题，将游戏体验推向极致。既可以完成必要任务，也可以深入探寻“异域”的秘密以及背后的答案。

旅程的终点
在《塔罗斯法则》的故事中迈出最后一步。塔罗斯原班创作团队（约拿·基拉泽斯，维蕾娜·基拉泽斯和汤姆·朱伯特）带来了一场以角色为中心的生命、死亡与崇高之旅，邀请玩家踏上这段充满哲思的道路。

宇宙共和国
通过个人记忆的碎片，探索雄心勃勃的未来历史。从正在经历地球化改造的沙漠星球，到极乐世界的美丽花园，体验人类对遥远未来充满希望的愿景：后稀缺时代，但绝非后人类时代。

现实即音乐
欣赏出自大师级作曲家达米安·姆拉武纳茨之手的全新原创配乐，他的音乐是三部曲的灵魂所在。

あの名セリフは、かくして生まれた!

『北斗の拳』『サンクチュアリ』ほか、数々のヒット作を手がけてきた漫画原作者・武論尊。画業50年超の大ベテランは、読者の記憶に強く残るストーリー、キャラクター、セリフをどのように生み出してきたのか。

漫画家・本宮ひろ志氏との出会い、「少年ジャンプ」伝説の編集長に見出されての原作者デビュー、『ドーベルマン刑事』で培った漫画表現、代表作『北斗の拳』の誕生秘話……。波瀾万丈の原作者人生を振り返り、「武論尊流の漫画原作術」を初めて明かす。

〈『北斗の拳』の大ファン、予備校講師・林修さんの推薦コメント〉
「『悪役』が作品の成否を決める」、「キャラクターとは、セリフのことである」といった作者の明確な「哲学」にまず感心した。しかし、この書はそれにとどまらない。「原作者になりたい」という「夢を実現するための羅針盤」にはならないと宣言されているにもかかわらず、社会で成功するための知恵に満ちているのだ。たとえば、「直せばよくなると分かっている原稿に、余計なプライドは必要ない」-小さなプライドのせいで仕事がうまくいかない人がどれほど多いか。この書は、漫画原作論を超えて処世の道筋を教えてくれる。

summary:

昭和100年。高度経済成長の末、労働人口が9割を超えたニッポンは、プロレタリア星の指揮監督のもと新たな「労働憲章」の制定を急いでいた。
そんな時代の変化に抗うように、進歩的な働き方を示す「労働博覧会」パビリオンを“会獣"（＝会社の獣）が襲撃する。
出展企業の一社である「毎日商事」には、かつてサラリーマンだった男・ヤマダが転職していた。同僚のユメコと共に駆け出すヤマダ。
「ほんとは、どっちでも良かったんだ…！この国が変わろうが変わるまいが、当たり前のいつもが続けば、それで…」
悲痛な叫びに応えるように、彼の目の前に労働の巨人が飛来する。しかし、その姿は漆黒に染まっていた。
「黒い…サラリーマン」
巨人の名は、サラリーマンBLACK。
過重労働をものともしないその姿は、失われたモーレツ社員の残影なのか。何が彼を変えたのか。
その正体は、果たして──。

死に戻りの世界でルミナスとの幸せを取り戻したオリヴィア。ナージュ王国で商会長夫婦となった二人の元に祖国・ガロン王国の国王から、二人を引き裂くよう暗躍していたクヴァル帝国が再びガロン王国を狙った動きをしているということで、調査依頼の密書が届く。調査に乗り出す二人だが、クヴァル帝国の帝位継承争いに巻き込まれてしまう。そして、それは二人の死に戻りを起こした国宝「守護の短剣」にも繋がっていき……。

name: さようなら王子様、どうか私のことは忘れてください
summary:
悲恋の果てに待っていたのは、絶望に染まったあの人でした。

婚約者である王太子・ルミナスの裏切りで断罪され命を落としたオリヴィアは、気が付くと断罪前に時が戻っていた。同じ過ちは繰り返すまいと国を出て新たな人生を歩み始めるオリヴィアだが、なぜか追いかけてくるルミナス。どうやら時が戻ったことに彼が関係しているようで――。不器用な二人のやり直しラブロマンス。
